name: hansen_cograph_mahler
statement:
theorem hansen_cograph_mahler
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : IsCograph G) :
    1 ≤ mahlerRho (hansen G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mahlerRho_hansen_eq_graphRho_of_cograph G hG]

name: hansen_cograph_mahler_eq_one_iff_threshold

theorem hansen_cograph_mahler_eq_one_iff_threshold

proof:
:= by

name: HansenCograph.hansen_cograph_three_pow
statement:
theorem hansen_cograph_three_pow
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : IsCograph G) :

proof:
:= by

name: HansenCograph.hansen_cograph_three_pow_eq_iff_threshold
statement:
theorem hansen_cograph_three_pow_eq_iff_threshold
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : IsCograph G) :
    hansenNonemptyFaceCount G = 3 ^ (Fintype.card V + 1) ↔
      IsThresholdGraph G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    apply (hansen_cograph_three_pow_faces_eq_iff_threshold G hG).mp
    exact_mod_cast heq
  · intro hthreshold
    have heq :=
      (hansen_cograph_three_pow_faces_eq_iff_threshold G hG).mpr hthreshold
    exact_mod_cast heq

name: HansenCograph.hansen_cograph_full_flag_eq_iff_threshold

name: HansenCograph.IncidenceClosedSet.ext
proof:
:=
  SetLike.coe_injective h

name: HansenCograph.ShufflePath.coord_sum_eq
statement:
theorem ShufflePath.coord_sum_eq {n m : ℕ} (s : ShufflePath n m)
    (i : Fin (n + m + 1)) :
    (s.left i).val + (s.right i).val = i.val
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.induction with
  | zero => simp [s.left_zero, s.right_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
      rcases s.step k with h | h
      · have hl := Nat.covBy_iff_add_one_eq.mp (Fin.covBy_iff.mp h.1)
        have hr := congrArg Fin.val h.2
        change (s.left k.castSucc).val + (s.right k.castSucc).val = k.val at ih
        change (s.left k.castSucc).val + 1 = (s.left k.succ).val at hl
        change (s.right k.castSucc).val = (s.right k.succ).val at hr
        change (s.left k.succ).val + (s.right k.succ).val = k.val + 1
        omega
      · have hr := Nat.covBy_iff_add_one_eq.mp (Fin.covBy_iff.mp h.1)
        have hl := congrArg Fin.val h.2
        change (s.left k.castSucc).val + (s.right k.castSucc).val = k.val at ih
        change (s.right k.castSucc).val + 1 = (s.right k.succ).val at hr
        change (s.left k.castSucc).val = (s.left k.succ).val at hl
        change (s.left k.succ).val + (s.right k.succ).val = k.val + 1
        omega

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.castSucc_mem_leftStepSupport
statement:
@[simp] theorem castSucc_mem_leftStepSupport (s : ShufflePath n m)
    (k : Fin (n + m)) :
    k.castSucc ∈ leftStepSupport s ↔
      s.left k.castSucc ≠ s.left k.succ
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftStepSupport, leftSteps]

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.leftPrefix_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftPrefix_zero (s : ShufflePath n m) :
    leftPrefix s 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftPrefix]

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.leftPrefix_succ_of_ne
statement:
theorem leftPrefix_succ_of_ne (s : ShufflePath n m) (k : Fin (n + m))
    (h : s.left k.castSucc ≠ s.left k.succ) :
    leftPrefix s k.succ = leftPrefix s k.castSucc + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftPrefix, leftPrefix,
    filter_lt_succ_eq_insert (leftStepSupport s) k (by simpa)]
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem]
  simp

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.leftPrefix_succ_of_eq
statement:
theorem leftPrefix_succ_of_eq (s : ShufflePath n m) (k : Fin (n + m))
    (h : s.left k.castSucc = s.left k.succ) :
    leftPrefix s k.succ = leftPrefix s k.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftPrefix, leftPrefix,
    filter_lt_succ_eq_of_notMem (leftStepSupport s) k (by simpa)]

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.left_covBy_of_ne
statement:
theorem left_covBy_of_ne (s : ShufflePath n m) (k : Fin (n + m))
    (h : s.left k.castSucc ≠ s.left k.succ) :
    s.left k.castSucc ⋖ s.left k.succ
proof:
:= by
  rcases s.step k with hstep | hstep
  · exact hstep.1
  · exact False.elim (h hstep.2)

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.left_val_eq_leftPrefix
statement:
theorem left_val_eq_leftPrefix (s : ShufflePath n m)
    (i : Fin (n + m + 1)) :
    (s.left i).val = leftPrefix s i
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.induction with
  | zero => simp [leftPrefix, s.left_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
      by_cases h : s.left k.castSucc = s.left k.succ
      · rw [leftPrefix_succ_of_eq s k h]
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        omega
      · rw [leftPrefix_succ_of_ne s k h]
        have hc := Nat.covBy_iff_add_one_eq.mp
          (Fin.covBy_iff.mp (left_covBy_of_ne s k h))
        omega

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.leftPrefix_last
statement:
theorem leftPrefix_last (s : ShufflePath n m) :
    leftPrefix s (.last (n + m)) = (leftStepSupport s).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftPrefix, Finset.filter_eq_self.mpr]
  intro x hx
  rcases Finset.mem_map.mp hx with ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
  exact Fin.castSucc_lt_last k

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.card_leftStepSupport
statement:
@[simp] theorem card_leftStepSupport (s : ShufflePath n m) :
    (leftStepSupport s).card = n
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (leftStepSupport s).card = leftPrefix s (.last (n + m)) :=
      (leftPrefix_last s).symm
    _ = (s.left (.last (n + m))).val :=
      (left_val_eq_leftPrefix s (.last (n + m))).symm
    _ = n := by rw [s.left_last]; rfl

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.card_leftSteps
statement:
@[simp] theorem card_leftSteps (s : ShufflePath n m) :
    (leftSteps s).card = n
proof:
:= by
  simpa [leftStepSupport] using card_leftStepSupport s

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.toShufflePath_ofShufflePath
statement:
theorem toShufflePath_ofShufflePath (s : ShufflePath n m) :
    toShufflePath (ofShufflePath s) = s
proof:
:= by
  apply ShufflePath.ext
  · intro i
    apply Fin.ext
    change leftCount (ofShufflePath s) i = (s.left i).val
    simpa [ofShufflePath, leftPrefix, leftStepSupport, leftSteps,
      leftCount, leftSupport] using (left_val_eq_leftPrefix s i).symm
  · intro i
    have hleft :
        (toShufflePath (ofShufflePath s)).left i = s.left i := by
      apply Fin.ext
      change leftCount (ofShufflePath s) i = (s.left i).val
      simpa [ofShufflePath, leftPrefix, leftStepSupport, leftSteps,
        leftCount, leftSupport] using (left_val_eq_leftPrefix s i).symm
    have hsum₁ := ShufflePath.coord_sum_eq (toShufflePath (ofShufflePath s)) i
    have hsum₂ := ShufflePath.coord_sum_eq s i
    apply Fin.ext
    have hleftval := congrArg Fin.val hleft
    omega

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.toShufflePath_surjective
statement:
theorem toShufflePath_surjective :
    Function.Surjective
      (toShufflePath : Interleaving n m → ShufflePath n m)
proof:
:=
  fun s ↦ ⟨ofShufflePath s, toShufflePath_ofShufflePath s⟩

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.card_shufflePath_eq_choose
statement:
theorem card_shufflePath_eq_choose (n m : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (ShufflePath n m) = Nat.choose (n + m) n
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Nat.card (ShufflePath n m) = Nat.card (Interleaving n m) :=
      Nat.card_congr (equiv n m).symm
    _ = Nat.choose (n + m) n := by
      rw [Set.powersetCard.card, Nat.card_fin]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPairedSquareState_compl_iff
statement:
theorem hansenPairedSquareState_compl_iff (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    HansenPairedSquareState Gᶜ ↔ HansenPairedSquareState G
proof:
:= by
  change (PairedPositivePortalSquare Gᶜ ∧
      PairedPositivePortalSquare Gᶜᶜ) ↔
    (PairedPositivePortalSquare G ∧ PairedPositivePortalSquare Gᶜ)
  simpa only [compl_compl, and_comm]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.eq_bottom_of_mem_both_distinguished
statement:
theorem eq_bottom_of_mem_both_distinguished {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (F : HansenCombinatorialFace G)
    (hpos : positiveDistinguishedFacet G ∈ (F : Set _))
    (hneg : negativeDistinguishedFacet G ∈ (F : Set _)) :
    F = bottom G
proof:
:= by
  apply IncidenceClosedSet.ext
  change F.carrier = Set.univ
  apply Set.eq_univ_iff_forall.mpr
  intro facet
  change facet ∈ F.carrier
  rw [← F.isClosed]
  intro vertex hvertex
  have hp := hvertex (positiveDistinguishedFacet G) hpos
  have hn := hvertex (negativeDistinguishedFacet G) hneg
  rcases vertex with ⟨sign, stable⟩
  cases sign <;>
    simp [positiveDistinguishedFacet, negativeDistinguishedFacet,
      emptyHansenFacet, hansenLabelIncidence] at hp hn

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.DistinguishedNonemptyFace.not_mem_negativeDistinguishedFacet
statement:
theorem DistinguishedNonemptyFace.not_mem_negativeDistinguishedFacet
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (F : DistinguishedNonemptyFace G) :
    negativeDistinguishedFacet G ∉ (F.1.1 : Set _)
proof:
:= by
  intro hneg
  exact F.2 (eq_bottom_of_mem_both_distinguished F.1.1 F.1.2 hneg)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rootedPos_covBy_val_iff
statement:
theorem rootedPos_covBy_val_iff {G : SimpleGraph V} (F H : RootedPos G) :
    F.1 ⋖ H.1 ↔ F ⋖ H
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
    intro X hFX hXH
    exact h.2 hFX hXH
  · intro h
    apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
    · exact h.1
    · intro X hFX hXH
      have hXtop : X ≠ top G := by
        intro htop
        apply H.2.ne_top
        rw [htop] at hXH
        exact top_unique hXH
      let X' : RootedPos G := ⟨X, F.2.upper_of_ne_top hFX hXtop⟩
      rcases h.eq_or_eq (show F ≤ X' from hFX) (show X' ≤ H from hXH) with hXF | hXH'
      · exact Or.inl (congrArg Subtype.val hXF)
      · exact Or.inr (congrArg Subtype.val hXH')

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.neutral_covBy_val_iff
statement:
theorem neutral_covBy_val_iff {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (E L : NeutralOrEmpty G) : E.1 ⋖ L.1 ↔ E ⋖ L
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
    intro X hEX hXL
    exact h.2 hEX hXL
  · intro h
    apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
    · exact h.1
    · intro X hEX hXL
      let X' : NeutralOrEmpty G := ⟨X, L.2.lower hXL⟩
      rcases h.eq_or_eq (show E ≤ X' from hEX) (show X' ≤ L from hXL) with hXE | hXL'
      · exact Or.inl (congrArg Subtype.val hXE)
      · exact Or.inr (congrArg Subtype.val hXL')

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.not_covBy_of_two_covers
statement:
private theorem not_covBy_of_two_covers {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P]
    {a b c : P} (hab : a ⋖ b) (hbc : b ⋖ c) : ¬a ⋖ c
proof:
:= by
  intro hac
  rcases hac.eq_or_eq hab.le hbc.le with hab' | hbc'
  · exact hab.ne hab'.symm
  · exact hbc.ne hbc'

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.PositivePortalSquare.join
statement:
theorem PositivePortalSquare.join
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (hA : PositivePortalSquare A) (hB : PositivePortalSquare B) :
    PositivePortalSquare (A ⊗g B)
proof:
:= by
  intro E F H hEF hFH
  let eN := joinNeutralOrderIso A B
  let eP := joinRootedPosOrderIso A B
  let e : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B := eN.symm E
  let f : RootedPos A × RootedPos B := eP.symm F
  let h : RootedPos A × RootedPos B := eP.symm H
  have hErep : joinNeutral A B e.1 e.2 = E.1 := by
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (eN.apply_symm_apply E)
  have hFrep : joinRootedPos A B f.1 f.2 = F.1 := by
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (eP.apply_symm_apply F)
  have hHrep : joinRootedPos A B h.1 h.2 = H.1 := by
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (eP.apply_symm_apply H)
  have hportal : e.1.1 ⋖ f.1.1 ∧ e.2.1 ⋖ f.2.1 := by
    apply (joinPortal_covBy_iff A B e.1 e.2 f.1 f.2).mp
    simpa only [hErep, hFrep] using hEF
  have hFHsub : F ⋖ H := (rootedPos_covBy_val_iff F H).mp hFH
  have hfh : f ⋖ h := by
    exact (apply_covBy_apply_iff eP.symm).mpr hFHsub
  rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hfh with hleft | hright
  · obtain ⟨E'A, hE'A, huniqA⟩ := hA e.1 f.1 h.1 hportal.1
        ((rootedPos_covBy_val_iff f.1 h.1).mpr hleft.1)
    let E' : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B) := eN (E'A, e.2)
    refine ⟨E', ?_, ?_⟩
    · constructor
      · apply (neutral_covBy_val_iff E E').mpr
        have hp : e ⋖ (E'A, e.2) := Prod.covBy_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨
            (neutral_covBy_val_iff e.1 E'A).mp hE'A.1, rfl⟩)
        have heN : eN e = E := eN.apply_symm_apply E
        rw [← heN]
        exact (apply_covBy_apply_iff eN).mpr hp
      · have heq : f.2 = h.2 := hleft.2
        rw [← hHrep]
        change E'.1 ⋖ joinRootedPos A B h.1 h.2
        change joinNeutral A B E'A e.2 ⋖ joinRootedPos A B h.1 h.2
        apply joinPortal_covBy_of_factors
        · exact hE'A.2
        · simpa only [← heq] using hportal.2
    · intro X hX
      let x : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B := eN.symm X
      have hXrep : joinNeutral A B x.1 x.2 = X.1 := by
        exact congrArg Subtype.val (eN.apply_symm_apply X)
      have hEXsub : E ⋖ X := (neutral_covBy_val_iff E X).mp hX.1
      have hex : e ⋖ x := (apply_covBy_apply_iff eN.symm).mpr hEXsub
      have hxportal : x.1.1 ⋖ h.1.1 ∧ x.2.1 ⋖ h.2.1 := by
        apply (joinPortal_covBy_iff A B x.1 x.2 h.1 h.2).mp
        simpa only [hXrep, hHrep] using hX.2
      rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hex with hxleft | hxright
      · have hxA : x.1 = E'A := huniqA x.1 ⟨
            (neutral_covBy_val_iff e.1 x.1).mpr hxleft.1,
            hxportal.1⟩
        calc
          X = eN x := (eN.apply_symm_apply X).symm
          _ = eN (E'A, e.2) := congrArg eN (Prod.ext hxA hxleft.2.symm)
          _ = E' := rfl
      · exfalso
        apply not_covBy_of_two_covers hportal.1
          ((rootedPos_covBy_val_iff f.1 h.1).mpr hleft.1)
        simpa only [← hxright.2] using hxportal.1
  · obtain ⟨E'B, hE'B, huniqB⟩ := hB e.2 f.2 h.2 hportal.2
        ((rootedPos_covBy_val_iff f.2 h.2).mpr hright.1)
    let E' : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B) := eN (e.1, E'B)
    refine ⟨E', ?_, ?_⟩
    · constructor
      · apply (neutral_covBy_val_iff E E').mpr
        have hp : e ⋖ (e.1, E'B) := Prod.covBy_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨
            (neutral_covBy_val_iff e.2 E'B).mp hE'B.1, rfl⟩)
        have heN : eN e = E := eN.apply_symm_apply E
        rw [← heN]
        exact (apply_covBy_apply_iff eN).mpr hp
      · have heq : f.1 = h.1 := hright.2
        rw [← hHrep]
        change E'.1 ⋖ joinRootedPos A B h.1 h.2
        change joinNeutral A B e.1 E'B ⋖ joinRootedPos A B h.1 h.2
        apply joinPortal_covBy_of_factors
        · simpa only [← heq] using hportal.1
        · exact hE'B.2
    · intro X hX
      let x : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B := eN.symm X
      have hXrep : joinNeutral A B x.1 x.2 = X.1 := by
        exact congrArg Subtype.val (eN.apply_symm_apply X)
      have hEXsub : E ⋖ X := (neutral_covBy_val_iff E X).mp hX.1
      have hex : e ⋖ x := (apply_covBy_apply_iff eN.symm).mpr hEXsub
      have hxportal : x.1.1 ⋖ h.1.1 ∧ x.2.1 ⋖ h.2.1 := by
        apply (joinPortal_covBy_iff A B x.1 x.2 h.1 h.2).mp
        simpa only [hXrep, hHrep] using hX.2
      rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hex with hxleft | hxright
      · exfalso
        apply not_covBy_of_two_covers hportal.2
          ((rootedPos_covBy_val_iff f.2 h.2).mpr hright.1)
        simpa only [← hxleft.2] using hxportal.2
      · have hxB : x.2 = E'B := huniqB x.2 ⟨
            (neutral_covBy_val_iff e.2 x.2).mpr hxright.1,
            hxportal.2⟩
        calc
          X = eN x := (eN.apply_symm_apply X).symm
          _ = eN (e.1, E'B) := congrArg eN (Prod.ext hxright.2.symm hxB)
          _ = E' := rfl

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.RootedPortalMiddleUnique.join
statement:
theorem RootedPortalMiddleUnique.join
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (hA : RootedPortalMiddleUnique A)
    (hB : RootedPortalMiddleUnique B) :
    RootedPortalMiddleUnique (A ⊗g B)
proof:
:= by
  intro E F H hEF hFH X hX
  let eN := joinNeutralOrderIso A B
  let eP := joinRootedPosOrderIso A B
  let e : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B := eN.symm E
  let f : RootedPos A × RootedPos B := eP.symm F
  let h : RootedPos A × RootedPos B := eP.symm H
  let x : RootedPos A × RootedPos B := eP.symm X
  have hErep : joinNeutral A B e.1 e.2 = E.1 := by
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (eN.apply_symm_apply E)
  have hFrep : joinRootedPos A B f.1 f.2 = F.1 := by
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (eP.apply_symm_apply F)
  have hHrep : joinRootedPos A B h.1 h.2 = H.1 := by
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (eP.apply_symm_apply H)
  have hXrep : joinRootedPos A B x.1 x.2 = X.1 := by
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (eP.apply_symm_apply X)
  have hef : e.1.1 ⋖ f.1.1 ∧ e.2.1 ⋖ f.2.1 := by
    apply (joinPortal_covBy_iff A B e.1 e.2 f.1 f.2).mp
    simpa only [hErep, hFrep] using hEF
  have hex : e.1.1 ⋖ x.1.1 ∧ e.2.1 ⋖ x.2.1 := by
    apply (joinPortal_covBy_iff A B e.1 e.2 x.1 x.2).mp
    simpa only [hErep, hXrep] using hX.1
  have hfh : f ⋖ h := by
    apply (apply_covBy_apply_iff eP.symm).mpr
    exact (rootedPos_covBy_val_iff F H).mp hFH
  have hxh : x ⋖ h := by
    apply (apply_covBy_apply_iff eP.symm).mpr
    exact (rootedPos_covBy_val_iff X H).mp hX.2
  rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hfh with hfleft | hfright
  · rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hxh with hxleft | hxright
    · have hxA : x.1 = f.1 := hA e.1 f.1 h.1 hef.1
          ((rootedPos_covBy_val_iff f.1 h.1).mpr hfleft.1) x.1 ⟨
            hex.1, (rootedPos_covBy_val_iff x.1 h.1).mpr hxleft.1⟩
      calc
        X = eP x := (eP.apply_symm_apply X).symm
        _ = eP f := congrArg eP (Prod.ext hxA (hxleft.2.trans hfleft.2.symm))
        _ = F := eP.apply_symm_apply F
    · exfalso
      apply not_covBy_of_two_covers hef.1
        ((rootedPos_covBy_val_iff f.1 h.1).mpr hfleft.1)
      simpa only [← hxright.2] using hex.1
  · rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hxh with hxleft | hxright
    · exfalso
      apply not_covBy_of_two_covers hef.2
        ((rootedPos_covBy_val_iff f.2 h.2).mpr hfright.1)
      simpa only [← hxleft.2] using hex.2
    · have hxB : x.2 = f.2 := hB e.2 f.2 h.2 hef.2
          ((rootedPos_covBy_val_iff f.2 h.2).mpr hfright.1) x.2 ⟨
            hex.2, (rootedPos_covBy_val_iff x.2 h.2).mpr hxright.1⟩
      calc
        X = eP x := (eP.apply_symm_apply X).symm
        _ = eP f := congrArg eP (Prod.ext (hxright.2.trans hfright.2.symm) hxB)
        _ = F := eP.apply_symm_apply F

name: HansenCograph.integral_pow_mul_one_sub_pow
statement:
theorem integral_pow_mul_one_sub_pow (k l : ℕ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in 0..1, x ^ k * (1 - x) ^ l) =
      (k.factorial : ℝ) * (l.factorial : ℝ) /
        ((k + l + 1).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ofReal_injective
  calc
    ((↑(∫ x : ℝ in 0..1, x ^ k * (1 - x) ^ l) : ℂ)) =
        Complex.betaIntegral ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
      simp only [Complex.betaIntegral, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_sub_cancel_right,
        Complex.cpow_natCast, Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofReal_sub,
        Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_mul]
    _ = Complex.Gamma ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) *
          Complex.Gamma ((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) /
          Complex.Gamma (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) + ((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)) := by
      rw [Complex.betaIntegral_eq_Gamma_mul_div]
      · exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_lt_succ k
      · exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_lt_succ l
    _ = ((k.factorial : ℂ) * (l.factorial : ℂ)) /
          ((k + l + 1).factorial : ℂ) := by
      have hgammaK : Complex.Gamma ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) =
          (k.factorial : ℂ) := by
        simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
          Complex.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial k
      have hgammaL : Complex.Gamma ((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) =
          (l.factorial : ℂ) := by
        simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
          Complex.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial l
      have hgamma :
          Complex.Gamma (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) + ((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)) =
            ((k + l + 1).factorial : ℂ) := by
        rw [show (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) + ((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)) =
            ((k + l + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 by push_cast; ring]
        exact Complex.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial (k + l + 1)
      rw [hgammaK, hgammaL, hgamma]
    _ = ↑((k.factorial : ℝ) * (l.factorial : ℝ) /
          ((k + l + 1).factorial : ℝ)) := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> norm_num

name: HansenCograph.integral_portalPolynomial
statement:
theorem integral_portalPolynomial (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in 0..1, portalPolynomial n a x) =
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k) /
        ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold portalPolynomial
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum]
  · calc
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        ∫ x : ℝ in 0..1,
          a k / ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ((n - k).factorial : ℝ)) *
            x ^ k * (1 - x) ^ (n - k)) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          a k / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k hk
        have hk' : k ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
        have hsum : k + (n - k) + 1 = n + 1 := by omega
        have hintegrand :
            (fun x : ℝ ↦
              a k / ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ((n - k).factorial : ℝ)) *
                x ^ k * (1 - x) ^ (n - k)) =
              fun x : ℝ ↦
                (a k / ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ((n - k).factorial : ℝ))) *
                  (x ^ k * (1 - x) ^ (n - k)) := by
          funext x
          ring
        rw [hintegrand, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
          integral_pow_mul_one_sub_pow, hsum]
        have hkfac : (k.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
        have hnkfac : ((n - k).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
        have hnfac : ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
        field_simp
      _ = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k) /
          ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
  · intro k hk
    exact Continuous.intervalIntegrable (by fun_prop) 0 1

name: HansenCograph.Flag.productShuffle_fst_range
statement:
theorem Flag.productShuffle_fst_range
    {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}
    [PartialOrder P] [Finite P]
    [PartialOrder Q] [Finite Q]
    (f : Flag P) (g : Flag Q)
    {n m : ℕ} (hf : Nat.card f = n + 1) (hg : Nat.card g = m + 1)
    (s : ShufflePath n m) :
    Prod.fst '' (Flag.productShuffle f g hf hg s).carrier = f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype f := Fintype.ofFinite f
  letI : Fintype g := Fintype.ofFinite g
  have hf' : Fintype.card f = n + 1 := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hf
  have hg' : Fintype.card g = m + 1 := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hg
  let ef : Fin (n + 1) ≃o f := Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq f hf'
  let eg : Fin (m + 1) ≃o g := Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq g hg'
  change Prod.fst '' Set.range (fun k : Fin (n + m + 1) ↦
      ((ef (s.left k)).1, (eg (s.right k)).1)) = (f : Set P)
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, ⟨k, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact (ef (s.left k)).2
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := ef.surjective ⟨x, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := s.left_surjective i
    refine ⟨((ef (s.left k)).1, (eg (s.right k)).1), ⟨k, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa [hk] using congrArg Subtype.val hi

name: HansenCograph.Flag.productShuffle_snd_range
statement:
theorem Flag.productShuffle_snd_range
    {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}
    [PartialOrder P] [Finite P]
    [PartialOrder Q] [Finite Q]
    (f : Flag P) (g : Flag Q)
    {n m : ℕ} (hf : Nat.card f = n + 1) (hg : Nat.card g = m + 1)
    (s : ShufflePath n m) :
    Prod.snd '' (Flag.productShuffle f g hf hg s).carrier = g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype f := Fintype.ofFinite f
  letI : Fintype g := Fintype.ofFinite g
  have hf' : Fintype.card f = n + 1 := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hf
  have hg' : Fintype.card g = m + 1 := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hg
  let ef : Fin (n + 1) ≃o f := Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq f hf'
  let eg : Fin (m + 1) ≃o g := Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq g hg'
  change Prod.snd '' Set.range (fun k : Fin (n + m + 1) ↦
      ((ef (s.left k)).1, (eg (s.right k)).1)) = (g : Set Q)
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, ⟨k, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact (eg (s.right k)).2
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := eg.surjective ⟨y, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := s.right_surjective j
    refine ⟨((ef (s.left k)).1, (eg (s.right k)).1), ⟨k, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa [hk] using congrArg Subtype.val hj

name: HansenCograph.Flag.productShuffle_injective_fixed
statement:
theorem Flag.productShuffle_injective_fixed
    {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}
    [PartialOrder P] [Finite P]
    [PartialOrder Q] [Finite Q]
    (f : Flag P) (g : Flag Q)
    {n m : ℕ} (hf : Nat.card f = n + 1) (hg : Nat.card g = m + 1) :
    Function.Injective (fun s : ShufflePath n m ↦
      Flag.productShuffle f g hf hg s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype f := Fintype.ofFinite f
  letI : Fintype g := Fintype.ofFinite g
  have hf' : Fintype.card f = n + 1 := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hf
  have hg' : Fintype.card g = m + 1 := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hg
  let ef : Fin (n + 1) ≃o f := Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq f hf'
  let eg : Fin (m + 1) ≃o g := Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq g hg'
  intro s t hst
  have hgrid :
      (RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle (finRankedFlag n) (finRankedFlag m) s).toFlag =
        (RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle (finRankedFlag n) (finRankedFlag m) t).toFlag := by
    apply Flag.ext
    ext q
    constructor
    · intro hq
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ :=
        (RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle (finRankedFlag n)
          (finRankedFlag m) s).mem_toFlag_iff q |>.mp hq
      have hz_s :
          ((ef q.1).1, (eg q.2).1) ∈
            Flag.productShuffle f g hf hg s := by
        change ((ef q.1).1, (eg q.2).1) ∈
          Set.range (fun j : Fin (n + m + 1) ↦
            ((ef (s.left j)).1, (eg (s.right j)).1))
        refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
        apply Prod.ext
        · simpa [RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle, finRankedFlag] using
            congrArg Prod.fst hk
        · simpa [RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle, finRankedFlag] using
            congrArg Prod.snd hk
      have hz :
          ((ef q.1).1, (eg q.2).1) ∈
            Flag.productShuffle f g hf hg t :=
        (congrArg (fun z : Flag (P × Q) ↦
          ((ef q.1).1, (eg q.2).1) ∈ z) hst).mp hz_s
      change ((ef q.1).1, (eg q.2).1) ∈
        Set.range (fun j : Fin (n + m + 1) ↦
          ((ef (t.left j)).1, (eg (t.right j)).1)) at hz
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hz
      refine ((RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle (finRankedFlag n)
        (finRankedFlag m) t).mem_toFlag_iff q).2 ⟨j, ?_⟩
      apply Prod.ext
      · have hj' := congrArg Prod.fst hj
        apply Fin.ext
        exact congrArg Fin.val (ef.injective (Subtype.ext hj'))
      · have hj' := congrArg Prod.snd hj
        apply Fin.ext
        exact congrArg Fin.val (eg.injective (Subtype.ext hj'))
    · intro hq
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ :=
        (RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle (finRankedFlag n)
          (finRankedFlag m) t).mem_toFlag_iff q |>.mp hq
      have hz_t :
          ((ef q.1).1, (eg q.2).1) ∈
            Flag.productShuffle f g hf hg t := by
        change ((ef q.1).1, (eg q.2).1) ∈
          Set.range (fun j : Fin (n + m + 1) ↦
            ((ef (t.left j)).1, (eg (t.right j)).1))
        refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
        apply Prod.ext
        · simpa [RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle, finRankedFlag] using
            congrArg Prod.fst hk
        · simpa [RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle, finRankedFlag] using
            congrArg Prod.snd hk
      have hz :
          ((ef q.1).1, (eg q.2).1) ∈
            Flag.productShuffle f g hf hg s :=
        (congrArg (fun z : Flag (P × Q) ↦
          ((ef q.1).1, (eg q.2).1) ∈ z) hst).mpr hz_t
      change ((ef q.1).1, (eg q.2).1) ∈
        Set.range (fun j : Fin (n + m + 1) ↦
          ((ef (s.left j)).1, (eg (s.right j)).1)) at hz
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hz
      refine ((RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle (finRankedFlag n)
        (finRankedFlag m) s).mem_toFlag_iff q).2 ⟨j, ?_⟩
      apply Prod.ext
      · have hj' := congrArg Prod.fst hj
        apply Fin.ext
        exact congrArg Fin.val (ef.injective (Subtype.ext hj'))
      · have hj' := congrArg Prod.snd hj
        apply Fin.ext
        exact congrArg Fin.val (eg.injective (Subtype.ext hj'))
  have hranked := RankedFlag.toFlag_injective hgrid
  have hranked' :
      (fun x : RankedFlag (Fin (n + 1)) n × RankedFlag (Fin (m + 1)) m ×
        ShufflePath n m ↦
        RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)
        (finRankedFlag n, finRankedFlag m, s) =
      (fun x : RankedFlag (Fin (n + 1)) n × RankedFlag (Fin (m + 1)) m ×
        ShufflePath n m ↦
        RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)
        (finRankedFlag n, finRankedFlag m, t) := hranked
  have hcode := RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle_injective hranked'
  exact congrArg (fun x : RankedFlag (Fin (n + 1)) n ×
      RankedFlag (Fin (m + 1)) m × ShufflePath n m ↦ x.2.2) hcode

name: HansenCograph.RankTwoDiamond.otherMiddle_spec
statement:
theorem otherMiddle_spec {P : Type u} [PartialOrder P]
    (hP : RankTwoDiamond P) {a b c : P} (hab : a ⋖ b) (hbc : b ⋖ c) :
    a ⋖ hP.otherMiddle hab hbc ∧
      hP.otherMiddle hab hbc ⋖ c ∧
      hP.otherMiddle hab hbc ≠ b
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (hP hab hbc)).1

name: HansenCograph.RankTwoDiamond.otherMiddle_reverse
statement:
theorem otherMiddle_reverse {P : Type u} [PartialOrder P]
    (hP : RankTwoDiamond P) {a b c : P} (hab : a ⋖ b) (hbc : b ⋖ c) :
    hP.otherMiddle (hP.otherMiddle_spec hab hbc).1
        (hP.otherMiddle_spec hab hbc).2.1 = b
proof:
:= by
  unfold otherMiddle
  exact ((Classical.choose_spec
    (hP (hP.otherMiddle_spec hab hbc).1
      (hP.otherMiddle_spec hab hbc).2.1)).2 b
        ⟨hab, hbc, (hP.otherMiddle_spec hab hbc).2.2.symm⟩).symm

name: HansenCograph.RankTwoDiamond.orderIso
statement:
theorem orderIso {P Q : Type u} [PartialOrder P] [PartialOrder Q]
    (e : P ≃o Q) (hP : RankTwoDiamond P) : RankTwoDiamond Q
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c hab hbc
  obtain ⟨b', hb', hub'⟩ := hP
    ((apply_covBy_apply_iff e.symm).mpr hab)
    ((apply_covBy_apply_iff e.symm).mpr hbc)
  refine ⟨e b', ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · simpa only [OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using
        (apply_covBy_apply_iff e).mpr hb'.1
    constructor
    · simpa only [OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using
        (apply_covBy_apply_iff e).mpr hb'.2.1
    · intro h
      apply hb'.2.2
      apply e.injective
      simpa only [OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using h
  · intro x hx
    have hxpre : (e.symm a) ⋖ (e.symm x) ∧
        (e.symm x) ⋖ (e.symm c) ∧ e.symm x ≠ e.symm b :=
      ⟨(apply_covBy_apply_iff e.symm).mpr hx.1,
        (apply_covBy_apply_iff e.symm).mpr hx.2.1,
        fun h ↦ hx.2.2 (e.symm.injective h)⟩
    have heq : e.symm x = b' := hub' (e.symm x) hxpre
    apply e.symm.injective
    simpa only [OrderIso.symm_apply_apply] using heq

name: HansenCograph.RankTwoDiamond.orderDual
statement:
theorem orderDual {P : Type u} [PartialOrder P]
    (hP : RankTwoDiamond P) : RankTwoDiamond (OrderDual P)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c hab hbc
  have hab' : @CovBy P _ b a := by
    refine ⟨hab.1, ?_⟩
    intro x hbx hxa
    exact hab.2 hxa hbx
  have hbc' : @CovBy P _ c b := by
    refine ⟨hbc.1, ?_⟩
    intro x hcx hxb
    exact hbc.2 hxb hcx
  obtain ⟨b', hb', hub'⟩ := @hP c b a hbc' hab'
  refine ⟨b', ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · refine ⟨hb'.2.1.1, ?_⟩
      intro x hb'x hxa
      exact hb'.2.1.2 hxa hb'x
    constructor
    · refine ⟨hb'.1.1, ?_⟩
      intro x hcx hxb'
      exact hb'.1.2 hxb' hcx
    · exact hb'.2.2
  intro x hx
  apply hub' x
  constructor
  · refine ⟨hx.2.1.1, ?_⟩
    intro y hcy hyx
    exact hx.2.1.2 hyx hcy
  constructor
  · refine ⟨hx.1.1, ?_⟩
    intro y hxy hya
    exact hx.1.2 hya hxy
  · exact hx.2.2

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.covBy_switchPred_middle
proof:
:= by
  let j : Fin (N + 1) := ⟨i.1, by omega⟩
  have h := f.covBy_succ j
  have hpred : j.castSucc = switchPredIndex i := by
    apply Fin.ext
    rfl
  have hmid : j.succ = switchMiddleIndex i := by

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.covBy_switchMiddle_succ
proof:

  let j : Fin (N + 1) := ⟨i.1 + 1, by omega⟩
  have h := f.covBy_succ j
  have hmid : j.castSucc = switchMiddleIndex i := by

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.switchMiddle_apply_middle
statement:
@[simp] theorem switchMiddle_apply_middle {N : ℕ}
    (f : RankedFlag P (N + 1)) (i : Fin N) (b' : P)
    (hlo : f (switchPredIndex i) ⋖ b')
    (hhi : b' ⋖ f (switchSuccIndex i)) :
    switchMiddle f i b' hlo hhi (switchMiddleIndex i) = b'
proof:
:= by
  simp [switchMiddle]

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.switchMiddle_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem switchMiddle_apply_of_ne {N : ℕ}
    (f : RankedFlag P (N + 1)) (i : Fin N) (b' : P)
    (hlo : f (switchPredIndex i) ⋖ b')
    (hhi : b' ⋖ f (switchSuccIndex i))
    (j : Fin (N + 2)) (hj : j ≠ switchMiddleIndex i) :
    switchMiddle f i b' hlo hhi j = f j
proof:
:= by
  simp [switchMiddle, hj]

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.switchMiddle_restore
statement:
theorem switchMiddle_restore {N : ℕ}
    (f : RankedFlag P (N + 1)) (i : Fin N) (b' : P)
    (hlo : f (switchPredIndex i) ⋖ b')
    (hhi : b' ⋖ f (switchSuccIndex i)) :
    switchMiddle (switchMiddle f i b' hlo hhi) i
        (f (switchMiddleIndex i))
        (by
          have hne : switchPredIndex i ≠ switchMiddleIndex i := by
            intro h
            have := congrArg Fin.val h
            simp [switchPredIndex, switchMiddleIndex] at this
          rw [switchMiddle_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ hne]
          exact covBy_switchPred_middle f i
          )
        (by
          have hne : switchSuccIndex i ≠ switchMiddleIndex i := by
            intro h
            have := congrArg Fin.val h
            simp [switchSuccIndex, switchMiddleIndex] at this
          rw [switchMiddle_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ hne]
          exact covBy_switchMiddle_succ f i
          ) = f
proof:
:= by
  apply RankedFlag.ext
  intro j
  by_cases hj : j = switchMiddleIndex i
  · subst j
    simp
  · rw [switchMiddle_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ hj,
      switchMiddle_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ hj]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector_singleton_one

proof:

  exact SingletonFace.card_portalLayer_one

name: HansenCograph.PortalPolynomialConstant.join
statement:
theorem PortalPolynomialConstant.join
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (hAcard : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace A)
      (Fintype.card V + 3))
    (hBcard : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace B)
      (Fintype.card W + 3))
    (hA : PortalPolynomialConstant A)
    (hB : PortalPolynomialConstant B) :
    PortalPolynomialConstant (A ⊗g B)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector A k : ℝ)
  let b : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector B k : ℝ)
  have hpoly (z : ℝ) :
      portalPolynomial (Fintype.card (V ⊕ W))
          (fun k =>
            (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector (A ⊗g B) k : ℝ)) z =
        portalPolynomial (Fintype.card V) a z *
          portalPolynomial (Fintype.card W) b z := by
    rw [Fintype.card_sum]
    calc
      portalPolynomial (Fintype.card V + Fintype.card W)
          (fun k =>
            (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector (A ⊗g B) k : ℝ)) z =
          portalPolynomial (Fintype.card V + Fintype.card W)
            (portalShuffleConvolution (Fintype.card V) (Fintype.card W) a b) z := by
              congr 1
              funext k
              exact
                HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector_join_cast_eq_portalShuffleConvolution
                  A B hAcard hBcard k
      _ = portalPolynomial (Fintype.card V) a z *
            portalPolynomial (Fintype.card W) b z :=
        portalPolynomial_convolution (Fintype.card V) (Fintype.card W) a b z
  rw [hpoly x, hpoly y, hA x y, hB x y]

name: HansenCograph.portalShuffleConvolution_mass_normalized_eq_of_constant
statement:
theorem portalShuffleConvolution_mass_normalized_eq_of_constant
    {n m : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hconstant : IsConstantFunction (portalPolynomial n a) ∨
      IsConstantFunction (portalPolynomial m b)) :
    ( ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k) /
          ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) *
        ((∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), b l) /
          ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) =
      (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1),
          portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s) /
        ((n + m + 1).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_portalPolynomial n a,
    ← integral_portalPolynomial m b,
    ← integral_portalPolynomial (n + m)
      (portalShuffleConvolution n m a b)]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ =>
    portalPolynomial_convolution n m a b x)]
  rcases hconstant with ha | hb
  · let c := portalPolynomial n a 0
    have hc : portalPolynomial n a = fun _ => c := by
      funext x
      exact ha x 0
    rw [hc, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    simp [c]
  · let c := portalPolynomial m b 0
    have hc : portalPolynomial m b = fun _ => c := by
      funext x
      exact hb x 0
    rw [hc, intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
    simp [c]

name: HansenCograph.hansenFullFlagRatio_join_eq_of_portalPolynomialConstant
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagRatio_join_eq_of_portalPolynomialConstant
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (hA : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace A)
      (Fintype.card V + 3))
    (hB : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace B)
      (Fintype.card W + 3))
    (hconstant : PortalPolynomialConstant A ∨
      PortalPolynomialConstant B) :
    hansenFullFlagRatio A * hansenFullFlagRatio B =
      hansenFullFlagRatio (A ⊗g B)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let n := Fintype.card V
  let m := Fintype.card W
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector A k : ℝ)
  let b : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector B k : ℝ)
  have hconstant' : IsConstantFunction (portalPolynomial n a) ∨
      IsConstantFunction (portalPolynomial m b) := by
    simpa only [PortalPolynomialConstant, n, m, a, b] using hconstant
  have hmass := portalShuffleConvolution_mass_normalized_eq_of_constant
    (n := n) (m := m) (a := a) (b := b) hconstant'
  have hjoinUniform :
      UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B))
        (Fintype.card (V ⊕ W) + 3) := by
    have h := UniformFlagCard.hansenJoin A B hA hB
    have hlen :
        (Fintype.card V + 3) + (Fintype.card W + 3) - 3 =
          Fintype.card (V ⊕ W) + 3 := by
      simp only [Fintype.card_sum]
      omega
    rw [hlen] at h
    exact h
  have hconv (s : ℕ) :
      (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector (A ⊗g B) s : ℝ) =
        portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s := by
    exact
      HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector_join_cast_eq_portalShuffleConvolution
        A B hA hB s
  rw [hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_portalVector_mass A hA,
    hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_portalVector_mass B hB,
    hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_portalVector_mass (A ⊗g B) hjoinUniform]
  simp only [Fintype.card_sum]
  simp_rw [hconv]
  change
    ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k) /
          (2 ^ n * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))) *
        ((∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), b l) /
          (2 ^ m * ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ))) =
      (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1),
          portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s) /
        (2 ^ (n + m) * ((n + m + 1).factorial : ℝ))
  calc
    ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k) /
          (2 ^ n * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))) *
        ((∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), b l) /
          (2 ^ m * ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ))) =
      (((∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k) /
          ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)) *
        ((∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), b l) /
          ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ))) / 2 ^ (n + m) := by
        rw [pow_add]
        ring
    _ = ((∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1),
          portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s) /
        ((n + m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) / 2 ^ (n + m) := by
      rw [hmass]
    _ = (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1),
          portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s) /
        (2 ^ (n + m) * ((n + m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) := by
      ring

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.portalPolynomialConstant_extremal
statement:
theorem portalPolynomialConstant_extremal :
    ∀ T : Cotree,
      (T.eval = ⊤ → PortalPolynomialConstant T.eval) ∧
      (T.eval = ⊥ → PortalPolynomialConstant T.evalᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | leaf =>
      have hcard : Fintype.card (Vert .leaf) = 1 := by
        have f : Vert .leaf ≃ PUnit := Equiv.refl PUnit
        simpa using Fintype.card_congr f
      have hw0 :
          HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector (eval .leaf) 0 = 2 := by
        change
          @HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector PUnit
              (instFintypeVert .leaf) (instDecidableEqVert .leaf)
              (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit) 0 = 2
        calc
          _ = HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector
                (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit) 0 :=
            HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector_eq_of_instances
              (instFintypeVert .leaf) inferInstance
              (instDecidableEqVert .leaf) inferInstance _ _
          _ = 2 :=
            HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector_singleton_zero
      have hw1 :
          HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector (eval .leaf) 1 = 2 := by
        change
          @HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector PUnit
              (instFintypeVert .leaf) (instDecidableEqVert .leaf)
              (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit) 1 = 2
        calc
          _ = HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector
                (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit) 1 :=
            HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector_eq_of_instances
              (instFintypeVert .leaf) inferInstance
              (instDecidableEqVert .leaf) inferInstance _ _
          _ = 2 :=
            HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector_singleton_one
      have hleaf : PortalPolynomialConstant (eval .leaf) := by
        intro x y
        rw [hcard]
        unfold portalPolynomial
        simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add]
        rw [hw0, hw1]
        norm_num
        ring
      constructor
      · intro _
        exact hleaf
      · intro _
        have htop : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Vert .leaf)) = ⊥ := by
          change (⊤ : SimpleGraph PUnit) = ⊥
          ext u v
          have huv : u = v := Subsingleton.elim _ _
          subst v
          simp
        have hself : (eval .leaf)ᶜ = eval .leaf := by
          simp [eval, htop]
        rw [hself]
        exact hleaf
  | compl A ih =>
      constructor
      · intro htop
        change @PortalPolynomialConstant (Vert A) (instFintypeVert A)
          (instDecidableEqVert A) (eval A)ᶜ
        change A.evalᶜ = ⊤ at htop
        have hbot : A.eval = ⊥ :=
          (compl_eq_top_iff_eq_bot_local A.eval).mp htop
        exact ih.2 hbot
      · intro hbot
        change @PortalPolynomialConstant (Vert A) (instFintypeVert A)
          (instDecidableEqVert A) ((eval A)ᶜ)ᶜ
        change A.evalᶜ = ⊥ at hbot
        have htop : A.eval = ⊤ :=
          (compl_eq_bot_iff_eq_top_local A.eval).mp hbot
        rw [compl_compl]
        exact ih.1 htop
  | sum A B ihA ihB =>
      constructor
      · intro htop
        exact False.elim (eval_sum_ne_top A B htop)
      · intro hbot
        have hAB := (eval_sum_eq_bot_iff A B).mp hbot
        have hAc : PortalPolynomialConstant A.evalᶜ := ihA.2 hAB.1
        have hBc : PortalPolynomialConstant B.evalᶜ := ihB.2 hAB.2
        have hjoin := PortalPolynomialConstant.join A.evalᶜ B.evalᶜ
          (UniformFlagCard.hansenCompl A.eval (uniformFlagCard_eval A))
          (UniformFlagCard.hansenCompl B.eval (uniformFlagCard_eval B))
          hAc hBc
        change PortalPolynomialConstant ((A.eval ⊕g B.eval)ᶜ)
        rw [compl_sum_eq_join]
        exact hjoin

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.portalPolynomialConstant_compl_of_eval_eq_bot

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.hansenFullFlagRatio_sum_eq_of_eval_eq_bot
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagRatio_sum_eq_of_eval_eq_bot
    (A B : Cotree) (hbot : A.eval = ⊥ ∨ B.eval = ⊥) :
    hansenFullFlagRatio A.eval * hansenFullFlagRatio B.eval =
      hansenFullFlagRatio (A.eval ⊕g B.eval)
proof:
:= by
  have hconstant : PortalPolynomialConstant A.evalᶜ ∨
      PortalPolynomialConstant B.evalᶜ := by
    rcases hbot with hA | hB
    · exact Or.inl (portalPolynomialConstant_compl_of_eval_eq_bot A hA)
    · exact Or.inr (portalPolynomialConstant_compl_of_eval_eq_bot B hB)
  have hjoin := hansenFullFlagRatio_join_eq_of_portalPolynomialConstant
    A.evalᶜ B.evalᶜ
    (UniformFlagCard.hansenCompl A.eval (uniformFlagCard_eval A))
    (UniformFlagCard.hansenCompl B.eval (uniformFlagCard_eval B))
    hconstant
  calc
    hansenFullFlagRatio A.eval * hansenFullFlagRatio B.eval =
        hansenFullFlagRatio A.evalᶜ * hansenFullFlagRatio B.evalᶜ := by
      simp
    _ = hansenFullFlagRatio (A.evalᶜ ⊗g B.evalᶜ) := hjoin
    _ = hansenFullFlagRatio (A.eval ⊕g B.eval) := by
      rw [← compl_sum_eq_join, hansenFullFlagRatio_compl]

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_one_of_isThreshold
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_one_of_isThreshold :
    ∀ T : Cotree, T.IsThreshold → hansenFullFlagRatio T.eval = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | leaf =>
      intro _
      let e : (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit) ≃g eval .leaf := SimpleGraph.Iso.refl
      have hcount : hansenFullFlagCount (eval .leaf) = 8 := by
        rw [← hansenFullFlagCount_iso e]
        exact hansenFullFlagCount_singleton
      have hcard : Fintype.card (Vert .leaf) = 1 := by
        have f : Vert .leaf ≃ PUnit := Equiv.refl PUnit
        simpa using Fintype.card_congr f
      unfold hansenFullFlagRatio
      rw [hcount, hcard]
      norm_num
  | compl A ih =>
      intro hA
      change @hansenFullFlagRatio (Vert A) (instFintypeVert A)
        (instDecidableEqVert A) (eval A)ᶜ = 1
      rw [hansenFullFlagRatio_compl]
      exact ih hA
  | sum A B ihA ihB =>
      rintro ⟨hA, hB, hbot⟩
      let _ : Fintype (Vert A ⊕ Vert B) := instFintypeVert (.sum A B)
      let _ : DecidableEq (Vert A ⊕ Vert B) :=
        instDecidableEqVert (.sum A B)
      change hansenFullFlagRatio (A.eval ⊕g B.eval) = 1
      have hsum :
          hansenFullFlagRatio A.eval * hansenFullFlagRatio B.eval =
            hansenFullFlagRatio (A.eval ⊕g B.eval) :=
        hansenFullFlagRatio_sum_eq_of_eval_eq_bot A B hbot
      calc
        hansenFullFlagRatio (A.eval ⊕g B.eval) =
            hansenFullFlagRatio A.eval * hansenFullFlagRatio B.eval := hsum.symm
        _ = 1 := by rw [ihA hA, ihB hB, one_mul]

name: HansenCograph.isIndepSet_finsetCongr_iff
statement:
theorem isIndepSet_finsetCongr_iff (e : G ≃g H) (s : Finset V) :
    G.IsIndepSet (s : Set V) ↔
      H.IsIndepSet (e.toEquiv.finsetCongr s : Set W)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs x hx y hy hxy hadj
    rw [Equiv.finsetCongr_apply] at hx hy
    rcases Finset.mem_map.mp hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    rcases Finset.mem_map.mp hy with ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    exact hs ha hb (fun hab ↦ hxy (congrArg e hab)) (e.map_adj_iff.mp hadj)
  · intro hs x hx y hy hxy hadj
    have hx' : e x ∈ e.toEquiv.finsetCongr s := by
      rw [Equiv.finsetCongr_apply]
      exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have hy' : e y ∈ e.toEquiv.finsetCongr s := by
      rw [Equiv.finsetCongr_apply]
      exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    apply hs hx' hy'
    · exact fun h ↦ hxy (e.injective h)
    · exact e.map_adj_iff.mpr hadj

name: HansenCograph.isClique_finsetCongr_iff
statement:
theorem isClique_finsetCongr_iff (e : G ≃g H) (s : Finset V) :
    G.IsClique (s : Set V) ↔
      H.IsClique (e.toEquiv.finsetCongr s : Set W)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs x hx y hy hxy
    rw [Equiv.finsetCongr_apply] at hx hy
    rcases Finset.mem_map.mp hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    rcases Finset.mem_map.mp hy with ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    apply e.map_adj_iff.mpr
    exact hs ha hb (fun hab ↦ hxy (congrArg e hab))
  · intro hs x hx y hy hxy
    have hx' : e x ∈ e.toEquiv.finsetCongr s := by
      rw [Equiv.finsetCongr_apply]
      exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have hy' : e y ∈ e.toEquiv.finsetCongr s := by
      rw [Equiv.finsetCongr_apply]
      exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact e.map_adj_iff.mp (hs hx' hy' (fun h ↦ hxy (e.injective h)))

name: HansenCograph.finsetCongr_inter_nonempty_iff
statement:
theorem finsetCongr_inter_nonempty_iff (e : V ≃ W) (s t : Finset V) :
    (e.finsetCongr s ∩ e.finsetCongr t).Nonempty ↔ (s ∩ t).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    refine ⟨e.symm x, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · simpa [Equiv.finsetCongr_apply] using (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).1
    · simpa [Equiv.finsetCongr_apply] using (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).2
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    refine ⟨e x, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · simpa [Equiv.finsetCongr_apply] using (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).1
    · simpa [Equiv.finsetCongr_apply] using (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).2

name: HansenCograph.hansenLabelIncidence_iso
statement:
theorem hansenLabelIncidence_iso (e : G ≃g H)
    (vertex : HansenVertexLabel G) (facet : HansenFacetLabel G) :
    hansenLabelIncidence H (hansenVertexLabelIso e vertex)
        (hansenFacetLabelIso e facet) ↔
      hansenLabelIncidence G vertex facet
proof:
:= by
  rcases vertex with ⟨vertexSign, vertexSet⟩
  rcases facet with ⟨facetSign, facetSet⟩
  change (facetSign = vertexSign ↔
      (e.toEquiv.finsetCongr facetSet.1 ∩
        e.toEquiv.finsetCongr vertexSet.1).Nonempty) ↔
    (facetSign = vertexSign ↔ (facetSet.1 ∩ vertexSet.1).Nonempty)
  rw [finsetCongr_inter_nonempty_iff]

name: HansenCograph.hansen_cograph_three_pow_faces_eq_iff_threshold
statement:
theorem hansen_cograph_three_pow_faces_eq_iff_threshold
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : IsCograph G) :
    (hansenNonemptyFaceCount G : Int) =
        (3 : Int) ^ (Fintype.card V + 1) ↔
      IsThresholdGraph G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    rcases hG with ⟨T, ⟨e⟩⟩
    refine ⟨T, ?_, ⟨e⟩⟩
    apply (Cotree.hansenNonemptyFaceCount_eval_eq_three_pow_card_iff_threshold T).mp
    rw [← hansenNonemptyFaceCount_iso e, ← Fintype.card_congr e.toEquiv]
    exact heq
  · rintro ⟨T, hT, ⟨e⟩⟩
    rw [hansenNonemptyFaceCount_iso e, Fintype.card_congr e.toEquiv]
    exact (Cotree.hansenNonemptyFaceCount_eval_eq_three_pow_card_iff_threshold T).mpr hT

name: HansenCograph.card_nonbottomHansenFace
statement:
theorem card_nonbottomHansenFace (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Fintype.card (NonbottomHansenFace G) = hansenNonemptyFaceCount G
proof:
:= by
  have h := Fintype.card_subtype_compl
    (fun F : HansenCombinatorialFace G ↦
      F = HansenCombinatorialFace.bottom G)
  simpa [NonbottomHansenFace, hansenNonemptyFaceCount] using h

name: HansenCograph.incidenceModels_nonempty_of_ne_bottom
statement:
theorem incidenceModels_nonempty_of_ne_bottom
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (F : HansenCombinatorialFace G)
    (hF : F ≠ HansenCombinatorialFace.bottom G) :
    (incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) F).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hmodels
  apply hF
  apply IncidenceClosedSet.ext
  change F.carrier = Set.univ
  calc
    F.carrier = incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence G) F := F.isClosed.symm
    _ = Set.univ := by
      ext facet
      simp only [incidenceClosure, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
      intro vertex hvertex
      exact (hmodels ⟨vertex, hvertex⟩).elim

name: HansenCograph.geometricCarrier_nonempty_of_ne_bottom
statement:
theorem geometricCarrier_nonempty_of_ne_bottom
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (F : HansenCombinatorialFace G)
    (hF : F ≠ HansenCombinatorialFace.bottom G) :
    F.geometricCarrier.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rcases incidenceModels_nonempty_of_ne_bottom G F hF with ⟨vertex, hvertex⟩
  exact ⟨vertex.point,
    (HansenCombinatorialFace.vertexPoint_mem_geometricCarrier_iff F vertex).mpr
      hvertex⟩

name: HansenCograph.hansen_cograph_three_pow_geometric
statement:
theorem hansen_cograph_three_pow_geometric
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : IsCograph G) :
    Nonempty
      (Fin (3 ^ (Fintype.card V + 1)) ↪ NonemptyGeometricHansenFace G)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Fintype.card (Fin (3 ^ (Fintype.card V + 1))) ≤
      Fintype.card (NonbottomHansenFace G) := by
    rw [Fintype.card_fin, card_nonbottomHansenFace]
    exact hansen_cograph_three_pow_faces_nat G hG
  rcases Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le hle with ⟨embedding⟩
  exact ⟨embedding.trans (nonbottomFaceEmbeddingGeometric G)⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsRootedPos.upper_of_ne_top
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := hF.1.mono hFX
  refine ⟨hpos, ?_⟩
  intro hneg
  exact hX ((eq_top_iff_contains_both G X).mpr ⟨hpos, hneg⟩)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rootedUpperWithTopMap_top
statement:
@[simp] private theorem rootedUpperWithTopMap_top
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (F : RootedPos G) :
    rootedUpperWithTopMap G F ⊤ =
      ⟨top G, (show F.1 ≤ top G from le_top)⟩
proof: := rfl

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rootedUpperWithTopMap_coe
statement:
@[simp] private theorem rootedUpperWithTopMap_coe
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (F : RootedPos G) (X : Set.Ici F) :
    rootedUpperWithTopMap G F (X : WithTop (Set.Ici F)) =
      ⟨X.1.1, X.2⟩
proof: := rfl

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rootedUpperWithTopMap_bijective
statement:
private theorem rootedUpperWithTopMap_bijective
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (F : RootedPos G) :
    Function.Bijective (rootedUpperWithTopMap G F)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro X Y hXY
    induction X using WithTop.recTopCoe with
    | top =>
        induction Y using WithTop.recTopCoe with
        | top => rfl
        | coe Y =>
            exfalso
            have hface := congrArg Subtype.val hXY
            rw [rootedUpperWithTopMap_top,
              rootedUpperWithTopMap_coe] at hface
            exact Y.1.2.ne_top hface.symm
    | coe X =>
        induction Y using WithTop.recTopCoe with
        | top =>
            exfalso
            have hface := congrArg Subtype.val hXY
            rw [rootedUpperWithTopMap_coe,
              rootedUpperWithTopMap_top] at hface
            exact X.1.2.ne_top hface
        | coe Y =>
            apply congrArg ((↑) : Set.Ici F → WithTop (Set.Ici F))
            apply Subtype.ext
            apply Subtype.ext
            have hface := congrArg Subtype.val hXY
            rw [rootedUpperWithTopMap_coe,
              rootedUpperWithTopMap_coe] at hface
            exact hface
  · intro X
    by_cases hX : X.1 = top G
    · refine ⟨⊤, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [rootedUpperWithTopMap_top]
      exact hX.symm
    · let Xr : RootedPos G :=
        ⟨X.1, F.2.upper_of_ne_top X.2 hX⟩
      let Xi : Set.Ici F := ⟨Xr, X.2⟩
      refine ⟨(Xi : WithTop (Set.Ici F)), ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [rootedUpperWithTopMap_coe]

name: HansenCograph.N_nonneg
statement:
theorem N_nonneg (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    0 ≤ N G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold N
  apply mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro s hs
  exact mul_nonneg (nu_nonneg _) (nu_nonneg _)

name: HansenCograph.N_pos
statement:
theorem N_pos (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    0 < N G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hterm :
      0 < nuInduced G ∅ * nuInduced G (∅ : Finset V)ᶜ :=
    mul_pos (nu_pos _) (nu_pos _)
  have hle :
      nuInduced G ∅ * nuInduced G (∅ : Finset V)ᶜ ≤
        ∑ s ∈ Finset.univ.powerset,
          nuInduced G s * nuInduced G sᶜ := by
    apply Finset.single_le_sum
      (s := Finset.univ.powerset)
      (f := fun s => nuInduced G s * nuInduced G sᶜ)
    · intro s hs
      exact mul_nonneg (nu_nonneg _) (nu_nonneg _)
    · simp
  unfold N
  nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.N_eq_two_factorial_mul_integral_q
statement:
theorem N_eq_two_factorial_mul_integral_q (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    N G =
      2 * ((Fintype.card V + 1).factorial : ℝ) *
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q G x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold N q qCoeff
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum]
  · simp_rw [mul_assoc]
    simp_rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    simp_rw [integral_pow_mul_one_sub_pow]
    congr 2
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s hs
    have hsle : s.card ≤ Fintype.card V := Finset.card_le_univ s
    have hsum : s.card + (Fintype.card V - s.card) + 1 =
        Fintype.card V + 1 := by
      omega
    rw [hsum]
    have hsf : (s.card.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hcf : ((Fintype.card V - s.card).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hmf : ((Fintype.card V + 1).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
  · intro s hs
    exact (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
      nuInduced G s * nuInduced G sᶜ /
          ((s.card.factorial : ℝ) *
            ((Fintype.card V - s.card).factorial : ℝ)) *
        x ^ s.card * (1 - x) ^ (Fintype.card V - s.card))).intervalIntegrable
          (μ := volume) 0 1

name: HansenCograph.integral_q_pos
statement:
theorem integral_q_pos (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    0 < ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q G x
proof:
:= by
  have hN := N_pos G
  rw [N_eq_two_factorial_mul_integral_q] at hN
  have hfac : 0 < ((Fintype.card V + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
    positivity
  nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.sum_left_indep
statement:
theorem sum_left_indep (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    {s : Finset (V ⊕ W)}
    (hs : (A ⊕g B).IsIndepSet (↑s : Set (V ⊕ W))) :
    A.IsIndepSet (↑(sumLeftPart s) : Set V)
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu v hv huv hadj
  exact hs (by simpa using hu) (by simpa using hv)
    (fun h => huv (Sum.inl_injective h))
    (by simpa [SimpleGraph.sum_adj] using hadj)

name: HansenCograph.sum_right_indep
statement:
theorem sum_right_indep (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    {s : Finset (V ⊕ W)}
    (hs : (A ⊕g B).IsIndepSet (↑s : Set (V ⊕ W))) :
    B.IsIndepSet (↑(sumRightPart s) : Set W)
proof:
:= by

name: HansenCograph.sumFinset_indep
statement:
theorem sumFinset_indep (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    {s : Finset V} {t : Finset W}
    (hs : A.IsIndepSet (↑s : Set V))
    (ht : B.IsIndepSet (↑t : Set W)) :
    (A ⊕g B).IsIndepSet (↑(sumFinset s t) : Set (V ⊕ W))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  cases x with
  | inl u =>
      cases y with
      | inl v =>
          intro hadj
          exact hs (by simpa using hx) (by simpa using hy)
            (fun h => hxy (congrArg Sum.inl h))
            (by simpa [SimpleGraph.sum_adj] using hadj)
      | inr w => simp [SimpleGraph.sum_adj]
  | inr u =>
      cases y with
      | inl v => simp [SimpleGraph.sum_adj]
      | inr w =>
          intro hadj
          exact ht (by simpa using hx) (by simpa using hy)
            (fun h => hxy (congrArg Sum.inr h))
            (by simpa [SimpleGraph.sum_adj] using hadj)

name: HansenCograph.sumCoordinateSplit_indicator
statement:
theorem sumCoordinateSplit_indicator (s : Finset (V ⊕ W)) :
    sumCoordinateSplit (indicator s) =
      (indicator (sumLeftPart s), indicator (sumRightPart s))
proof:
:= by
  ext z <;> simp [sumCoordinateSplit, indicator]

name: HansenCograph.sumCoordinateSplit_sumFinset_indicator
statement:
theorem sumCoordinateSplit_sumFinset_indicator
    (s : Finset V) (t : Finset W) :
    sumCoordinateSplit (indicator (sumFinset s t)) =
      (indicator s, indicator t)
proof:
:= by
  ext z <;> simp [sumCoordinateSplit, indicator]

name: HansenCograph.sumCoordinateSplit_image_stableIndicators
statement:
theorem sumCoordinateSplit_image_stableIndicators
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    sumCoordinateSplit '' stableIndicators (A ⊕g B) =
      stableIndicators A ×ˢ stableIndicators B
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [sumCoordinateSplit_indicator]
    exact ⟨⟨sumLeftPart s, sum_left_indep A B hs, rfl⟩,
      ⟨sumRightPart s, sum_right_indep A B hs, rfl⟩⟩
  · rcases p with ⟨x, y⟩
    rintro ⟨⟨s, hs, hx⟩, ⟨t, ht, hy⟩⟩
    change (x, y) ∈ sumCoordinateSplit '' stableIndicators (A ⊕g B)
    dsimp at hx hy
    rw [hx, hy]
    refine ⟨indicator (sumFinset s t), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨sumFinset s t, sumFinset_indep A B hs ht, rfl⟩
    · exact sumCoordinateSplit_sumFinset_indicator s t

name: HansenCograph.sumCoordinateSplit_image_stab
statement:
theorem sumCoordinateSplit_image_stab
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    sumCoordinateSplit '' stab (A ⊕g B) = stab A ×ˢ stab B
proof:
:= by
  unfold stab
  calc
    sumCoordinateSplit '' convexHull ℝ (stableIndicators (A ⊕g B)) =
        convexHull ℝ (sumCoordinateSplit '' stableIndicators (A ⊕g B)) :=
      LinearMap.image_convexHull sumCoordinateSplit.toLinearMap _
    _ = convexHull ℝ (stableIndicators A ×ˢ stableIndicators B) := by
      rw [sumCoordinateSplit_image_stableIndicators]
    _ = convexHull ℝ (stableIndicators A) ×ˢ
        convexHull ℝ (stableIndicators B) :=
      convexHull_prod _ _

name: HansenCograph.sumCoordinateSplit_measurePreserving
statement:
theorem sumCoordinateSplit_measurePreserving :
    MeasurePreserving (sumCoordinateSplit : ((V ⊕ W) → ℝ) →
      ((V → ℝ) × (W → ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sumCoordinateSplit, MeasurableEquiv.sumPiEquivProdPi,
    Equiv.sumPiEquivProdPi] using
      (volume_measurePreserving_sumPiEquivProdPi
        (fun _ : V ⊕ W => ℝ))

name: HansenCograph.stab_sum_eq_split_preimage
statement:
theorem stab_sum_eq_split_preimage (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    stab (A ⊕g B) =
      (sumCoordinateSplit : ((V ⊕ W) → ℝ) →
        ((V → ℝ) × (W → ℝ))) ⁻¹' (stab A ×ˢ stab B)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [← sumCoordinateSplit_image_stab A B]
    exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  · intro hx
    rw [← sumCoordinateSplit_image_stab A B] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    have : y = x := sumCoordinateSplit.injective hxy
    simpa [this] using hy

name: HansenCograph.volume_stab_sum
statement:
theorem volume_stab_sum (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    volume (stab (A ⊕g B)) = volume (stab A) * volume (stab B)
proof:
:= by
  have hpre := sumCoordinateSplit_measurePreserving.measure_preimage_emb
    (MeasurableEquiv.sumPiEquivProdPi
      (fun _ : V ⊕ W => ℝ)).measurableEmbedding (stab A ×ˢ stab B)
  rw [stab_sum_eq_split_preimage A B]
  rw [hpre, Measure.volume_eq_prod, Measure.prod_prod]

name: HansenCograph.nu_sum
statement:
theorem nu_sum (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    nu (A ⊕g B)
      =
    (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V + Fintype.card W) (Fintype.card V) : ℝ) *
      nu A * nu B
proof:
:= by
  have hfac :
      (((Fintype.card V + Fintype.card W).factorial : ℕ) : ℝ) =
        (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V + Fintype.card W)
            (Fintype.card V) : ℝ) *
          (Fintype.card V).factorial * (Fintype.card W).factorial := by
    norm_cast
    simpa using (Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial
      (show Fintype.card V ≤ Fintype.card V + Fintype.card W by omega)).symm
  unfold nu
  rw [Fintype.card_sum, volume_stab_sum, ENNReal.toReal_mul, hfac]
  ring

name: HansenCograph.graphJoin_adj_inl_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem graphJoin_adj_inl_inl (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)

statement:

proof:

statement:

theorem graphJoin_adj_inr_inl (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)

name: HansenCograph.join_left_indep
statement:
theorem join_left_indep (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    {s : Finset (V ⊕ W)}
    (hs : (A ⊗g B).IsIndepSet (↑s : Set (V ⊕ W))) :
    A.IsIndepSet (↑(sumLeftPart s) : Set V)
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu v hv huv hadj
  exact hs (by simpa using hu) (by simpa using hv)
    (fun h => huv (Sum.inl_injective h)) (by simpa using hadj)

name: HansenCograph.join_right_indep
statement:
theorem join_right_indep (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    {s : Finset (V ⊕ W)}
    (hs : (A ⊗g B).IsIndepSet (↑s : Set (V ⊕ W))) :
    B.IsIndepSet (↑(sumRightPart s) : Set W)

name: HansenCograph.join_indep_right_empty
statement:
theorem join_indep_right_empty (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    {s : Finset (V ⊕ W)}
    (hs : (A ⊗g B).IsIndepSet (↑s : Set (V ⊕ W)))
    (hl : sumLeftPart s ≠ ∅) : sumRightPart s = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  simp only [Finset.notMem_empty, iff_false]
  intro hw
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hl

name: HansenCograph.join_sumFinset_left_indep
statement:
theorem join_sumFinset_left_indep (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    {s : Finset V} (hs : A.IsIndepSet (↑s : Set V)) :
    (A ⊗g B).IsIndepSet
      (↑(sumFinset s (∅ : Finset W)) : Set (V ⊕ W))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  cases x with
  | inl u =>
      cases y with
      | inl v =>
          intro hadj
          exact hs (by simpa using hx) (by simpa using hy)
            (fun h => hxy (congrArg Sum.inl h)) (by simpa using hadj)
      | inr w => simp at hy
  | inr u => simp at hx

    (A ⊗g B).IsIndepSet
      (↑(sumFinset (∅ : Finset V) t) : Set (V ⊕ W))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  cases x with
  | inl u => simp at hx
  | inr u =>
      cases y with
      | inl v => simp at hy
      | inr w =>
          intro hadj
          exact ht (by simpa using hx) (by simpa using hy)
            (fun h => hxy (congrArg Sum.inr h)) (by simpa using hadj)

name: HansenCograph.sumCoordinateSplit_image_stableIndicators_join
statement:
theorem sumCoordinateSplit_image_stableIndicators_join
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    sumCoordinateSplit '' stableIndicators (A ⊗g B) =
      (productAxisLeft '' stableIndicators A) ∪
        (productAxisRight '' stableIndicators B)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [sumCoordinateSplit_indicator]
    by_cases hl : sumLeftPart s = ∅
    · right
      refine ⟨indicator (sumRightPart s),
        ⟨sumRightPart s, join_right_indep A B hs, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      simp [productAxisRight, hl]
    · left
      have hr := join_indep_right_empty A B hs hl
      refine ⟨indicator (sumLeftPart s),
        ⟨sumLeftPart s, join_left_indep A B hs, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      simp [productAxisLeft, hr]
  · rintro (⟨x, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ | ⟨y, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, rfl⟩)
    · refine ⟨indicator (sumFinset s (∅ : Finset W)), ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact ⟨sumFinset s ∅, join_sumFinset_left_indep A B hs, rfl⟩
      · rw [sumCoordinateSplit_sumFinset_indicator]
        simp [productAxisLeft]
    · refine ⟨indicator (sumFinset (∅ : Finset V) t), ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact ⟨sumFinset ∅ t, join_sumFinset_right_indep A B ht, rfl⟩
      · rw [sumCoordinateSplit_sumFinset_indicator]
        simp [productAxisRight]

name: HansenCograph.stableIndicators_nonempty
statement:
theorem stableIndicators_nonempty (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    (stableIndicators G).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨0, ∅, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp
  · exact indicator_empty.symm

name: HansenCograph.sumCoordinateSplit_image_stab_join
statement:
theorem sumCoordinateSplit_image_stab_join
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    sumCoordinateSplit '' stab (A ⊗g B) =
      convexJoin ℝ (productAxisLeft '' stab A) (productAxisRight '' stab B)
proof:
:= by
  unfold stab
  calc
    sumCoordinateSplit '' convexHull ℝ (stableIndicators (A ⊗g B)) =
        convexHull ℝ
          (sumCoordinateSplit '' stableIndicators (A ⊗g B)) :=
      LinearMap.image_convexHull sumCoordinateSplit.toLinearMap _
    _ = convexHull ℝ
        ((productAxisLeft '' stableIndicators A) ∪
          (productAxisRight '' stableIndicators B)) := by
      rw [sumCoordinateSplit_image_stableIndicators_join]
    _ = convexJoin ℝ
        (convexHull ℝ (productAxisLeft '' stableIndicators A))
        (convexHull ℝ (productAxisRight '' stableIndicators B)) :=
      convexHull_union
        ((stableIndicators_nonempty A).image productAxisLeft)
        ((stableIndicators_nonempty B).image productAxisRight)
    _ = convexJoin ℝ
        (productAxisLeft '' convexHull ℝ (stableIndicators A))
        (productAxisRight '' convexHull ℝ (stableIndicators B)) := by
      have hleft : convexHull ℝ
          ((productAxisLeft (V := V) (W := W)) '' stableIndicators A) =
          (productAxisLeft (V := V) (W := W)) ''
            convexHull ℝ (stableIndicators A) := by
        exact (LinearMap.image_convexHull
          (productAxisLeftLinear (V := V) (W := W)) _).symm
      have hright : convexHull ℝ
          ((productAxisRight (V := V) (W := W)) '' stableIndicators B) =
          (productAxisRight (V := V) (W := W)) ''
            convexHull ℝ (stableIndicators B) := by
        exact (LinearMap.image_convexHull
          (productAxisRightLinear (V := V) (W := W)) _).symm
      rw [hleft, hright]

name: HansenCograph.interior_stab_nonempty
statement:
theorem interior_stab_nonempty (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    (interior (stab G)).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := 1 / ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) + 1)
  have hc : 0 < c := by
    dsimp [c]
    positivity
  let U : Set (V → ℝ) :=
    {x | ∀ v, x v ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c}
  have hUopen : IsOpen U := by
    rw [show U = ⋂ v : V,
        (fun x : V → ℝ => x v) ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c by
      ext x
      simp [U]]
    apply isOpen_iInter_of_finite
    intro v
    exact isOpen_Ioo.preimage (continuous_apply v)
  have hUne : U.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨fun _ => c / 2, ?_⟩
    intro v
    constructor <;> dsimp <;> linarith
  have hUstab : U ⊆ stab G := by
    intro x hx
    apply smallCube_subset_stab G
    constructor
    · intro v
      exact le_of_lt (hx v).1
    · intro v
      exact le_of_lt (hx v).2
  rcases hUne with ⟨x, hx⟩
  refine ⟨x, interior_mono hUstab ?_⟩
  rw [mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds]
  exact hUopen.mem_nhds hx

name: HansenCograph.stab_join_eq_split_preimage
statement:
theorem stab_join_eq_split_preimage (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    stab (A ⊗g B) =
      (sumCoordinateSplit : ((V ⊕ W) → ℝ) →
        ((V → ℝ) × (W → ℝ))) ⁻¹'
        (convexJoin ℝ (productAxisLeft '' stab A)
          (productAxisRight '' stab B))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [← sumCoordinateSplit_image_stab_join A B]
    exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  · intro hx
    rw [← sumCoordinateSplit_image_stab_join A B] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    have : y = x := sumCoordinateSplit.injective hxy
    simpa [this] using hy

name: HansenCograph.nu_join
statement:
theorem nu_join (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    nu (A ⊗g B) = nu A * nu B
proof:
:= by
  have hpre := sumCoordinateSplit_measurePreserving.measure_preimage_emb
    (MeasurableEquiv.sumPiEquivProdPi
      (fun _ : V ⊕ W => ℝ)).measurableEmbedding
      (convexJoin ℝ (productAxisLeft '' stab A)
        (productAxisRight '' stab B))
  have hvol : volume (stab (A ⊗g B)) =
      volume (convexJoin ℝ (productAxisLeft '' stab A)
        (productAxisRight '' stab B)) := by
    rw [stab_join_eq_split_preimage A B]
    exact hpre
  have hjoin := volume_convexJoin_productAxis_toReal
    (stab A) (stab B) (convex_stab A) (convex_stab B)
    (zero_mem_stab A) (zero_mem_stab B)
    (interior_stab_nonempty A) (interior_stab_nonempty B)
  have hjoin' :
      (volume (convexJoin ℝ (productAxisLeft '' stab A)
        (productAxisRight '' stab B))).toReal =
      ((Fintype.card V).factorial : ℝ) *
          ((Fintype.card W).factorial : ℝ) /
            ((Fintype.card V + Fintype.card W).factorial : ℝ) *
          (volume (stab A)).toReal * (volume (stab B)).toReal := by
    change
      (volume (convexJoin ℝ ((fun x : V → ℝ => (x, 0)) '' stab A)
        ((fun y : W → ℝ => (0, y)) '' stab B))).toReal = _
    exact hjoin
  change (Fintype.card (V ⊕ W)).factorial *
      (volume (stab (A ⊗g B))).toReal =
    ((Fintype.card V).factorial * (volume (stab A)).toReal) *
      ((Fintype.card W).factorial * (volume (stab B)).toReal)
  rw [Fintype.card_sum, hvol, hjoin']
  have hfac : ((Fintype.card V + Fintype.card W).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    positivity
  field_simp

name: HansenCograph.sumLeftPart_sumFinset
statement:
private theorem sumLeftPart_sumFinset (s : Finset V) (t : Finset W) :
    sumLeftPart (sumFinset s t) = s
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp

name: HansenCograph.sumRightPart_sumFinset
statement:
private theorem sumRightPart_sumFinset (s : Finset V) (t : Finset W) :
    sumRightPart (sumFinset s t) = t
proof:
:= by

name: HansenCograph.sumFinset_parts
statement:
private theorem sumFinset_parts (s : Finset (V ⊕ W)) :
    sumFinset (sumLeftPart s) (sumRightPart s) = s
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  cases z <;> simp

name: HansenCograph.card_sumFinset
proof:
:= by
  unfold sumFinset
  rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint]
  · simp
  · simp [Finset.disjoint_left]

name: HansenCograph.compl_sumFinset
statement:
private theorem compl_sumFinset (s : Finset V) (t : Finset W) :
    (sumFinset s t)ᶜ = sumFinset sᶜ tᶜ
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  cases z <;> simp

name: HansenCograph.sum_powerset_sumFinset
statement:
private theorem sum_powerset_sumFinset
    (f : Finset (V ⊕ W) → ℝ) :
    ∑ u ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (V ⊕ W)).powerset, f u =
      ∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset V).powerset,
        ∑ t ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset W).powerset,
          f (sumFinset s t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.sum_product
    (Finset.univ : Finset V).powerset
    (Finset.univ : Finset W).powerset
    (fun p => f (sumFinset p.1 p.2))]
  apply Finset.sum_bij
      (fun u _ => (sumLeftPart u, sumRightPart u))
  · intro u hu
    simp
  · intro u₁ hu₁ u₂ hu₂ h
    have hleft : sumLeftPart u₁ = sumLeftPart u₂ := congrArg Prod.fst h
    have hright : sumRightPart u₁ = sumRightPart u₂ := congrArg Prod.snd h
    calc
      u₁ = sumFinset (sumLeftPart u₁) (sumRightPart u₁) :=
        (sumFinset_parts u₁).symm
      _ = sumFinset (sumLeftPart u₂) (sumRightPart u₂) := by
        rw [hleft, hright]
      _ = u₂ := sumFinset_parts u₂
  · rintro ⟨s, t⟩ hst
    refine ⟨sumFinset s t, by simp, ?_⟩
    simp [sumLeftPart_sumFinset, sumRightPart_sumFinset]
  · intro u hu
    rw [sumFinset_parts]

name: HansenCograph.nuInduced_sumFinset
statement:
private theorem nuInduced_sumFinset
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (s : Finset V) (t : Finset W) :
    nuInduced (A ⊕g B) (sumFinset s t) =
      (Nat.choose (s.card + t.card) s.card : ℝ) *
        nuInduced A s * nuInduced B t
proof:
:= by
  unfold nuInduced
  rw [nu_iso (inducedSumFinsetIso A B s t), nu_sum]
  simp

name: HansenCograph.nuInduced_joinFinset
statement:
private theorem nuInduced_joinFinset
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (s : Finset V) (t : Finset W) :
    nuInduced (A ⊗g B) (sumFinset s t) =
      nuInduced A s * nuInduced B t
proof:
:= by
  unfold nuInduced
  rw [nu_iso (inducedJoinFinsetIso A B s t), nu_join]

name: HansenCograph.qCoeff_sumFinset
statement:
theorem qCoeff_sumFinset
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (s : Finset V) (t : Finset W) :
    qCoeff (A ⊕g B) (sumFinset s t) = qCoeff A s * qCoeff B t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsle : s.card ≤ Fintype.card V := Finset.card_le_univ s
  have htle : t.card ≤ Fintype.card W := Finset.card_le_univ t
  have hremaining :
      Fintype.card V + Fintype.card W - (s.card + t.card) =
        (Fintype.card V - s.card) + (Fintype.card W - t.card) := by
    omega
  have hfac (a b : ℕ) :
      (((a + b).factorial : ℕ) : ℝ) =
        (Nat.choose (a + b) a : ℝ) * a.factorial * b.factorial := by
    norm_cast
    simpa using
      (Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial
        (show a ≤ a + b by omega)).symm
  unfold qCoeff
  rw [compl_sumFinset, card_sumFinset, Fintype.card_sum, hremaining,
    nuInduced_sumFinset, nuInduced_sumFinset,
    Finset.card_compl, Finset.card_compl,
    hfac s.card t.card,
    hfac (Fintype.card V - s.card) (Fintype.card W - t.card)]
  have hs : (s.card.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have ht : (t.card.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hsc : ((Fintype.card V - s.card).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have htc : ((Fintype.card W - t.card).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hchoose (a b : ℕ) : (Nat.choose (a + b) a : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.choose_pos (by omega : a ≤ a + b)))
  field_simp [hchoose]

name: HansenCograph.qCoeff_joinFinset
statement:
theorem qCoeff_joinFinset
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (s : Finset V) (t : Finset W) :
    qCoeff (A ⊗g B) (sumFinset s t) =
      qCoeff A s * qCoeff B t /
        ((Nat.choose (s.card + t.card) s.card : ℝ) *
          (Nat.choose
            ((Fintype.card V - s.card) + (Fintype.card W - t.card))
            (Fintype.card V - s.card) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsle : s.card ≤ Fintype.card V := Finset.card_le_univ s
  have htle : t.card ≤ Fintype.card W := Finset.card_le_univ t
  have hremaining :
      Fintype.card V + Fintype.card W - (s.card + t.card) =
        (Fintype.card V - s.card) + (Fintype.card W - t.card) := by
    omega
  have hfac (a b : ℕ) :
      (((a + b).factorial : ℕ) : ℝ) =
        (Nat.choose (a + b) a : ℝ) * a.factorial * b.factorial := by
    norm_cast
    simpa using
      (Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial
        (show a ≤ a + b by omega)).symm
  unfold qCoeff
  rw [compl_sumFinset, card_sumFinset, Fintype.card_sum, hremaining,
    nuInduced_joinFinset, nuInduced_joinFinset,
    hfac s.card t.card,
    hfac (Fintype.card V - s.card) (Fintype.card W - t.card)]
  have hs : (s.card.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have ht : (t.card.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hsc : ((Fintype.card V - s.card).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have htc : ((Fintype.card W - t.card).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hchoose (a b : ℕ) : (Nat.choose (a + b) a : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.choose_pos (by omega : a ≤ a + b)))
  field_simp [hchoose]

name: HansenCograph.q_sum
statement:
theorem q_sum (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) (x : ℝ) :
    q (A ⊕g B) x = q A x * q B x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold q
  rw [sum_powerset_sumFinset]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s hs
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t ht
  rw [qCoeff_sumFinset, card_sumFinset, Fintype.card_sum]
  have hremaining :
      Fintype.card V + Fintype.card W - (s.card + t.card) =
        (Fintype.card V - s.card) + (Fintype.card W - t.card) := by
    have hsle : s.card ≤ Fintype.card V := Finset.card_le_univ s
    have htle : t.card ≤ Fintype.card W := Finset.card_le_univ t
    omega
  rw [hremaining, pow_add, pow_add]
  ring

name: HansenCograph.N_join
statement:
theorem N_join (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    N (A ⊗g B) = N A * N B / 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold N
  rw [sum_powerset_sumFinset]
  simp_rw [compl_sumFinset, nuInduced_joinFinset]
  have hfactor :
      ∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset V).powerset,
          ∑ t ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset W).powerset,
            (nuInduced A s * nuInduced B t) *
              (nuInduced A sᶜ * nuInduced B tᶜ) =
        (∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset V).powerset,
            nuInduced A s * nuInduced A sᶜ) *
          (∑ t ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset W).powerset,
            nuInduced B t * nuInduced B tᶜ) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s hs
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro t ht
    ring
  rw [hfactor]
  ring

:=
