name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_eq_card_portalCode
statement:
theorem hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_eq_card_portalCode
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    hansenPositivePortalFlagCount G = Nat.card (HansenPortalCode G)
proof:
:= by
  change Fintype.card (HansenPortalFlag G) = Nat.card (HansenPortalCode G)
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  exact Fintype.card_congr (hansenPortalCodeEquiv G)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.portalLayer_index_lt
statement:
theorem portalLayer_index_lt
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n k : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (c : HansenPortalLayer G k) :
    k < n + 1
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Nonempty c.1.2.2 :=
    (c.1.2.2.maxChain.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance).to_subtype
  have hup : 0 < Nat.card c.1.2.2 := Nat.card_pos
  have htotal := portalCode_card hG c.1
  omega

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_eq_sum_portalVector
statement:
theorem hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_eq_sum_portalVector
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3)) :
    hansenPositivePortalFlagCount G =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), hansenPortalVector G k
proof:
:= by
  rw [hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_eq_card_portalCode G]
  calc
    Nat.card (HansenPortalCode G) =
        Nat.card (Σ k : Fin (n + 1), HansenPortalLayer G k.1) :=
      Nat.card_congr (portalLayerSigmaEquiv hG)
    _ = ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), Nat.card (HansenPortalLayer G k.1) :=
      Nat.card_sigma
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), hansenPortalVector G k := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
        (fun k : Nat => Nat.card (HansenPortalLayer G k))]
      simp only [hansenPortalVector, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

name: HansenCograph.graphRho_nonneg
statement:
theorem graphRho_nonneg (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    0 ≤ graphRho G
proof:
:= by
  unfold graphRho
  exact div_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (N_nonneg G) (N_nonneg Gᶜ))
    (by positivity)

name: HansenCograph.graphRho_pos
statement:
theorem graphRho_pos (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    0 < graphRho G
proof:
:= by
  unfold graphRho
  exact div_pos
    (mul_pos (N_pos G) (N_pos Gᶜ))

name: HansenCograph.graphRho_compl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem graphRho_compl (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    graphRho Gᶜ = graphRho G
proof:
:= by
  unfold graphRho
  simp only [compl_compl]
  ring

name: HansenCograph.graphRho_sum_eq
statement:
theorem graphRho_sum_eq (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    graphRho (A ⊕g B)
      =
    graphRho A * graphRho B *
      ((∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q A x * q B x) /
        ((∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q A x) *
         (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q B x)))
proof:
:= by
  have hcompl : (A ⊕g B)ᶜ = Aᶜ ⊗g Bᶜ := by
    unfold graphJoin
    rw [compl_compl, compl_compl]
  have hNsum :
      N (A ⊕g B) =
        2 * ((Fintype.card V + Fintype.card W + 1).factorial : ℝ) *
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q A x * q B x) := by
    rw [N_eq_two_factorial_mul_integral_q, Fintype.card_sum]
    congr 1
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro x hx
    exact q_sum A B x
  have hNcompl :
      N (A ⊕g B)ᶜ = N Aᶜ * N Bᶜ / 2 := by
    rw [hcompl, N_join]
  have hNA := N_eq_two_factorial_mul_integral_q A
  have hNB := N_eq_two_factorial_mul_integral_q B
  have hIA : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q A x) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (integral_q_pos A)
  have hIB : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q B x) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (integral_q_pos B)
  unfold graphRho
  rw [hNsum, hNcompl, hNA, hNB, Fintype.card_sum]
  field_simp [hIA, hIB, pow_add]
  ring

name: HansenCograph.integral_mul_ge_mul_integral_of_monovary
statement:
theorem integral_mul_ge_mul_integral_of_monovary
    {f g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hg : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hmono : MonovaryOnUnit f g) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f x) *
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, g x)
      ≤
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f x * g x
proof:
:= by
  let D : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun x y =>
    (f x - f y) * (g x - g y)
  have hfi : IntervalIntegrable f volume 0 1 :=
    hf.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by norm_num)
  have hgi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1 :=
    hg.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by norm_num)
  have hfgi : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => f x * g x) volume 0 1 :=
    (hf.mul hg).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by norm_num)
  have hnonneg :
      0 ≤ ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, D x y := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num)
    intro x hx
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num)
    intro y hy
    exact hmono hx hy
  have hinner (x : ℝ) :
      (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, D x y) =
        (f x * g x -
          f x * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, g y) -
          (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, f y) * g x) +
          (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, f y * g y) := by
    have hconst : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun _ : ℝ => f x * g x) volume 0 1 :=
      continuousOn_const.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by norm_num)
    have hfxg : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun y : ℝ => f x * g y) volume 0 1 :=
      (continuousOn_const.mul hg).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by norm_num)
    have hfygx : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun y : ℝ => f y * g x) volume 0 1 :=
      (hf.mul continuousOn_const).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by norm_num)
    have hD : (fun y => D x y) =
        (fun y => ((f x * g x - f x * g y) - f y * g x) +
          f y * g y) := by
      funext y
      dsimp [D]
      ring
    rw [hD]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add
      ((hconst.sub hfxg).sub hfygx) hfgi]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hconst.sub hfxg) hfygx]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hconst hfxg]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
    norm_num
  have hdouble :
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, D x y) =
        2 * ((∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f x * g x) -
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f x) *
            (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, g x)) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x hx => hinner x)]
    have hfg_sub : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun x => f x * g x -
          f x * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, g y)) volume 0 1 :=
      hfgi.sub (hfi.mul_const _)
    have hthree : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun x => f x * g x -
          f x * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, g y) -
          (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, f y) * g x) volume 0 1 :=
      hfg_sub.sub (hgi.const_mul _)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hthree
      (continuousOn_const.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by norm_num))]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hfg_sub (hgi.const_mul _)]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hfgi (hfi.mul_const _)]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const]
    norm_num
    ring
  rw [hdouble] at hnonneg
  nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.integral_mul_gt_mul_integral_of_strict_monovary
statement:
theorem integral_mul_gt_mul_integral_of_strict_monovary
    {f g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hg : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hmono : MonovaryOnUnit f g)
    (hstrict :
      ∃ x y : ℝ,
        x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
        y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
        0 < (f x - f y) * (g x - g y)) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f x) *
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, g x)
      <
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f x * g x
proof:
:= by
  rcases hstrict with ⟨x₀, y₀, hx₀, hy₀, hDxy⟩
  let D : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun x y =>
    (f x - f y) * (g x - g y)
  let I : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, D x y
  have hfi : IntervalIntegrable f volume 0 1 :=
    hf.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by norm_num)
  have hgi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1 :=
    hg.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by norm_num)
  have hfgi : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => f x * g x) volume 0 1 :=
    (hf.mul hg).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by norm_num)
  have hDcont (x : ℝ) : ContinuousOn (D x) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    dsimp [D]
    exact (continuousOn_const.sub hf).mul (continuousOn_const.sub hg)
  have hInonneg : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ I x := by
    intro x hx
    dsimp [I]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num)
    intro y hy
    exact hmono ⟨hx.1.le, hx.2⟩ hy
  have hIx₀ : 0 < I x₀ := by
    dsimp [I]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_pos (by norm_num) (hDcont x₀)
    · intro y hy
      exact hmono hx₀ ⟨hy.1.le, hy.2⟩
    · exact ⟨y₀, hy₀, hDxy⟩
  have hinner (x : ℝ) :
      I x =
        (f x * g x -
          f x * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, g y) -
          (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, f y) * g x) +
          (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, f y * g y) := by
    have hconst : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun _ : ℝ => f x * g x) volume 0 1 :=
      continuousOn_const.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by norm_num)
    have hfxg : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun y : ℝ => f x * g y) volume 0 1 :=
      (continuousOn_const.mul hg).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by norm_num)
    have hfygx : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun y : ℝ => f y * g x) volume 0 1 :=
      (hf.mul continuousOn_const).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by norm_num)
    have hD : (fun y => D x y) =
        (fun y => ((f x * g x - f x * g y) - f y * g x) +
          f y * g y) := by
      funext y
      dsimp [D]
      ring
    dsimp [I]
    rw [hD]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add
      ((hconst.sub hfxg).sub hfygx) hfgi]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hconst.sub hfxg) hfygx]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hconst hfxg]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
    norm_num
  have hIcont : ContinuousOn I (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    have hIeq : I = fun x =>
        (f x * g x -
          f x * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, g y) -
          (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, f y) * g x) +
          (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, f y * g y) := by
      funext x
      exact hinner x
    rw [hIeq]
    exact (((hf.mul hg).sub (hf.mul continuousOn_const)).sub
      (continuousOn_const.mul hg)).add continuousOn_const
  have hdoublepos : 0 < ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, I x := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_pos (by norm_num) hIcont hInonneg
    exact ⟨x₀, hx₀, hIx₀⟩
  have hfg_sub : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x => f x * g x -
        f x * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, g y)) volume 0 1 :=
    hfgi.sub (hfi.mul_const _)
  have hthree : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x => f x * g x -
        f x * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, g y) -
        (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, f y) * g x) volume 0 1 :=
    hfg_sub.sub (hgi.const_mul _)
  have hdouble :
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, I x) =
        2 * ((∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f x * g x) -
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f x) *
            (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, g x)) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x hx => hinner x)]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hthree
      (continuousOn_const.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by norm_num))]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hfg_sub (hgi.const_mul _)]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hfgi (hfi.mul_const _)]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const]
    norm_num
    ring
  rw [hdouble] at hdoublepos
  nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.stableIndicators_finite
statement:
private theorem stableIndicators_finite (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    (stableIndicators G).Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_range (indicator : Finset V → V → ℝ)) ?_
  rintro x ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
  exact Set.mem_range_self s

name: HansenCograph.isCompact_stab
statement:
private theorem isCompact_stab (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    IsCompact (stab G)
proof:
:= by
  exact (stableIndicators_finite G).isCompact_convexHull ℝ

name: HansenCograph.isCompact_sectionSet
statement:
private theorem isCompact_sectionSet (G : SimpleGraph V) (x : ℝ) :
    IsCompact (sectionSet G x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sectionSet
  exact ((isCompact_stab G).smul x).add
    ((isCompact_stab G).smul (-(1 - x)))

name: HansenCograph.convex_sectionSet
statement:
private theorem convex_sectionSet (G : SimpleGraph V) (x : ℝ) :
    Convex ℝ (sectionSet G x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sectionSet
  exact ((convex_stab G).smul x).add
    ((convex_stab G).smul (-(1 - x)))

name: HansenCograph.zero_mem_sectionSet
statement:
private theorem zero_mem_sectionSet (G : SimpleGraph V) (x : ℝ) :
    (0 : V → ℝ) ∈ sectionSet G x
proof:
:= by
  unfold sectionSet
  rw [Set.mem_add]
  refine ⟨0, ?_, 0, ?_, by simp⟩
  · exact Set.mem_smul_set.mpr ⟨0, zero_mem_stab G, by simp⟩
  · exact Set.mem_smul_set.mpr ⟨0, zero_mem_stab G, by simp⟩

name: HansenCograph.exists_weighted_stab
statement:
private theorem exists_weighted_stab
    (G : SimpleGraph V) {r s : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    {p q : V → ℝ} (hp : p ∈ stab G) (hq : q ∈ stab G) :
    ∃ w ∈ stab G, r • p + s • q = (r + s) • w
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hrs : r + s = 0
  · have hr0 : r = 0 := by linarith
    have hs0 : s = 0 := by linarith
    subst r
    subst s
    exact ⟨0, zero_mem_stab G, by simp⟩
  · have hrspos : 0 < r + s := lt_of_le_of_ne (add_nonneg hr hs) (Ne.symm hrs)
    let a := r / (r + s)
    let b := s / (r + s)
    have ha : 0 ≤ a := div_nonneg hr hrspos.le
    have hb : 0 ≤ b := div_nonneg hs hrspos.le
    have hab : a + b = 1 := by
      dsimp [a, b]
      field_simp
    refine ⟨a • p + b • q, (convex_stab G) hp hq ha hb hab, ?_⟩
    dsimp [a, b]
    ext v
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp

name: HansenCograph.sectionSet_combo_subset
statement:
private theorem sectionSet_combo_subset
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {x y a b : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hy : y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    a • sectionSet G x + b • sectionSet G y ⊆
      sectionSet G (a * x + b * y)
proof:
:= by
  rintro z ⟨zx, hzx, zy, hzy, rfl⟩
  rcases Set.mem_smul_set.mp hzx with ⟨sx, hsx, rfl⟩
  rcases Set.mem_smul_set.mp hzy with ⟨sy, hsy, rfl⟩
  rcases Set.mem_add.mp hsx with ⟨xp, hxp, xn, hxn, hsx'⟩
  rcases Set.mem_add.mp hsy with ⟨yp, hyp, yn, hyn, hsy'⟩
  rcases Set.mem_smul_set.mp hxp with ⟨p, hp, hxp'⟩
  rcases Set.mem_smul_set.mp hxn with ⟨q, hq, hxn'⟩
  rcases Set.mem_smul_set.mp hyp with ⟨p', hp', hyp'⟩
  rcases Set.mem_smul_set.mp hyn with ⟨q', hq', hyn'⟩
  have hax : 0 ≤ a * x := mul_nonneg ha hx.1
  have hby : 0 ≤ b * y := mul_nonneg hb hy.1
  obtain ⟨p'', hp'', hpcomb⟩ :=
    exists_weighted_stab G hax hby hp hp'
  have hanx : 0 ≤ a * (1 - x) :=
    mul_nonneg ha (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.2)
  have hbny : 0 ≤ b * (1 - y) :=
    mul_nonneg hb (sub_nonneg.mpr hy.2)
  obtain ⟨q'', hq'', hqcomb⟩ :=
    exists_weighted_stab G hanx hbny hq hq'
  have hqneg :
      (-(1 - (a * x + b * y))) • q'' =
        a • (-(1 - x) • q) + b • (-(1 - y) • q') := by
    ext v
    have hqv := congrFun hqcomb v
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hqv ⊢
    have hcoeff :
        1 - (a * x + b * y) = a * (1 - x) + b * (1 - y) := by
      nlinarith
    rw [hcoeff]
    linear_combination hqv
  unfold sectionSet
  apply Set.mem_add.mpr
  refine ⟨(a * x + b * y) • p'',
    Set.smul_mem_smul_set hp'',
    (-(1 - (a * x + b * y))) • q'',
    Set.smul_mem_smul_set hq'', ?_⟩
  subst sx
  subst sy
  subst xp
  subst xn
  subst yp
  subst yn
  rw [← hpcomb, hqneg]
  module

name: HansenCograph.volume_smul_toReal
statement:
private theorem volume_smul_toReal
    {S : Set (V → ℝ)} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (volume (r • S)).toReal =
      r ^ Fintype.card V * (volume S).toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.addHaar_smul]
  simp [abs_of_nonneg hr, abs_pow, pow_nonneg hr]

name: HansenCograph.rpow_nat_pow_inv
statement:
private theorem rpow_nat_pow_inv
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hcard : Fintype.card V ≠ 0) :
    Real.rpow (r ^ Fintype.card V) ((Fintype.card V : ℝ)⁻¹) = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.rpow_eq_pow, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hr]
  have hcast : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hcard
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hcast, Real.rpow_one]

name: HansenCograph.sectionSet_smul_root
statement:
private theorem sectionSet_smul_root
    (G : SimpleGraph V) {x r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hcard : Fintype.card V ≠ 0) :
    Real.rpow (volume (r • sectionSet G x)).toReal
        ((Fintype.card V : ℝ)⁻¹) =
      r * Real.rpow (volume (sectionSet G x)).toReal
        ((Fintype.card V : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [volume_smul_toReal hr]
  simp only [Real.rpow_eq_pow]
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (pow_nonneg hr _)
    ENNReal.toReal_nonneg]
  rw [← Real.rpow_eq_pow, rpow_nat_pow_inv hr hcard]

name: HansenCograph.section_root_concave
statement:
theorem section_root_concave (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Fintype.card V = 0 ∨
      ConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
        (fun x => Real.rpow (q G x) ((Fintype.card V : ℝ)⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : Fintype.card V = 0
  · exact Or.inl hzero
  right
  let _ : Nonempty V := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero)
  refine ⟨convex_Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  have hcombo : a * x + b * y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    constructor
    · exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hx.1) (mul_nonneg hb hy.1)
    · calc
        a * x + b * y ≤ a * 1 + b * 1 := by
          exact add_le_add
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.2 ha)
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy.2 hb)
        _ = 1 := by linarith
  let A : Set (V → ℝ) := a • sectionSet G x
  let B : Set (V → ℝ) := b • sectionSet G y
  have hAcompact : IsCompact A := (isCompact_sectionSet G x).smul a
  have hBcompact : IsCompact B := (isCompact_sectionSet G y).smul b
  have hABcompact : IsCompact (A + B) := hAcompact.add hBcompact
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := by
    exact ⟨a • (0 : V → ℝ), Set.smul_mem_smul_set (zero_mem_sectionSet G x)⟩
  have hBne : B.Nonempty := by
    exact ⟨b • (0 : V → ℝ), Set.smul_mem_smul_set (zero_mem_sectionSet G y)⟩
  have hbm := brunn_minkowski_fintype_toReal
    hAne hAcompact.measurableSet hBne hBcompact.measurableSet
    hABcompact.measurableSet hAcompact.measure_lt_top.ne
    hBcompact.measure_lt_top.ne hABcompact.measure_lt_top.ne
  have hsubset : A + B ⊆ sectionSet G (a * x + b * y) := by
    exact sectionSet_combo_subset G hx hy ha hb hab
  have hvol : (volume (A + B)).toReal ≤
      (volume (sectionSet G (a * x + b * y))).toReal := by
    exact ENNReal.toReal_mono
      (isCompact_sectionSet G (a * x + b * y)).measure_lt_top.ne
      (measure_mono hsubset)
  have hrootmono :
      Real.rpow (volume (A + B)).toReal ((Fintype.card V : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        Real.rpow (volume (sectionSet G (a * x + b * y))).toReal
          ((Fintype.card V : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow ENNReal.toReal_nonneg hvol (by positivity)
  dsimp [A, B] at hbm
  simp only [← Real.rpow_eq_pow] at hbm
  rw [sectionSet_smul_root G ha hzero,
    sectionSet_smul_root G hb hzero] at hbm
  change a * Real.rpow (q G x) ((Fintype.card V : ℝ)⁻¹) +
      b * Real.rpow (q G y) ((Fintype.card V : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
    Real.rpow (q G (a * x + b * y)) ((Fintype.card V : ℝ)⁻¹)
  rw [q_eq_section_volume G hx.1 hx.2,
    q_eq_section_volume G hy.1 hy.2,
    q_eq_section_volume G hcombo.1 hcombo.2]
  exact hbm.trans hrootmono

name: HansenCograph.q_monotoneOn_half
statement:
theorem q_monotoneOn_half (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    MonotoneOn (q G) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  by_cases hzero : Fintype.card V = 0
  · have : IsEmpty V := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp hzero
    have hG : G = ⊥ := by
      ext u v
      exact isEmptyElim u
    subst G
    have huniv : (Finset.univ : Finset V) = ∅ :=
      Finset.card_eq_zero.mp (by simp)
    unfold q
    rw [huniv]
    simp [qCoeff, nuInduced, inducedFinset, nu_bot]
  · have hconc := (section_root_concave G).resolve_left hzero
    have hcardpos : 0 < Fintype.card V := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
    have hexp : 0 < ((Fintype.card V : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
      exact inv_pos.mpr (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hcardpos)
    have hxfull : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      constructor
      · exact hx.1
      · linarith [hx.2]
    have hxmirror : 1 - x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2]
    have hseg : y ∈ segment ℝ x (1 - x) := by
      rw [segment_eq_Icc (by linarith [hx.2])]
      constructor
      · exact hxy
      · linarith [hy.2]
    have hroot := hconc.ge_on_segment hxfull hxmirror hseg
    have hsymroot :
        Real.rpow (q G (1 - x)) ((Fintype.card V : ℝ)⁻¹) =
          Real.rpow (q G x) ((Fintype.card V : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
      rw [q_one_sub]
    rw [hsymroot, min_self] at hroot
    by_contra hnot
    have hlt : q G y < q G x := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    have hry : 0 ≤ q G y :=
      q_nonneg_on_unit G hy.1 (by linarith [hy.2])
    have hrootlt := Real.rpow_lt_rpow hry hlt hexp
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hroot) hrootlt

name: HansenCograph.q_symmCenterIncreasing
statement:
theorem q_symmCenterIncreasing (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    SymmCenterIncreasing (q G)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact q_one_sub G
  · exact q_monotoneOn_half G

name: HansenCograph.monovary_of_symmCenterIncreasing
statement:
theorem monovary_of_symmCenterIncreasing
    {f g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : SymmCenterIncreasing f)
    (hg : SymmCenterIncreasing g) :
    MonovaryOnUnit f g
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy
  rcases hf with ⟨hsf, hmf⟩
  rcases hg with ⟨hsg, hmg⟩
  let fold : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => min z (1 - z)
  have fold_mem (z : ℝ) (hz : z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
      fold z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    constructor
    · exact le_min hz.1 (sub_nonneg.mpr hz.2)
    · by_cases h : z ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
      · exact (min_le_left z (1 - z)).trans h
      · have hz' : 1 - z ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by linarith
        exact (min_le_right z (1 - z)).trans hz'
  have f_fold (z : ℝ) : f (fold z) = f z := by
    dsimp [fold]
    by_cases h : z ≤ 1 - z
    · rw [min_eq_left h]
    · rw [min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge h)]
      exact hsf z
  have g_fold (z : ℝ) : g (fold z) = g z := by
    dsimp [fold]
    by_cases h : z ≤ 1 - z
    · rw [min_eq_left h]
    · rw [min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge h)]
      exact hsg z
  rcases le_total (fold x) (fold y) with hxy | hyx
  · have hfx : f (fold x) ≤ f (fold y) :=
      hmf (fold_mem x hx) (fold_mem y hy) hxy
    have hgx : g (fold x) ≤ g (fold y) :=
      hmg (fold_mem x hx) (fold_mem y hy) hxy
    rw [f_fold x, f_fold y] at hfx
    rw [g_fold x, g_fold y] at hgx
    exact mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos
      (sub_nonpos.mpr hfx) (sub_nonpos.mpr hgx)
  · have hfy : f (fold y) ≤ f (fold x) :=
      hmf (fold_mem y hy) (fold_mem x hx) hyx
    have hgy : g (fold y) ≤ g (fold x) :=
      hmg (fold_mem y hy) (fold_mem x hx) hyx
    rw [f_fold y, f_fold x] at hfy
    rw [g_fold y, g_fold x] at hgy
    exact mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hfy) (sub_nonneg.mpr hgy)

name: HansenCograph.q_positive_correlation
statement:
theorem q_positive_correlation
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q A x) *
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q B x)
      ≤
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q A x * q B x
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_mul_ge_mul_integral_of_monovary
  · exact (continuous_q A).continuousOn
  · exact (continuous_q B).continuousOn
  · exact monovary_of_symmCenterIncreasing
      (q_symmCenterIncreasing A)
      (q_symmCenterIncreasing B)

name: HansenCograph.graphRho_mul_le_sum
statement:
theorem graphRho_mul_le_sum
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    graphRho A * graphRho B ≤ graphRho (A ⊕g B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphRho_sum_eq A B]
  have hcorr := q_positive_correlation A B
  have hIA : 0 < ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q A x :=
    integral_q_pos A
  have hIB : 0 < ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q B x :=
    integral_q_pos B
  have hquot :
      1 ≤
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q A x * q B x) /
          ((∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q A x) *
           (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q B x)) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hIA hIB)).2
    simpa using hcorr
  have hρ : 0 ≤ graphRho A * graphRho B :=
    mul_nonneg (graphRho_nonneg A) (graphRho_nonneg B)
  nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.mem_projectionBox_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_projectionBox_iff
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (s : Finset V) (x : V → ℝ) :
    x ∈ projectionBox G s ↔
      restrictTo s x ∈ stab (inducedFinset G s) ∧
      restrictTo sᶜ x ∈ stab (inducedFinset G sᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold projectionBox
  change splitEquiv s x ∈
      (stab (inducedFinset G s) ×ˢ stab (inducedFinset G sᶜ)) ↔ _
  rw [splitEquiv_apply]
  rfl

name: HansenCograph.stab_subset_projectionBox
statement:
private theorem stab_subset_projectionBox (G : SimpleGraph V) (s : Finset V) :
    stab G ⊆ projectionBox G s
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_projectionBox_iff]
  exact ⟨restrictTo_mem_stab G s hx, restrictTo_mem_stab G sᶜ hx⟩

name: HansenCograph.convex_projectionBox
statement:
private theorem convex_projectionBox (G : SimpleGraph V) (s : Finset V) :
    Convex ℝ (projectionBox G s)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  rw [mem_projectionBox_iff] at hx hy ⊢
  have hs : restrictTo s (a • x + b • y) =
      a • restrictTo s x + b • restrictTo s y := by
    ext v
    rfl
  have hsc : restrictTo sᶜ (a • x + b • y) =
      a • restrictTo sᶜ x + b • restrictTo sᶜ y := by
    ext v
    rfl
  rw [hs, hsc]
  constructor
  · exact (convex_stab (inducedFinset G s)) hx.1 hy.1 ha hb hab
  · exact (convex_stab (inducedFinset G sᶜ)) hx.2 hy.2 ha hb hab

name: HansenCograph.interior_projectionBox_nonempty
statement:
private theorem interior_projectionBox_nonempty
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (s : Finset V) :
    (interior (projectionBox G s)).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := interior_stab_nonempty G
  exact ⟨x, interior_mono (stab_subset_projectionBox G s) hx⟩

name: HansenCograph.projectionBox_volume_toReal
statement:
private theorem projectionBox_volume_toReal
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (s : Finset V) :
    (volume (projectionBox G s)).toReal =
      (volume (stab (inducedFinset G s))).toReal *
        (volume (stab (inducedFinset G sᶜ))).toReal
proof:
:= by
  unfold projectionBox
  rw [(splitEquiv_measurePreserving (V := V) s).measure_preimage_equiv]
  rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod, Measure.prod_prod, ENNReal.toReal_mul]

name: HansenCograph.projectionBox_volume_ne_top
statement:
private theorem projectionBox_volume_ne_top
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (s : Finset V) :
    volume (projectionBox G s) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  unfold projectionBox
  rw [(splitEquiv_measurePreserving (V := V) s).measure_preimage_equiv]
  rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod, Measure.prod_prod]
  exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top
    (volume_stab_ne_top (inducedFinset G s))
    (volume_stab_ne_top (inducedFinset G sᶜ))

name: HansenCograph.qCoeff_eq_projectionBox_volume
statement:
private theorem qCoeff_eq_projectionBox_volume
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (s : Finset V) :
    qCoeff G s = (volume (projectionBox G s)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [projectionBox_volume_toReal]
  unfold qCoeff nuInduced nu
  have hs : Fintype.card ↥(↑s : Set V) = s.card := by simp
  have hsc : Fintype.card ↥(↑sᶜ : Set V) = Fintype.card V - s.card := by
    rw [← Finset.card_compl s]
    unfold Fintype.card
    simp
  rw [hs, hsc]
  have hsf : (s.card.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hscf : ((Fintype.card V - s.card).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp

name: HansenCograph.projectionBox_empty
statement:
private theorem projectionBox_empty (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    projectionBox G ∅ = stab G
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_projectionBox_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hempty, hfull⟩
    have hext := extendZero_mem_stab G (∅ : Finset V)ᶜ hfull
    convert hext using 1
    ext v
    simp [extendZero, restrictTo]
  · intro hx
    exact (stab_subset_projectionBox G ∅) hx

name: HansenCograph.qCoeff_empty_eq_volume_stab
statement:
private theorem qCoeff_empty_eq_volume_stab (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    qCoeff G ∅ = (volume (stab G)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [qCoeff_eq_projectionBox_volume, projectionBox_empty]

name: HansenCograph.qCoeff_empty_le
statement:
private theorem qCoeff_empty_le (G : SimpleGraph V) (s : Finset V) :
    qCoeff G ∅ ≤ qCoeff G s
proof:
:= by
  rw [qCoeff_empty_eq_volume_stab, qCoeff_eq_projectionBox_volume]
  exact ENNReal.toReal_mono
    (projectionBox_volume_ne_top G s)
    (measure_mono (stab_subset_projectionBox G s))

name: HansenCograph.convex_eq_of_subset_of_volume_eq
statement:
private theorem convex_eq_of_subset_of_volume_eq
    {K L : Set (V → ℝ)}
    (hKcompact : IsCompact K) (hLconvex : Convex ℝ L)
    (hLint : (interior L).Nonempty) (hKL : K ⊆ L)
    (hvol : volume K = volume L) : K = L
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm hKL
  have hinterior : interior L ⊆ K := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hxK
    let U := interior L \ K
    have hUopen : IsOpen U :=
      isOpen_interior.sdiff hKcompact.isClosed
    have hUne : U.Nonempty := ⟨x, hx, hxK⟩
    have hUpos : 0 < volume U := hUopen.measure_pos volume hUne
    have hUsub : U ⊆ L \ K := by
      exact Set.sdiff_subset_sdiff interior_subset (Set.Subset.rfl)
    have hdiff : volume (L \ K) = 0 := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.measure_sdiff hKL hKcompact.measurableSet.nullMeasurableSet
        hKcompact.measure_lt_top.ne, ← hvol, tsub_self]
    have hmono : (volume : Measure (V → ℝ)) U ≤ volume (L \ K) :=
      measure_mono hUsub
    rw [hdiff] at hmono
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hmono) hUpos
  have hclosure : closure (interior L) ⊆ K :=
    closure_minimal hinterior hKcompact.isClosed
  intro x hx
  apply hclosure
  rw [hLconvex.closure_interior_eq_closure_of_nonempty_interior hLint]
  exact subset_closure hx

name: HansenCograph.qCoeff_singleton_lt_of_adj
proof:
:= by
  have hle := qCoeff_empty_le G {u}
  rcases hle.lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
  · exact hlt
  · exfalso
    have hreal :
        (volume (stab G)).toReal =
          (volume (projectionBox G {u})).toReal := by
      rw [← qCoeff_empty_eq_volume_stab G,
        ← qCoeff_eq_projectionBox_volume G {u}]
      exact heq
    have hvol : volume (stab G) = volume (projectionBox G {u}) := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · exact (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal
          (volume_stab_ne_top G)
          (projectionBox_volume_ne_top G {u})).mp hreal.le
      · exact (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal
          (projectionBox_volume_ne_top G {u})
          (volume_stab_ne_top G)).mp hreal.ge
    have hsets : stab G = projectionBox G {u} :=
      convex_eq_of_subset_of_volume_eq
        (isCompact_stab G) (convex_projectionBox G {u})
        (interior_projectionBox_nonempty G {u})
        (stab_subset_projectionBox G {u}) hvol
    have hzbox : indicator ({u, v} : Finset V) ∈ projectionBox G {u} := by
      rw [mem_projectionBox_iff]
      constructor
      · rw [restrictTo_indicator]
        apply indicator_mem_stab
        intro a ha b hb hab
        exfalso
        apply hab
        apply Subtype.ext
        have ha' : (a : V) = u := by simpa using a.property
        have hb' : (b : V) = u := by simpa using b.property
        exact ha'.trans hb'.symm
      · rw [restrictTo_indicator]
        apply indicator_mem_stab
        intro a ha b hb hab
        exfalso
        apply hab
        apply Subtype.ext
        have ha' : (a : V) = u ∨ (a : V) = v := by
          simpa [restrictFinset] using ha
        have hb' : (b : V) = u ∨ (b : V) = v := by
          simpa [restrictFinset] using hb
        have hau : (a : V) ≠ u := by simpa using a.property
        have hbu : (b : V) ≠ u := by simpa using b.property
        exact (ha'.resolve_left hau).trans (hb'.resolve_left hbu).symm
    have hz : indicator ({u, v} : Finset V) ∈ stab G := by
      rw [hsets]
      exact hzbox
    have hedge := stab_edge_ineq G hz huv
    have hu_mem : u ∈ ({u, v} : Finset V) := by simp
    have hv_mem : v ∈ ({u, v} : Finset V) := by simp
    rw [indicator_apply_mem hu_mem, indicator_apply_mem hv_mem] at hedge
    norm_num at hedge

name: HansenCograph.q_zero_eq_qCoeff_empty
statement:
private theorem q_zero_eq_qCoeff_empty (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    q G 0 = qCoeff G ∅
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold q
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ∅]
  · simp
  · intro s hs hne
    have hcard : 0 < s.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr (Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hne)
    simp [zero_pow hcard.ne']
  · simp

name: HansenCograph.q_mid_eq_scaled_coeff_sum
statement:
private theorem q_mid_eq_scaled_coeff_sum (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    q G (1 / 2 : ℝ) =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card V *
        ∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset V).powerset, qCoeff G s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold q
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s hs
  have hcard : s.card + (Fintype.card V - s.card) = Fintype.card V :=
    Nat.add_sub_of_le (Finset.card_le_univ s)
  norm_num
  calc
    qCoeff G s * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ s.card *
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card V - s.card) =
        qCoeff G s * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ s.card *
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card V - s.card)) := by ring
    _ = qCoeff G s * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card V := by
      rw [← pow_add, hcard]
    _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card V * qCoeff G s := by ring

name: HansenCograph.q_mid_gt_endpoint_of_adj
statement:
private theorem q_mid_gt_endpoint_of_adj
    (G : SimpleGraph V) {u v : V} (huv : G.Adj u v) :
    q G 0 < q G (1 / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a := qCoeff G ∅
  let P := (Finset.univ : Finset V).powerset
  have hsum :
      (∑ _s ∈ P, a) < ∑ s ∈ P, qCoeff G s := by
    apply Finset.sum_lt_sum
    · intro s hs
      exact qCoeff_empty_le G s
    · refine ⟨{u}, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [P]
      · exact qCoeff_singleton_lt_of_adj G huv
  have hscale : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card V := by positivity
  have hscaled := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hsum hscale
  rw [q_zero_eq_qCoeff_empty, q_mid_eq_scaled_coeff_sum]
  change a < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card V * ∑ s ∈ P, qCoeff G s
  calc
    a = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card V * ∑ _s ∈ P, a := by
      simp [P]
    _ < _ := hscaled

name: HansenCograph.centrallySymmetric_stab_of_q_mid_eq_endpoint
statement:
theorem centrallySymmetric_stab_of_q_mid_eq_endpoint
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (h : q G (1 / 2 : ℝ) = q G 0) :
    ∃ c : V → ℝ,
      ∀ x : V → ℝ,
        x ∈ stab G ↔ (2 • c - x) ∈ stab G
proof:
:= by
  have hG : G = ⊥ := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro u v huv
      have hstrict := q_mid_gt_endpoint_of_adj G huv
      linarith
    · exact bot_le
  refine ⟨fun _ => (1 / 2 : ℝ), ?_⟩
  rw [hG, stab_bot]
  intro x
  simp only [Set.mem_Icc, Pi.le_def, Pi.zero_apply, Pi.one_apply,
    Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply]
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨hlower, hupper⟩ <;> constructor <;> intro v
  all_goals specialize hlower v
  all_goals specialize hupper v
  all_goals norm_num at *
  all_goals linarith

name: HansenCograph.stab_symmetry_center_eq_half
statement:
theorem stab_symmetry_center_eq_half
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {c : V → ℝ}
    (hc :
      ∀ x : V → ℝ,
        x ∈ stab G ↔ (2 • c - x) ∈ stab G) :
    c = fun _ => (1 / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  funext v
  have hzero : (0 : V → ℝ) ∈ stab G := zero_mem_stab G
  have hreflectZero : (2 • c - (0 : V → ℝ)) ∈ stab G :=
    (hc (0 : V → ℝ)).mp hzero
  have hupper := stab_coordinate_le_one G hreflectZero v
  have hsingleton : indicator ({v} : Finset V) ∈ stab G := by
    apply indicator_mem_stab
    simp
  have hreflectSingleton :
      (2 • c - indicator ({v} : Finset V)) ∈ stab G :=
    (hc (indicator ({v} : Finset V))).mp hsingleton
  have hlower := stab_coordinate_nonneg G hreflectSingleton v
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.zero_apply,
    indicator_apply_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self v)] at hupper hlower
  norm_num at hupper hlower ⊢
  linarith

name: HansenCograph.allOnes_mem_stab_of_centrallySymmetric
statement:
theorem allOnes_mem_stab_of_centrallySymmetric
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hsym :
      ∃ c : V → ℝ,
        ∀ x : V → ℝ,
          x ∈ stab G ↔ (2 • c - x) ∈ stab G) :
    (fun _ : V => (1 : ℝ)) ∈ stab G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hsym
  have hc' : c = fun _ : V => (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    stab_symmetry_center_eq_half G hc
  subst c
  have h0 : (0 : V → ℝ) ∈ stab G :=
    zero_mem_stab G
  have hreflect := (hc (0 : V → ℝ)).mp h0
  convert hreflect using 1
  ext v
  norm_num [Pi.smul_apply]

name: HansenCograph.eq_bot_of_allOnes_mem_stab
statement:
theorem eq_bot_of_allOnes_mem_stab
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (h1 : (fun _ : V => (1 : ℝ)) ∈ stab G) :
    G = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro u v huv
    have hineq := stab_edge_ineq G h1 huv
    norm_num at hineq
  · exact bot_le

name: HansenCograph.q_bot_eq_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem q_bot_eq_one (x : ℝ) :
    q (⊥ : SimpleGraph V) x = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcoeff (s : Finset V) :
      qCoeff (⊥ : SimpleGraph V) s = 1 := by
    unfold qCoeff nuInduced inducedFinset
    change nu (⊥ : SimpleGraph ↥(↑s : Set V)) *
        nu (⊥ : SimpleGraph ↥(↑sᶜ : Set V)) /
          ((s.card.factorial : ℝ) *
            ((Fintype.card V - s.card).factorial : ℝ)) = 1
    simp only [nu_bot, Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard,
      Set.ncard_coe_finset, Finset.card_compl]
    field_simp
  unfold q
  simp_rw [hcoeff, one_mul]
  rw [show (∑ s ∈ Finset.univ.powerset,
      x ^ s.card * (1 - x) ^ (Fintype.card V - s.card)) =
      (x + (1 - x)) ^ Fintype.card V by
        simpa using Finset.sum_pow_mul_eq_add_pow
          x (1 - x) (Finset.univ : Finset V)]
  simp

name: HansenCograph.q_bot_constant
statement:
theorem q_bot_constant :
    IsConstantFunction (q (⊥ : SimpleGraph V))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  rw [q_bot_eq_one, q_bot_eq_one]

name: HansenCograph.q_constant_iff_edgeless
statement:
theorem q_constant_iff_edgeless (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    IsConstantFunction (q G) ↔ G = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hq
    have hmid : q G (1 / 2 : ℝ) = q G 0 :=
      hq _ _
    have hsym :=
      centrallySymmetric_stab_of_q_mid_eq_endpoint G hmid
    exact eq_bot_of_allOnes_mem_stab G
      (allOnes_mem_stab_of_centrallySymmetric G hsym)
  · intro hG
    subst G
    exact q_bot_constant

name: HansenCograph.q_mid_gt_endpoint_of_nonconstant
statement:
theorem q_mid_gt_endpoint_of_nonconstant
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (h : ¬ IsConstantFunction (q G)) :
    q G 0 < q G (1 / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : q G 0 ≤ q G (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    apply q_monotoneOn_half G
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne hle
  intro heq
  have hmid : q G (1 / 2 : ℝ) = q G 0 := heq.symm
  have hsym := centrallySymmetric_stab_of_q_mid_eq_endpoint G hmid
  have hG : G = ⊥ :=
    eq_bot_of_allOnes_mem_stab G
      (allOnes_mem_stab_of_centrallySymmetric G hsym)
  exact h ((q_constant_iff_edgeless G).mpr hG)

name: HansenCograph.q_strict_positive_correlation
statement:
theorem q_strict_positive_correlation
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (hA : ¬ IsConstantFunction (q A))
    (hB : ¬ IsConstantFunction (q B)) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q A x) *
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q B x)
      <
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q A x * q B x
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_mul_gt_mul_integral_of_strict_monovary
  · exact (continuous_q A).continuousOn
  · exact (continuous_q B).continuousOn
  · exact monovary_of_symmCenterIncreasing
      (q_symmCenterIncreasing A)
      (q_symmCenterIncreasing B)
  · refine ⟨(1 / 2 : ℝ), 0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · have hA' := q_mid_gt_endpoint_of_nonconstant A hA
      have hB' := q_mid_gt_endpoint_of_nonconstant B hB
      nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hA') (sub_pos.mpr hB')]

name: HansenCograph.graphRho_sum_eq_mul_iff
statement:
theorem graphRho_sum_eq_mul_iff
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    graphRho (A ⊕g B) = graphRho A * graphRho B
      ↔ A = ⊥ ∨ B = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hEq
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    obtain ⟨hAne, hBne⟩ := h
    have hqA : ¬ IsConstantFunction (q A) := by
      intro hconst
      exact hAne ((q_constant_iff_edgeless A).mp hconst)
    have hqB : ¬ IsConstantFunction (q B) := by
      intro hconst
      exact hBne ((q_constant_iff_edgeless B).mp hconst)
    have hstrict :=
      q_strict_positive_correlation A B hqA hqB
    have hIA : 0 < ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q A x :=
      integral_q_pos A
    have hIB : 0 < ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q B x :=
      integral_q_pos B
    have hfactor :
        1 <
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q A x * q B x) /
            ((∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q A x) *
             (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q B x)) := by
      apply (lt_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hIA hIB)).2
      simpa using hstrict
    rw [graphRho_sum_eq A B] at hEq
    have hρ : 0 < graphRho A * graphRho B := by
      exact mul_pos (graphRho_pos A) (graphRho_pos B)
    nlinarith
  · rintro (hA | hB)
    · subst A
      have hfun : q (⊥ : SimpleGraph V) =
          fun _ => q (⊥ : SimpleGraph V) 0 := by
        funext x
        exact q_bot_constant x 0
      have hcov :
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1,
              q (⊥ : SimpleGraph V) x * q B x) =
            (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q (⊥ : SimpleGraph V) x) *
              (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q B x) := by
        rw [hfun]
        simp
      rw [graphRho_sum_eq, hcov,
        div_self (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (integral_q_pos _))
          (ne_of_gt (integral_q_pos B))), mul_one]
    · subst B
      have hfun : q (⊥ : SimpleGraph W) =
          fun _ => q (⊥ : SimpleGraph W) 0 := by
        funext x
        exact q_bot_constant x 0
      have hcov :
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1,
              q A x * q (⊥ : SimpleGraph W) x) =
            (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q A x) *
              (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q (⊥ : SimpleGraph W) x) := by
        rw [hfun]
        simp
      rw [graphRho_sum_eq, hcov,
        div_self (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (integral_q_pos A))
          (ne_of_gt (integral_q_pos _))), mul_one]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinFacetLabel_distinguishedJoinFacetPair
statement:
@[simp] theorem joinFacetLabel_distinguishedJoinFacetPair
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    joinFacetLabel A B (distinguishedJoinFacetPair A B) =
      positiveDistinguishedFacet (A ⊗g B)
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · apply Subtype.ext
    simp [distinguishedJoinFacetPair, positiveDistinguishedFacet,
      emptyHansenFacet, joinFacetLabel, sumFinset]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenJoinFaceEquiv_distinguished_iff
statement:
theorem hansenJoinFaceEquiv_distinguished_iff
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) (C : AbstractJoinFace A B) :
    (hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B C).IsInPositiveDistinguishedFacet ↔
      distinguishedJoinFacetPair A B ∈ (C : Set _)
proof:
:= by
  change positiveDistinguishedFacet (A ⊗g B) ∈
      joinFacetLabelEquiv A B '' (C : Set _) ↔ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨facet, hfacet, hmap⟩
    have hpair : facet = distinguishedJoinFacetPair A B := by
      apply (joinFacetLabelEquiv A B).injective
      exact hmap.trans (joinFacetLabel_distinguishedJoinFacetPair A B).symm
    simpa [hpair] using hfacet
  · intro hpair
    exact ⟨distinguishedJoinFacetPair A B, hpair,
      joinFacetLabel_distinguishedJoinFacetPair A B⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinRootedPos_distinguished_iff
statement:
theorem joinRootedPos_distinguished_iff
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (F : RootedPos A) (K : RootedPos B) :
    (joinRootedPos A B F K).IsInPositiveDistinguishedFacet ↔
      F.1.IsInPositiveDistinguishedFacet ∧
        K.1.IsInPositiveDistinguishedFacet
proof:
:= by
  unfold joinRootedPos
  rw [hansenJoinFaceEquiv_distinguished_iff]
  rfl

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinNeutral_distinguished_iff
statement:
theorem joinNeutral_distinguished_iff
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (F : NeutralOrEmpty A) (K : NeutralOrEmpty B) :
    (joinNeutral A B F K).IsInPositiveDistinguishedFacet ↔
      F.1.IsInPositiveDistinguishedFacet ∧
        K.1.IsInPositiveDistinguishedFacet
proof:
:= by
  unfold joinNeutral
  rw [hansenJoinFaceEquiv_distinguished_iff]
  rfl

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.faceStrataCodeToFace_surjective
statement:
theorem faceStrataCodeToFace_surjective (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Function.Surjective (faceStrataCodeToFace G)
proof:
:= by
  intro F
  rcases strata_cases G F with htop | hpos | hneg | hneutral
  · exact ⟨Sum.inl PUnit.unit, by simpa [faceStrataCodeToFace] using htop.symm⟩
  · exact ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inl ⟨F, hpos⟩), rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl ⟨F, hneg⟩)), rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr ⟨F, hneutral⟩)), rfl⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.faceStrataCodeToFace_injective
statement:
theorem faceStrataCodeToFace_injective (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Function.Injective (faceStrataCodeToFace G)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  rcases x with x | x
  · rcases y with y | y
    · rfl
    · rcases y with y | y
      · exfalso
        simp only [faceStrataCodeToFace] at h
        apply y.2.2
        rw [← h]
        exact containsVertex_top G (emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.neg)
      · rcases y with y | y
        · exfalso
          simp only [faceStrataCodeToFace] at h
          apply y.2.2
          rw [← h]
          exact containsVertex_top G (emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos)
        · exfalso
          simp only [faceStrataCodeToFace] at h
          apply y.2.1
          rw [← h]
          exact containsVertex_top G (emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos)
  · rcases x with x | x
    · rcases y with y | y
      · exfalso
        simp only [faceStrataCodeToFace] at h
        apply x.2.2
        rw [h]
        exact containsVertex_top G (emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.neg)
      · rcases y with y | y
        · simp only [faceStrataCodeToFace] at h
          exact congrArg Sum.inr (congrArg Sum.inl (Subtype.ext h))
        · rcases y with y | y
          · exfalso
            simp only [faceStrataCodeToFace] at h
            apply x.2.2
            rw [h]
            exact y.2.1
          · exfalso
            simp only [faceStrataCodeToFace] at h
            apply y.2.1
            rw [← h]
            exact x.2.1
    · rcases x with x | x
      · rcases y with y | y
        · exfalso
          simp only [faceStrataCodeToFace] at h
          apply x.2.2
          rw [h]
          exact containsVertex_top G (emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos)
        · rcases y with y | y
          · exfalso
            simp only [faceStrataCodeToFace] at h
            apply x.2.2
            rw [h]
            exact y.2.1
          · rcases y with y | y
            · simp only [faceStrataCodeToFace] at h
              exact congrArg Sum.inr (congrArg Sum.inr
                (congrArg Sum.inl (Subtype.ext h)))
            · exfalso
              simp only [faceStrataCodeToFace] at h
              apply y.2.2
              rw [← h]
              exact x.2.1
      · rcases y with y | y
        · exfalso
          simp only [faceStrataCodeToFace] at h
          apply x.2.1
          rw [h]
          exact containsVertex_top G (emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos)
        · rcases y with y | y
          · exfalso
            simp only [faceStrataCodeToFace] at h
            apply x.2.1
            rw [h]
            exact y.2.1
          · rcases y with y | y
            · exfalso
              simp only [faceStrataCodeToFace] at h
              apply x.2.2
              rw [h]
              exact y.2.1
            · simp only [faceStrataCodeToFace] at h
              exact congrArg Sum.inr (congrArg Sum.inr
                (congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext h)))

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.bottom_isNeutralOrEmpty
statement:
theorem bottom_isNeutralOrEmpty (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    (bottom G).IsNeutralOrEmpty
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro hcontains
  · exact emptyHansenVertex_not_incident_same_sign G HansenSign.pos
      (hcontains (emptyHansenFacet G HansenSign.pos)
        (by change _ ∈ (Set.univ : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)); exact Set.mem_univ _))
  · exact emptyHansenVertex_not_incident_same_sign G HansenSign.neg
      (hcontains (emptyHansenFacet G HansenSign.neg)
        (by change _ ∈ (Set.univ : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)); exact Set.mem_univ _))

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.bottom_isInPositiveDistinguishedFacet
statement:
@[simp] theorem bottom_isInPositiveDistinguishedFacet (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    (bottom G).IsInPositiveDistinguishedFacet
proof:
:= by
  change positiveDistinguishedFacet G ∈ (Set.univ : Set (HansenFacetLabel G))
  exact Set.mem_univ _

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.distinguishedStrataToFace_injective
statement:
theorem distinguishedStrataToFace_injective (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Function.Injective (distinguishedStrataToFace G)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  rcases x with x | x <;> rcases y with y | y
  · exact congrArg Sum.inl (Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext
      (congrArg (fun z : DistinguishedFace G ↦ z.1) h)))
  · exfalso
    have hface := congrArg (fun z : DistinguishedFace G ↦ z.1) h
    change x.1.1 = y.1.1 at hface
    apply y.1.2.1
    rw [← hface]
    exact x.1.2.1
  · exfalso
    have hface := congrArg (fun z : DistinguishedFace G ↦ z.1) h
    change x.1.1 = y.1.1 at hface
    apply x.1.2.1
    rw [hface]
    exact y.1.2.1
  · exact congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext
      (congrArg (fun z : DistinguishedFace G ↦ z.1) h)))

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.distinguishedStrataToFace_surjective
statement:
theorem distinguishedStrataToFace_surjective (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Function.Surjective (distinguishedStrataToFace G)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨F, hdist⟩
  rcases strata_cases G F with htop | hpos | hneg | hneutral
  · subst F
    change positiveDistinguishedFacet G ∈ (∅ : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)) at hdist
    exact hdist.elim
  · exact ⟨Sum.inl ⟨⟨F, hpos⟩, hdist⟩, rfl⟩
  · have hsign := hneg.facet_sign hdist
    simp [positiveDistinguishedFacet, emptyHansenFacet] at hsign
  · exact ⟨Sum.inr ⟨⟨F, hneutral⟩, hdist⟩, rfl⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.distinguishedEmptyOrNonemptyToFace_bijective
statement:
theorem distinguishedEmptyOrNonemptyToFace_bijective (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Function.Bijective (distinguishedEmptyOrNonemptyToFace G)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    rcases x with x | x <;> rcases y with y | y
    · rfl
    · exfalso
      apply y.2
      exact congrArg (fun z : DistinguishedFace G ↦ z.1) h |>.symm
    · exfalso
      apply x.2
      exact congrArg (fun z : DistinguishedFace G ↦ z.1) h
    · exact congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext h)
  · intro F
    by_cases hbottom : F.1 = bottom G
    · exact ⟨Sum.inl PUnit.unit, Subtype.ext hbottom.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨Sum.inr ⟨F, hbottom⟩, rfl⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenFaceDualEquiv_facet_mem
statement:
theorem hansenFaceDualEquiv_facet_mem
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (F : HansenCombinatorialFace G)
    (vertex : HansenVertexLabel G) :
    vertexComplFacetEquiv G vertex ∈
        ((hansenFaceDualEquiv G F : HansenCombinatorialFace Gᶜ) :
          Set (HansenFacetLabel Gᶜ)) ↔
      F.ContainsVertex vertex
proof:
:= by
  change vertexComplFacetEquiv G vertex ∈
      vertexComplFacetEquiv G ''
        incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) F ↔ _
  simp [ContainsVertex]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenFaceDualEquiv_contains_facet
statement:
theorem hansenFaceDualEquiv_contains_facet
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (F : HansenCombinatorialFace G)
    (facet : HansenFacetLabel G) :
    (hansenFaceDualEquiv G F).ContainsVertex
        (facetComplVertexEquiv G facet) ↔ facet ∈ (F : Set _)
proof:
:= by
  have h := incidenceClosedTransportSurjEquiv_models
    (dualIncidence (hansenLabelIncidence G))
    (hansenLabelIncidence Gᶜ)
    (facetComplVertexEquiv G) (vertexComplFacetEquiv G)
    (facetComplVertexEquiv G).surjective
    (fun f v ↦ hansenLabelIncidence_compl_transpose G v f)
    (incidenceClosedDual (hansenLabelIncidence G) F) facet
  change (hansenFaceDualEquiv G F).ContainsVertex
      (facetComplVertexEquiv G facet) ↔
    facet ∈ incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence G) F at h
  have hclosed : incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence G) (F : Set _) =
      (F : Set _) := F.isClosed
  rw [hclosed] at h
  exact h

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenFaceDualEquiv_symm_contains
statement:
theorem hansenFaceDualEquiv_symm_contains
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (F : HansenCombinatorialFace Gᶜ)
    (vertex : HansenVertexLabel G) :
    ((hansenFaceDualEquiv G).symm F).ContainsVertex vertex ↔
      vertexComplFacetEquiv G vertex ∈ (F : Set _)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hansenFaceDualEquiv_facet_mem G
    ((hansenFaceDualEquiv G).symm F) vertex]
  simp

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenCentralFaceEquiv_facet_mem
statement:
theorem hansenCentralFaceEquiv_facet_mem
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (F : HansenCombinatorialFace G)
    (facet : HansenFacetLabel G) :
    facetSignFlipEquiv G facet ∈
        ((hansenCentralFaceEquiv G F : HansenCombinatorialFace G) : Set _) ↔
      facet ∈ (F : Set _)
proof:
:= by
  change facetSignFlipEquiv G facet ∈ facetSignFlipEquiv G '' (F : Set _) ↔ _
  simp

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenFaceDualEquiv_top
statement:
theorem hansenFaceDualEquiv_top (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    hansenFaceDualEquiv G (top G) = bottom Gᶜ
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : (hansenFaceDualEquiv G).symm (bottom Gᶜ) = top G := by
    apply (eq_top_iff_contains_both G _).mpr
    constructor
    · rw [hansenFaceDualEquiv_symm_contains]
      change vertexComplFacetEquiv G (emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos) ∈
        (Set.univ : Set (HansenFacetLabel Gᶜ))
      exact Set.mem_univ _
    · rw [hansenFaceDualEquiv_symm_contains]
      change vertexComplFacetEquiv G (emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.neg) ∈
        (Set.univ : Set (HansenFacetLabel Gᶜ))
      exact Set.mem_univ _
  apply (hansenFaceDualEquiv G).symm.injective
  simpa [hinv]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.distinguishedNonemptyFaceCount_eq
statement:
theorem distinguishedNonemptyFaceCount_eq (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Fintype.card (DistinguishedNonemptyFace G) =
      cornerFaceCount G + neutralDistinguishedOrEmptyCount G - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hstrata := Fintype.card_congr (distinguishedStrataEquiv G)
  have hempty := Fintype.card_congr (distinguishedEmptyOrNonemptyEquiv G)
  have hstrata' : cornerFaceCount G + neutralDistinguishedOrEmptyCount G =
      Fintype.card (DistinguishedFace G) := by
    simpa [cornerFaceCount, neutralDistinguishedOrEmptyCount] using hstrata
  have hempty' : 1 + Fintype.card (DistinguishedNonemptyFace G) =
      Fintype.card (DistinguishedFace G) := by
    simpa using hempty
  omega

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rootedFaceCount_compl_add_one
statement:
theorem rootedFaceCount_compl_add_one (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    1 + rootedFaceCount Gᶜ =
      cornerFaceCount G + neutralDistinguishedOrEmptyCount G
proof:
:= by
  have hroot := Fintype.card_congr (rootedDistinguishedEquiv Gᶜ)
  have hstrata := Fintype.card_congr (distinguishedStrataEquiv G)
  have hempty := Fintype.card_congr (distinguishedEmptyOrNonemptyEquiv G)
  have hroot' : rootedFaceCount Gᶜ =
      Fintype.card (DistinguishedNonemptyFace G) := by
    simpa [rootedFaceCount] using hroot
  have hstrata' : cornerFaceCount G + neutralDistinguishedOrEmptyCount G =
      Fintype.card (DistinguishedFace G) := by
    simpa [cornerFaceCount, neutralDistinguishedOrEmptyCount] using hstrata
  have hempty' : 1 + Fintype.card (DistinguishedNonemptyFace G) =
      Fintype.card (DistinguishedFace G) := by
    simpa using hempty
  omega

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rootedFaceCount_compl_int
statement:
theorem rootedFaceCount_compl_int (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    (rootedFaceCount Gᶜ : ℤ) =
      (cornerFaceCount G : ℤ) +
        (neutralDistinguishedOrEmptyCount G : ℤ) - 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Int.ofNat (rootedFaceCount_compl_add_one G)
  norm_num at h ⊢
  omega

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.cornerFaceCount_compl
statement:
theorem cornerFaceCount_compl (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    cornerFaceCount Gᶜ = cornerFaceCount G
proof:
:= by
  simpa [cornerFaceCount] using
    (Fintype.card_congr (cornerComplEquiv G)).symm

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rootedFaceCount_join
statement:
theorem rootedFaceCount_join (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    rootedFaceCount (A ⊗g B) = rootedFaceCount A * rootedFaceCount B
proof:
:= by
  simpa [rootedFaceCount] using Fintype.card_congr (joinRootedPosEquiv A B).symm

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.neutralOrEmptyFaceCount_join
statement:
theorem neutralOrEmptyFaceCount_join
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    neutralOrEmptyFaceCount (A ⊗g B) =
      neutralOrEmptyFaceCount A * neutralOrEmptyFaceCount B
proof:
:= by
  simpa [neutralOrEmptyFaceCount] using
    Fintype.card_congr (joinNeutralEquiv A B).symm

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.cornerFaceCount_join
statement:
theorem cornerFaceCount_join (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    cornerFaceCount (A ⊗g B) = cornerFaceCount A * cornerFaceCount B
proof:
:= by
  simpa [cornerFaceCount] using Fintype.card_congr (joinCornerEquiv A B).symm

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.neutralDistinguishedOrEmptyCount_join
statement:
theorem neutralDistinguishedOrEmptyCount_join
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    neutralDistinguishedOrEmptyCount (A ⊗g B) =
      neutralDistinguishedOrEmptyCount A *
        neutralDistinguishedOrEmptyCount B
proof:
:= by
  simpa [neutralDistinguishedOrEmptyCount] using
    Fintype.card_congr (joinNeutralDistinguishedEquiv A B).symm

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rootedNegFaceCount_eq
statement:
theorem rootedNegFaceCount_eq (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Fintype.card (RootedNeg G) = rootedFaceCount G
proof:
:= by
  simpa [rootedFaceCount] using
    Fintype.card_congr (rootedPosNegEquiv G).symm

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenFaceCount_eq_strata
statement:
theorem hansenFaceCount_eq_strata (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Fintype.card (HansenCombinatorialFace G) =
      1 + 2 * rootedFaceCount G + neutralOrEmptyFaceCount G
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fintype.card_congr (faceStrataEquiv G)]
  simp [FaceStrataCode, rootedFaceCount, neutralOrEmptyFaceCount,
    rootedNegFaceCount_eq]
  omega

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenNonemptyFaceCount_eq_strata
statement:
theorem hansenNonemptyFaceCount_eq_strata (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    hansenNonemptyFaceCount G =
      2 * rootedFaceCount G + neutralOrEmptyFaceCount G
proof:
:= by
  rw [hansenNonemptyFaceCount, hansenFaceCount_eq_strata]
  omega

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenFaceCount_join
statement:
theorem hansenFaceCount_join (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    Fintype.card (HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B)) =
      1 + 2 * (rootedFaceCount A * rootedFaceCount B) +
        neutralOrEmptyFaceCount A * neutralOrEmptyFaceCount B
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fintype.card_congr (joinFaceCodeEquiv A B)]
  simp [JoinFaceCode, rootedFaceCount, neutralOrEmptyFaceCount,
    rootedNegFaceCount_eq]
  omega

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPointedFaceState_wellFormed
statement:
theorem hansenPointedFaceState_wellFormed (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    (hansenPointedFaceState G).WellFormed
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rfl
  · dsimp [hansenPointedFaceState]
    ring

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPointedFaceState_s
statement:
theorem hansenPointedFaceState_s (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    (hansenPointedFaceState G).s = (hansenNonemptyFaceCount G : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [hansenPointedFaceState, hansenNonemptyFaceCount_eq_strata]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPointedFaceState_join
statement:
theorem hansenPointedFaceState_join
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    hansenPointedFaceState (A ⊗g B) =
      (hansenPointedFaceState A).join (hansenPointedFaceState B)
proof:
:= by
  unfold hansenPointedFaceState PointedFaceState.join
  congr 1 <;>
    simp [
      rootedFaceCount_join, neutralOrEmptyFaceCount_join,
      cornerFaceCount_join, neutralDistinguishedOrEmptyCount_join] <;>
    ring

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPointedFaceState_compl
statement:
theorem hansenPointedFaceState_compl (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    hansenPointedFaceState Gᶜ = (hansenPointedFaceState G).dual
proof:
:= by
  unfold hansenPointedFaceState PointedFaceState.dual
  congr 1
  · calc
      2 * (rootedFaceCount Gᶜ : ℤ) + (neutralOrEmptyFaceCount Gᶜ : ℤ) =
          (hansenNonemptyFaceCount Gᶜ : ℤ) := by
            exact hansenPointedFaceState_s Gᶜ
      _ = (hansenNonemptyFaceCount G : ℤ) := by
            rw [hansenNonemptyFaceCount_compl]
      _ = 2 * (rootedFaceCount G : ℤ) +
          (neutralOrEmptyFaceCount G : ℤ) := (hansenPointedFaceState_s G).symm
  · exact rootedFaceCount_compl_int G
  · simpa using (rootedFaceCount_compl_int Gᶜ).symm
  · change (cornerFaceCount Gᶜ : ℤ) = (cornerFaceCount G : ℤ)
    exact_mod_cast cornerFaceCount_compl G
  · rw [rootedFaceCount_compl_int, cornerFaceCount_compl]
    ring
  · have h := rootedFaceCount_compl_int Gᶜ
    simp only [compl_compl] at h
    rw [cornerFaceCount_compl] at h
    change (neutralDistinguishedOrEmptyCount Gᶜ : ℤ) =
      (rootedFaceCount G : ℤ) - (cornerFaceCount G : ℤ) + 1
    linarith

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.compl_sum_eq_join_compl
statement:
theorem compl_sum_eq_join_compl (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    (A ⊕g B)ᶜ = Aᶜ ⊗g Bᶜ
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  rcases x with x | x <;> rcases y with y | y <;> simp

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPointedFaceState_sum
statement:
theorem hansenPointedFaceState_sum
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    hansenPointedFaceState (A ⊕g B) =
      (hansenPointedFaceState A).union (hansenPointedFaceState B)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hansenPointedFaceState_compl (A ⊕g B)
  rw [compl_sum_eq_join_compl, hansenPointedFaceState_join,
    hansenPointedFaceState_compl A, hansenPointedFaceState_compl B] at h
  have hd := congrArg PointedFaceState.dual h
  simpa [PointedFaceState.union] using hd.symm

name: HansenCograph.portalRankCompatible_iff
statement:
theorem portalRankCompatible_iff (s k l : ℕ) :
    PortalRankCompatible s k l ↔ k + l = s
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: HansenCograph.restrictedProduct_rank_sum
statement:
theorem restrictedProduct_rank_sum
    {s k l : ℕ} (h : PortalRankCompatible s k l) : k + l = s

name: HansenCograph.restrictedProduct_upper_rank_sum
statement:
theorem restrictedProduct_upper_rank_sum
    {n m s k l : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ n) (hl : l ≤ m) (h : PortalRankCompatible s k l) :
    n + m - s = (n - k) + (m - l)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [PortalRankCompatible] at h
  omega

name: HansenCograph.card_restrictedProductPortalChain
statement:
theorem card_restrictedProductPortalChain
    (n m s k l a b : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (RestrictedProductPortalChain n m s k l a b) =
      a * b * Nat.choose (k + l) k * Nat.choose (n + m - s) (n - k)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Nat.mul_assoc]

name: HansenCograph.restrictedProductPortalCount_eq
statement:
theorem restrictedProductPortalCount_eq
    (n m s : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℕ) :
    restrictedProductPortalCount n m s a b =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        if PortalRankCompatible s k l then
          a k * b l * Nat.choose (k + l) k *
            Nat.choose (n + m - s) (n - k)
        else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold restrictedProductPortalCount
  simp_rw [card_restrictedProductPortalChain]

name: HansenCograph.restrictedProductPortalCount_cast_eq_portalShuffleConvolution
statement:
theorem restrictedProductPortalCount_cast_eq_portalShuffleConvolution
    (n m s : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℕ) :
    (restrictedProductPortalCount n m s a b : ℝ) =
      portalShuffleConvolution n m (fun k ↦ (a k : ℝ))
        (fun l ↦ (b l : ℝ)) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrictedProductPortalCount_eq]
  unfold portalShuffleConvolution portalShuffleKernel
  simp only [Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_ite, Nat.cast_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro l hl
  by_cases h : k + l = s
  · simp [PortalRankCompatible, h]
    ring
  · simp [PortalRankCompatible, h]

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem RankedFlag.ext {P : Type u} [PartialOrder P] [BoundedOrder P]
    {n : ℕ} {f g : RankedFlag P n} (h : ∀ k, f k = g k) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  cases f
  cases g
  simp only [mk.injEq]
  exact funext h

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.strictMono
statement:
theorem RankedFlag.strictMono {P : Type u} [PartialOrder P] [BoundedOrder P]
    {n : ℕ} (f : RankedFlag P n) : StrictMono f
proof:
:=
  Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.mpr fun k ↦ (f.covBy_succ k).lt

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.injective
statement:
theorem RankedFlag.injective {P : Type u} [PartialOrder P] [BoundedOrder P]
    {n : ℕ} (f : RankedFlag P n) : Function.Injective f
proof:
:=
  f.strictMono.injective

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.mem_toFlag_iff
statement:
theorem RankedFlag.mem_toFlag_iff (f : RankedFlag P n) (x : P) :
    x ∈ f.toFlag ↔ ∃ k, f k = x
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.toFlag_card
statement:
theorem RankedFlag.toFlag_card [Finite P] (f : RankedFlag P n) :
    Nat.card f.toFlag = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  change Nat.card (Set.range f) = n + 1
  rw [Nat.card_range_of_injective f.injective, Nat.card_fin]

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.toFlag_injective
statement:
theorem RankedFlag.toFlag_injective : Function.Injective
    (RankedFlag.toFlag : RankedFlag P n → Flag P)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  apply RankedFlag.ext
  intro k
  induction k using Fin.induction with
  | zero => exact f.map_zero.trans g.map_zero.symm
  | succ k ih =>
      have hfmem : f k.succ ∈ g.toFlag := by
        rw [← h]
        exact ⟨k.succ, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (g.mem_toFlag_iff (f k.succ)).mp hfmem
      have hkj : k.succ ≤ j := by
        apply Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr
        by_contra hnot
        have hjk : j ≤ k.castSucc := Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr (by omega)
        have hvalues : g j ≤ g k.castSucc := g.strictMono.monotone hjk
        rw [hj, ← ih] at hvalues
        exact (not_le_of_gt (f.covBy_succ k).lt) hvalues
      have hgf : g k.succ ≤ f k.succ := by
        rw [← hj]
        exact g.strictMono.monotone hkj
      have hgmem : g k.succ ∈ f.toFlag := by
        rw [h]
        exact ⟨k.succ, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (f.mem_toFlag_iff (g k.succ)).mp hgmem
      have hki : k.succ ≤ i := by
        apply Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr
        by_contra hnot
        have hik : i ≤ k.castSucc := Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr (by omega)
        have hvalues : f i ≤ f k.castSucc := f.strictMono.monotone hik
        rw [hi, ih] at hvalues
        exact (not_le_of_gt (g.covBy_succ k).lt) hvalues
      have hfg : f k.succ ≤ g k.succ := by
        rw [← hi]
        exact f.strictMono.monotone hki
      exact le_antisymm hfg hgf

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.grade_apply
statement:
theorem RankedFlag.grade_apply (f : RankedFlag P n) :
    ∀ k, grade (Fin (n + 1)) (f k) = k
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k using Fin.induction with
  | zero =>
      rw [f.map_zero, grade_bot]
      rfl
  | succ k ih =>
      have hgrade := (f.covBy_succ k).grade (Fin (n + 1))
      rw [ih] at hgrade
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [Fin.covBy_iff, Nat.covBy_iff_add_one_eq] at hgrade
      exact hgrade.symm

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.toFlag_ofFlag
statement:
theorem RankedFlag.toFlag_ofFlag (h : FlagGradeSurjective P n)
    (s : Flag P) : (RankedFlag.ofFlag h s).toFlag = s
proof:
:= by
  apply Flag.ext
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact ((flagGradeOrderIso h s).symm k).2
  · intro hx
    let xs : s := ⟨x, hx⟩
    refine ⟨flagGradeOrderIso h s xs, ?_⟩
    exact congrArg Subtype.val ((flagGradeOrderIso h s).symm_apply_apply xs)

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.ofFlag_toFlag
statement:
theorem RankedFlag.ofFlag_toFlag (h : FlagGradeSurjective P n)
    (f : RankedFlag P n) : RankedFlag.ofFlag h f.toFlag = f
proof:
:= by
  apply RankedFlag.ext
  intro k
  let x : f.toFlag := ⟨f k, ⟨k, rfl⟩⟩
  have hxgrade : flagGradeOrderIso h f.toFlag x = k := by
    change grade (Fin (n + 1)) (f k) = k
    exact f.grade_apply k
  have hinv : (flagGradeOrderIso h f.toFlag).symm k = x := by
    apply (flagGradeOrderIso h f.toFlag).injective
    simp [hxgrade]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hinv

name: HansenCograph.compl_sum_eq_join
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compl_sum_eq_join {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) :
    (G ⊕g H)ᶜ = Gᶜ ⊗g Hᶜ
proof:
:= by
  simp [graphJoin]

name: HansenCograph.compl_join_eq_sum
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compl_join_eq_sum {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) :
    (G ⊗g H)ᶜ = Gᶜ ⊕g Hᶜ
proof:
:= by
  unfold graphJoin
  exact compl_compl (Gᶜ ⊕g Hᶜ)

name: HansenCograph.indicator_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem indicator_empty : indicator (∅ : Finset V) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp [indicator]

name: HansenCograph.indicator_apply_mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem indicator_apply_mem {s : Finset V} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ s) :
    indicator s v = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [indicator, hv]

name: HansenCograph.indicator_apply_not_mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem indicator_apply_not_mem {s : Finset V} {v : V} (hv : v ∉ s) :
    indicator s v = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [indicator, hv]

name: HansenCograph.convex_stab
statement:
theorem convex_stab (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Convex ℝ (stab G)
proof:
:= by
  exact convex_convexHull ℝ _

name: HansenCograph.indicator_mem_stab
statement:
theorem indicator_mem_stab (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {s : Finset V} (hs : G.IsIndepSet (↑s : Set V)) :
    indicator s ∈ stab G
proof:
:= by
  apply subset_convexHull ℝ
  exact ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩

name: HansenCograph.zero_mem_stab
statement: theorem zero_mem_stab (G : SimpleGraph V) : (0 : V → ℝ) ∈ stab G
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : G.IsIndepSet (↑(∅ : Finset V) : Set V) := by
    simp
  have h := indicator_mem_stab G h0
  convert h using 1
  ext v
  simp [indicator]

name: HansenCograph.stab_coordinate_nonneg
statement:
theorem stab_coordinate_nonneg (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {x : V → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ stab G) (v : V) :
    0 ≤ x v
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ {y : V → ℝ | 0 ≤ y v}
  apply (convexHull_min ?_ ?_) hx
  · rintro y ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    change 0 ≤ indicator s v
    by_cases hv : v ∈ s <;> simp [indicator, hv]
  · intro y hy z hz a b ha hb hab
    change 0 ≤ y v at hy
    change 0 ≤ z v at hz
    change 0 ≤ (a • y + b • z) v
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.stab_coordinate_le_one
statement:
theorem stab_coordinate_le_one (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {x : V → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ stab G) (v : V) :
    x v ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ {y : V → ℝ | y v ≤ 1}
  apply (convexHull_min ?_ ?_) hx
  · rintro y ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    change indicator s v ≤ 1
    by_cases hv : v ∈ s <;> simp [indicator, hv]
  · intro y hy z hz a b ha hb hab
    change y v ≤ 1 at hy
    change z v ≤ 1 at hz
    change (a • y + b • z) v ≤ 1
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.stab_edge_ineq
statement:
theorem stab_edge_ineq (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {x : V → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ stab G)
    {u v : V} (huv : G.Adj u v) :
    x u + x v ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ {y : V → ℝ | y u + y v ≤ 1}
  apply (convexHull_min ?_ ?_) hx
  · rintro y ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    change indicator s u + indicator s v ≤ 1
    by_cases hu : u ∈ s
    · have hv : v ∉ s := by
        intro hvs
        have hn : ¬G.Adj u v :=
          hs (by simpa using hu) (by simpa using hvs) huv.ne
        exact hn huv
      simp [indicator, hu, hv]
    · by_cases hv : v ∈ s <;> simp [indicator, hu, hv]
  · intro y hy z hz a b ha hb hab
    change y u + y v ≤ 1 at hy
    change z u + z v ≤ 1 at hz
    change (a • y + b • z) u + (a • y + b • z) v ≤ 1
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.nu_nonneg
statement:
theorem nu_nonneg (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    0 ≤ nu G
proof:
:= by
  unfold nu
  positivity

name: HansenCograph.smallCube_subset_stab
statement:
theorem smallCube_subset_stab (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Set.Icc (0 : V → ℝ)
        (fun _ => 1 / ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) + 1)) ⊆ stab G
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  let c : ℝ := 1 / ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) + 1)
  have hsum : ∑ v : V, x v ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      ∑ v : V, x v ≤ ∑ _v : V, c := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro v hv
        exact hx.2 v
      _ = (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * c := by simp
      _ ≤ 1 := by
        dsimp [c]
        calc
          (Fintype.card V : ℝ) *
                (1 / ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) + 1))
              ≤ ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) + 1) *
                (1 / ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) + 1)) := by
                  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                  · norm_num
                  · positivity
          _ = 1 := by field_simp
  let weight : Option V → ℝ
    | none => 1 - ∑ v : V, x v
    | some v => x v
  let point : Option V → (V → ℝ)
    | none => 0
    | some v => indicator {v}
  have hweight : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Option V)), 0 ≤ weight i := by
    intro i hi
    cases i with
    | none =>
        dsimp [weight]
        linarith
    | some v =>
        exact hx.1 v
  have hweight_sum : ∑ i : Option V, weight i = 1 := by
    simp [weight]
  have hpoint : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Option V)), point i ∈ stab G := by
    intro i hi
    cases i with
    | none => exact zero_mem_stab G
    | some v =>
        dsimp [point]
        apply indicator_mem_stab
        simp
  have hconv := (convex_stab G).sum_mem hweight hweight_sum hpoint
  convert hconv using 1
  ext v
  simp [weight, point, indicator]

name: HansenCograph.stab_subset_unitCube
statement:
theorem stab_subset_unitCube (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    stab G ⊆ Set.Icc (0 : V → ℝ) (1 : V → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  constructor
  · intro v
    exact stab_coordinate_nonneg G hx v
  · intro v
    exact stab_coordinate_le_one G hx v

name: HansenCograph.stableIndicators_bot
statement:
theorem stableIndicators_bot :
    stableIndicators (⊥ : SimpleGraph V) =
      Set.univ.pi (fun _ : V => ({0, 1} : Set ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    intro v hv
    by_cases hvs : v ∈ s
    · simp [indicator, hvs]
    · simp [indicator, hvs]
  · intro hx
    let s : Finset V := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => x v = 1)
    refine ⟨s, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro u hu v hv huv hadj
      exact hadj
    ext v
    have hv := hx v (by simp)
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hv
    rcases hv with hv | hv
    · have hvs : v ∉ s := by simp [s, hv]
      simp [indicator, hvs, hv]
    · have hvs : v ∈ s := by simp [s, hv]
      simp [indicator, hvs, hv]

name: HansenCograph.stab_bot
statement:
theorem stab_bot :
    stab (⊥ : SimpleGraph V) =
      Set.Icc (0 : V → ℝ) (1 : V → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold stab
  rw [stableIndicators_bot, convexHull_pi]
  simp_rw [convexHull_pair,
    segment_eq_Icc (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
  ext x
  simp [Pi.le_def]

name: HansenCograph.nu_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nu_bot :
    nu (⊥ : SimpleGraph V) = (Fintype.card V).factorial
proof:
:= by
  unfold nu
  rw [stab_bot, Real.volume_Icc_pi_toReal (by intro v; norm_num)]
  simp

name: HansenCograph.nu_pos
statement:
theorem nu_pos (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    0 < nu G
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := 1 / ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) + 1)
  have hc : 0 < c := by
    dsimp [c]
    positivity
  let U : Set (V → ℝ) :=
    {x | ∀ v, x v ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c}
  have hUopen : IsOpen U := by
    rw [show U = ⋂ v : V,
        (fun x : V → ℝ => x v) ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c by
      ext x
      simp [U]]
    apply isOpen_iInter_of_finite
    intro v
    exact isOpen_Ioo.preimage (continuous_apply v)
  have hUne : U.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨fun _ => c / 2, ?_⟩
    intro v
    constructor <;> dsimp <;> linarith
  have hUstab : U ⊆ stab G := by
    intro x hx
    apply smallCube_subset_stab G
    constructor
    · intro v
      exact le_of_lt (hx v).1
    · intro v
      exact le_of_lt (hx v).2
  have hvol_pos : 0 < volume (stab G) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (hUopen.measure_pos volume hUne) (measure_mono hUstab)
  have hvol_lt_top : volume (stab G) < ⊤ :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (measure_mono (stab_subset_unitCube G))
      (isCompact_Icc.measure_lt_top)
  unfold nu
  exact mul_pos (by positivity)
    (ENNReal.toReal_pos hvol_pos.ne' hvol_lt_top.ne)

name: HansenCograph.coordinateRelabel_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateRelabel_apply (e : V ≃ W) (x : V → ℝ) (w : W) :
    coordinateRelabel e x w = x (e.symm w)
proof: := rfl

name: HansenCograph.mem_relabelFinset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_relabelFinset (e : V ≃ W) (s : Finset V) (w : W) :
    w ∈ relabelFinset e s ↔ e.symm w ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  simp [relabelFinset]

name: HansenCograph.isIndepSet_relabel
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw z hz hwz
  have hw' : e.symm w ∈ s := by
    exact (mem_relabelFinset e.toEquiv s w).mp hw
  have hz' : e.symm z ∈ s := by
    exact (mem_relabelFinset e.toEquiv s z).mp hz
  have hwz' : e.symm w ≠ e.symm z := by
    intro h
    apply hwz
    simpa using congrArg e h
  have hn := hs hw' hz' hwz'
  intro hadj
  apply hn
  exact (e.symm.map_rel_iff).mpr hadj

name: HansenCograph.coordinateRelabel_indicator
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateRelabel_indicator
    (e : V ≃ W) (s : Finset V) :
    coordinateRelabel e (indicator s) = indicator (relabelFinset e s)
proof:
:= by
  funext w
  simp [indicator]

name: HansenCograph.coordinateRelabel_mem_stab
statement:
theorem coordinateRelabel_mem_stab
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (e : G ≃g H) {x : V → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ stab G) :
    coordinateRelabel e.toEquiv x ∈ stab H
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ (coordinateRelabel e.toEquiv : (V → ℝ) → (W → ℝ)) ⁻¹' stab H
  apply (convexHull_min ?_ ((convex_stab H).linear_preimage
    (coordinateRelabel e.toEquiv).toLinearMap)) hx
  rintro y ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
  change coordinateRelabel e.toEquiv (indicator s) ∈ stab H
  rw [coordinateRelabel_indicator]
  exact indicator_mem_stab H (isIndepSet_relabel e hs)

name: HansenCograph.stab_eq_coordinateRelabel_preimage
statement:
theorem stab_eq_coordinateRelabel_preimage
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (e : G ≃g H) :
    stab G = (coordinateRelabel e.toEquiv : (V → ℝ) → (W → ℝ)) ⁻¹' stab H
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro x hx
    exact coordinateRelabel_mem_stab e hx
  · intro x hx
    have hback := coordinateRelabel_mem_stab e.symm hx
    have heq : coordinateRelabel e.symm.toEquiv
        (coordinateRelabel e.toEquiv x) = x := by
      ext v
      change x (e.symm (e v)) = x v
      rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [heq] at hback
    exact hback

name: HansenCograph.coordinateRelabel_measurePreserving
statement:
theorem coordinateRelabel_measurePreserving (e : V ≃ W) :
    MeasurePreserving (coordinateRelabel e)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · change Measurable (fun x : V → ℝ => fun w => x (e.symm w))
    fun_prop
  · symm
    rw [volume_pi]
    apply Measure.pi_eq
    intro s hs
    rw [Measure.map_apply (by
      change Measurable (fun x : V → ℝ => fun w => x (e.symm w))
      fun_prop) (MeasurableSet.univ_pi hs)]
    rw [show (coordinateRelabel e : (V → ℝ) → (W → ℝ)) ⁻¹' Set.univ.pi s =
        Set.univ.pi (fun v => s (e v)) by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, forall_const,
        coordinateRelabel_apply]
      constructor
      · intro h v
        simpa using h (e v)
      · intro h w
        simpa using h (e.symm w)]
    rw [volume_pi_pi]
    exact Fintype.prod_equiv e
      (fun v => volume (s (e v))) (fun w => volume (s w)) (fun v => rfl)

name: HansenCograph.nu_iso
statement:
theorem nu_iso
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (e : G ≃g H) :
    nu G = nu H
proof:
:= by
  have hpre :=
    (coordinateRelabel_measurePreserving e.toEquiv).measure_preimage_emb
      (coordinateRelabelMeasurableEquiv e.toEquiv).measurableEmbedding (stab H)
  have hvol : volume (stab G) = volume (stab H) := by
    rw [stab_eq_coordinateRelabel_preimage e]
    exact hpre
  unfold nu
  rw [Fintype.card_congr e.toEquiv, hvol]

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.eval_leaf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_leaf :
    eval .leaf = (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit)
proof: := rfl

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.eval_sum
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_sum (A B : Cotree) :
    eval (.sum A B) = eval A ⊕g eval B
proof: := rfl

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.eval_compl
statement:
@[simp]
