theorem eval_compl (A : Cotree) :
    eval (.compl A) = (eval A)ᶜ
proof: := rfl

name: HansenCograph.isInducedP4_compl
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨hnd, hab, hbc, hcd, hac, had, hbd⟩
  have hne_bd : b ≠ d := by
    intro h
    subst d
    simp at hnd
  have hne_da : d ≠ a := by
    intro h
    subst d
    simp at hnd
  have hne_ac : a ≠ c := by
    intro h
    subst c
    simp at hnd
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply hnd.perm
    have h1 : [a, b, c, d].Perm [b, a, c, d] :=
      List.Perm.swap b a [c, d]
    have h2 : [b, a, c, d].Perm [b, c, a, d] :=
      List.Perm.cons b (List.Perm.swap c a [d])
    have h3 : [b, c, a, d].Perm [b, c, d, a] :=
      List.Perm.cons b (List.Perm.cons c (List.Perm.swap d a []))
    have h4 : [b, c, d, a].Perm [b, d, c, a] :=
      List.Perm.cons b (List.Perm.swap d c [a])
    have h5 : [b, d, c, a].Perm [b, d, a, c] :=
      List.Perm.cons b (List.Perm.cons d (List.Perm.swap a c []))
    exact h1.trans (h2.trans (h3.trans (h4.trans h5)))
  · change b ≠ d ∧ ¬ G.Adj b d
    exact ⟨hne_bd, hbd⟩
  · change d ≠ a ∧ ¬ G.Adj d a
    exact ⟨hne_da, fun h => had ((G.adj_comm _ _).mp h)⟩
  · change a ≠ c ∧ ¬ G.Adj a c
    exact ⟨hne_ac, hac⟩
  · change ¬ (b ≠ a ∧ ¬ G.Adj b a)
    intro h
    exact h.2 ((G.adj_comm _ _).mp hab)
  · change ¬ (b ≠ c ∧ ¬ G.Adj b c)
    intro h
    exact h.2 hbc
  · change ¬ (d ≠ c ∧ ¬ G.Adj d c)
    intro h
    exact h.2 ((G.adj_comm _ _).mp hcd)

name: HansenCograph.isInducedP4_iso
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨hnd, hab, hbc, hcd, hac, had, hbd⟩
  refine ⟨?_, (e.map_adj_iff).mpr hab, (e.map_adj_iff).mpr hbc,
    (e.map_adj_iff).mpr hcd, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hnd.map e.injective
  · simpa only [e.map_adj_iff] using hac
  · simpa only [e.map_adj_iff] using had
  · simpa only [e.map_adj_iff] using hbd

name: HansenCograph.isP4Free_compl_iff
statement:
theorem isP4Free_compl_iff (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    IsP4Free Gᶜ ↔ IsP4Free G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rintro ⟨a, b, c, d, hP4⟩
    exact h ⟨b, d, a, c, isInducedP4_compl hP4⟩
  · intro h
    rintro ⟨a, b, c, d, hP4⟩
    have hP4' : IsInducedP4 G b d a c := by
      simpa [compl_compl] using (isInducedP4_compl hP4)
    simpa using h ⟨b, d, a, c, hP4'⟩

name: HansenCograph.N_iso
statement:
theorem N_iso
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (e : G ≃g H) :
    N G = N H
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnu (s : Finset V) :
      nuInduced G s = nuInduced H (s.image e) := by
    unfold nuInduced
    exact nu_iso (e.induce (e.toEquiv.bijOn (by simp)))
  unfold N
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun s _ => s.image e)
  · intro s hs
    simp
  · intro s₁ hs₁ s₂ hs₂ h
    exact Finset.image_injective e.injective h
  · intro t ht
    refine ⟨t.image e.symm, by simp, ?_⟩
    ext w
    simp
  · intro s hs
    have hcompl : sᶜ.image e = (s.image e)ᶜ := by
      ext w
      simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_compl]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ ⟨x, hx, hxeq⟩
        apply ha
        simpa [e.injective hxeq] using hx
      · intro h
        refine ⟨e.symm w, ?_, by simp⟩
        intro hs
        exact h ⟨e.symm w, hs, by simp⟩
    have hnucompl := hnu sᶜ
    rw [hcompl] at hnucompl
    rw [hnu s, hnucompl]

name: HansenCograph.graphRho_iso
statement:
theorem graphRho_iso
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (e : G ≃g H) :
    graphRho G = graphRho H
proof:
:= by
  let ec : Gᶜ ≃g Hᶜ :=
    { toEquiv := e.toEquiv
      map_rel_iff' := by
        intro a b
        simp only [SimpleGraph.compl_adj]
        simp [e.map_rel_iff] }
  unfold graphRho
  rw [N_iso e, N_iso ec, Fintype.card_congr e.toEquiv]

name: HansenCograph.threshold_iso_iff
statement:
theorem threshold_iso_iff
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (e : G ≃g H) :
    IsThresholdGraph G ↔ IsThresholdGraph H
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨T, hT, ⟨f⟩⟩
    exact ⟨T, hT, ⟨e.symm.trans f⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨T, hT, ⟨f⟩⟩
    exact ⟨T, hT, ⟨e.trans f⟩⟩

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.graphRho_leaf
statement:
theorem graphRho_leaf :
    graphRho (eval .leaf) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have htop : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Vert .leaf)) = ⊥ := by
    ext u v
    have huv : u = v := by
      cases u
      cases v
      rfl
    subst v
    simp
  have hcompl : (eval .leaf)ᶜ = eval .leaf := by
    simp [eval, htop]
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Vert .leaf) = 1 := by
    have f : Vert .leaf ≃ PUnit := Equiv.refl PUnit
    simpa using Fintype.card_congr f
  have hN : N (eval .leaf) = 4 := by
    rw [N_eq_two_factorial_mul_integral_q]
    simp [eval, hcard]
    norm_num
  unfold graphRho
  rw [hcompl, hN, hcard]
  norm_num

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.graphRho_ge_one
statement:
theorem graphRho_ge_one :
    ∀ T : Cotree, 1 ≤ graphRho (eval T)
proof:
:= by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | leaf =>
      rw [graphRho_leaf]
  | compl T ih =>
      change 1 ≤ graphRho (eval T)ᶜ
      rwa [graphRho_compl]
  | sum A B ihA ihB =>
      change 1 ≤ graphRho (eval A ⊕g eval B)
      calc
        1 ≤ graphRho (eval A) * graphRho (eval B) := by
          nlinarith
        _ ≤ graphRho (eval A ⊕g eval B) :=
          graphRho_mul_le_sum (eval A) (eval B)

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.graphRho_eq_one_iff_threshold
statement:
theorem graphRho_eq_one_iff_threshold :
    ∀ T : Cotree,
      graphRho (eval T) = 1 ↔ IsThreshold T
proof:
:= by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | leaf =>
      constructor
      · intro h
        trivial
      · intro h
        exact graphRho_leaf
  | compl A ih =>
      change graphRho (eval A)ᶜ = 1 ↔ IsThreshold A
      rwa [graphRho_compl]
  | sum A B ihA ihB =>
      change graphRho (eval A ⊕g eval B) = 1 ↔
        (IsThreshold A ∧ IsThreshold B ∧
          (eval A = ⊥ ∨ eval B = ⊥))
      constructor
      · intro hEq
        have hA1 : 1 ≤ graphRho (eval A) :=
          graphRho_ge_one A
        have hB1 : 1 ≤ graphRho (eval B) :=
          graphRho_ge_one B
        have hprod :
            graphRho (eval A) * graphRho (eval B)
              ≤ graphRho (eval A ⊕g eval B) :=
          graphRho_mul_le_sum (eval A) (eval B)
        have hsum1 :
            graphRho (eval A ⊕g eval B) = 1 := by
          simpa [eval] using hEq
        have hprod_le_one :
            graphRho (eval A) * graphRho (eval B) ≤ 1 := by
          simpa [hsum1] using hprod
        have hprod_ge_one :
            1 ≤ graphRho (eval A) * graphRho (eval B) := by
          nlinarith
        have hprod_eq :
            graphRho (eval A) * graphRho (eval B) = 1 :=
          le_antisymm hprod_le_one hprod_ge_one
        have hAe : graphRho (eval A) = 1 := by
          have hAp := graphRho_pos (eval A)
          have hBp := graphRho_pos (eval B)
          nlinarith
        have hBe : graphRho (eval B) = 1 := by
          have hAp := graphRho_pos (eval A)
          have hBp := graphRho_pos (eval B)
          nlinarith
        have hexact :
            graphRho (eval A ⊕g eval B)
              =
            graphRho (eval A) * graphRho (eval B) := by
          rw [hsum1, hprod_eq]
        have hedge :
            eval A = ⊥ ∨ eval B = ⊥ :=
          (graphRho_sum_eq_mul_iff (eval A) (eval B)).mp hexact
        exact ⟨ihA.mp hAe, ihB.mp hBe, hedge⟩
      · rintro ⟨hTA, hTB, hedge⟩
        have hAe : graphRho (eval A) = 1 :=
          ihA.mpr hTA
        have hBe : graphRho (eval B) = 1 :=
          ihB.mpr hTB
        have hexact :
            graphRho (eval A ⊕g eval B)
              =
            graphRho (eval A) * graphRho (eval B) :=
          (graphRho_sum_eq_mul_iff (eval A) (eval B)).mpr hedge
        simpa [eval, hAe, hBe] using hexact

name: HansenCograph.cograph_graphRho_ge_one
statement:
theorem cograph_graphRho_ge_one
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hG : IsCograph G) :
    1 ≤ graphRho G
proof:
:= by
  rcases hG with ⟨T, ⟨e⟩⟩
  rw [graphRho_iso e]
  exact Cotree.graphRho_ge_one T

name: HansenCograph.cograph_graphRho_eq_one_iff_threshold
statement:
theorem cograph_graphRho_eq_one_iff_threshold
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hG : IsCograph G) :
    graphRho G = 1 ↔ IsThresholdGraph G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hρ
    rcases hG with ⟨T, ⟨e⟩⟩
    have hρT : graphRho (Cotree.eval T) = 1 := by
      rw [← graphRho_iso e]
      exact hρ
    have hT : Cotree.IsThreshold T :=
      (Cotree.graphRho_eq_one_iff_threshold T).mp hρT
    exact ⟨T, hT, ⟨e⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨T, hT, ⟨e⟩⟩
    rw [graphRho_iso e]
    exact (Cotree.graphRho_eq_one_iff_threshold T).mpr hT

name: HansenCograph.isThresholdStandard_iso_iff
statement:
private theorem isThresholdStandard_iso_iff
    {W : Type v} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (e : G ≃g H) :
    IsThresholdStandard G ↔ IsThresholdStandard H
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hV, f, d, hd⟩
    refine ⟨Nonempty.map e.toEquiv hV, ?_⟩
    rw [← Fintype.card_congr e.toEquiv]
    refine ⟨f.trans e.toEquiv, d, ?_⟩
    intro i j hij
    change H.Adj (e (f i)) (e (f j)) ↔ d j
    rw [e.map_rel_iff]
    exact hd i j hij
  · rintro ⟨hW, f, d, hd⟩
    refine ⟨Nonempty.map e.symm.toEquiv hW, ?_⟩
    rw [Fintype.card_congr e.toEquiv]
    refine ⟨f.trans e.symm.toEquiv, d, ?_⟩
    intro i j hij
    change G.Adj (e.symm (f i)) (e.symm (f j)) ↔ d j
    rw [e.symm.map_rel_iff]
    exact hd i j hij

name: HansenCograph.isThresholdStandard_compl
statement:
private theorem isThresholdStandard_compl
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (h : IsThresholdStandard G) :
    IsThresholdStandard Gᶜ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases h with ⟨hV, e, d, hd⟩
  refine ⟨hV, e, fun j => ¬ d j, ?_⟩
  intro i j hij
  have hne : e i ≠ e j := by
    intro h
    exact (ne_of_lt hij) (e.injective h)
  simp only [SimpleGraph.compl_adj]
  rw [hd i j hij]
  simp [hne]

name: HansenCograph.isThresholdStandard_sum_right_bot
statement:
private theorem isThresholdStandard_sum_right_bot
    {W : Type v} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (hG : IsThresholdStandard G) (hH : IsThresholdStandard H)
    (hbot : H = ⊥) :
    IsThresholdStandard (G ⊕g H)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases hG with ⟨hV, eG, dG, hdG⟩
  rcases hH with ⟨hW, eH, dH, hdH⟩
  refine ⟨⟨Sum.inl (Classical.choice hV)⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [Fintype.card_sum]
  refine ⟨finSumFinEquiv.symm.trans (eG.sumCongr eH), ?_⟩
  refine ⟨fun j =>
    match finSumFinEquiv.symm j with
    | Sum.inl k => dG k
    | Sum.inr _ => False, ?_⟩
  intro i j
  refine Fin.addCases (m := Fintype.card V) (n := Fintype.card W) ?_ ?_ i
  · intro i'
    refine Fin.addCases (m := Fintype.card V) (n := Fintype.card W) ?_ ?_ j
    · intro j' hij
      simpa [finSumFinEquiv] using hdG i' j' hij
    · intro j' hij
      simp
  · intro i'
    refine Fin.addCases (m := Fintype.card V) (n := Fintype.card W) ?_ ?_ j
    · intro j' hij
      change Fintype.card V + (i' : ℕ) < (j' : ℕ) at hij
      have hj := j'.isLt
      omega
    · intro j' hij
      simp [hbot]

name: HansenCograph.isThresholdStandard_sum_left_bot
statement:
private theorem isThresholdStandard_sum_left_bot
    {W : Type v} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (hG : IsThresholdStandard G) (hH : IsThresholdStandard H)
    (hbot : G = ⊥) :
    IsThresholdStandard (G ⊕g H)
proof:
:= by
  have hswap : IsThresholdStandard (H ⊕g G) :=
    isThresholdStandard_sum_right_bot hH hG hbot
  exact
    (isThresholdStandard_iso_iff
      (SimpleGraph.Iso.sumComm : G ⊕g H ≃g H ⊕g G)).mpr hswap

name: HansenCograph.cotree_threshold_standard
proof:
:= by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | leaf =>
      intro h
      classical
      refine ⟨⟨PUnit.unit⟩,
        (Fintype.equivFin (Cotree.Vert .leaf)).symm, fun _ => False, ?_⟩
      intro i j hij
      simp [Cotree.eval]
  | compl A ih =>
      intro h
      exact isThresholdStandard_compl (ih h)
  | sum A B ihA ihB =>
      rintro ⟨hA, hB, hbot⟩
      rcases hbot with hbot | hbot
      · exact isThresholdStandard_sum_left_bot (ihA hA) (ihB hB) hbot
      · exact isThresholdStandard_sum_right_bot (ihA hA) (ihB hB) hbot

name: HansenCograph.isThresholdGraph_compl
statement:
private theorem isThresholdGraph_compl
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (h : IsThresholdGraph G) :
    IsThresholdGraph Gᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨T, hT, ⟨e⟩⟩
  let ec : Gᶜ ≃g (Cotree.eval T)ᶜ :=
    { toEquiv := e.toEquiv
      map_rel_iff' := by
        intro a b
        simp only [SimpleGraph.compl_adj]
        simp [e.map_rel_iff] }
  refine ⟨.compl T, hT, ?_⟩
  have ec' : Gᶜ ≃g Cotree.eval (.compl T) := by
    change Gᶜ ≃g (Cotree.eval T)ᶜ
    exact ec
  exact ⟨ec'⟩

name: HansenCograph.finSnocCotreeEquiv_castSucc
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem finSnocCotreeEquiv_castSucc {n : ℕ} {T : Cotree}
    (e : Fin n ≃ Cotree.Vert T) (i : Fin n) :
    finSnocCotreeEquiv e i.castSucc = Sum.inl (e i)
proof:
:= by
  change (finSumFinEquiv.symm.trans (e.sumCongr finOneEquivLeaf)) i.castSucc = _
  simp [finOneEquivLeaf]

name: HansenCograph.finSnocCotreeEquiv_last
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem finSnocCotreeEquiv_last {n : ℕ} {T : Cotree}
    (e : Fin n ≃ Cotree.Vert T) :
    finSnocCotreeEquiv e (Fin.last n) = Sum.inr (finOneEquivLeaf 0)
proof:
:= by
  change (finSumFinEquiv.symm.trans (e.sumCongr finOneEquivLeaf)) (Fin.last n) = _
  simp [finOneEquivLeaf]

name: HansenCograph.thresholdGraph_fin_add_isolated
statement:
private theorem thresholdGraph_fin_add_isolated
    {n : ℕ} {G : SimpleGraph (Fin (n + 1))} {T : Cotree}
    (hT : Cotree.IsThreshold T)
    (e : SimpleGraph.comap (fun i : Fin n => i.castSucc) G ≃g Cotree.eval T)
    (hlast : ∀ i : Fin n, ¬ G.Adj i.castSucc (Fin.last n)) :
    IsThresholdGraph G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let eg : G ≃g Cotree.eval (.sum T .leaf) :=
    { toEquiv := finSnocCotreeEquiv e.toEquiv
      map_rel_iff' := by
        intro a b
        refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) a
        · refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) b
          · rw [Cotree.eval_sum, finSnocCotreeEquiv_last]
            rw [SimpleGraph.sum_adj]
            exact ⟨fun hadj => ((Cotree.eval .leaf).loopless.irrefl _ hadj).elim,
              fun hadj => (G.loopless.irrefl _ hadj).elim⟩
          · have hno : ¬ G.Adj (Fin.last n) j.castSucc := by
              intro h
              exact hlast j ((G.adj_comm _ _).mp h)
            rw [Cotree.eval_sum, finSnocCotreeEquiv_last,
              finSnocCotreeEquiv_castSucc]
            rw [SimpleGraph.sum_adj]
            simp [hno]
        · refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) b
          · rw [Cotree.eval_sum, finSnocCotreeEquiv_castSucc,
              finSnocCotreeEquiv_last]
            rw [SimpleGraph.sum_adj]
            simp [hlast i]
          · rw [Cotree.eval_sum, finSnocCotreeEquiv_castSucc e.toEquiv i,
              finSnocCotreeEquiv_castSucc e.toEquiv j]
            rw [SimpleGraph.sum_adj]
            exact
              (e.map_rel_iff :
                (Cotree.eval T).Adj (e i) (e j) ↔
                  G.Adj i.castSucc j.castSucc) }
  refine ⟨.sum T .leaf, ?_, ⟨eg⟩⟩
  exact ⟨hT, trivial, Or.inr rfl⟩

name: HansenCograph.thresholdGraph_fin_add_dominating
statement:
private theorem thresholdGraph_fin_add_dominating
    {n : ℕ} {G : SimpleGraph (Fin (n + 1))} {T : Cotree}
    (hT : Cotree.IsThreshold T)
    (e : SimpleGraph.comap (fun i : Fin n => i.castSucc) G ≃g Cotree.eval T)
    (hlast : ∀ i : Fin n, G.Adj i.castSucc (Fin.last n)) :
    IsThresholdGraph G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ec :
      SimpleGraph.comap (fun i : Fin n => i.castSucc) Gᶜ ≃g
        Cotree.eval (.compl T) := by
    change SimpleGraph.comap (fun i : Fin n => i.castSucc) Gᶜ ≃g
      (Cotree.eval T)ᶜ
    exact
      { toEquiv := e.toEquiv
        map_rel_iff' := by
          intro a b
          simp only [SimpleGraph.comap_adj, SimpleGraph.compl_adj]
          simp [e.map_rel_iff] }
  have hc : IsThresholdGraph Gᶜ := by
    apply thresholdGraph_fin_add_isolated (T := .compl T) hT
    · exact ec
    · intro i hi
      have hi' :
          i.castSucc ≠ Fin.last n ∧
            ¬ G.Adj i.castSucc (Fin.last n) := by
        simpa only [SimpleGraph.compl_adj] using hi
      exact hi'.2 (hlast i)
  have hcc := isThresholdGraph_compl hc
  simpa using hcc

name: HansenCograph.thresholdStandardFin_to_thresholdGraph
statement:
private theorem thresholdStandardFin_to_thresholdGraph :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ G : SimpleGraph (Fin (n + 1)),
      (∃ d : Fin (n + 1) → Prop,
        ∀ i j, i < j → (G.Adj i j ↔ d j)) →
      IsThresholdGraph G
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro G h
      let eg : G ≃g Cotree.eval .leaf :=
        { toEquiv := finOneEquivLeaf
          map_rel_iff' := by
            intro i j
            have hij : i = j := Fin.ext (by omega)
            subst j
            exact ⟨fun hadj => ((Cotree.eval .leaf).loopless.irrefl _ hadj).elim,
              fun hadj => (G.loopless.irrefl _ hadj).elim⟩ }
      exact ⟨.leaf, trivial, ⟨eg⟩⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      intro G h
      rcases h with ⟨d, hd⟩
      let G0 : SimpleGraph (Fin (n + 1)) :=
        SimpleGraph.comap (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => i.castSucc) G
      have h0 :
          ∃ d0 : Fin (n + 1) → Prop,
            ∀ i j, i < j → (G0.Adj i j ↔ d0 j) := by
        refine ⟨fun j => d j.castSucc, ?_⟩
        intro i j hij
        change G.Adj i.castSucc j.castSucc ↔ d j.castSucc
        exact hd _ _ (by simpa using hij)
      rcases ih G0 h0 with ⟨T, hT, ⟨e⟩⟩
      by_cases hlast : d (Fin.last (n + 1))
      · apply thresholdGraph_fin_add_dominating hT e
        intro i
        exact
          (hd i.castSucc (Fin.last (n + 1))
            (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i)).mpr hlast
      · apply thresholdGraph_fin_add_isolated hT e
        intro i hadj
        exact hlast
          ((hd i.castSucc (Fin.last (n + 1))
            (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i)).mp hadj)

name: HansenCograph.threshold_cotree_iff_standard
statement:
theorem threshold_cotree_iff_standard (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    IsThresholdGraph G ↔ IsThresholdStandard G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨T, hT, ⟨e⟩⟩
    have hStdT := cotree_threshold_standard T hT
    exact (isThresholdStandard_iso_iff e).mpr hStdT
  · rintro ⟨hV, e, d, hd⟩
    have hcard : 0 < Fintype.card V := (Fintype.card_pos_iff).2 hV
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hcard)
    let c : Fin (n + 1) ≃ Fin (Fintype.card V) :=
      finCongr (by simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using hn.symm)
    let e' : Fin (n + 1) ≃ V := c.trans e
    let G' : SimpleGraph (Fin (n + 1)) := SimpleGraph.comap e' G
    let d' : Fin (n + 1) → Prop := fun j => d (c j)
    have hd' : ∀ i j, i < j → (G'.Adj i j ↔ d' j) := by
      intro i j hij
      change G.Adj (e (c i)) (e (c j)) ↔ d (c j)
      apply hd
      simpa [c] using hij
    have hG' : IsThresholdGraph G' :=
      thresholdStandardFin_to_thresholdGraph n G' ⟨d', hd'⟩
    let eg : G' ≃g G :=
      { toEquiv := e'
        map_rel_iff' := by
          intro i j
          rfl }
    exact (threshold_iso_iff eg).mp hG'

name: HansenCograph.isCograph_of_thresholdGraph
statement:
theorem isCograph_of_thresholdGraph (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hG : IsThresholdGraph G) :
    IsCograph G
proof:
:= by
  rcases hG with ⟨T, _, hIso⟩
  exact ⟨T, hIso⟩

name: HansenCograph.isCograph_of_thresholdStandard
statement:
theorem isCograph_of_thresholdStandard (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hG : IsThresholdStandard G) :
    IsCograph G
proof:
:=
  isCograph_of_thresholdGraph G ((threshold_cotree_iff_standard G).mpr hG)

name: HansenCograph.isClique_relabel
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy z hz hyz
  have hy' : e.symm y ∈ s :=
    (mem_relabelFinset e.toEquiv s y).mp hy
  have hz' : e.symm z ∈ s :=
    (mem_relabelFinset e.toEquiv s z).mp hz
  have hne : e.symm y ≠ e.symm z := by
    intro h
    apply hyz
    simpa using congrArg e h
  have hadj := hs hy' hz' hne
  exact (e.symm.map_rel_iff).mp hadj

name: HansenCograph.hasOptimalCliqueColoring_iso_forward
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rintro ⟨n, ⟨color, hcolor⟩, ⟨c, hc, hclique⟩⟩
  refine ⟨n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨fun y => color (e.symm y), ?_⟩
    intro y z hyz
    apply hcolor
    exact (e.symm.map_rel_iff).mpr hyz
  · refine ⟨relabelFinset e.toEquiv c, ?_, isClique_relabel e hclique⟩
    simpa [relabelFinset] using hc

name: HansenCograph.hasOptimalCliqueColoring_iso
proof:
:=
  ⟨hasOptimalCliqueColoring_iso_forward e,
    hasOptimalCliqueColoring_iso_forward e.symm⟩

name: HansenCograph.hasOptimalCliqueColoring_bot
statement:
private theorem hasOptimalCliqueColoring_bot
    {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] :
    HasOptimalCliqueColoring (⊥ : SimpleGraph X)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hX : Nonempty X
  · let x := Classical.choice hX
    refine ⟨1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨fun _ => 0, ?_⟩
      simp
    · exact ⟨{x}, by simp, by simp⟩
  · refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨fun x => (hX ⟨x⟩).elim, ?_⟩
      intro u v huv
      exact (hX ⟨u⟩).elim
    · exact ⟨∅, by simp, by simp⟩

name: HansenCograph.hasOptimalCliqueColoring_sum
statement:
private theorem hasOptimalCliqueColoring_sum
    {X : Type u} {Y : Type v}
    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y]
    {G : SimpleGraph X} {H : SimpleGraph Y}
    (hG : HasOptimalCliqueColoring G)
    (hH : HasOptimalCliqueColoring H) :
    HasOptimalCliqueColoring (G ⊕g H)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases hG with ⟨n, ⟨colorG, hcolorG⟩, ⟨cG, hcG, hcliqueG⟩⟩
  rcases hH with ⟨m, ⟨colorH, hcolorH⟩, ⟨cH, hcH, hcliqueH⟩⟩
  let CG : G.Coloring (Fin n) :=
    SimpleGraph.Coloring.mk colorG (by intro u v huv; exact hcolorG huv)
  let CH : H.Coloring (Fin m) :=
    SimpleGraph.Coloring.mk colorH (by intro u v huv; exact hcolorH huv)
  refine ⟨max n m, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨fun x => (CG.sumFin CH) x, ?_⟩
    intro x y hxy
    exact (CG.sumFin CH).valid hxy
  · rcases le_total n m with hnm | hmn
    · refine ⟨(∅ : Finset X).disjSum cH, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [hcH, Nat.max_eq_right hnm]
      · intro x hx y hy hxy
        cases x with
        | inl x => simp at hx
        | inr x =>
            cases y with
            | inl y => simp at hy
            | inr y =>
                simp at hx hy
                have hne : x ≠ y := by
                  intro h
                  exact hxy (congrArg Sum.inr h)
                simpa using hcliqueH hx hy hne
    · refine ⟨cG.disjSum (∅ : Finset Y), ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [hcG, Nat.max_eq_left hmn]
      · intro x hx y hy hxy
        cases x with
        | inl x =>
            cases y with
            | inl y =>
                simp at hx hy
                have hne : x ≠ y := by
                  intro h
                  exact hxy (congrArg Sum.inl h)
                simpa using hcliqueG hx hy hne
            | inr y => simp at hy
        | inr x => simp at hx

name: HansenCograph.hasOptimalCliqueColoring_compl_sum
statement:
private theorem hasOptimalCliqueColoring_compl_sum
    {X : Type u} {Y : Type v}
    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y]
    {G : SimpleGraph X} {H : SimpleGraph Y}
    (hG : HasOptimalCliqueColoring Gᶜ)
    (hH : HasOptimalCliqueColoring Hᶜ) :
    HasOptimalCliqueColoring (G ⊕g H)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases hG with ⟨n, ⟨colorG, hcolorG⟩, ⟨cG, hcG, hcliqueG⟩⟩
  rcases hH with ⟨m, ⟨colorH, hcolorH⟩, ⟨cH, hcH, hcliqueH⟩⟩
  let CG : Gᶜ.Coloring (Fin n) :=
    SimpleGraph.Coloring.mk colorG (by intro u v huv; exact hcolorG huv)
  let CH : Hᶜ.Coloring (Fin m) :=
    SimpleGraph.Coloring.mk colorH (by intro u v huv; exact hcolorH huv)
  let color : X ⊕ Y → Fin (n + m)
    | Sum.inl x => finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl (CG x))
    | Sum.inr y => finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr (CH y))
  refine ⟨n + m, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨color, ?_⟩
    intro x y hxy
    cases x with
    | inl x =>
        cases y with
        | inl y =>
            have hxy' : Gᶜ.Adj x y := by
              simpa [SimpleGraph.compl_adj] using hxy
            change finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl (CG x)) ≠
              finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl (CG y))
            intro h
            apply CG.valid hxy'
            simpa using finSumFinEquiv.injective h
        | inr y =>
            change finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl (CG x)) ≠
              finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr (CH y))
            intro h
            simpa using finSumFinEquiv.injective h
    | inr x =>
        cases y with
        | inl y =>
            change finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr (CH x)) ≠
              finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl (CG y))
            intro h
            simpa using finSumFinEquiv.injective h
        | inr y =>
            have hxy' : Hᶜ.Adj x y := by
              simpa [SimpleGraph.compl_adj] using hxy
            change finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr (CH x)) ≠
              finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr (CH y))
            intro h
            apply CH.valid hxy'
            simpa using finSumFinEquiv.injective h
  · refine ⟨cG.disjSum cH, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [hcG, hcH]
    · intro x hx y hy hxy
      cases x with
      | inl x =>
          cases y with
          | inl y =>
              simp at hx hy
              have hne : x ≠ y := by
                intro h
                exact hxy (congrArg Sum.inl h)
              simpa [SimpleGraph.compl_adj] using hcliqueG hx hy hne
          | inr y =>
              rw [SimpleGraph.compl_adj, SimpleGraph.sum_adj]
              simp
      | inr x =>
          cases y with
          | inl y =>
              rw [SimpleGraph.compl_adj, SimpleGraph.sum_adj]
              simp
          | inr y =>
              simp at hx hy
              have hne : x ≠ y := by
                intro h
                exact hxy (congrArg Sum.inr h)
              simpa [SimpleGraph.compl_adj] using hcliqueH hx hy hne

name: HansenCograph.inducedFinset_compl
statement:
private theorem inducedFinset_compl
    {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    (G : SimpleGraph X) (s : Finset X) :
    inducedFinset Gᶜ s = (inducedFinset G s)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  simp [inducedFinset, SimpleGraph.compl_adj]

name: HansenCograph.isPerfect_of_subsingleton
statement:
private theorem isPerfect_of_subsingleton
    {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Subsingleton X]
    (G : SimpleGraph X) :
    IsPerfectGraph G
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  have hbot : inducedFinset G s = ⊥ := by
    ext x y
    have hxy : x = y := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst y
    simp
  rw [hbot]
  exact hasOptimalCliqueColoring_bot

name: HansenCograph.isPerfect_sum
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  have hparts := hasOptimalCliqueColoring_sum (hG s.toLeft) (hH s.toRight)
  exact (hasOptimalCliqueColoring_iso (inducedSumIso G H s)).mpr hparts

name: HansenCograph.isPerfect_compl_sum
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  rw [inducedFinset_compl]
  have hGc : HasOptimalCliqueColoring (inducedFinset G s.toLeft)ᶜ := by
    rw [← inducedFinset_compl]
    exact hG s.toLeft
  have hHc : HasOptimalCliqueColoring (inducedFinset H s.toRight)ᶜ := by
    rw [← inducedFinset_compl]
    exact hH s.toRight
  have hjoin := hasOptimalCliqueColoring_compl_sum hGc hHc
  exact
    (hasOptimalCliqueColoring_iso
      (isoCompl (inducedSumIso G H s))).mpr hjoin

name: HansenCograph.cotree_isPerfect_both
statement:
private theorem cotree_isPerfect_both :
    ∀ T : Cotree,
      IsPerfectGraph (Cotree.eval T) ∧
      IsPerfectGraph (Cotree.eval T)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | leaf =>
      let hsub : Subsingleton (Cotree.Vert .leaf) :=
        ⟨fun x y => by
          change PUnit at x y
          cases x
          cases y
          rfl⟩
      exact ⟨@isPerfect_of_subsingleton _ _ _ hsub _,
        @isPerfect_of_subsingleton _ _ _ hsub _⟩
  | compl A ih =>
      have hde : Cotree.instDecidableEqVert (.compl A) =
          Cotree.instDecidableEqVert A := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      constructor
      · rw [hde]
        exact ih.2
      · rw [hde]
        change IsPerfectGraph ((Cotree.eval A)ᶜ)ᶜ
        simpa only [compl_compl] using ih.1
  | sum A B ihA ihB =>
      exact ⟨isPerfect_sum ihA.1 ihB.1,
        isPerfect_compl_sum ihA.2 ihB.2⟩

name: HansenCograph.cograph_isPerfect
statement:
theorem cograph_isPerfect
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hG : IsCograph G) :
    IsPerfectGraph G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases hG with ⟨T, ⟨e⟩⟩
  intro s
  have hT :
      HasOptimalCliqueColoring
        (inducedFinset (Cotree.eval T) (s.image e)) :=
    (cotree_isPerfect_both T).1 (s.image e)
  exact
    (hasOptimalCliqueColoring_iso
      (e.induce (e.toEquiv.bijOn (by simp)))).mpr hT

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.markedOfPortalCode_portal
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hansenPortalCodeEquiv G).apply_symm_apply c

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.card_restrictIic_markedOfPortalCode
statement:
private theorem card_restrictIic_markedOfPortalCode
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (c : HansenPortalCode G) :
    Nat.card
        (Flag.restrictIic (markedOfPortalCode G c).1.2
          (markedOfPortalCode G c).1.1.1.1
          (markedOfPortalCode G c).2.1) =
      Nat.card c.2.1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun z : HansenPortalCode G ↦ Nat.card z.2.1)
    ((hansenPortalCodeEquiv G).apply_symm_apply c)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.portalLayer_lower_card
statement:
private theorem portalLayer_lower_card
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {k : ℕ} (c : HansenPortalLayer G k) :
    Nat.card c.1.2.1 = k + 1
proof:
:= by
  let topMember : c.1.2.1 :=
    ⟨⟨c.1.1.1.1.1, show c.1.1.1.1.1 ≤ c.1.1.1.1.1 from le_rfl⟩,
      Flag.top_mem c.1.2.1⟩
  let _ : Nonempty c.1.2.1 := ⟨topMember⟩
  have hpos : 0 < Nat.card c.1.2.1 := Nat.card_pos
  omega

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.sourceRankedFlag_toFlag
statement:
private theorem sourceRankedFlag_toFlag
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n k : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (c : HansenPortalLayer G k) :
    (sourceRankedFlag hG c).toFlag = (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.2
proof:
:= by
  unfold sourceRankedFlag
  apply Flag.toFlag_toRankedFlagOfCardEq

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.portalLayerRankedFlag_toFlag
statement:
@[simp] theorem portalLayerRankedFlag_toFlag
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n k : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (c : HansenPortalLayer G k) :
    (portalLayerRankedFlag hG c).toFlag =
      ((hansenPortalCodeEquiv G).symm c.1).1.2
proof:
:=
  sourceRankedFlag_toFlag hG c

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.sourceRankedFlag_pred_eq
statement:
private theorem sourceRankedFlag_pred_eq
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n k : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (c : HansenPortalLayer G k) (hk : k < n) :
    sourceRankedFlag hG c (predIndex hk) =
      (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.1.1
proof:
:= by
  let f := sourceRankedFlag hG c
  have htoFlag := sourceRankedFlag_toFlag hG c
  have hmem : (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.1.1 ∈ f.toFlag := by
    rw [htoFlag]
    exact (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).2.1
  apply RankedFlag.apply_eq_of_mem_of_card_restrictIic f (predIndex hk) _ hmem
  have hcard := card_restrictIic_markedOfPortalCode G c.1
  dsimp only [f]
  simpa only [sourceRankedFlag_toFlag, predIndex,
    portalLayer_lower_card c] using hcard

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.portalLayerRankedFlag_portalLower_eq
statement:
theorem portalLayerRankedFlag_portalLower_eq
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n k : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (c : HansenPortalLayer G k) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    portalLayerRankedFlag hG c ⟨k, by omega⟩ = c.1.1.1.1.1
proof:
:= by
  let f := sourceRankedFlag hG c
  have hmem : (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.1.1 ∈ f.toFlag := by
    rw [sourceRankedFlag_toFlag hG c]
    exact (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).2.1
  have hfirst : f ⟨k, by omega⟩ =
      (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.1.1 := by
    apply RankedFlag.apply_eq_of_mem_of_card_restrictIic f
      ⟨k, by omega⟩ _ hmem
    have hcard := card_restrictIic_markedOfPortalCode G c.1
    simpa only [f, sourceRankedFlag_toFlag,
      portalLayer_lower_card c] using hcard
  exact hfirst.trans (congrArg (fun p : HansenPortal G ↦ p.1.1.1)
    (markedOfPortalCode_portal G c.1))

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.sourceRankedFlag_middle_eq
statement:
private theorem sourceRankedFlag_middle_eq
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n k : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (c : HansenPortalLayer G k) (hk : k < n) :
    sourceRankedFlag hG c (middleIndex hk) =
      (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.2.1
proof:
:= by
  let f := sourceRankedFlag hG c
  let E := (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.1.1
  let F := (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.2.1
  have htoFlag := sourceRankedFlag_toFlag hG c
  have hFmem : F ∈ f.toFlag := by
    rw [htoFlag]
    exact (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).2.2
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (f.mem_toFlag_iff F).mp hFmem
  have hpred : f (predIndex hk) = E := sourceRankedFlag_pred_eq hG c hk
  have hpj : predIndex hk < j := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hjp : j ≤ predIndex hk := Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr (Nat.le_of_not_gt hnot)
    have hFE : F ≤ E := by
      rw [← hj, ← hpred]
      exact f.strictMono.monotone hjp
    exact (not_le_of_gt (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.2.lt) hFE
  have hmj : middleIndex hk ≤ j := by
    apply Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr
    change k + 1 ≤ j.1
    change k < j.1 at hpj
    omega
  have hEmid : E ≤ f (middleIndex hk) := by
    rw [← hpred]
    apply f.strictMono.monotone
    exact Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr (by simp [predIndex, middleIndex])
  have hmidF : f (middleIndex hk) ≤ F := by
    rw [← hj]
    exact f.strictMono.monotone hmj
  rcases (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.2.eq_or_eq hEmid hmidF with hmid | hmid
  · exfalso
    have hne : predIndex hk ≠ middleIndex hk := by
      intro h
      have := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp [predIndex, middleIndex] at this
    exact hne (f.injective (hpred.trans hmid.symm))
  · exact hmid

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.sourceRankedFlag_middle_covBy_succ
statement:
private theorem sourceRankedFlag_middle_covBy_succ
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n k : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (c : HansenPortalLayer G k) (hk : k < n) :
    sourceRankedFlag hG c (middleIndex hk) ⋖
      sourceRankedFlag hG c (succIndex hk)
proof:
:= by
  let j : Fin (n + 2) := ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩
  have h := (sourceRankedFlag hG c).covBy_succ j
  have hleft : j.castSucc = middleIndex hk := by
    apply Fin.ext
    rfl
  have hright : j.succ = succIndex hk := by
    apply Fin.ext
    rfl
  rwa [hleft, hright] at h

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.sourceRankedFlag_succ_ne_top
statement:
private theorem sourceRankedFlag_succ_ne_top
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n k : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (c : HansenPortalLayer G k) (hk : k < n) :
    sourceRankedFlag hG c (succIndex hk) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro htop
  have heq : succIndex hk = Fin.last (n + 2) :=
    (sourceRankedFlag hG c).injective
      (htop.trans (sourceRankedFlag hG c).map_last.symm)
  have hval := congrArg Fin.val heq
  simp only [succIndex, Fin.val_last] at hval
  omega

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.sourcePortal_covBy_successor
statement:
private theorem sourcePortal_covBy_successor
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n k : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (c : HansenPortalLayer G k) (hk : k < n) :
    (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.2.1 ⋖
      (sourceSuccessor hG c hk).1
proof:
:= by
  change (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.2.1 ⋖
    sourceRankedFlag hG c (succIndex hk)
  rw [← sourceRankedFlag_middle_eq hG c hk]
  exact sourceRankedFlag_middle_covBy_succ hG c hk

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.neutralAlternative_spec
statement:
private theorem neutralAlternative_spec
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n k : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (hSquare : PairedPositivePortalSquare G)
    (c : HansenPortalLayer G k) (hk : k < n) :
    (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.1.1 ⋖
        (neutralAlternative hG hSquare c hk).1 ∧
      (neutralAlternative hG hSquare c hk).1 ⋖
        (sourceSuccessor hG c hk).1
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (hSquare.1
    (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.1
    (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.2
    (sourceSuccessor hG c hk)
    (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.2
    (sourcePortal_covBy_successor hG c hk))).1

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.switchedRankedFlag_middle_eq
statement:
private theorem switchedRankedFlag_middle_eq
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n k : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (hSquare : PairedPositivePortalSquare G)
    (c : HansenPortalLayer G k) (hk : k < n) :
    switchedRankedFlag hG hSquare c hk (middleIndex hk) =
      (neutralAlternative hG hSquare c hk).1
proof:
:= by
  unfold switchedRankedFlag RankedFlag.switchMiddle
  simp [switchSlot, middleIndex, RankedFlag.switchMiddleIndex]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.switchedRankedFlag_succ_eq
statement:
private theorem switchedRankedFlag_succ_eq
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n k : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (hSquare : PairedPositivePortalSquare G)
    (c : HansenPortalLayer G k) (hk : k < n) :
    switchedRankedFlag hG hSquare c hk (succIndex hk) =
      (sourceSuccessor hG c hk).1
proof:
:= by
  unfold switchedRankedFlag RankedFlag.switchMiddle sourceSuccessor
  simp [succIndex, switchSlot, RankedFlag.switchMiddleIndex]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.switchedPortalCode_lower_card
statement:
private theorem switchedPortalCode_lower_card
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n k : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (hSquare : PairedPositivePortalSquare G)
    (c : HansenPortalLayer G k) (hk : k < n) :
    Nat.card (switchedPortalCode hG hSquare c hk).2.1 = k + 2
proof:
:= by
  have hcode := card_restrictIic_markedOfPortalCode G
    (switchedPortalCode hG hSquare c hk)
  have hmarked :
      markedOfPortalCode G (switchedPortalCode hG hSquare c hk) =
        switchedMarkedPortalFlag hG hSquare c hk := by
    exact (hansenPortalCodeEquiv G).symm_apply_apply _
  have hrank := RankedFlag.card_restrictIic_apply
    (switchedRankedFlag hG hSquare c hk) (middleIndex hk)
  rw [hmarked] at hcode
  change Nat.card
      (Flag.restrictIic (switchedRankedFlag hG hSquare c hk).toFlag
        (switchedRankedFlag hG hSquare c hk (middleIndex hk)) _) = _ at hcode
  exact hcode.symm.trans (by simpa only [middleIndex] using hrank)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.switchedRankedFlag_pred_eq_source
statement:
private theorem switchedRankedFlag_pred_eq_source
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n k : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (hSquare : PairedPositivePortalSquare G)
    (c : HansenPortalLayer G k) (hk : k < n) :
    switchedRankedFlag hG hSquare c hk (predIndex hk) =
      sourceRankedFlag hG c (predIndex hk)
proof:
:= by
  unfold switchedRankedFlag RankedFlag.switchMiddle
  simp [predIndex, switchSlot, RankedFlag.switchMiddleIndex]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.switchedRankedFlag_apply_of_ne
statement:
private theorem switchedRankedFlag_apply_of_ne
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n k : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (hSquare : PairedPositivePortalSquare G)
    (c : HansenPortalLayer G k) (hk : k < n)
    (j : Fin (n + 3)) (hj : j ≠ middleIndex hk) :
    switchedRankedFlag hG hSquare c hk j = sourceRankedFlag hG c j
proof:
:= by
  unfold switchedRankedFlag RankedFlag.switchMiddle
  have hne : j ≠ RankedFlag.switchMiddleIndex (switchSlot hk) := by
    intro heq
    apply hj
    apply Fin.ext
    have hval := congrArg Fin.val heq
    simpa only [middleIndex, switchSlot, RankedFlag.switchMiddleIndex] using hval
  simp only [hne, ite_false]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalLayerSwitch_injective
statement:
theorem hansenPortalLayerSwitch_injective
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n k : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (hSquare : PairedPositivePortalSquare G) (hk : k < n) :
    Function.Injective (hansenPortalLayerSwitch hG hSquare hk)
proof:
:= by
  intro c d hcd
  have hcode : switchedPortalCode hG hSquare c hk =
      switchedPortalCode hG hSquare d hk := congrArg Subtype.val hcd
  have hmarked : switchedMarkedPortalFlag hG hSquare c hk =
      switchedMarkedPortalFlag hG hSquare d hk :=
    (hansenPortalCodeEquiv G).injective hcode
  have hflag : (switchedRankedFlag hG hSquare c hk).toFlag =
      (switchedRankedFlag hG hSquare d hk).toFlag :=
    congrArg (fun z : HansenPortalFlag G ↦ z.1.2) hmarked
  have hranked : switchedRankedFlag hG hSquare c hk =
      switchedRankedFlag hG hSquare d hk :=
    RankedFlag.toFlag_injective hflag
  have hEface : (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.1.1 =
      (markedOfPortalCode G d.1).1.1.1.1.1 := by
    calc
      (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.1.1 =
          sourceRankedFlag hG c (predIndex hk) :=
        (sourceRankedFlag_pred_eq hG c hk).symm
      _ = switchedRankedFlag hG hSquare c hk (predIndex hk) :=
        (switchedRankedFlag_pred_eq_source hG hSquare c hk).symm
      _ = switchedRankedFlag hG hSquare d hk (predIndex hk) :=
        congrArg (fun f ↦ f (predIndex hk)) hranked
      _ = sourceRankedFlag hG d (predIndex hk) :=
        switchedRankedFlag_pred_eq_source hG hSquare d hk
      _ = (markedOfPortalCode G d.1).1.1.1.1.1 :=
        sourceRankedFlag_pred_eq hG d hk
  have hE : (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.1 =
      (markedOfPortalCode G d.1).1.1.1.1 := Subtype.ext hEface
  have hportalOut : switchedPortal hG hSquare c hk =
      switchedPortal hG hSquare d hk :=
    congrArg (fun z : HansenPortalFlag G ↦ z.1.1) hmarked
  have hH : sourceSuccessor hG c hk = sourceSuccessor hG d hk := by
    have h := congrArg (fun p : HansenPortal G ↦ p.1.2) hportalOut
    simpa only [switchedPortal] using h
  let Ec := (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.1
  let Fc := (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.2
  let Ed := (markedOfPortalCode G d.1).1.1.1.1
  let Fd := (markedOfPortalCode G d.1).1.1.1.2
  let Hc := sourceSuccessor hG c hk
  let Hd := sourceSuccessor hG d hk
  have hFdSquare : Ec.1 ⋖ Fd.1 ∧ Fd.1 ⋖ Hc.1 := by
    constructor
    · simpa only [Ec, Ed, Fd, hE] using
        (markedOfPortalCode G d.1).1.1.2
    · simpa only [Fc, Fd, Hc, Hd, hH] using
        sourcePortal_covBy_successor hG d hk
  have hF : Fd = Fc := hSquare.2 Ec Fc Hc
    (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.2
    (sourcePortal_covBy_successor hG c hk) Fd hFdSquare
  have hsourceRanked : sourceRankedFlag hG c = sourceRankedFlag hG d := by
    apply RankedFlag.ext
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j = middleIndex hk
    · subst j
      rw [sourceRankedFlag_middle_eq hG c hk,
        sourceRankedFlag_middle_eq hG d hk]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val hF.symm
    · calc
        sourceRankedFlag hG c j = switchedRankedFlag hG hSquare c hk j :=
          (switchedRankedFlag_apply_of_ne hG hSquare c hk j hj).symm
        _ = switchedRankedFlag hG hSquare d hk j :=
          congrArg (fun f ↦ f j) hranked
        _ = sourceRankedFlag hG d j :=
          switchedRankedFlag_apply_of_ne hG hSquare d hk j hj
  have hsourcePortal : (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1 =
      (markedOfPortalCode G d.1).1.1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact hE
    · exact hF.symm
  have hsourceFlag : (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.2 =
      (markedOfPortalCode G d.1).1.2 := by
    calc
      (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.2 = (sourceRankedFlag hG c).toFlag :=
        (sourceRankedFlag_toFlag hG c).symm
      _ = (sourceRankedFlag hG d).toFlag := congrArg RankedFlag.toFlag hsourceRanked
      _ = (markedOfPortalCode G d.1).1.2 := sourceRankedFlag_toFlag hG d
  have hsourceMarked : markedOfPortalCode G c.1 = markedOfPortalCode G d.1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact hsourcePortal
    · exact hsourceFlag
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (hansenPortalCodeEquiv G).symm.injective hsourceMarked

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalLayerSwitch_has_rooted_middle
statement:
theorem hansenPortalLayerSwitch_has_rooted_middle
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n k : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (hSquare : PairedPositivePortalSquare G) (hk : k < n)
    (c : HansenPortalLayer G k) :
    ∃ F : RootedPos G,
      (portalLayerRankedFlag hG
          (hansenPortalLayerSwitch hG hSquare hk c)
          ⟨k, by omega⟩) ⋖ F.1 ∧
        F.1 ⋖ (hansenPortalLayerSwitch hG hSquare hk c).1.1.1.2.1
proof:
:= by
  let target := hansenPortalLayerSwitch hG hSquare hk c
  have hmarked :
      markedOfPortalCode G target.1 =
        switchedMarkedPortalFlag hG hSquare c hk := by
    exact (hansenPortalCodeEquiv G).symm_apply_apply _
  have hflag :
      (portalLayerRankedFlag hG target).toFlag =
        (switchedRankedFlag hG hSquare c hk).toFlag := by
    rw [portalLayerRankedFlag_toFlag]
    exact congrArg (fun z : HansenPortalFlag G ↦ z.1.2) hmarked
  have hranked :
      portalLayerRankedFlag hG target =
        switchedRankedFlag hG hSquare c hk :=
    RankedFlag.toFlag_injective hflag
  have hportal : target.1.1 = switchedPortal hG hSquare c hk := by
    calc
      target.1.1 = (markedOfPortalCode G target.1).1.1 :=
        (markedOfPortalCode_portal G target.1).symm
      _ = (switchedMarkedPortalFlag hG hSquare c hk).1.1 :=
        congrArg (fun z : HansenPortalFlag G ↦ z.1.1) hmarked
      _ = switchedPortal hG hSquare c hk := rfl
  have hupper : target.1.1.1.2 = sourceSuccessor hG c hk := by
    have h := congrArg (fun p : HansenPortal G ↦ p.1.2) hportal
    simpa only [switchedPortal] using h
  refine ⟨(markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change portalLayerRankedFlag hG target (predIndex hk) ⋖
      (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.1.2.1
    rw [hranked, switchedRankedFlag_pred_eq_source,
      sourceRankedFlag_pred_eq]
    exact (markedOfPortalCode G c.1).1.1.2
  · rw [hupper]
    exact sourcePortal_covBy_successor hG c hk

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.HansenJoinPortalShuffleCode.upper_left_steps
statement:
theorem HansenJoinPortalShuffleCode.upper_left_steps
    {A : SimpleGraph V} {B : SimpleGraph W} {n : ℕ}

    (c : HansenJoinPortalShuffleCode A B) :

proof:
:= by
  have htotal := portalCode_card hA c.leftFactorCode
  change Nat.card c.2.1.leftFlag + Nat.card c.2.2.leftFlag + 1 =
    n + 3 at htotal
  rw [c.2.1.left_card, c.2.2.left_card] at htotal

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.HansenJoinPortalShuffleCode.card_path_fibre
statement:
theorem HansenJoinPortalShuffleCode.card_path_fibre
    {A : SimpleGraph V} {B : SimpleGraph W} {n m : ℕ}
    (hA : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace A) (n + 3))
    (hB : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace B) (m + 3))
    (c : HansenJoinPortalShuffleCode A B) :
    Nat.card
        (ShufflePath c.2.1.n c.2.1.m ×
          ShufflePath c.2.2.n c.2.2.m) =
      Nat.choose (c.2.1.n + c.2.1.m) c.2.1.n *
        Nat.choose
          ((n - c.2.1.n) + (m - c.2.1.m))
          (n - c.2.1.n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_prod, Interleaving.card_shufflePath_eq_choose,
    Interleaving.card_shufflePath_eq_choose,
    c.upper_left_steps hA, c.upper_right_steps hB]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.card_hansenJoinFactorLayer_fibre
statement:
theorem card_hansenJoinFactorLayer_fibre
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (n m t : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1)) (l : Fin (m + 1)) :
    Nat.card
        {_z :
            (HansenPortalLayer A k.1 × HansenPortalLayer B l.1) ×
              (ShufflePath k.1 l.1 ×
                ShufflePath (n - k.1) (m - l.1)) //
          k.1 + l.1 = t} =
      if PortalRankCompatible t k.1 l.1 then
        Fintype.card
          (RestrictedProductPortalChain n m t k.1 l.1
            (hansenPortalVector A k.1) (hansenPortalVector B l.1))
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : k.1 + l.1 = t
  · have hp : PortalRankCompatible t k.1 l.1 := h
    rw [ite_eq_left hp]
    let e :
        {z :
            (HansenPortalLayer A k.1 × HansenPortalLayer B l.1) ×
              (ShufflePath k.1 l.1 ×
                ShufflePath (n - k.1) (m - l.1)) //
          k.1 + l.1 = t} ≃
        (HansenPortalLayer A k.1 × HansenPortalLayer B l.1) ×
          (ShufflePath k.1 l.1 ×
            ShufflePath (n - k.1) (m - l.1)) :=
      { toFun := fun z => z.1
        invFun := fun z => ⟨z, h⟩
        left_inv := fun _ => rfl
        right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
    rw [Nat.card_congr e, Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_prod,
      Interleaving.card_shufflePath_eq_choose,
      Interleaving.card_shufflePath_eq_choose,
      card_restrictedProductPortalChain]
    simp only [hansenPortalVector, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    have hk : k.1 ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp k.2
    have hl : l.1 ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp l.2
    have hu := restrictedProduct_upper_rank_sum hk hl hp
    rw [hu]
    ac_rfl
  · have hp : ¬ PortalRankCompatible t k.1 l.1 := h
    rw [ite_eq_right hp]
    let e :
          {z :
              (HansenPortalLayer A k.1 × HansenPortalLayer B l.1) ×
                (ShufflePath k.1 l.1 ×
                  ShufflePath (n - k.1) (m - l.1)) //
            k.1 + l.1 = t} ≃ Empty :=
      { toFun := fun z => False.elim (h z.2)
        invFun := fun z => nomatch z
        left_inv := fun z => False.elim (h z.2)
        right_inv := fun z => nomatch z }
    rw [Nat.card_congr e]
    simp

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.card_hansenJoinFactorLayerCode_eq_restrictedProductPortalCount
statement:
theorem card_hansenJoinFactorLayerCode_eq_restrictedProductPortalCount
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (n m t : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (HansenJoinFactorLayerCode A B n m t) =
      restrictedProductPortalCount n m t
        (hansenPortalVector A) (hansenPortalVector B)
proof:
:= by
  unfold restrictedProductPortalCount
  let F : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ := fun k l =>
    Nat.card
      {z :
          (HansenPortalLayer A k × HansenPortalLayer B l) ×
            (ShufflePath k l × ShufflePath (n - k) (m - l)) //
        k + l = t}
  rw [Nat.card_sigma]
  simp_rw [Nat.card_sigma]
  change (∑ k : Fin (n + 1), ∑ l : Fin (m + 1), F k.1 l.1) = _
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
    (fun k : ℕ => ∑ l : Fin (m + 1), F k l.1)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun l : ℕ => F k l)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro l hl
  exact card_hansenJoinFactorLayer_fibre A B n m t
    ⟨k, Finset.mem_range.mp hk⟩ ⟨l, Finset.mem_range.mp hl⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector_join_eq_restrictedProductPortalCount
statement:
theorem hansenPortalVector_join_eq_restrictedProductPortalCount
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    {n m : ℕ}
    (hA : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace A) (n + 3))
    (hB : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace B) (m + 3))
    (t : ℕ) :
    hansenPortalVector (A ⊗g B) t =
      restrictedProductPortalCount n m t
        (hansenPortalVector A) (hansenPortalVector B)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    hansenPortalVector (A ⊗g B) t =
        Nat.card (HansenJoinPortalShuffleLayerCode A B t) :=
      (by
        change Fintype.card (HansenPortalLayer (A ⊗g B) t) = _
        rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
        exact (Nat.card_congr (hansenJoinPortalLayerEquiv A B t)).symm)
    _ = Nat.card (HansenJoinFactorLayerCode A B n m t) :=
      Nat.card_congr (hansenJoinFactorLayerEquiv A B hA hB t)
    _ = restrictedProductPortalCount n m t
          (hansenPortalVector A) (hansenPortalVector B) :=
      card_hansenJoinFactorLayerCode_eq_restrictedProductPortalCount
        A B n m t

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector_join_cast_eq_portalShuffleConvolution
statement:
theorem hansenPortalVector_join_cast_eq_portalShuffleConvolution
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    {n m : ℕ}
    (hA : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace A) (n + 3))
    (hB : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace B) (m + 3))
    (t : ℕ) :
    (hansenPortalVector (A ⊗g B) t : ℝ) =
      portalShuffleConvolution n m
        (fun k => (hansenPortalVector A k : ℝ))
        (fun l => (hansenPortalVector B l : ℝ)) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [hansenPortalVector_join_eq_restrictedProductPortalCount A B hA hB t]
  exact restrictedProductPortalCount_cast_eq_portalShuffleConvolution
    n m t (hansenPortalVector A) (hansenPortalVector B)

name: HansenCograph.card_sumFinset_hda
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_sumFinset_hda (s : Finset V) (t : Finset W) :

proof:
:= by
  unfold sumFinset

  · simp
  · simp [Finset.disjoint_left]

name: HansenCograph.sectionWeight_eq_qCoeff_mul_factorials
statement:
theorem sectionWeight_eq_qCoeff_mul_factorials
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (s : Finset V) :
    sectionWeight G s =
      qCoeff G s *
        ((s.card.factorial : ℝ) *
          ((Fintype.card V - s.card).factorial : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  unfold sectionWeight qCoeff
  have hleft : (s.card.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hright : ((Fintype.card V - s.card).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp [hleft, hright]

name: HansenCograph.sectionWeight_sumFinset
statement:
theorem sectionWeight_sumFinset
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (s : Finset V) (t : Finset W) :
    sectionWeight (A ⊕g B) (sumFinset s t) =
      sumSectionKernel (Fintype.card V) (Fintype.card W) s.card t.card *
        sectionWeight A s * sectionWeight B t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsle : s.card ≤ Fintype.card V := Finset.card_le_univ s
  have htle : t.card ≤ Fintype.card W := Finset.card_le_univ t
  have hremaining :
      Fintype.card V + Fintype.card W - (s.card + t.card) =
        (Fintype.card V - s.card) + (Fintype.card W - t.card) := by
    omega
  have hfac (a b : ℕ) :
      (((a + b).factorial : ℕ) : ℝ) =
        (Nat.choose (a + b) a : ℝ) * a.factorial * b.factorial := by
    norm_cast
    simpa using
      (Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial
        (show a ≤ a + b by omega)).symm
  rw [sectionWeight_eq_qCoeff_mul_factorials (A ⊕g B) (sumFinset s t)]
  rw [qCoeff_sumFinset, card_sumFinset_hda, Fintype.card_sum, hremaining,
    hfac s.card t.card,
    hfac (Fintype.card V - s.card) (Fintype.card W - t.card)]
  rw [sectionWeight_eq_qCoeff_mul_factorials A s,
    sectionWeight_eq_qCoeff_mul_factorials B t]
  unfold sumSectionKernel
  ring

name: HansenCograph.sectionWeight_joinFinset
statement:
theorem sectionWeight_joinFinset
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (s : Finset V) (t : Finset W) :
    sectionWeight (A ⊗g B) (sumFinset s t) =
      joinSectionKernel (Fintype.card V) (Fintype.card W) s.card t.card *
        sectionWeight A s * sectionWeight B t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsle : s.card ≤ Fintype.card V := Finset.card_le_univ s
  have htle : t.card ≤ Fintype.card W := Finset.card_le_univ t
  have hremaining :
      Fintype.card V + Fintype.card W - (s.card + t.card) =
        (Fintype.card V - s.card) + (Fintype.card W - t.card) := by
    omega
  have hfac (a b : ℕ) :
      (((a + b).factorial : ℕ) : ℝ) =
        (Nat.choose (a + b) a : ℝ) * a.factorial * b.factorial := by
    norm_cast
    simpa using
      (Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial
        (show a ≤ a + b by omega)).symm
  have hchoose (a b : ℕ) : (Nat.choose (a + b) a : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.choose_pos (by omega : a ≤ a + b)))
  rw [sectionWeight_eq_qCoeff_mul_factorials (A ⊗g B) (sumFinset s t)]
  rw [qCoeff_joinFinset, card_sumFinset_hda, Fintype.card_sum, hremaining,
    hfac s.card t.card,
    hfac (Fintype.card V - s.card) (Fintype.card W - t.card)]
  rw [sectionWeight_eq_qCoeff_mul_factorials A s,
    sectionWeight_eq_qCoeff_mul_factorials B t]
  unfold joinSectionKernel
  field_simp [hchoose s.card t.card,
    hchoose (Fintype.card V - s.card) (Fintype.card W - t.card)]
  <;> ring

name: HansenCograph.sumLeftPart_sumFinset_hda
statement:
theorem sumLeftPart_sumFinset_hda (s : Finset V) (t : Finset W) :
    sumLeftPart (sumFinset s t) = s
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp

name: HansenCograph.sumRightPart_sumFinset_hda
statement:
theorem sumRightPart_sumFinset_hda (s : Finset V) (t : Finset W) :
    sumRightPart (sumFinset s t) = t
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  simp

name: HansenCograph.sumFinset_parts_hda
statement:
theorem sumFinset_parts_hda (s : Finset (V ⊕ W)) :
    sumFinset (sumLeftPart s) (sumRightPart s) = s
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  cases z <;> simp

name: HansenCograph.sum_powersetCard_sumFinset_filter
statement:
theorem sum_powersetCard_sumFinset_filter
    (p : ℕ) (f : Finset (V ⊕ W) → ℝ) :
    ∑ u ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (V ⊕ W)).powersetCard p, f u =
      ∑ st ∈
          (((Finset.univ : Finset V).powerset ×ˢ
            (Finset.univ : Finset W).powerset).filter
              (fun st => st.1.card + st.2.card = p)),
        f (sumFinset st.1 st.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun u _ => (sumLeftPart u, sumRightPart u))
  · intro u hu
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
    calc
      (sumLeftPart u).card + (sumRightPart u).card =
          (sumFinset (sumLeftPart u) (sumRightPart u)).card :=
        (card_sumFinset_hda _ _).symm
      _ = u.card := congrArg Finset.card (sumFinset_parts_hda u)
      _ = p := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hu).2
  · intro u₁ hu₁ u₂ hu₂ h
    have hleft : sumLeftPart u₁ = sumLeftPart u₂ := congrArg Prod.fst h
    have hright : sumRightPart u₁ = sumRightPart u₂ := congrArg Prod.snd h
    calc
      u₁ = sumFinset (sumLeftPart u₁) (sumRightPart u₁) :=
        (sumFinset_parts_hda u₁).symm
      _ = sumFinset (sumLeftPart u₂) (sumRightPart u₂) := by
        rw [hleft, hright]
      _ = u₂ := sumFinset_parts_hda u₂
  · rintro ⟨s, t⟩ hst
    have hmem := Finset.mem_filter.mp hst
    refine ⟨sumFinset s t, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, ?_⟩
      simpa [card_sumFinset_hda] using hmem.2
    · simp [sumLeftPart_sumFinset_hda, sumRightPart_sumFinset_hda]
  · intro u hu
    rw [sumFinset_parts_hda]

name: HansenCograph.filtered_pair_sum_eq_cardFiberPairs
statement:
theorem filtered_pair_sum_eq_cardFiberPairs
    (p : ℕ) (f : Finset V → Finset W → ℝ) :
    ∑ st ∈
        (((Finset.univ : Finset V).powerset ×ˢ
          (Finset.univ : Finset W).powerset).filter
            (fun st => st.1.card + st.2.card = p)),
      f st.1 st.2 =
      ∑ z ∈ cardFiberPairs (V := V) (W := W) p, f z.2.1 z.2.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold cardFiberPairs
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun st _ => ⟨(st.1.card, st.2.card), st⟩)
  · intro st hst
    rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hst with ⟨hstmem, hcard⟩
    refine Finset.mem_sigma.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, hcard⟩, ?_⟩
    · refine Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Finset.mem_range.mpr
          (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Finset.card_le_univ st.1))
      · exact Finset.mem_range.mpr
          (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Finset.card_le_univ st.2))
    · exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨
        Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, rfl⟩,
        Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, rfl⟩⟩
  · intro st₁ hst₁ st₂ hst₂ h
    exact eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp h).2
  · rintro ⟨ij, st⟩ h
    rcases ij with ⟨i, j⟩
    rcases Finset.mem_sigma.mp h with ⟨hij, hst⟩
    rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hij with ⟨hijrange, hijcard⟩
    rcases Finset.mem_product.mp hst with ⟨hs, ht⟩
    refine ⟨st, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · refine Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa using (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hs).1
      · simpa using (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp ht).1
    · have hscard : st.1.card = i := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hs).2
      have htcard : st.2.card = j := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp ht).2
      simpa [hscard, htcard] using hijcard
    · have hscard : st.1.card = i := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hs).2
      have htcard : st.2.card = j := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp ht).2
      simp [hscard, htcard]
  · intro st hst
    rfl

name: HansenCograph.cardinal_fiber_product_factor
statement:
theorem cardinal_fiber_product_factor
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) (κ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (i j : ℕ) :
    ∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset V).powersetCard i,
      ∑ t ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset W).powersetCard j,
        κ s.card t.card * sectionWeight A s * sectionWeight B t =
      κ i j * dArray A i * dArray B j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    ∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset V).powersetCard i,
        ∑ t ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset W).powersetCard j,
          κ s.card t.card * sectionWeight A s * sectionWeight B t =
        ∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset V).powersetCard i,
          ∑ t ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset W).powersetCard j,
            κ i j * sectionWeight A s * sectionWeight B t := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s hs
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro t ht
      have hscard : s.card = i := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hs).2
      have htcard : t.card = j := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp ht).2
      simp [hscard, htcard]
    _ = ∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset V).powersetCard i,
          (κ i j * sectionWeight A s) *
            ∑ t ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset W).powersetCard j,
              sectionWeight B t := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s hs
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset V).powersetCard i,
          (κ i j *
            ∑ t ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset W).powersetCard j,
              sectionWeight B t) * sectionWeight A s := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s hs
      ring
    _ = (κ i j *
          ∑ t ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset W).powersetCard j,
            sectionWeight B t) *
          ∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset V).powersetCard i,
            sectionWeight A s := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = κ i j * dArray A i * dArray B j := by
      unfold dArray
      ring

name: HansenCograph.dArray_sum_filter_expansion
statement:
theorem dArray_sum_filter_expansion
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) (p : ℕ) :
    dArray (A ⊕g B) p =
      ∑ st ∈
          (((Finset.univ : Finset V).powerset ×ˢ
            (Finset.univ : Finset W).powerset).filter
              (fun st => st.1.card + st.2.card = p)),
        sumSectionKernel (Fintype.card V) (Fintype.card W)
            st.1.card st.2.card *
          sectionWeight A st.1 * sectionWeight B st.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold dArray
  rw [sum_powersetCard_sumFinset_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro st hst
  rw [sectionWeight_sumFinset]

name: HansenCograph.dArray_join_filter_expansion
statement:
theorem dArray_join_filter_expansion
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) (p : ℕ) :
    dArray (A ⊗g B) p =
      ∑ st ∈
          (((Finset.univ : Finset V).powerset ×ˢ
            (Finset.univ : Finset W).powerset).filter
              (fun st => st.1.card + st.2.card = p)),
        joinSectionKernel (Fintype.card V) (Fintype.card W)
            st.1.card st.2.card *
          sectionWeight A st.1 * sectionWeight B st.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold dArray
  rw [sum_powersetCard_sumFinset_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro st hst
  rw [sectionWeight_joinFinset]

name: HansenCograph.dArray_sum
statement:
theorem dArray_sum
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) (p : ℕ) :
    dArray (A ⊕g B) p = sumDArrayRhs A B p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold sumDArrayRhs
  rw [dArray_sum_filter_expansion]
  rw [filtered_pair_sum_eq_cardFiberPairs
    (V := V) (W := W) p
    (fun s t =>
      sumSectionKernel (Fintype.card V) (Fintype.card W) s.card t.card *
        sectionWeight A s * sectionWeight B t)]
  unfold cardFiberPairs
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_product]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_product]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  by_cases h : i + j = p
  · simpa only [if_pos h, Prod.fst, Prod.snd] using
      (cardinal_fiber_product_factor A B
        (sumSectionKernel (Fintype.card V) (Fintype.card W)) i j)
  · simp [h]

name: HansenCograph.dArray_join
statement:
theorem dArray_join
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) (p : ℕ) :
    dArray (A ⊗g B) p = joinDArrayRhs A B p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold joinDArrayRhs
  rw [dArray_join_filter_expansion]
  rw [filtered_pair_sum_eq_cardFiberPairs
    (V := V) (W := W) p
    (fun s t =>
      joinSectionKernel (Fintype.card V) (Fintype.card W) s.card t.card *
        sectionWeight A s * sectionWeight B t)]
  unfold cardFiberPairs
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_product]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_product]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  by_cases h : i + j = p
  · simpa only [if_pos h, Prod.fst, Prod.snd] using
      (cardinal_fiber_product_factor A B
        (joinSectionKernel (Fintype.card V) (Fintype.card W)) i j)
  · simp [h]

name: HansenCograph.generalBoundedSizedFlagProduct_card_lower_bound
statement:
theorem generalBoundedSizedFlagProduct_card_lower_bound :
    Nat.card (GeneralBoundedSizedProductCode (P := P) (Q := Q)) ≤
      Nat.card (Flag (P × Q))
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.card_le_card_of_injective
    (generalBoundedSizedFlagProductEmbedding (P := P) (Q := Q))
    (generalBoundedSizedFlagProductEmbedding (P := P) (Q := Q)).injective

name: HansenCograph.generalBoundedSizedFlagProduct_card_lower_bound_sum
statement:
theorem generalBoundedSizedFlagProduct_card_lower_bound_sum :
    (∑ n : Fin (Fintype.card P), ∑ m : Fin (Fintype.card Q),
      Nat.card (SizedFlag P n) * Nat.card (SizedFlag Q m) *
        Nat.choose (n + m) n) ≤ Nat.card (Flag (P × Q))
proof:
:= by
  have h := generalBoundedSizedFlagProduct_card_lower_bound
    (P := P) (Q := Q)
  simp only [Nat.card_sigma, Nat.card_prod, Set.powersetCard.card,
    Nat.card_fin] at h
  simpa only [Nat.mul_assoc] using h

name: HansenCograph.portalShuffleConvolution_mass_normalized_ge
statement:
theorem portalShuffleConvolution_mass_normalized_ge
    {n m : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha : MonotoneOn (portalPolynomial n a) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hb : MonotoneOn (portalPolynomial m b) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k) /
          ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) *
        ((∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), b l) /
          ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) ≤
      (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1),
          portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s) /
        ((n + m + 1).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [integral_portalPolynomial] using
    (portalPolynomial_convolution_integral_ge ha hb)

name: HansenCograph.portalShuffleConvolution_mass_normalized_gt
statement:
theorem portalShuffleConvolution_mass_normalized_gt
    {n m : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha : MonotoneOn (portalPolynomial n a) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hb : MonotoneOn (portalPolynomial m b) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (ha_strict : a 0 < a n) (hb_strict : b 0 < b m) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k) /
          ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) *
        ((∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), b l) /
          ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) <
      (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1),
          portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s) /
        ((n + m + 1).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [integral_portalPolynomial] using
    (portalPolynomial_convolution_integral_gt ha hb
      ((portalPolynomial_zero_lt_one_iff n a).mpr ha_strict)
      ((portalPolynomial_zero_lt_one_iff m b).mpr hb_strict))

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.singletonState_admissible
statement: theorem singletonState_admissible : singletonState.Admissible
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [singletonState, Admissible, WellFormed, pointedDefect,
    coPointedDefect]

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.singletonState_stronglyAdmissible
statement:
theorem singletonState_stronglyAdmissible :
    singletonState.StronglyAdmissible
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨singletonState_admissible, by norm_num [singletonState],
    by norm_num [singletonState], by norm_num [singletonState]⟩

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.s_pos_of_admissible
statement:
theorem s_pos_of_admissible {X : PointedFaceState} (hX : X.Admissible) :
    0 < X.s
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 1 ≤ X.r := by nlinarith [hX.1.1, hX.2.1, hX.2.2.1]
  have hx := hX.2.2.2.2.1
  simp only [pointedDefect] at hx
  nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.union_total_correction
statement:
theorem union_total_correction {A B : PointedFaceState} :
    3 * (A.union B).s - A.s * B.s =
      2 * A.coPointedDefect * B.coPointedDefect
proof:
:= by
  change 3 * (A.dual.join B.dual).s - A.s * B.s =
    2 * A.coPointedDefect * B.coPointedDefect
  rw [← dual_pointedDefect A, ← dual_pointedDefect B]
  exact join_total_correction (A := A.dual) (B := B.dual)

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.StateExpr.weight_pos
statement: theorem weight_pos : forall E : StateExpr, 0 < E.weight
proof:
:= by
  intro E
  induction E with
  | leaf => norm_num [weight]
  | union A B ihA ihB =>
      simpa [weight] using Int.mul_pos ihA ihB
  | join A B ihA ihB =>
      simpa [weight] using Int.mul_pos ihA ihB

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.StateExpr.weight_eq_pow
statement:
theorem weight_eq_pow : forall E : StateExpr,
    E.weight = (3 : Int) ^ E.order
proof:
:= by
  intro E
  induction E with
  | leaf => simp [weight, order]
  | union A B ihA ihB => simp [weight, order, ihA, ihB, pow_add]
  | join A B ihA ihB => simp [weight, order, ihA, ihB, pow_add]

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.StateExpr.product_lower_bound
statement:
private theorem product_lower_bound
    {wA wB sA sB : Int}
    (hwA : 0 <= wA) (hwB : 0 <= wB)
    (hA : 3 * wA <= sA) (hB : 3 * wB <= sB) :
    (3 * wA) * (3 * wB) <= sA * sB
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (3 * wA) * (3 * wB) <= sA * (3 * wB) :=
      Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA (by positivity)
    _ <= sA * sB :=
      Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB (le_trans (by positivity) hA)

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.StateExpr.eval_s_ge_three_mul_weight
statement:
theorem eval_s_ge_three_mul_weight : forall E : StateExpr,
    3 * E.weight <=
      (E.eval singletonState PointedFaceState.union).s
proof:
:= by
  intro E
  induction E with
  | leaf => norm_num [weight, eval, singletonState]
  | union A B ihA ihB =>
      let XA := A.eval singletonState PointedFaceState.union
      let XB := B.eval singletonState PointedFaceState.union
      have hwA : 0 <= A.weight := (weight_pos A).le
      have hwB : 0 <= B.weight := (weight_pos B).le
      have hprod : (3 * A.weight) * (3 * B.weight) <= XA.s * XB.s :=
        product_lower_bound hwA hwB ihA ihB
      have hAdmA : XA.Admissible :=
        eval_admissible singletonState singletonState_admissible A
      have hAdmB : XB.Admissible :=
        eval_admissible singletonState singletonState_admissible B
      have hcorr := union_total_correction (A := XA) (B := XB)
      have hdefect :
          0 <= 2 * XA.coPointedDefect * XB.coPointedDefect := by
        exact Int.mul_nonneg
          (Int.mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hAdmA.2.2.2.2.2) hAdmB.2.2.2.2.2
      change 3 * (A.weight * B.weight) <= (XA.union XB).s
      nlinarith
  | join A B ihA ihB =>
      let XA := A.eval singletonState PointedFaceState.union
      let XB := B.eval singletonState PointedFaceState.union
      have hwA : 0 <= A.weight := (weight_pos A).le
      have hwB : 0 <= B.weight := (weight_pos B).le
      have hprod : (3 * A.weight) * (3 * B.weight) <= XA.s * XB.s :=
        product_lower_bound hwA hwB ihA ihB
      have hAdmA : XA.Admissible :=
        eval_admissible singletonState singletonState_admissible A
      have hAdmB : XB.Admissible :=
        eval_admissible singletonState singletonState_admissible B
      have hcorr := join_total_correction (A := XA) (B := XB)
      have hdefect : 0 <= 2 * XA.pointedDefect * XB.pointedDefect := by
        exact Int.mul_nonneg
          (Int.mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hAdmA.2.2.2.2.1) hAdmB.2.2.2.2.1
      change 3 * (A.weight * B.weight) <= (XA.join XB).s
      nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.StateExpr.eval_s_ge_three_pow_order
statement:
theorem eval_s_ge_three_pow_order (E : StateExpr) :
    (3 : Int) ^ (E.order + 1) <=
      (E.eval singletonState PointedFaceState.union).s
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_succ, ← weight_eq_pow E]
  simpa [mul_comm] using eval_s_ge_three_mul_weight E

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.card_vert_eq_order
statement:
theorem card_vert_eq_order : forall T : HansenCograph.Cotree,
    Fintype.card T.Vert = T.order

      rw [order]
      apply Fintype.card_eq_one_iff.mpr
      exact ⟨PUnit.unit, fun y ↦ by cases y; rfl⟩
  | sum A B ihA ihB => simp [HansenCograph.Cotree.Vert, order, ihA, ihB]
  | compl A ih => simpa [HansenCograph.Cotree.Vert, order] using ih

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.weight_pos

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.weight_eq_pow

  intro T
  induction T with

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.faceState_admissible

  | sum A B ihA ihB => exact union_admissible ihA ihB
  | compl A ih => exact dual_admissible ih

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.faceState_stronglyAdmissible

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.faceState_defects_zero_iff
statement:
theorem faceState_defects_zero_iff : forall T : HansenCograph.Cotree,
    (T.faceState.pointedDefect = 0 ↔ T.IsStateComplete) ∧
      (T.faceState.coPointedDefect = 0 ↔ T.IsStateEdgeless)
proof:
:= by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | leaf => norm_num [faceState, singletonState, pointedDefect,
      coPointedDefect, IsStateComplete, IsStateEdgeless]
  | compl A ih =>
      simpa [faceState, IsStateComplete, IsStateEdgeless] using And.intro ih.2 ih.1
  | sum A B ihA ihB =>
      have hStrongA := faceState_stronglyAdmissible A
      have hStrongB := faceState_stronglyAdmissible B
      constructor
      · constructor
        · intro hzero
          exact (ne_of_gt (union_pointedDefect_pos hStrongA hStrongB) hzero).elim
        · intro hfalse
          exact hfalse.elim
      · change (A.faceState.union B.faceState).coPointedDefect = 0 ↔
          A.IsStateEdgeless ∧ B.IsStateEdgeless
        rw [union_coPointedDefect_eq_zero_iff hStrongA hStrongB,
          ihA.2, ihB.2]

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.eval_sum_eq_bot_iff
statement:
theorem eval_sum_eq_bot_iff (A B : HansenCograph.Cotree) :
    HansenCograph.Cotree.eval (.sum A B) = ⊥ ↔
      HansenCograph.Cotree.eval A = ⊥ ∧ HansenCograph.Cotree.eval B = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · apply SimpleGraph.eq_bot_iff_forall_not_adj.mpr
      intro x y hxy
      have hj : (HansenCograph.Cotree.eval (.sum A B)).Adj
          (Sum.inl x) (Sum.inl y) := by simpa using hxy
      rw [h] at hj
      exact hj
    · apply SimpleGraph.eq_bot_iff_forall_not_adj.mpr
      intro x y hxy
      have hj : (HansenCograph.Cotree.eval (.sum A B)).Adj
          (Sum.inr x) (Sum.inr y) := by simpa using hxy
      rw [h] at hj
      exact hj
  · rintro ⟨hA, hB⟩
    apply SimpleGraph.eq_bot_iff_forall_not_adj.mpr
    rintro (x | x) (y | y) <;> simp [HansenCograph.Cotree.eval, hA, hB]

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.eval_sum_ne_top
statement:
theorem eval_sum_ne_top (A B : HansenCograph.Cotree) :
    HansenCograph.Cotree.eval (.sum A B) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  change HansenCograph.Cotree.eval A ⊕g HansenCograph.Cotree.eval B ≠
    (⊤ : SimpleGraph (A.Vert ⊕ B.Vert))
  intro h
  have hcross : (HansenCograph.Cotree.eval A ⊕g
      HansenCograph.Cotree.eval B).Adj
      (Sum.inl A.witness) (Sum.inr B.witness) := by
    rw [h]
    simp
  exact SimpleGraph.not_adj_sum_inl_inr A.witness B.witness hcross

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.compl_eq_top_iff_eq_bot
statement:
private theorem compl_eq_top_iff_eq_bot {X : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph X) :
    Gᶜ = ⊤ ↔ G = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · have hc := congrArg (fun H : SimpleGraph X => Hᶜ) h
    simpa using hc
  · rw [h]
    simp

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.compl_eq_bot_iff_eq_top
statement:
private theorem compl_eq_bot_iff_eq_top {X : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph X) :
    Gᶜ = ⊥ ↔ G = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · have hc := congrArg (fun H : SimpleGraph X => Hᶜ) h
    simpa using hc
  · rw [h]
    simp

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.state_extremal_iff_eval
statement:
theorem state_extremal_iff_eval : forall T : HansenCograph.Cotree,
    (T.IsStateComplete ↔ HansenCograph.Cotree.eval T = ⊤) ∧
      (T.IsStateEdgeless ↔ HansenCograph.Cotree.eval T = ⊥)
proof:
:= by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | leaf =>
      have hbotTop : (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit) = ⊤ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      constructor
      · change True ↔ (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit) = ⊤
        exact ⟨fun _ ↦ hbotTop, fun _ ↦ True.intro⟩
      · change True ↔ (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit) = ⊥
        simp
  | sum A B ihA ihB =>
      constructor
      · constructor
        · intro hfalse
          exact hfalse.elim
        · intro htop
          exact (eval_sum_ne_top A B htop).elim
      · rw [IsStateEdgeless, eval_sum_eq_bot_iff, ← ihA.2, ← ihB.2]
  | compl A ih =>
      constructor
      · change A.IsStateEdgeless ↔
          (HansenCograph.Cotree.eval A)ᶜ = (⊤ : SimpleGraph A.Vert)
        rw [compl_eq_top_iff_eq_bot]
        exact ih.2
      · change A.IsStateComplete ↔
          (HansenCograph.Cotree.eval A)ᶜ = (⊥ : SimpleGraph A.Vert)
        rw [compl_eq_bot_iff_eq_top]
        exact ih.1

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.faceState_pointedDefect_eq_zero_iff_eval_top
statement:
theorem faceState_pointedDefect_eq_zero_iff_eval_top
    (T : HansenCograph.Cotree) :
    T.faceState.pointedDefect = 0 ↔ HansenCograph.Cotree.eval T = ⊤
proof:
:=
  (faceState_defects_zero_iff T).1.trans (state_extremal_iff_eval T).1

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.faceState_coPointedDefect_eq_zero_iff_eval_bot
statement:
theorem faceState_coPointedDefect_eq_zero_iff_eval_bot
    (T : HansenCograph.Cotree) :
