name: HansenCograph.Cotree.product_lower_bound
statement:
private theorem product_lower_bound
    {wA wB sA sB : Int}
    (hwA : 0 <= wA) (hwB : 0 <= wB)
    (hA : 3 * wA <= sA) (hB : 3 * wB <= sB) :
    (3 * wA) * (3 * wB) <= sA * sB
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (3 * wA) * (3 * wB) <= sA * (3 * wB) :=
      Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA (by positivity)
    _ <= sA * sB :=
      Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB (le_trans (by positivity) hA)

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.faceState_s_ge_three_mul_weight
statement:
theorem faceState_s_ge_three_mul_weight : forall T : HansenCograph.Cotree,
    3 * T.weight <= T.faceState.s
proof:
:= by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | leaf => norm_num [weight, faceState, singletonState]
  | compl A ih => simpa [weight, faceState, dual] using ih
  | sum A B ihA ihB =>
      let XA := A.faceState
      let XB := B.faceState
      have hwA : 0 <= A.weight := (weight_pos A).le
      have hwB : 0 <= B.weight := (weight_pos B).le
      have hprod : (3 * A.weight) * (3 * B.weight) <= XA.s * XB.s :=
        product_lower_bound hwA hwB ihA ihB
      have hAdmA : XA.Admissible := faceState_admissible A
      have hAdmB : XB.Admissible := faceState_admissible B
      have hcorr := union_total_correction (A := XA) (B := XB)
      have hdefect :
          0 <= 2 * XA.coPointedDefect * XB.coPointedDefect := by
        exact Int.mul_nonneg
          (Int.mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hAdmA.2.2.2.2.2) hAdmB.2.2.2.2.2
      change 3 * (A.weight * B.weight) <= (XA.union XB).s
      nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.faceState_s_ge_three_pow_order
statement:
theorem faceState_s_ge_three_pow_order (T : HansenCograph.Cotree) :
    (3 : Int) ^ (T.order + 1) <= T.faceState.s
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_succ, ← weight_eq_pow T]
  simpa [mul_comm] using faceState_s_ge_three_mul_weight T

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.faceState_s_ge_three_pow_card
statement:
theorem faceState_s_ge_three_pow_card (T : HansenCograph.Cotree) :
    (3 : Int) ^ (Fintype.card T.Vert + 1) ≤ T.faceState.s
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_vert_eq_order]
  exact faceState_s_ge_three_pow_order T

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.faceState_s_eq_three_pow_order_iff_threshold
statement:
theorem faceState_s_eq_three_pow_order_iff_threshold :
    forall T : HansenCograph.Cotree,
      T.faceState.s = (3 : Int) ^ (T.order + 1) ↔ T.IsThreshold
proof:
:= by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | leaf => norm_num [faceState, singletonState, order, HansenCograph.Cotree.IsThreshold]
  | compl A ih =>
      simpa [faceState, order, dual, HansenCograph.Cotree.IsThreshold] using ih
  | sum A B ihA ihB =>
      let XA := A.faceState
      let XB := B.faceState
      let pA : Int := 3 ^ (A.order + 1)
      let pB : Int := 3 ^ (B.order + 1)
      let p : Int := 3 ^ (A.order + B.order + 1)
      have hStrongA := faceState_stronglyAdmissible A
      have hStrongB := faceState_stronglyAdmissible B
      have hsA : 0 < XA.s := s_pos_of_admissible hStrongA.admissible
      have hsB : 0 < XB.s := s_pos_of_admissible hStrongB.admissible
      have hpA : 0 < pA := by positivity
      have hpB : 0 < pB := by positivity
      have hlowerA : pA ≤ XA.s := faceState_s_ge_three_pow_order A
      have hlowerB : pB ≤ XB.s := faceState_s_ge_three_pow_order B
      have hprod : pA * pB ≤ XA.s * XB.s :=
        Int.mul_le_mul hlowerA hlowerB (by positivity) hsA.le
      have hpow : 3 * p = pA * pB := by
        dsimp [p, pA, pB]
        rw [show A.order + B.order + 1 = (A.order + 1) + B.order by omega,
          pow_add, pow_succ]
        ring
      have hcorr := union_total_correction (A := XA) (B := XB)
      have hyprod : 0 ≤ XA.coPointedDefect * XB.coPointedDefect :=
        Int.mul_nonneg hStrongA.admissible.2.2.2.2.2
          hStrongB.admissible.2.2.2.2.2
      change (XA.union XB).s = p ↔
        A.IsThreshold ∧ B.IsThreshold ∧
          (HansenCograph.Cotree.eval A = ⊥ ∨
            HansenCograph.Cotree.eval B = ⊥)
      constructor
      · intro hparent
        have hprodEq : XA.s * XB.s = pA * pB := by nlinarith
        have hyzero : XA.coPointedDefect * XB.coPointedDefect = 0 := by nlinarith
        have hsAEq : XA.s = pA := by
          by_contra hne
          have hlt : pA < XA.s := lt_of_le_of_ne hlowerA (Ne.symm hne)
          have h1 : pA * pB < XA.s * pB :=
            Int.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hlt hpB
          have h2 : XA.s * pB ≤ XA.s * XB.s :=
            Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlowerB hsA.le
          nlinarith
        have hsBEq : XB.s = pB := by
          by_contra hne
          have hlt : pB < XB.s := lt_of_le_of_ne hlowerB (Ne.symm hne)
          have h1 : pA * pB < pA * XB.s :=
            Int.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlt hpA
          have h2 : pA * XB.s ≤ XA.s * XB.s :=
            Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlowerA hsB.le
          nlinarith
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hyzero with hyA | hyB
        · exact ⟨ihA.mp hsAEq, ihB.mp hsBEq,
            Or.inl ((faceState_coPointedDefect_eq_zero_iff_eval_bot A).mp hyA)⟩
        · exact ⟨ihA.mp hsAEq, ihB.mp hsBEq,
            Or.inr ((faceState_coPointedDefect_eq_zero_iff_eval_bot B).mp hyB)⟩
      · rintro ⟨hTA, hTB, hedge⟩
        have hsAEq : XA.s = pA := ihA.mpr hTA
        have hsBEq : XB.s = pB := ihB.mpr hTB
        have hyzero : XA.coPointedDefect * XB.coPointedDefect = 0 := by
          rcases hedge with hedge | hedge
          · rw [(faceState_coPointedDefect_eq_zero_iff_eval_bot A).mpr hedge,
              zero_mul]
          · rw [(faceState_coPointedDefect_eq_zero_iff_eval_bot B).mpr hedge,
              mul_zero]
        nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.faceState_s_eq_three_pow_card_iff_threshold
statement:
theorem faceState_s_eq_three_pow_card_iff_threshold
    (T : HansenCograph.Cotree) :
    T.faceState.s = (3 : Int) ^ (Fintype.card T.Vert + 1) ↔ T.IsThreshold
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_vert_eq_order]
  exact faceState_s_eq_three_pow_order_iff_threshold T

name: HansenCograph.hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_portalVector_mass
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_portalVector_mass
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G)
      (Fintype.card V + 3)) :
    hansenFullFlagRatio G =
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card V + 1),
          (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector G k : ℝ)) /
        (2 ^ Fintype.card V *
          ((Fintype.card V + 1).factorial : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hansenFullFlagRatio,
    HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenFullFlagCount_eq_two_mul_positivePortalFlagCount,
    HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_eq_sum_portalVector hG]
  simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_sum]
  rw [pow_succ]
  ring

name: HansenCograph.hansenFullFlagRatio_compl
statement:
@[simp] theorem hansenFullFlagRatio_compl
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    hansenFullFlagRatio Gᶜ = hansenFullFlagRatio G
proof:
:= by
  unfold hansenFullFlagRatio
  rw [hansenFullFlagCount_compl]

name: HansenCograph.hansenFullFlagRatio_join_ge
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagRatio_join_ge
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (hA : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace A)
      (Fintype.card V + 3))
    (hB : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace B)
      (Fintype.card W + 3))
    (hmonoA : MonotoneOn
      (portalPolynomial (Fintype.card V)
        (fun k ↦ (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector A k : ℝ)))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hmonoB : MonotoneOn
      (portalPolynomial (Fintype.card W)
        (fun k ↦ (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector B k : ℝ)))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) :
    hansenFullFlagRatio A * hansenFullFlagRatio B ≤
      hansenFullFlagRatio (A ⊗g B)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let n := Fintype.card V
  let m := Fintype.card W
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun k ↦
    (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector A k : ℝ)
  let b : ℕ → ℝ := fun k ↦
    (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector B k : ℝ)
  have hmass := portalShuffleConvolution_mass_normalized_ge
    (n := n) (m := m) (a := a) (b := b) hmonoA hmonoB
  have hposA :=
    HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_eq_sum_portalVector hA
  have hposB :=
    HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_eq_sum_portalVector hB
  have hjoinUniform :
      UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B)) (n + m + 3) := by
    have h := UniformFlagCard.hansenJoin A B hA hB
    have hlen :
        (Fintype.card V + 3) + (Fintype.card W + 3) - 3 =
          Fintype.card V + Fintype.card W + 3 := by omega
    rw [hlen] at h
    exact h
  have hposJoin :=
    HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_eq_sum_portalVector
      hjoinUniform
  have hconv (s : ℕ) :
      (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector (A ⊗g B) s : ℝ) =
        portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s := by
    exact HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector_join_cast_eq_portalShuffleConvolution
      A B hA hB s
  rw [show hansenFullFlagRatio A =
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k) /
        (2 ^ n * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)) by
    rw [hansenFullFlagRatio,
      HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenFullFlagCount_eq_two_mul_positivePortalFlagCount,
      hposA]
    simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_sum]
    change (2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k) /
        (2 ^ (n + 1) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)) = _
    rw [pow_succ]
    ring,
    show hansenFullFlagRatio B =
      (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), b l) /
        (2 ^ m * ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) by
      rw [hansenFullFlagRatio,
        HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenFullFlagCount_eq_two_mul_positivePortalFlagCount,
        hposB]
      simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_sum]
      change (2 * ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), b l) /
          (2 ^ (m + 1) * ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) = _
      rw [pow_succ]
      ring,
    show hansenFullFlagRatio (A ⊗g B) =
      (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1),
          portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s) /
        (2 ^ (n + m) * ((n + m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) by
      rw [hansenFullFlagRatio,
        HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenFullFlagCount_eq_two_mul_positivePortalFlagCount,
        hposJoin]
      simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_sum]
      simp_rw [hconv]
      change (2 * ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1),
          portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s) /
          (2 ^ (n + m + 1) * ((n + m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) = _
      rw [pow_succ]
      ring]
  have hpow : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ (n + m) := by positivity
  calc
    ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k) /
          (2 ^ n * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))) *
        ((∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), b l) /
          (2 ^ m * ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ))) =
      (((∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k) /
          ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)) *
        ((∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), b l) /
          ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ))) / 2 ^ (n + m) := by
        rw [pow_add]
        ring
    _ ≤ ((∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1),
          portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s) /
        ((n + m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) / 2 ^ (n + m) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmass hpow.le
    _ = (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1),
          portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s) /
        (2 ^ (n + m) * ((n + m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) := by
      ring

name: HansenCograph.hansenFullFlagRatio_join_gt
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagRatio_join_gt
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (hA : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace A)
      (Fintype.card V + 3))
    (hB : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace B)
      (Fintype.card W + 3))
    (hmonoA : MonotoneOn
      (portalPolynomial (Fintype.card V)
        (fun k ↦ (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector A k : ℝ)))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hmonoB : MonotoneOn
      (portalPolynomial (Fintype.card W)
        (fun k ↦ (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector B k : ℝ)))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hstrictA : HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector A 0 <
      HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector A (Fintype.card V))
    (hstrictB : HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector B 0 <
      HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector B (Fintype.card W)) :
    hansenFullFlagRatio A * hansenFullFlagRatio B <
      hansenFullFlagRatio (A ⊗g B)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let n := Fintype.card V
  let m := Fintype.card W
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun k ↦
    (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector A k : ℝ)
  let b : ℕ → ℝ := fun k ↦
    (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector B k : ℝ)
  have hmass := portalShuffleConvolution_mass_normalized_gt
    (n := n) (m := m) (a := a) (b := b) hmonoA hmonoB
    (by dsimp [a, n]; exact_mod_cast hstrictA)
    (by dsimp [b, m]; exact_mod_cast hstrictB)
  have hjoinUniform :
      UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B))
        (Fintype.card (V ⊕ W) + 3) := by
    have h := UniformFlagCard.hansenJoin A B hA hB
    have hlen :
        (Fintype.card V + 3) + (Fintype.card W + 3) - 3 =
          Fintype.card (V ⊕ W) + 3 := by
      simp only [Fintype.card_sum]
      omega
    rw [hlen] at h
    exact h
  have hconv (s : ℕ) :
      (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector (A ⊗g B) s : ℝ) =
        portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s := by
    exact HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector_join_cast_eq_portalShuffleConvolution
      A B hA hB s
  rw [hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_portalVector_mass A hA,
    hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_portalVector_mass B hB,
    hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_portalVector_mass (A ⊗g B) hjoinUniform]
  simp only [Fintype.card_sum]
  simp_rw [hconv]
  change
    ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k) /
          (2 ^ n * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))) *
        ((∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), b l) /
          (2 ^ m * ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ))) <
      (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1),
          portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s) /
        (2 ^ (n + m) * ((n + m + 1).factorial : ℝ))
  have hpow : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ (n + m) := by positivity
  calc
    ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k) /
          (2 ^ n * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))) *
        ((∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), b l) /
          (2 ^ m * ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ))) =
      (((∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k) /
          ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)) *
        ((∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), b l) /
          ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ))) / 2 ^ (n + m) := by
        rw [pow_add]
        ring
    _ < ((∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1),
          portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s) /
        ((n + m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) / 2 ^ (n + m) :=
      div_lt_div_of_pos_right hmass hpow
    _ = (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1),
          portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s) /
        (2 ^ (n + m) * ((n + m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) := by
      ring

name: HansenCograph.hansenFullFlagRatio_sum_ge
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagRatio_sum_ge
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (hA : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace A)
      (Fintype.card V + 3))
    (hB : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace B)
      (Fintype.card W + 3))
    (hmonoA : MonotoneOn
      (portalPolynomial (Fintype.card V)
        (fun k ↦ (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector Aᶜ k : ℝ)))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hmonoB : MonotoneOn
      (portalPolynomial (Fintype.card W)
        (fun k ↦ (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector Bᶜ k : ℝ)))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) :
    hansenFullFlagRatio A * hansenFullFlagRatio B ≤
      hansenFullFlagRatio (A ⊕g B)
proof:
:= by
  have hAc := UniformFlagCard.hansenCompl A hA
  have hBc := UniformFlagCard.hansenCompl B hB
  calc
    hansenFullFlagRatio A * hansenFullFlagRatio B =
        hansenFullFlagRatio Aᶜ * hansenFullFlagRatio Bᶜ := by simp
    _ ≤ hansenFullFlagRatio (Aᶜ ⊗g Bᶜ) :=
      hansenFullFlagRatio_join_ge Aᶜ Bᶜ hAc hBc hmonoA hmonoB
    _ = hansenFullFlagRatio (A ⊕g B) := by
      rw [← compl_sum_eq_join, hansenFullFlagRatio_compl]

name: HansenCograph.hansenFullFlagRatio_sum_gt
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagRatio_sum_gt
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (hA : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace A)
      (Fintype.card V + 3))
    (hB : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace B)
      (Fintype.card W + 3))
    (hmonoA : MonotoneOn
      (portalPolynomial (Fintype.card V)
        (fun k ↦ (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector Aᶜ k : ℝ)))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hmonoB : MonotoneOn
      (portalPolynomial (Fintype.card W)
        (fun k ↦ (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector Bᶜ k : ℝ)))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hstrictA : HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector Aᶜ 0 <
      HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector Aᶜ (Fintype.card V))
    (hstrictB : HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector Bᶜ 0 <
      HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector Bᶜ (Fintype.card W)) :
    hansenFullFlagRatio A * hansenFullFlagRatio B <
      hansenFullFlagRatio (A ⊕g B)
proof:
:= by
  have hAc := UniformFlagCard.hansenCompl A hA
  have hBc := UniformFlagCard.hansenCompl B hB
  calc
    hansenFullFlagRatio A * hansenFullFlagRatio B =
        hansenFullFlagRatio Aᶜ * hansenFullFlagRatio Bᶜ := by simp
    _ < hansenFullFlagRatio (Aᶜ ⊗g Bᶜ) :=
      hansenFullFlagRatio_join_gt Aᶜ Bᶜ hAc hBc hmonoA hmonoB hstrictA hstrictB
    _ = hansenFullFlagRatio (A ⊕g B) := by
      rw [← compl_sum_eq_join, hansenFullFlagRatio_compl]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.vertexSpanFace_carrier
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexSpanFace_carrier (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (S : Set (HansenVertexLabel G)) :
    (vertexSpanFace G S : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)) =
      incidenceModels (dualIncidence (hansenLabelIncidence G)) S
proof:
:= by
  change incidenceModels (dualIncidence (hansenLabelIncidence G))
      (incidenceClosure (dualIncidence (hansenLabelIncidence G)) S) = _
  exact incidenceModels_incidenceClosure_eq _ _

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.incidenceModels_vertexSpanFace
statement:
@[simp] theorem incidenceModels_vertexSpanFace (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (S : Set (HansenVertexLabel G)) :
    incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) (vertexSpanFace G S) =
      incidenceClosure (dualIncidence (hansenLabelIncidence G)) S
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (vertexSpanFace G S : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)) =
      incidenceModels (dualIncidence (hansenLabelIncidence G)) S from
    vertexSpanFace_carrier G S]
  rfl

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.mem_incidenceModels_vertexSpanFace
statement:
theorem mem_incidenceModels_vertexSpanFace
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (S : Set (HansenVertexLabel G))
    {vertex : HansenVertexLabel G} (hvertex : vertex ∈ S) :
    vertex ∈ incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G)
      (vertexSpanFace G S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [incidenceModels_vertexSpanFace]
  exact subset_incidenceClosure _ _ hvertex

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.vertexSpanFace_mono
statement:
theorem vertexSpanFace_mono (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {S T : Set (HansenVertexLabel G)} (hST : S ⊆ T) :
    vertexSpanFace G S ≤ vertexSpanFace G T
proof:
:= by
  change (vertexSpanFace G T : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)) ⊆
    (vertexSpanFace G S : Set (HansenFacetLabel G))
  rw [vertexSpanFace_carrier, vertexSpanFace_carrier]
  intro facet hfacet vertex hvertex
  exact hfacet vertex (hST hvertex)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.incidenceModels_mono
statement:
theorem incidenceModels_mono {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {F K : HansenCombinatorialFace G} (hFK : F ≤ K) :
    incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) F ⊆
      incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) K
proof:
:= by
  intro vertex hvertex facet hfacet
  exact hvertex facet (hFK hfacet)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.le_iff_incidenceModels_subset
statement:
theorem le_iff_incidenceModels_subset {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {F K : HansenCombinatorialFace G} :
    F ≤ K ↔
      incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) F ⊆
        incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) K
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact incidenceModels_mono
  · intro hmodels facet hfacet
    apply (Set.ext_iff.mp F.isClosed facet).mp
    intro vertex hvertex
    exact hmodels hvertex facet hfacet

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.eq_of_incidenceModels_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply IncidenceClosedSet.ext
  calc
    (F : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)) =
        incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence G) F := F.isClosed.symm
    _ = incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence G) K := by
      simp only [incidenceClosure, hmodels]
    _ = (K : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)) := K.isClosed

name: HansenCograph.N_eq_two_sum_dArray
statement:
theorem N_eq_two_sum_dArray (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    N G = 2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card V + 1), dArray G i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold N dArray sectionWeight
  rw [Finset.sum_powerset]
  simp

name: HansenCograph.q_eq_dPoly
statement:
theorem q_eq_dPoly (G : SimpleGraph V) (x : ℝ) :
    q G x = dPoly (Fintype.card V) (dArray G) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold q dPoly dArray sectionWeight qCoeff
  rw [Finset.sum_powerset]
  simp only [Finset.card_univ]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s hs
  have hcard : s.card = i := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hs).2
  simp [hcard]

name: HansenCograph.weighted_delete_coeff
statement:
theorem weighted_delete_coeff (G : SimpleGraph V) (i : ℕ) :
    ∑ v : V, N (deleteVertex Gᶜ v) * dArray (deleteVertex G v) i =
      2 * deletionRow G i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty V with hV | hV
  · letI := hV
    simp [deletionRow, deletionTensor]
  · have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card V := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr hV
    have hcard : Fintype.card V - 1 + 1 = Fintype.card V := by
      omega
    unfold deletionRow deletionTensor
    simp_rw [N_eq_two_sum_dArray, card_deleteVertex, hcard]
    calc
      ∑ v : V,
          (2 * ∑ h ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card V),
            dArray (deleteVertex Gᶜ v) h) * dArray (deleteVertex G v) i =
          ∑ v : V,
            2 * ∑ h ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card V),
              dArray (deleteVertex G v) i * dArray (deleteVertex Gᶜ v) h := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro v hv
        calc
          (2 * ∑ h ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card V),
              dArray (deleteVertex Gᶜ v) h) * dArray (deleteVertex G v) i =
              2 * ((∑ h ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card V),
                dArray (deleteVertex Gᶜ v) h) * dArray (deleteVertex G v) i) :=
            mul_assoc _ _ _
          _ = 2 * ∑ h ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card V),
              dArray (deleteVertex Gᶜ v) h * dArray (deleteVertex G v) i := by
            rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          _ = 2 * ∑ h ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card V),
              dArray (deleteVertex G v) i * dArray (deleteVertex Gᶜ v) h := by
            apply congrArg (fun z : ℝ => 2 * z)
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro h hh
            ring
      _ = 2 * ∑ v : V, ∑ h ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card V),
            dArray (deleteVertex G v) i * dArray (deleteVertex Gᶜ v) h := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = 2 * ∑ h ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card V), ∑ v : V,
            dArray (deleteVertex G v) i * dArray (deleteVertex Gᶜ v) h := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: HansenCograph.deletion_tensor_identity
statement:
theorem deletion_tensor_identity (G : SimpleGraph V) (x : ℝ) :
    (∑ v : V, N (deleteVertex Gᶜ v) * q (deleteVertex G v) x) =
      2 * dPoly (Fintype.card V - 1) (deletionRow G) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty V with hV | hV
  · letI := hV
    simp [dPoly, deletionRow, deletionTensor]
  · have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card V := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr hV
    have hcard : Fintype.card V - 1 + 1 = Fintype.card V := by
      omega
    simp_rw [q_eq_dPoly, card_deleteVertex]
    unfold dPoly
    rw [hcard]
    calc
      ∑ v : V,
          N (deleteVertex Gᶜ v) *
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card V),
              dArray (deleteVertex G v) i /
                  ((i.factorial : ℝ) *
                    ((Fintype.card V - 1 - i).factorial : ℝ)) *
                x ^ i * (1 - x) ^ (Fintype.card V - 1 - i) =
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card V),
            ∑ v : V,
              N (deleteVertex Gᶜ v) *
                (dArray (deleteVertex G v) i /
                    ((i.factorial : ℝ) *
                      ((Fintype.card V - 1 - i).factorial : ℝ)) *
                  x ^ i * (1 - x) ^ (Fintype.card V - 1 - i)) := by
        simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card V),
            (∑ v : V,
              N (deleteVertex Gᶜ v) * dArray (deleteVertex G v) i) /
                ((i.factorial : ℝ) *
                  ((Fintype.card V - 1 - i).factorial : ℝ)) *
              x ^ i * (1 - x) ^ (Fintype.card V - 1 - i) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro v hv
        ring
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card V),
            2 * (deletionRow G i /
                ((i.factorial : ℝ) *
                  ((Fintype.card V - 1 - i).factorial : ℝ)) *
              x ^ i * (1 - x) ^ (Fintype.card V - 1 - i)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [weighted_delete_coeff]
        ring
      _ = 2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card V),
            deletionRow G i /
                ((i.factorial : ℝ) *
                  ((Fintype.card V - 1 - i).factorial : ℝ)) *
              x ^ i * (1 - x) ^ (Fintype.card V - 1 - i) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: HansenCograph.sectionWeight_iso
statement:
theorem sectionWeight_iso
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (e : G ≃g H) (s : Finset V) :
    sectionWeight G s = sectionWeight H (s.image e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnu (t : Finset V) :
      nuInduced G t = nuInduced H (t.image e) := by
    unfold nuInduced
    exact nu_iso (e.induce (e.toEquiv.bijOn (by simp)))
  have hcompl : sᶜ.image e = (s.image e)ᶜ := by
    ext w
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_compl]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ ⟨x, hx, hxeq⟩
      apply ha
      simpa [e.injective hxeq] using hx
    · intro h
      refine ⟨e.symm w, ?_, by simp⟩
      intro hs
      exact h ⟨e.symm w, hs, by simp⟩
  unfold sectionWeight
  have hnucompl := hnu sᶜ
  rw [hcompl] at hnucompl
  rw [hnu s, hnucompl]

name: HansenCograph.dArray_iso
statement:
theorem dArray_iso
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (e : G ≃g H) (i : ℕ) :
    dArray G i = dArray H i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold dArray
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun s _ => s.image e)
  · intro s hs
    refine Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective s e.injective]
    exact (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hs).2
  · intro s₁ hs₁ s₂ hs₂ h
    exact Finset.image_injective e.injective h
  · intro t ht
    refine ⟨t.image e.symm, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective t e.symm.injective]
      exact (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp ht).2
    · ext w
      simp
  · intro s hs
    exact sectionWeight_iso e s

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.sourceIndex_spec
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec ((f.mem_toFlag_iff x).mp hx)

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.card_restrictIic_apply
statement:
theorem card_restrictIic_apply {n : ℕ} (f : RankedFlag P n)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Nat.card (Flag.restrictIic f.toFlag (f i) ⟨i, rfl⟩) = i.1 + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.card_congr (prefixEquiv f i), Nat.card_fin]

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.apply_eq_of_mem_of_card_restrictIic
statement:
theorem apply_eq_of_mem_of_card_restrictIic {n : ℕ} (f : RankedFlag P n)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : P) (hx : x ∈ f.toFlag)
    (hcard : Nat.card (Flag.restrictIic f.toFlag x hx) = i.1 + 1) :
    f i = x
proof:
:= by
  rcases (f.mem_toFlag_iff x).mp hx with ⟨j, hj⟩
  subst x
  have hjcard := card_restrictIic_apply f j
  have heq : j.1 + 1 = i.1 + 1 := by
    exact hjcard.symm.trans hcard
  have hji : j = i := by
    apply Fin.ext
    omega
  rw [← hji]

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.dual_dual
statement: @[simp] theorem dual_dual (X : PointedFaceState) : X.dual.dual = X
proof:
:= by
  cases X
  rfl

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.dual_wellFormed
statement:
theorem dual_wellFormed {X : PointedFaceState} (hX : X.WellFormed) :
    X.dual.WellFormed
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨hX.2, hX.1⟩

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.dual_pointedDefect
statement:
@[simp] theorem dual_pointedDefect (X : PointedFaceState) :
    X.dual.pointedDefect = X.coPointedDefect
proof: := rfl

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.dual_coPointedDefect
statement:
@[simp] theorem dual_coPointedDefect (X : PointedFaceState) :
    X.dual.coPointedDefect = X.pointedDefect
proof: := rfl

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.coPointedDefect_eq_pointedDefect_add
proof:
:= by
  rcases hX with ⟨hp, hq⟩
  simp only [coPointedDefect, pointedDefect]
  rw [hp, hq]
  ring

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.join_wellFormed
proof:
:= by
  rcases hA with ⟨hpA, hqA⟩
  rcases hB with ⟨hpB, hqB⟩
  constructor
  · dsimp [join]
  · dsimp [join]
    rw [hqA, hqB]
    ring

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.union_wellFormed
proof:
:=
  dual_wellFormed (join_wellFormed (dual_wellFormed hA) (dual_wellFormed hB))

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.join_p_eq_product_add_corrections
statement:
theorem join_p_eq_product_add_corrections {A B : PointedFaceState}
    (hA : A.WellFormed) (hB : B.WellFormed) :
    (A.join B).p =
      A.p * B.p + (A.a - 1) * (B.p - 1) + (B.a - 1) * (A.p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hA with ⟨hpA, _⟩
  rcases hB with ⟨hpB, _⟩
  dsimp [join]
  rw [hpA, hpB]
  ring

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.join_pointedDefect
statement:
theorem join_pointedDefect {A B : PointedFaceState} :
    (A.join B).pointedDefect =
      A.r * B.pointedDefect + B.r * A.pointedDefect +
        A.pointedDefect * B.pointedDefect
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pointedDefect, join]
  ring

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.join_pointedDefect_nonneg
statement:
theorem join_pointedDefect_nonneg {A B : PointedFaceState}
    (hrA : 0 ≤ A.r) (hrB : 0 ≤ B.r)
    (hxA : 0 ≤ A.pointedDefect) (hxB : 0 ≤ B.pointedDefect) :
    0 ≤ (A.join B).pointedDefect
proof:
:= by
  rw [join_pointedDefect]
  exact add_nonneg
    (add_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg hrA hxB) (Int.mul_nonneg hrB hxA))
    (Int.mul_nonneg hxA hxB)

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.join_pointedDefect_eq_zero_iff_of_pos
statement:
theorem join_pointedDefect_eq_zero_iff_of_pos {A B : PointedFaceState}
    (hrA : 0 < A.r) (hrB : 0 < B.r)
    (hxA : 0 ≤ A.pointedDefect) (hxB : 0 ≤ B.pointedDefect) :
    (A.join B).pointedDefect = 0 ↔
      A.pointedDefect = 0 ∧ B.pointedDefect = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hjoin
    rw [join_pointedDefect] at hjoin
    have hAxB : 0 ≤ A.r * B.pointedDefect :=
      Int.mul_nonneg hrA.le hxB
    have hBxA : 0 ≤ B.r * A.pointedDefect :=
      Int.mul_nonneg hrB.le hxA
    have hxx : 0 ≤ A.pointedDefect * B.pointedDefect :=
      Int.mul_nonneg hxA hxB
    have hsum : A.r * B.pointedDefect + B.r * A.pointedDefect = 0 :=
      (add_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (add_nonneg hAxB hBxA) hxx).mp hjoin |>.1
    have hprodB : A.r * B.pointedDefect = 0 :=
      (add_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hAxB hBxA).mp hsum |>.1
    have hprodA : B.r * A.pointedDefect = 0 :=
      (add_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hAxB hBxA).mp hsum |>.2
    constructor
    · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprodA with hroot | hdefect
      · exact False.elim ((ne_of_gt hrB) hroot)
      · exact hdefect
    · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprodB with hroot | hdefect
      · exact False.elim ((ne_of_gt hrA) hroot)
      · exact hdefect
  · rintro ⟨hA, hB⟩
    rw [join_pointedDefect, hA, hB]
    ring

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.join_total_correction
statement:
theorem join_total_correction {A B : PointedFaceState} :
    3 * (A.join B).s - A.s * B.s =
      2 * A.pointedDefect * B.pointedDefect
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pointedDefect, join]
  ring

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.dual_admissible
statement:
theorem dual_admissible {X : PointedFaceState} (hX : X.Admissible) :
    X.dual.Admissible
proof:
:= by
  rcases hX with ⟨hwf, ha, hp, hq, hx, hy⟩
  exact ⟨dual_wellFormed hwf, ha, hq, hp, hy, hx⟩

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.join_coPointedDefect_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  rcases hA with ⟨hwfA, haA, hpA, hqA, hxA, hyA⟩
  rcases hB with ⟨hwfB, haB, hpB, hqB, hxB, hyB⟩
  have hrA : 0 ≤ A.r := by nlinarith [hwfA.1]
  have hrB : 0 ≤ B.r := by nlinarith [hwfB.1]
  have hpAr : A.p ≤ A.r := by nlinarith [hwfA.1]
  have hpBr : B.p ≤ B.r := by nlinarith [hwfB.1]
  have hrelA := coPointedDefect_eq_pointedDefect_add hwfA
  have hrelB := coPointedDefect_eq_pointedDefect_add hwfB
  have hformula :
      (A.join B).coPointedDefect =
        A.r * B.pointedDefect + B.r * A.pointedDefect +
          A.pointedDefect * B.pointedDefect +
        3 * (A.p * B.p + (A.a - 1) * (B.p - 1) +
          (B.a - 1) * (A.p - 1) - A.q * B.q) := by
    rw [coPointedDefect_eq_pointedDefect_add (join_wellFormed hwfA hwfB),
      join_pointedDefect, join_p_eq_product_add_corrections hwfA hwfB]
    rfl
  have hrootA : 0 ≤ A.r * B.pointedDefect := Int.mul_nonneg hrA hxB
  have hrootB : 0 ≤ B.r * A.pointedDefect := Int.mul_nonneg hrB hxA
  have hxx : 0 ≤ A.pointedDefect * B.pointedDefect := Int.mul_nonneg hxA hxB
  have hcorrA : 0 ≤ (A.a - 1) * (B.p - 1) :=
    Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)
  have hcorrB : 0 ≤ (B.a - 1) * (A.p - 1) :=
    Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)
  by_cases hAqp : A.q ≤ A.p
  · by_cases hBqp : B.q ≤ B.p
    · have hprodA : 0 ≤ (A.p - A.q) * B.p :=
        Int.mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hAqp) (by omega)
      have hprodB : 0 ≤ A.q * (B.p - B.q) :=
        Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (sub_nonneg.mpr hBqp)
      rw [hformula]
      nlinarith
    · have hdeltaB : 0 ≤ B.q - B.p := by omega
      have hxBdelta : 3 * (B.q - B.p) ≤ B.pointedDefect := by
        nlinarith
      have hrAq : A.q ≤ A.r := hAqp.trans hpAr
      have hmul :
          A.r * (3 * (B.q - B.p)) ≤ A.r * B.pointedDefect :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxBdelta hrA
      have hgoodA : 0 ≤ (A.p - A.q) * B.p :=
        Int.mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hAqp) (by omega)
      have hgoodB : 0 ≤ (A.r - A.q) * (B.q - B.p) :=
        Int.mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hrAq) hdeltaB
      rw [hformula]
      nlinarith
  · by_cases hBqp : B.q ≤ B.p
    · have hdeltaA : 0 ≤ A.q - A.p := by omega
      have hxAdelta : 3 * (A.q - A.p) ≤ A.pointedDefect := by
        nlinarith
      have hrBq : B.q ≤ B.r := hBqp.trans hpBr
      have hmul :
          B.r * (3 * (A.q - A.p)) ≤ B.r * A.pointedDefect :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxAdelta hrB
      have hgoodA : 0 ≤ A.p * (B.p - B.q) :=
        Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (sub_nonneg.mpr hBqp)
      have hgoodB : 0 ≤ (A.q - A.p) * (B.r - B.q) :=
        Int.mul_nonneg hdeltaA (sub_nonneg.mpr hrBq)
      rw [hformula]
      nlinarith
    · have hdeltaA : 0 ≤ A.q - A.p := by omega
      have hdeltaB : 0 ≤ B.q - B.p := by omega
      have hxAdelta : 3 * (A.q - A.p) ≤ A.pointedDefect := by
        nlinarith
      have hxBdelta : 3 * (B.q - B.p) ≤ B.pointedDefect := by
        nlinarith
      have hmulA :
          A.r * (3 * (B.q - B.p)) ≤ A.r * B.pointedDefect :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxBdelta hrA
      have hmulB :
          B.r * (3 * (A.q - A.p)) ≤ B.r * A.pointedDefect :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxAdelta hrB
      have hmulXX₁ :
          (3 * (A.q - A.p)) * (3 * (B.q - B.p)) ≤
            A.pointedDefect * (3 * (B.q - B.p)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hxAdelta (by positivity)
      have hmulXX₂ :
          A.pointedDefect * (3 * (B.q - B.p)) ≤
            A.pointedDefect * B.pointedDefect :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxBdelta hxA
      have hgapA : 0 ≤ (A.r - A.p) * (B.q - B.p) :=
        Int.mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hpAr) hdeltaB
      have hgapB : 0 ≤ (B.r - B.p) * (A.q - A.p) :=
        Int.mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hpBr) hdeltaA
      have hdeltaProd : 0 ≤ (A.q - A.p) * (B.q - B.p) :=
        Int.mul_nonneg hdeltaA hdeltaB
      rw [hformula]
      nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.join_admissible
proof:
:= by
  rcases hA with ⟨hwfA, haA, hpA, hqA, hxA, hyA⟩
  rcases hB with ⟨hwfB, haB, hpB, hqB, hxB, hyB⟩
  have hrA : 0 ≤ A.r := by nlinarith [hwfA.1]
  have hrB : 0 ≤ B.r := by nlinarith [hwfB.1]
  refine ⟨join_wellFormed hwfA hwfB, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [join]
    nlinarith [Int.mul_nonneg (by omega : 0 ≤ A.a) (by omega : 0 ≤ B.a)]
  · rw [join_p_eq_product_add_corrections hwfA hwfB]
    have hpA0 : 0 ≤ A.p := by omega
    have hpB0 : 0 ≤ B.p := by omega
    have hpp0 : 0 ≤ A.p * B.p := Int.mul_nonneg hpA0 hpB0
    have hpp : 1 ≤ A.p * B.p := by nlinarith
    have hcA : 0 ≤ (A.a - 1) * (B.p - 1) := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)
    have hcB : 0 ≤ (B.a - 1) * (A.p - 1) := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)
    omega
  · dsimp [join]
    have hqq : 0 ≤ A.q * B.q := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)
    nlinarith
  · exact join_pointedDefect_nonneg hrA hrB hxA hxB
  · exact join_coPointedDefect_nonneg
      ⟨hwfA, haA, hpA, hqA, hxA, hyA⟩
      ⟨hwfB, haB, hpB, hqB, hxB, hyB⟩

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.union_admissible
proof:
:= by
  exact dual_admissible (join_admissible (dual_admissible hA) (dual_admissible hB))

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.StronglyAdmissible.admissible
statement:
theorem StronglyAdmissible.admissible {X : PointedFaceState}
    (hX : X.StronglyAdmissible) : X.Admissible

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.dual_stronglyAdmissible
statement:
theorem dual_stronglyAdmissible {X : PointedFaceState}
    (hX : X.StronglyAdmissible) : X.dual.StronglyAdmissible
proof:
:= by
  rcases hX with ⟨hAdm, ha, hp, hq⟩
  exact ⟨dual_admissible hAdm, ha, hq, hp⟩

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.join_stronglyAdmissible
proof:
:= by
  rcases hA with ⟨hAdmA, haA, hpA, hqA⟩
  rcases hB with ⟨hAdmB, haB, hpB, hqB⟩
  refine ⟨join_admissible hAdmA hAdmB, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [join]
    nlinarith [Int.mul_nonneg (by omega : 0 ≤ A.a) (by omega : 0 ≤ B.a)]
  · rw [join_p_eq_product_add_corrections hAdmA.1 hAdmB.1]
    have hpp : 4 ≤ A.p * B.p := by nlinarith
    have hcA : 0 ≤ (A.a - 1) * (B.p - 1) :=
      Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)
    have hcB : 0 ≤ (B.a - 1) * (A.p - 1) :=
      Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)
    omega
  · dsimp [join]
    nlinarith [Int.mul_nonneg (by omega : 0 ≤ A.q) (by omega : 0 ≤ B.q)]

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.union_stronglyAdmissible
proof:
:= by
  exact dual_stronglyAdmissible
    (join_stronglyAdmissible (dual_stronglyAdmissible hA)
      (dual_stronglyAdmissible hB))

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.join_coPointedDefect_pos
proof:
:= by
  rcases hA with ⟨⟨hwfA, haA, hpA, hqA, hxA, hyA⟩, haA2, hpA2, hqA2⟩
  rcases hB with ⟨⟨hwfB, haB, hpB, hqB, hxB, hyB⟩, haB2, hpB2, hqB2⟩
  have hrA : 0 ≤ A.r := by nlinarith [hwfA.1]
  have hrB : 0 ≤ B.r := by nlinarith [hwfB.1]
  have hpAr : A.p ≤ A.r := by nlinarith [hwfA.1]
  have hpBr : B.p ≤ B.r := by nlinarith [hwfB.1]
  have hrelA := coPointedDefect_eq_pointedDefect_add hwfA
  have hrelB := coPointedDefect_eq_pointedDefect_add hwfB
  have hformula :
      (A.join B).coPointedDefect =
        A.r * B.pointedDefect + B.r * A.pointedDefect +
          A.pointedDefect * B.pointedDefect +
        3 * (A.p * B.p + (A.a - 1) * (B.p - 1) +
          (B.a - 1) * (A.p - 1) - A.q * B.q) := by
    rw [coPointedDefect_eq_pointedDefect_add (join_wellFormed hwfA hwfB),
      join_pointedDefect, join_p_eq_product_add_corrections hwfA hwfB]
    rfl
  have hrootA : 0 ≤ A.r * B.pointedDefect := Int.mul_nonneg hrA hxB
  have hrootB : 0 ≤ B.r * A.pointedDefect := Int.mul_nonneg hrB hxA
  have hxx : 0 ≤ A.pointedDefect * B.pointedDefect := Int.mul_nonneg hxA hxB
  have hcorrA : 1 ≤ (A.a - 1) * (B.p - 1) := by nlinarith
  have hcorrB : 1 ≤ (B.a - 1) * (A.p - 1) := by nlinarith
  by_cases hAqp : A.q ≤ A.p
  · by_cases hBqp : B.q ≤ B.p
    · have hprodA : 0 ≤ (A.p - A.q) * B.p :=
        Int.mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hAqp) (by omega)
      have hprodB : 0 ≤ A.q * (B.p - B.q) :=
        Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (sub_nonneg.mpr hBqp)
      rw [hformula]
      nlinarith
    · have hdeltaB : 0 ≤ B.q - B.p := by omega
      have hxBdelta : 3 * (B.q - B.p) ≤ B.pointedDefect := by nlinarith
      have hrAq : A.q ≤ A.r := hAqp.trans hpAr
      have hmul : A.r * (3 * (B.q - B.p)) ≤ A.r * B.pointedDefect :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxBdelta hrA
      have hgoodA : 0 ≤ (A.p - A.q) * B.p :=
        Int.mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hAqp) (by omega)
      have hgoodB : 0 ≤ (A.r - A.q) * (B.q - B.p) :=
        Int.mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hrAq) hdeltaB
      rw [hformula]
      nlinarith
  · by_cases hBqp : B.q ≤ B.p
    · have hdeltaA : 0 ≤ A.q - A.p := by omega
      have hxAdelta : 3 * (A.q - A.p) ≤ A.pointedDefect := by nlinarith
      have hrBq : B.q ≤ B.r := hBqp.trans hpBr
      have hmul : B.r * (3 * (A.q - A.p)) ≤ B.r * A.pointedDefect :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxAdelta hrB
      have hgoodA : 0 ≤ A.p * (B.p - B.q) :=
        Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (sub_nonneg.mpr hBqp)
      have hgoodB : 0 ≤ (A.q - A.p) * (B.r - B.q) :=
        Int.mul_nonneg hdeltaA (sub_nonneg.mpr hrBq)
      rw [hformula]
      nlinarith
    · have hdeltaA : 0 ≤ A.q - A.p := by omega
      have hdeltaB : 0 ≤ B.q - B.p := by omega
      have hxAdelta : 3 * (A.q - A.p) ≤ A.pointedDefect := by nlinarith
      have hxBdelta : 3 * (B.q - B.p) ≤ B.pointedDefect := by nlinarith
      have hmulA : A.r * (3 * (B.q - B.p)) ≤ A.r * B.pointedDefect :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxBdelta hrA
      have hmulB : B.r * (3 * (A.q - A.p)) ≤ B.r * A.pointedDefect :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxAdelta hrB
      have hmulXX₁ :
          (3 * (A.q - A.p)) * (3 * (B.q - B.p)) ≤
            A.pointedDefect * (3 * (B.q - B.p)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hxAdelta (by positivity)
      have hmulXX₂ :
          A.pointedDefect * (3 * (B.q - B.p)) ≤
            A.pointedDefect * B.pointedDefect :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxBdelta hxA
      have hgapA : 0 ≤ (A.r - A.p) * (B.q - B.p) :=
        Int.mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hpAr) hdeltaB
      have hgapB : 0 ≤ (B.r - B.p) * (A.q - A.p) :=
        Int.mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hpBr) hdeltaA
      have hdeltaProd : 0 ≤ (A.q - A.p) * (B.q - B.p) :=
        Int.mul_nonneg hdeltaA hdeltaB
      rw [hformula]
      nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.union_pointedDefect_pos
proof:
:= by
  change 0 < (A.dual.join B.dual).coPointedDefect
  exact join_coPointedDefect_pos
    (dual_stronglyAdmissible hA) (dual_stronglyAdmissible hB)

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.join_pointedDefect_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem join_pointedDefect_eq_zero_iff {A B : PointedFaceState}
    (hA : A.StronglyAdmissible) (hB : B.StronglyAdmissible) :
    (A.join B).pointedDefect = 0 ↔
      A.pointedDefect = 0 ∧ B.pointedDefect = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hrA : 0 < A.r := by nlinarith [hA.1.1.1, hA.2.1, hA.2.2.1]
  have hrB : 0 < B.r := by nlinarith [hB.1.1.1, hB.2.1, hB.2.2.1]
  exact join_pointedDefect_eq_zero_iff_of_pos hrA hrB
    hA.1.2.2.2.2.1 hB.1.2.2.2.2.1

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.union_coPointedDefect_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem union_coPointedDefect_eq_zero_iff {A B : PointedFaceState}
    (hA : A.StronglyAdmissible) (hB : B.StronglyAdmissible) :
    (A.union B).coPointedDefect = 0 ↔
      A.coPointedDefect = 0 ∧ B.coPointedDefect = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (A.dual.join B.dual).pointedDefect = 0 ↔
    A.coPointedDefect = 0 ∧ B.coPointedDefect = 0
  simpa using join_pointedDefect_eq_zero_iff
    (dual_stronglyAdmissible hA) (dual_stronglyAdmissible hB)

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.StateExpr.eval_admissible
statement:
theorem StateExpr.eval_admissible
    (leafState : PointedFaceState) (hLeaf : leafState.Admissible) :
    ∀ E : StateExpr, (E.eval leafState PointedFaceState.union).Admissible
proof:
:= by
  intro E
  induction E with
  | leaf => exact hLeaf
  | union A B ihA ihB => exact union_admissible ihA ihB
  | join A B ihA ihB => exact join_admissible ihA ihB

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.RecursiveDecomposition.eval_toStateExpr_eq_state
statement:
theorem RecursiveDecomposition.eval_toStateExpr_eq_state
    (R : RecursiveDecomposition.StateRealization) :
    ∀ D : RecursiveDecomposition,
      (D.toStateExpr.eval R.leafState R.unionOp) = R.state D
proof:
:= by
  intro D
  induction D with
  | leaf =>
      simpa [toStateExpr, StateExpr.eval] using R.state_leaf.symm
  | union A B ihA ihB =>
      simp [toStateExpr, StateExpr.eval, ihA, ihB, R.state_union]
  | join A B ihA ihB =>
      simp [toStateExpr, StateExpr.eval, ihA, ihB, R.state_join]

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.StateExpr.eval_root_and_pointedDefect_nonneg
statement:
theorem StateExpr.eval_root_and_pointedDefect_nonneg
    (leafState : PointedFaceState)
    (unionOp : PointedFaceState → PointedFaceState → PointedFaceState)
    (hLeafRoot : 0 ≤ leafState.r)
    (hLeafDefect : 0 ≤ leafState.pointedDefect)
    (hUnion : ∀ A B : PointedFaceState,
      0 ≤ A.r → 0 ≤ B.r →
      0 ≤ A.pointedDefect → 0 ≤ B.pointedDefect →
      0 ≤ (unionOp A B).r ∧ 0 ≤ (unionOp A B).pointedDefect) :
    ∀ E : StateExpr,
      0 ≤ (E.eval leafState unionOp).r ∧
        0 ≤ (E.eval leafState unionOp).pointedDefect
proof:
:= by
  intro E
  induction E with
  | leaf => exact ⟨hLeafRoot, hLeafDefect⟩
  | union A B ihA ihB =>
      exact hUnion _ _ ihA.1 ihB.1 ihA.2 ihB.2
  | join A B ihA ihB =>
      constructor
      · exact Int.mul_nonneg ihA.1 ihB.1
      · exact join_pointedDefect_nonneg ihA.1 ihB.1 ihA.2 ihB.2

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.RecursiveDecomposition.StateRealization.root_and_pointedDefect_nonneg
statement:
theorem RecursiveDecomposition.StateRealization.root_and_pointedDefect_nonneg
    (R : RecursiveDecomposition.StateRealization)
    (hLeafRoot : 0 ≤ R.leafState.r)
    (hLeafDefect : 0 ≤ R.leafState.pointedDefect)
    (hUnion : ∀ A B : PointedFaceState,
      0 ≤ A.r → 0 ≤ B.r →
      0 ≤ A.pointedDefect → 0 ≤ B.pointedDefect →
      0 ≤ (R.unionOp A B).r ∧ 0 ≤ (R.unionOp A B).pointedDefect)
    (D : RecursiveDecomposition) :
    0 ≤ (R.state D).r ∧ 0 ≤ (R.state D).pointedDefect
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RecursiveDecomposition.eval_toStateExpr_eq_state R D]
  exact StateExpr.eval_root_and_pointedDefect_nonneg
    R.leafState R.unionOp hLeafRoot hLeafDefect hUnion D.toStateExpr

name: HansenCograph.PointedFaceState.StateExpr.eval_join_pointedDefect_eq_zero_iff_of_pos
statement:
theorem StateExpr.eval_join_pointedDefect_eq_zero_iff_of_pos
    (leafState : PointedFaceState)
    (unionOp : PointedFaceState → PointedFaceState → PointedFaceState)
    (A B : StateExpr)
    (hARoot : 0 < (A.eval leafState unionOp).r)
    (hBRoot : 0 < (B.eval leafState unionOp).r)
    (hADefect : 0 ≤ (A.eval leafState unionOp).pointedDefect)
    (hBDefect : 0 ≤ (B.eval leafState unionOp).pointedDefect) :
    ((StateExpr.join A B).eval leafState unionOp).pointedDefect = 0 ↔
      (A.eval leafState unionOp).pointedDefect = 0 ∧
        (B.eval leafState unionOp).pointedDefect = 0
proof:
:= by
  change ((A.eval leafState unionOp).join (B.eval leafState unionOp)).pointedDefect = 0 ↔
    (A.eval leafState unionOp).pointedDefect = 0 ∧
      (B.eval leafState unionOp).pointedDefect = 0
  exact join_pointedDefect_eq_zero_iff_of_pos hARoot hBRoot hADefect hBDefect

name: HansenCograph.Flag.card_finsetFlagEquiv
statement:
theorem card_finsetFlagEquiv
    {P : Type u} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P]
    (s : FinsetFlag P) :
    Nat.card (finsetFlagEquiv P s) = s.1.card
proof:
:= by
  change Nat.card {x // x ∈ (s.1 : Set P)} = s.1.card
  rw [Nat.card_coe_set_eq, Set.ncard_coe_finset]

name: HansenCograph.SingletonFace.fullFlag_card_four
statement:
theorem fullFlag_card_four :
    ∀ s : FullFlag, s.1.card = 4
proof: := by decide

name: HansenCograph.UniformFlagCard.hansenSingleton
statement:
theorem hansenSingleton :
    UniformFlagCard
      (HansenCombinatorialFace (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit)) 4
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  let mapped := Flag.map HansenCombinatorialFace.singletonFaceOrderIso t
  let finite : SingletonFace.FullFlag :=
    (finsetFlagEquiv (OrderDual SingletonFace.Closed)).symm mapped
  have hrecover :
      finsetFlagEquiv (OrderDual SingletonFace.Closed) finite = mapped :=
    (finsetFlagEquiv (OrderDual SingletonFace.Closed)).apply_symm_apply mapped
  calc
    Nat.card t = Nat.card mapped :=
      (Flag.card_map HansenCombinatorialFace.singletonFaceOrderIso t).symm
    _ = finite.1.card := by
      rw [← hrecover]
      exact Flag.card_finsetFlagEquiv finite
    _ = 4 := SingletonFace.fullFlag_card_four finite

name: HansenCograph.UniformFlagCard.hansenIso

:=
  UniformFlagCard.orderIso (hansenFaceOrderIso e) hG

name: HansenCograph.UniformFlagCard.hansenCompl
statement:
theorem hansenCompl
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) {r : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) r) :
    UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace Gᶜ) r

:=
  UniformFlagCard.orderIso (hansenFaceComplOrderIso G)
    (UniformFlagCard.orderDual hG)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.portalIntervalFlag_card_add_one
statement:
theorem portalIntervalFlag_card_add_one
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {r : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) r)
    (p : HansenPortal G)
    (lo : Flag (Set.Iic p.1.1.1))
    (up : Flag (Set.Ici p.1.2)) :
    Nat.card lo + Nat.card up + 1 = r
proof:
:= by
  let hi : Flag (Set.Ici p.1.2.1) :=
    Flag.map (rootedUpperWithTopOrderIso G p.1.2)
      (Flag.addWithTop up)
  let full : Flag (HansenCombinatorialFace G) :=
    (Flag.throughCoverEquiv p.2 (lo, hi)).1
  have hfull : Nat.card full = r := hG full
  have hsplit : Nat.card full = Nat.card lo + Nat.card hi :=
    Flag.card_throughCoverEquiv p.2 (lo, hi)
  have hhi : Nat.card hi = Nat.card up + 1 := by
    calc
      Nat.card hi = Nat.card (Flag.addWithTop up) :=
        Flag.card_map (rootedUpperWithTopOrderIso G p.1.2) _
      _ = Nat.card up + 1 := Flag.card_addWithTop up
  omega

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.card_joinRootedUpperIntervalFlagEquiv_add_one
statement:
theorem card_joinRootedUpperIntervalFlagEquiv_add_one
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (F : RootedPos A) (K : RootedPos B)
    (s : Flag (Set.Ici (joinRootedPos A B F K))) :
    Nat.card (joinRootedUpperIntervalFlagEquiv A B F K s) + 1 =
      Nat.card s
proof:
:= by
  change Nat.card
      (Flag.withTopEquiv
        (Flag.map (joinRootedUpperIntervalOrderIso A B F K) s)) + 1 =
    Nat.card s
  calc
    Nat.card
          (Flag.withTopEquiv
            (Flag.map (joinRootedUpperIntervalOrderIso A B F K) s)) + 1 =
        Nat.card (Flag.map (joinRootedUpperIntervalOrderIso A B F K) s) :=
      Flag.card_withTopEquiv_add_one _
    _ = Nat.card s := Flag.card_map _ _

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.card_of_mem_joinPortal
statement:
theorem card_of_mem_joinPortal
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    {r s : ℕ}
    (hA : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace A) r)
    (hB : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace B) s)
    (p : HansenPortal A) (q : HansenPortal B)
    (c : Flag (HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B)))
    (hlo : joinNeutral A B p.1.1 q.1.1 ∈ c)
    (hhi : joinRootedPos A B p.1.2 q.1.2 ∈ c) :
    Nat.card c = r + s - 3
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcover :
      joinNeutral A B p.1.1 q.1.1 ⋖
        joinRootedPos A B p.1.2 q.1.2 :=
    joinPortal_covBy_of_factors A B
      p.1.1 q.1.1 p.1.2 q.1.2 p.2 q.2
  let marked :
      {t : Flag (HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B)) //
        joinNeutral A B p.1.1 q.1.1 ∈ t ∧
          joinRootedPos A B p.1.2 q.1.2 ∈ t} :=
    ⟨c, hlo, hhi⟩
  let split := (Flag.throughCoverEquiv hcover).symm marked
  let loProd :=
    (joinNeutralLowerIntervalFlagEquiv A B p.1.1 q.1.1).symm split.1
  let upProd :=
    joinRootedUpperIntervalFlagEquiv A B p.1.2 q.1.2 split.2
  let loA := Flag.fstProjection loProd
  let loB := Flag.sndProjection loProd
  let upA := Flag.fstProjection upProd
  let upB := Flag.sndProjection upProd
  let _ : Nonempty loA :=
    (loA.maxChain.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance).to_subtype
  let _ : Nonempty loB :=
    (loB.maxChain.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance).to_subtype
  let _ : Nonempty upA :=
    (upA.maxChain.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance).to_subtype
  let _ : Nonempty upB :=
    (upB.maxChain.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance).to_subtype
  have hc : Nat.card c = Nat.card split.1 + Nat.card split.2 :=
    Flag.card_eq_add_card_throughCoverEquiv_symm hcover marked
  have hloMap : Nat.card split.1 = Nat.card loProd := by
    rw [← show
      joinNeutralLowerIntervalFlagEquiv A B p.1.1 q.1.1 loProd = split.1 from
        (joinNeutralLowerIntervalFlagEquiv A B p.1.1 q.1.1).apply_symm_apply
          split.1]
    simpa [joinNeutralLowerIntervalFlagEquiv] using
      Flag.card_map
        (joinNeutralLowerIntervalOrderIso A B p.1.1 q.1.1) loProd
  have hloProd :
      Nat.card loProd = Nat.card loA + Nat.card loB - 1 :=
    Flag.card_eq_projection_cards loProd
  have hupProd :
      Nat.card upProd = Nat.card upA + Nat.card upB - 1 :=
    Flag.card_eq_projection_cards upProd
  have hupMap : Nat.card upProd + 1 = Nat.card split.2 :=
    card_joinRootedUpperIntervalFlagEquiv_add_one
      A B p.1.2 q.1.2 split.2
  have hfactorA : Nat.card loA + Nat.card upA + 1 = r :=
    portalIntervalFlag_card_add_one hA p loA upA
  have hfactorB : Nat.card loB + Nat.card upB + 1 = s :=
    portalIntervalFlag_card_add_one hB q loB upB
  have hloApos : 0 < Nat.card loA := Nat.card_pos
  have hloBpos : 0 < Nat.card loB := Nat.card_pos
  have hupApos : 0 < Nat.card upA := Nat.card_pos
  have hupBpos : 0 < Nat.card upB := Nat.card_pos
  omega

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.positivePortalFlag_card_join
statement:
theorem positivePortalFlag_card_join
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    {r s : ℕ}
    (hA : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace A) r)
    (hB : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace B) s)
    (marked : HansenPortalFlag (A ⊗g B)) :
    Nat.card marked.1.2 = r + s - 3
proof:
:= by
  let pq := (joinPortalEquiv A B).symm marked.1.1
  rcases hpq : pq with ⟨p, q⟩
  have hportal : joinPortalEquiv A B (p, q) = marked.1.1 := by
    rw [← hpq]
    exact (joinPortalEquiv A B).apply_symm_apply marked.1.1
  have hlo : joinNeutral A B p.1.1 q.1.1 ∈ marked.1.2 := by
    change (joinPortalEquiv A B (p, q)).1.1.1 ∈ marked.1.2
    rw [hportal]
    exact marked.2.1
  have hhi : joinRootedPos A B p.1.2 q.1.2 ∈ marked.1.2 := by
    change (joinPortalEquiv A B (p, q)).1.2.1 ∈ marked.1.2
    rw [hportal]
    exact marked.2.2
  exact card_of_mem_joinPortal A B hA hB p q marked.1.2 hlo hhi

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.card_hansenCentralPortalFlagEquiv
statement:
theorem card_hansenCentralPortalFlagEquiv
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (marked : HansenPortalFlag G) :
    Nat.card (hansenCentralPortalFlagEquiv G marked).1.2 =
      Nat.card marked.1.2
proof:
:= by

name: HansenCograph.UniformFlagCard.hansenJoin
statement:
theorem hansenJoin
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    {r s : ℕ}
    (hA : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace A) r)
    (hB : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace B) s) :
    UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B)) (r + s - 3)
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  let code :=
    (HansenCombinatorialFace.signedPortalFlagEquiv (A ⊗g B)).symm c
  have hcode :
      HansenCombinatorialFace.signedPortalFlagEquiv (A ⊗g B) code = c :=
    (HansenCombinatorialFace.signedPortalFlagEquiv (A ⊗g B)).apply_symm_apply c
  rcases code with marked | marked
  · have hflag : marked.1.2 = c := hcode
    rw [← hflag]
    exact HansenCombinatorialFace.positivePortalFlag_card_join
      A B hA hB marked
  · let positive :=
      (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenCentralPortalFlagEquiv (A ⊗g B)).symm marked
    have hcentral :
        HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenCentralPortalFlagEquiv (A ⊗g B) positive =
          marked :=
      (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenCentralPortalFlagEquiv (A ⊗g B)).apply_symm_apply
        marked
    have hnegativeFlag : marked.1.2 = c := hcode
    calc
      Nat.card c = Nat.card marked.1.2 := by rw [hnegativeFlag]
      _ = Nat.card
          (HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenCentralPortalFlagEquiv
            (A ⊗g B) positive).1.2 := by rw [hcentral]
      _ = Nat.card positive.1.2 :=
        HansenCombinatorialFace.card_hansenCentralPortalFlagEquiv
          (A ⊗g B) positive
      _ = r + s - 3 :=
        HansenCombinatorialFace.positivePortalFlag_card_join
          A B hA hB positive

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.uniformFlagCard_eval_order
statement:
theorem uniformFlagCard_eval_order (T : Cotree) :
    UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace T.eval) (T.order + 3)
proof:
:= by
  induction T with
  | leaf =>
      rw [Cotree.eval_leaf, Cotree.order]
      exact UniformFlagCard.hansenSingleton
  | compl A ih =>
      rw [Cotree.eval_compl, Cotree.order]
      exact UniformFlagCard.hansenCompl A.eval ih
  | sum A B ihA ihB =>
      have hAc := UniformFlagCard.hansenCompl A.eval ihA
      have hBc := UniformFlagCard.hansenCompl B.eval ihB
      have hjoin := UniformFlagCard.hansenJoin A.evalᶜ B.evalᶜ hAc hBc
      have hlen :
          (A.order + 3) + (B.order + 3) - 3 =
            A.order + B.order + 3 := by
        omega
      rw [hlen] at hjoin
      rw [← compl_sum_eq_join] at hjoin
      have hsumCompl :
          UniformFlagCard
            (HansenCombinatorialFace (A.eval ⊕g B.eval)ᶜ)
            (A.order + B.order + 3) := by
        exact hjoin
      have hsum :=
        UniformFlagCard.hansenCompl (A.eval ⊕g B.eval)ᶜ hsumCompl
      rw [compl_compl] at hsum
      rw [Cotree.eval_sum, Cotree.order]
      exact hsum

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.uniformFlagCard_eval
statement:
theorem uniformFlagCard_eval (T : Cotree) :
    UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace T.eval)
      (Fintype.card T.Vert + 3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_vert_eq_order]
  exact uniformFlagCard_eval_order T

name: HansenCograph.incidenceClosedToFinset_models

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.singleton_label_incidence
statement:
theorem singleton_label_incidence
    (vertex : HansenVertexLabel (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit))
    (facet : HansenFacetLabel (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit)) :
    SingletonFace.incidence (singletonVertexLabelEquiv vertex)
        (singletonFacetLabelEquiv facet) ↔
      hansenLabelIncidence (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit) vertex facet
proof:
:= by
  rcases vertex with ⟨vertexSign, vertexSet⟩
  rcases facet with ⟨facetSign, facetSet⟩
  cases vertexSign <;> cases facetSign <;>
    simp [SingletonFace.incidence, singletonVertexLabelEquiv,
      singletonFacetLabelEquiv, singletonStableFinsetEquiv,
      singletonCliqueFinsetEquiv, punitFinsetEquivBool,
      punit_inter_nonempty_iff, hansenLabelIncidence, eq_comm] <;>
    aesop

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.singletonFaceEquiv_contains
statement:
theorem singletonFaceEquiv_contains
    (F : HansenCombinatorialFace (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit))
    (vertex : HansenVertexLabel (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit)) :
    SingletonFace.contains (singletonFaceEquiv F)
        (singletonVertexLabelEquiv vertex) ↔ F.ContainsVertex vertex
proof:
:= by
  change singletonVertexLabelEquiv vertex ∈
      incidenceModelsFinset SingletonFace.incidence
        (incidenceClosedToFinset SingletonFace.incidence
          (singletonFaceSetEquiv F)).1 ↔
    vertex ∈ incidenceModels
      (hansenLabelIncidence (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit)) F
  rw [incidenceClosedToFinset_models]
  exact incidenceClosedTransportSurjEquiv_models
    (hansenLabelIncidence (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit)) SingletonFace.incidence
    singletonVertexLabelEquiv singletonFacetLabelEquiv
    singletonVertexLabelEquiv.surjective singleton_label_incidence F vertex

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.singletonFaceEquiv_facet_mem
statement:
theorem singletonFaceEquiv_facet_mem
    (F : HansenCombinatorialFace (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit))

    singletonFacetLabelEquiv facet ∈ (singletonFaceEquiv F).1 ↔
      facet ∈ (F : Set _)
proof:
:= by
  change singletonFacetLabelEquiv facet ∈
      incidenceClosedCarrierFinset SingletonFace.incidence
        (singletonFaceSetEquiv F) ↔ facet ∈ (F : Set _)
  rw [mem_incidenceClosedCarrierFinset]
  change singletonFacetLabelEquiv facet ∈
      singletonFacetLabelEquiv '' (F : Set _) ↔ facet ∈ (F : Set _)
  simp
