name: HansenCograph.Cotree.hansenFullFlagRatio_leaf
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagRatio_leaf :
    hansenFullFlagRatio (eval .leaf) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let e : (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit) ≃g eval .leaf := SimpleGraph.Iso.refl
  have hcount : hansenFullFlagCount (eval .leaf) = 8 := by
    rw [← hansenFullFlagCount_iso e]
    exact hansenFullFlagCount_singleton
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Vert .leaf) = 1 := by
    have f : Vert .leaf ≃ PUnit := Equiv.refl PUnit
    simpa using Fintype.card_congr f
  unfold hansenFullFlagRatio
  rw [hcount, hcard]
  norm_num

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.hansenFullFlagRatio_ge_one_of_portalPolynomialMonotone
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagRatio_ge_one_of_portalPolynomialMonotone
    (hmono : ∀ T : Cotree, PortalPolynomialMonotone T) :
    ∀ T : Cotree, 1 ≤ hansenFullFlagRatio T.eval
proof:
:= by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | leaf =>
      rw [hansenFullFlagRatio_leaf]
  | compl A ih =>
      change 1 ≤
        @hansenFullFlagRatio (Vert A) (instFintypeVert A)
          (instDecidableEqVert A) (eval A)ᶜ
      rw [hansenFullFlagRatio_compl]
      exact ih
  | sum A B ihA ihB =>
      have hcorr := hansenFullFlagRatio_sum_ge A.eval B.eval
        (uniformFlagCard_eval A) (uniformFlagCard_eval B)
        (hmono (.compl A)) (hmono (.compl B))
      calc
        1 ≤ hansenFullFlagRatio A.eval * hansenFullFlagRatio B.eval := by
          nlinarith
        _ ≤ hansenFullFlagRatio (A.eval ⊕g B.eval) := hcorr

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.hansenFullFlagRatio_ge_one
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagRatio_ge_one (T : Cotree) :
    1 ≤ hansenFullFlagRatio T.eval
proof:
:=
  hansenFullFlagRatio_ge_one_of_portalPolynomialMonotone
    portalPolynomialMonotone T

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.hansenFullFlagCount_ge
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagCount_ge (T : Cotree) :
    2 ^ (Fintype.card T.Vert + 1) *
        (Fintype.card T.Vert + 1).factorial ≤
      hansenFullFlagCount T.eval
proof:
:= by
  have h := hansenFullFlagRatio_ge_one T
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) <
      2 ^ (Fintype.card T.Vert + 1) *
        ((Fintype.card T.Vert + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
  unfold hansenFullFlagRatio at h
  have hreal :
      (2 ^ (Fintype.card T.Vert + 1) : ℝ) *
          ((Fintype.card T.Vert + 1).factorial : ℝ) ≤
        (hansenFullFlagCount T.eval : ℝ) := by
    simpa using (le_div_iff₀ hden).mp h
  exact_mod_cast hreal

name: HansenCograph.hansen_cograph_fullFlagCount_ge
statement:
theorem hansen_cograph_fullFlagCount_ge
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : IsCograph G) :
    2 ^ (Fintype.card V + 1) * (Fintype.card V + 1).factorial ≤
      hansenFullFlagCount G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hG
  rw [Fintype.card_congr e.toEquiv, hansenFullFlagCount_iso e]
  exact Cotree.hansenFullFlagCount_ge T

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_eq_sum_intervalFlags
statement:
theorem hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_eq_sum_intervalFlags
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    hansenPositivePortalFlagCount G =
      ∑ p : HansenPortal G,
        Nat.card (Flag (Set.Iic p.1.1.1)) *
          Nat.card (Flag (Set.Ici p.1.2.1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    hansenPositivePortalFlagCount G = Nat.card (HansenPortalFlag G) := by
      exact Nat.card_eq_fintype_card.symm
    _ = Nat.card (HansenPortalIntervalFlags G) :=
      Nat.card_congr (hansenPortalFlagIntervalEquiv G)
    _ = ∑ p : HansenPortal G,
        Nat.card (Flag (Set.Iic p.1.1.1) ×
          Flag (Set.Ici p.1.2.1)) := Nat.card_sigma
    _ = ∑ p : HansenPortal G,
        Nat.card (Flag (Set.Iic p.1.1.1)) *
          Nat.card (Flag (Set.Ici p.1.2.1)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      exact Nat.card_prod _ _

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_join_eq_sum_factorPortals
statement:
theorem hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_join_eq_sum_factorPortals
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    hansenPositivePortalFlagCount (A ⊗g B) =
      ∑ p : HansenPortal A × HansenPortal B,
        Nat.card (Flag (Set.Iic (joinNeutral A B p.1.1.1 p.2.1.1))) *
          Nat.card (Flag (Set.Ici (joinRootedPos A B p.1.1.2 p.2.1.2)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_eq_sum_intervalFlags]
  symm
  refine Fintype.sum_equiv (joinPortalEquiv A B) _ _ ?_
  intro p
  rfl

name: HansenCograph.portalShuffleKernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem portalShuffleKernel_nonneg (n m s k l : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ portalShuffleKernel n m s k l
proof:
:= by
  unfold portalShuffleKernel
  split_ifs <;> positivity

name: HansenCograph.portalShuffleKernel_factorial_normalized
statement:
theorem portalShuffleKernel_factorial_normalized
    {n m s k l : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) (hl : l ≤ m) (hkl : k + l = s) :
    portalShuffleKernel n m s k l /
        ((s.factorial : ℝ) * ((n + m - s).factorial : ℝ)) =
      1 / ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ((n - k).factorial : ℝ)) *
        (1 / ((l.factorial : ℝ) * ((m - l).factorial : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hks : k ≤ s := by omega
  have hns : n - k ≤ n + m - s := by omega
  have hsl : s - k = l := by omega
  have hrest : n + m - s - (n - k) = m - l := by omega
  unfold portalShuffleKernel
  rw [ite_eq_left hkl, Nat.cast_choose ℝ hks, Nat.cast_choose ℝ hns]
  rw [hsl, hrest]
  have hsk : (k.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hslfac : (l.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hnk : ((n - k).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hml : ((m - l).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hs : (s.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hnsfac : ((n + m - s).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp

name: HansenCograph.portalShuffleConvolution_factorial_normalized
statement:
theorem portalShuffleConvolution_factorial_normalized
    (n m s : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) :
    portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s /
        ((s.factorial : ℝ) * ((n + m - s).factorial : ℝ)) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        if k + l = s then
          (a k / ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ((n - k).factorial : ℝ))) *
            (b l / ((l.factorial : ℝ) * ((m - l).factorial : ℝ)))
        else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold portalShuffleConvolution
  rw [Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro l hl
  by_cases h : k + l = s
  · have hk' : k ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
    have hl' : l ≤ m := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)
    have hnorm := portalShuffleKernel_factorial_normalized hk' hl' h
    simp only [ite_eq_left h]
    calc
      (portalShuffleKernel n m s k l * a k * b l) /
          ((s.factorial : ℝ) * ((n + m - s).factorial : ℝ)) =
          (portalShuffleKernel n m s k l /
            ((s.factorial : ℝ) * ((n + m - s).factorial : ℝ))) * a k * b l := by
              ring
      _ = (1 / ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ((n - k).factorial : ℝ)) *
            (1 / ((l.factorial : ℝ) * ((m - l).factorial : ℝ)))) * a k * b l := by
              rw [hnorm]
        _ = (a k / ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ((n - k).factorial : ℝ))) *
            (b l / ((l.factorial : ℝ) * ((m - l).factorial : ℝ))) := by
              field_simp
  · simp [portalShuffleKernel, h]

name: HansenCograph.portalShuffleConvolution_nonneg
statement:
theorem portalShuffleConvolution_nonneg
    {n m : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ k < n + 1, 0 ≤ a k)
    (hb : ∀ l < m + 1, 0 ≤ b l)
    (s : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s
proof:
:= by
  unfold portalShuffleConvolution
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro k hk
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro l hl
  exact mul_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (portalShuffleKernel_nonneg n m s k l)
      (ha k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)))
    (hb l (Finset.mem_range.mp hl))

name: HansenCograph.portalShuffleConvolution_le
statement:
theorem portalShuffleConvolution_le
    {n m : ℕ} {a a' b b' : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha0 : ∀ k < n + 1, 0 ≤ a k)
    (hb0 : ∀ l < m + 1, 0 ≤ b l)
    (haa' : ∀ k < n + 1, a k ≤ a' k)
    (hbb' : ∀ l < m + 1, b l ≤ b' l)
    (s : ℕ) :
    portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s ≤
      portalShuffleConvolution n m a' b' s
proof:
:= by
  unfold portalShuffleConvolution
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro k hk
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro l hl
  have hk' : k < n + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
  have hl' : l < m + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hl
  have hab : a k * b l ≤ a' k * b' l := by
    calc
      a k * b l ≤ a' k * b l := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (haa' k hk') (hb0 l hl')
      _ ≤ a' k * b' l := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbb' l hl')
        (le_trans (ha0 k hk') (haa' k hk'))
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hab (portalShuffleKernel_nonneg n m s k l))

name: HansenCograph.portalShuffleConvolution_strict_of_witness
statement:
theorem portalShuffleConvolution_strict_of_witness
    {n m : ℕ} {a a' b : ℕ → ℝ} {s k₀ l₀ : ℕ}
    (ha0 : ∀ k < n + 1, 0 ≤ a k)
    (hb0 : ∀ l < m + 1, 0 ≤ b l)
    (haa' : ∀ k < n + 1, a k ≤ a' k)
    (hk₀ : k₀ < n + 1) (hl₀ : l₀ < m + 1)
    (hkernel : 0 < portalShuffleKernel n m s k₀ l₀)
    (hstrict : a k₀ < a' k₀)
    (hother : 0 < b l₀) :
    portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s <
      portalShuffleConvolution n m a' b s
proof:
:= by
  have hbase_nonneg : 0 ≤ portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s :=
    portalShuffleConvolution_nonneg ha0 hb0 s
  let t : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun k l =>
    portalShuffleKernel n m s k l * (a' k - a k) * b l
  have ht_nonneg (k l : ℕ)
      (hk : k < n + 1) (hl : l < m + 1) : 0 ≤ t k l := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (portalShuffleKernel_nonneg n m s k l)
        (sub_nonneg.mpr (haa' k hk)))
      (hb0 l hl)
  have ht_strict : 0 < t k₀ l₀ := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact mul_pos (mul_pos hkernel (sub_pos.mpr hstrict)) hother
  have hsum_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), t k l := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro k hk
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro l hl
    exact ht_nonneg k l (Finset.mem_range.mp hk) (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)
  have hsingle :
      t k₀ l₀ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), t k l := by
    calc
      t k₀ l₀ ≤ ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), t k₀ l := by
        exact Finset.single_le_sum
          (fun l hl => ht_nonneg k₀ l hk₀ (Finset.mem_range.mp hl))
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr hl₀)
      _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), t k l := by
        exact Finset.single_le_sum
          (fun k hk => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun l hl =>
            ht_nonneg k l (Finset.mem_range.mp hk) (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)))
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr hk₀)
  have hsum_pos :
      0 < ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), t k l :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le ht_strict hsingle
  have hdiff :
      portalShuffleConvolution n m a' b s -
          portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), t k l := by
    unfold portalShuffleConvolution
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro l hl
    dsimp [t]
    ring
  rw [← hdiff] at hsum_pos
  linarith

name: HansenCograph.portalShuffleConvolution_strict_of_witness_right
statement:
theorem portalShuffleConvolution_strict_of_witness_right
    {n m : ℕ} {a b b' : ℕ → ℝ} {s k₀ l₀ : ℕ}
    (ha0 : ∀ k < n + 1, 0 ≤ a k)
    (hb0 : ∀ l < m + 1, 0 ≤ b l)
    (hbb' : ∀ l < m + 1, b l ≤ b' l)
    (hk₀ : k₀ < n + 1) (hl₀ : l₀ < m + 1)
    (hkernel : 0 < portalShuffleKernel n m s k₀ l₀)
    (hother : 0 < a k₀)
    (hstrict : b l₀ < b' l₀) :
    portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s <
      portalShuffleConvolution n m a b' s
proof:
:= by
  have hbase_nonneg : 0 ≤ portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s :=
    portalShuffleConvolution_nonneg ha0 hb0 s
  let t : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun k l =>
    portalShuffleKernel n m s k l * a k * (b' l - b l)
  have ht_nonneg (k l : ℕ)
      (hk : k < n + 1) (hl : l < m + 1) : 0 ≤ t k l := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (portalShuffleKernel_nonneg n m s k l) (ha0 k hk))
      (sub_nonneg.mpr (hbb' l hl))
  have ht_strict : 0 < t k₀ l₀ := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact mul_pos (mul_pos hkernel hother) (sub_pos.mpr hstrict)
  have hsingle :
      t k₀ l₀ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), t k l := by
    calc
      t k₀ l₀ ≤ ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), t k₀ l := by
        exact Finset.single_le_sum
          (fun l hl => ht_nonneg k₀ l hk₀ (Finset.mem_range.mp hl))
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr hl₀)
      _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), t k l := by
        exact Finset.single_le_sum
          (fun k hk => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun l hl =>
            ht_nonneg k l (Finset.mem_range.mp hk) (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)))
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr hk₀)
  have hsum_pos :
      0 < ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), t k l :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le ht_strict hsingle
  have hdiff :
      portalShuffleConvolution n m a b' s -
          portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), t k l := by
    unfold portalShuffleConvolution
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro l hl
    dsimp [t]
    ring
  rw [← hdiff] at hsum_pos
  linarith

name: HansenCograph.portalShuffleConvolution_strict_of_witness_either
statement:
theorem portalShuffleConvolution_strict_of_witness_either
    {n m : ℕ} {a a' b b' : ℕ → ℝ} (s : ℕ)
    (ha0 : ∀ k < n + 1, 0 ≤ a k)
    (hb0 : ∀ l < m + 1, 0 ≤ b l)
    (haa' : ∀ k < n + 1, a k ≤ a' k)
    (hbb' : ∀ l < m + 1, b l ≤ b' l)
    (hwitness :
      (∃ k l, k < n + 1 ∧ l < m + 1 ∧
        0 < portalShuffleKernel n m s k l ∧ a k < a' k ∧ 0 < b l) ∨
      (∃ k l, k < n + 1 ∧ l < m + 1 ∧
        0 < portalShuffleKernel n m s k l ∧ 0 < a k ∧ b l < b' l)) :
    portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s <
      portalShuffleConvolution n m a' b' s
proof:
:= by
  rcases hwitness with hleft | hright
  · rcases hleft with ⟨k, l, hk, hl, hkernel, hstrict, hother⟩
    have hfirst := portalShuffleConvolution_strict_of_witness
      ha0 hb0 haa' hk hl hkernel hstrict hother
    have ha'0 : ∀ i < n + 1, 0 ≤ a' i := fun i hi =>
      le_trans (ha0 i hi) (haa' i hi)
    have hsecond :
        portalShuffleConvolution n m a' b s ≤
          portalShuffleConvolution n m a' b' s :=
      portalShuffleConvolution_le ha'0 hb0 (fun i hi => le_rfl) hbb' s
    exact hfirst.trans_le hsecond
  · rcases hright with ⟨k, l, hk, hl, hkernel, hother, hstrict⟩
    have hfirst := portalShuffleConvolution_strict_of_witness_right
      ha0 hb0 hbb' hk hl hkernel hother hstrict
    have hb'0 : ∀ i < m + 1, 0 ≤ b' i := fun i hi =>
      le_trans (hb0 i hi) (hbb' i hi)
    have hsecond :
        portalShuffleConvolution n m a b' s ≤
          portalShuffleConvolution n m a' b' s :=
      portalShuffleConvolution_le ha0 hb'0 haa' (fun i hi => le_rfl) s
    exact hfirst.trans_le hsecond

name: HansenCograph.boundedSizedFlagProduct_card_lower_bound
statement:
theorem boundedSizedFlagProduct_card_lower_bound :
    Nat.card (BoundedSizedProductCode (P := P) (Q := Q)) ≤
      Nat.card (Flag (P × Q))
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.card_le_card_of_injective
    (boundedSizedFlagProductEmbedding (P := P) (Q := Q))
    (boundedSizedFlagProductEmbedding (P := P) (Q := Q)).injective

name: HansenCograph.boundedSizedFlagProduct_card_lower_bound_sum
statement:
theorem boundedSizedFlagProduct_card_lower_bound_sum :
    (∑ n : Fin (Fintype.card P), ∑ m : Fin (Fintype.card Q),
      Nat.card (SizedFlag P n) * Nat.card (SizedFlag Q m) *
        Nat.choose (n + m) n) ≤ Nat.card (Flag (P × Q))
proof:
:= by
  have h := boundedSizedFlagProduct_card_lower_bound (P := P) (Q := Q)
  simp only [Nat.card_sigma, Nat.card_prod, Set.powersetCard.card,
    Nat.card_fin] at h
  simpa only [Nat.mul_assoc] using h

name: HansenCograph.bernsteinCombination_eval
statement:
private theorem bernsteinCombination_eval (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    (bernsteinCombination n a).eval x = (n.factorial : ℝ) * portalPolynomial n a x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold bernsteinCombination portalPolynomial
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_smul, bernsteinPolynomial,
    Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_natCast, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X,
    Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_one, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  have hkn : k ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
  have hfac := Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hkn
  have hfacR : (n.choose k : ℝ) * (k.factorial : ℝ) * ((n - k).factorial : ℝ) =
      (n.factorial : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hfac
  rw [← hfacR]
  field_simp

name: HansenCograph.sum_shift_smul_eq_sub
statement:
private theorem sum_shift_smul_eq_sub
    {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℝ M]
    (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℕ → M) (hq : q (n + 1) = 0) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c (k + 1) • q (k + 1)) =
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c k • q k) - c 0 • q 0
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst := Finset.sum_range_succ' (fun k ↦ c k • q k) (n + 1)
  have hlast := Finset.sum_range_succ (fun k ↦ c k • q k) (n + 1)
  rw [hq, smul_zero, add_zero] at hlast
  rw [hfirst] at hlast
  rw [← hlast]
  abel

name: HansenCograph.bernsteinCombination_derivative_succ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold bernsteinCombination
  rw [Polynomial.derivative_sum, Finset.sum_range_succ']
  simp only [Polynomial.derivative_smul, bernsteinPolynomial.derivative_zero,
    bernsteinPolynomial.derivative_succ_aux, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  have hterminal : bernsteinPolynomial ℝ n (n + 1) = 0 :=
    bernsteinPolynomial.eq_zero_of_lt ℝ (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
  have hshift := sum_shift_smul_eq_sub n a (bernsteinPolynomial ℝ n) hterminal
  have hinner :
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          a (k + 1) • (bernsteinPolynomial ℝ n k - bernsteinPolynomial ℝ n (k + 1))) +
          a 0 • (-bernsteinPolynomial ℝ n 0) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (a (k + 1) - a k) • bernsteinPolynomial ℝ n k := by
    simp only [smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, smul_neg, sub_smul]
    rw [hshift]
    module
  calc
    _ = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ[X]) *
        ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            a (k + 1) • (bernsteinPolynomial ℝ n k - bernsteinPolynomial ℝ n (k + 1))) +
          a 0 • (-bernsteinPolynomial ℝ n 0)) := by
      rw [mul_add, Finset.mul_sum]
      apply congrArg₂ (fun p q ↦ p + q)
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k hk
        rw [Polynomial.smul_eq_C_mul]
        simp only [Polynomial.smul_eq_C_mul]
        push_cast
        ring
      · rw [Polynomial.smul_eq_C_mul]
        simp only [Polynomial.smul_eq_C_mul]
        ring
    _ = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ[X]) *
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (a (k + 1) - a k) • bernsteinPolynomial ℝ n k) := by rw [hinner]
    _ = (n + 1 : ℝ) •
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (a (k + 1) - a k) • bernsteinPolynomial ℝ n k) := by
      rw [Polynomial.smul_eq_C_mul]
      congr 1
      ext
      simp [Nat.cast_add]

name: HansenCograph.portalPolynomial_hasDerivAt_succ
statement:
theorem portalPolynomial_hasDerivAt_succ (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (portalPolynomial (n + 1) a)
      (portalPolynomial n (fun k ↦ a (k + 1) - a k) x) x
proof:
:= by
  let p := ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ • bernsteinCombination (n + 1) a
  have hp : p.eval = portalPolynomial (n + 1) a := by
    funext y
    simp only [p, Polynomial.eval_smul, bernsteinCombination_eval, smul_eq_mul,
      Nat.factorial_succ]
    field_simp
  rw [← hp]
  have hderiv :
      portalPolynomial n (fun k ↦ a (k + 1) - a k) x =
        p.derivative.eval x := by
    symm
    simp only [p, Polynomial.derivative_smul, Polynomial.eval_smul,
      bernsteinCombination_derivative_succ, smul_smul, bernsteinCombination_eval,
      smul_eq_mul, Nat.factorial_succ]
    field_simp
    push_cast
    rfl
  rw [hderiv]
  exact p.hasDerivAt x

name: HansenCograph.portalPolynomial_nonneg_of_coeff_nonneg
statement:
private theorem portalPolynomial_nonneg_of_coeff_nonneg
    (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (ha : ∀ k < n + 1, 0 ≤ a k) :
    0 ≤ portalPolynomial n a x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold portalPolynomial
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro k hk
  have hklt : k < n + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := hx.1
  have hx1 : 0 ≤ 1 - x := sub_nonneg.mpr hx.2
  have hak : 0 ≤ a k := ha k hklt
  positivity

name: HansenCograph.portalPolynomial_monotoneOn_of_coeff_monotone
statement:
theorem portalPolynomial_monotoneOn_of_coeff_monotone
    {n : ℕ} {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ k < n, a k ≤ a (k + 1)) :
    MonotoneOn (portalPolynomial n a) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      intro x hx y hy hxy
      simp [portalPolynomial]
  | succ n =>
      apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc 0 1)
        (portalPolynomial_continuous (n + 1) a).continuousOn
        (f' := portalPolynomial n (fun k ↦ a (k + 1) - a k))
      · intro x hx
        exact (portalPolynomial_hasDerivAt_succ n a x).hasDerivWithinAt
      · intro x hx
        rw [interior_Icc] at hx
        apply portalPolynomial_nonneg_of_coeff_nonneg n _ ⟨hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩
        intro k hk
        exact sub_nonneg.mpr (ha k hk)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinNeutralLowerInterval_flag_sum_lower_bound
statement:
theorem joinNeutralLowerInterval_flag_sum_lower_bound
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (E : NeutralOrEmpty A) (L : NeutralOrEmpty B) :
    (∑ n : Fin (Fintype.card (Set.Iic E.1)),
      ∑ m : Fin (Fintype.card (Set.Iic L.1)),
        Nat.card (SizedFlag (Set.Iic E.1) n) *
          Nat.card (SizedFlag (Set.Iic L.1) m) *
            Nat.choose (n + m) n) ≤
      Nat.card (Flag (Set.Iic (joinNeutral A B E L)))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ n : Fin (Fintype.card (Set.Iic E.1)),
        ∑ m : Fin (Fintype.card (Set.Iic L.1)),
          Nat.card (SizedFlag (Set.Iic E.1) n) *
            Nat.card (SizedFlag (Set.Iic L.1) m) *
              Nat.choose (n + m) n) ≤
        Nat.card (Flag (Set.Iic E.1 × Set.Iic L.1)) :=
      boundedSizedFlagProduct_card_lower_bound_sum
        (P := Set.Iic E.1) (Q := Set.Iic L.1)
    _ = Nat.card (Flag (Set.Iic (joinNeutral A B E L))) :=
      Nat.card_congr (joinNeutralLowerIntervalFlagEquiv A B E L)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinRootedUpperInterval_flag_sum_lower_bound
statement:
theorem joinRootedUpperInterval_flag_sum_lower_bound
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (F : RootedPos A) (K : RootedPos B) :
    (∑ n : Fin (Fintype.card (Set.Ici F)),
      ∑ m : Fin (Fintype.card (Set.Ici K)),
        Nat.card (SizedFlag (Set.Ici F) n) *
          Nat.card (SizedFlag (Set.Ici K) m) *
            Nat.choose (n + m) n) ≤
      Nat.card (Flag (Set.Ici (joinRootedPos A B F K)))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ n : Fin (Fintype.card (Set.Ici F)),
        ∑ m : Fin (Fintype.card (Set.Ici K)),
          Nat.card (SizedFlag (Set.Ici F) n) *
            Nat.card (SizedFlag (Set.Ici K) m) *
              Nat.choose (n + m) n) ≤
        Nat.card (Flag (Set.Ici F × Set.Ici K)) :=
      generalBoundedSizedFlagProduct_card_lower_bound_sum
        (P := Set.Ici F) (Q := Set.Ici K)
    _ = Nat.card (Flag (Set.Ici (joinRootedPos A B F K))) :=
      Nat.card_congr (joinRootedUpperIntervalFlagEquiv A B F K).symm

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinPortal_interval_flag_product_lower_bound
statement:
theorem joinPortal_interval_flag_product_lower_bound
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    ∀ (E : NeutralOrEmpty A) (L : NeutralOrEmpty B)
      (F : RootedPos A) (K : RootedPos B),
      (∑ n : Fin (Fintype.card (Set.Iic E.1)),
        ∑ m : Fin (Fintype.card (Set.Iic L.1)),
          Nat.card (SizedFlag (Set.Iic E.1) n) *
            Nat.card (SizedFlag (Set.Iic L.1) m) * Nat.choose (n + m) n) *
        (∑ n : Fin (Fintype.card (Set.Ici F)),
          ∑ m : Fin (Fintype.card (Set.Ici K)),
            Nat.card (SizedFlag (Set.Ici F) n) *
              Nat.card (SizedFlag (Set.Ici K) m) * Nat.choose (n + m) n) ≤
      Nat.card (Flag (Set.Iic (joinNeutral A B E L))) *
        Nat.card (Flag (Set.Ici (joinRootedPos A B F K)))
proof:
:= by
  intro E L F K
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul
    (joinNeutralLowerInterval_flag_sum_lower_bound A B E L)
    (joinRootedUpperInterval_flag_sum_lower_bound A B F K)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.portal_eq_of_mem_flag
statement:
theorem portal_eq_of_mem_flag
    (s : Flag (HansenCombinatorialFace G))
    (p q : HansenPortal G)
    (hpE : p.1.1.1 ∈ s) (hpF : p.1.2.1 ∈ s)
    (hqE : q.1.1.1 ∈ s) (hqF : q.1.2.1 ∈ s) :
    p = q
proof:
:= by
  have hpositive : p.1.2.1 = q.1.2.1 := by
    rcases s.le_or_le hpF hqF with hpq | hqp
    · rcases s.le_or_le hpF hqE with hpFqE | hqEpF
      · exact False.elim
          (q.1.1.2.1 (p.1.2.2.1.mono hpFqE))
      · rcases q.2.eq_or_eq hqEpF hpq with heq | heq
        · exact False.elim
            (q.1.1.2.1 (heq ▸ p.1.2.2.1))
        · exact heq
    · rcases s.le_or_le hqF hpE with hqFpE | hpEqF
      · exact False.elim
          (p.1.1.2.1 (q.1.2.2.1.mono hqFpE))
      · rcases p.2.eq_or_eq hpEqF hqp with heq | heq
        · exact False.elim
            (p.1.1.2.1 (heq ▸ q.1.2.2.1))
        · exact heq.symm
  have hneutral : p.1.1.1 = q.1.1.1 := by
    rcases s.le_or_le hpE hqE with hpq | hqp
    · have hqEpF : q.1.1.1 ≤ p.1.2.1 := by
        calc
          q.1.1.1 ≤ q.1.2.1 := q.2.le
          _ = p.1.2.1 := hpositive.symm
      rcases p.2.eq_or_eq hpq hqEpF with heq | heq
      · exact heq.symm
      · exact False.elim
          (q.1.1.2.1 (heq ▸ p.1.2.2.1))
    · have hpEqF : p.1.1.1 ≤ q.1.2.1 := by
        calc
          p.1.1.1 ≤ p.1.2.1 := p.2.le
          _ = q.1.2.1 := hpositive
      rcases q.2.eq_or_eq hqp hpEqF with heq | heq
      · exact heq
      · exact False.elim
          (p.1.1.2.1 (heq ▸ q.1.2.2.1))
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact Subtype.ext hneutral
  · exact Subtype.ext hpositive

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.portalFlagToFlag_injective
statement:
theorem portalFlagToFlag_injective (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Function.Injective (portalFlagToFlag G)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hflag
  change x.1.2 = y.1.2 at hflag
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply portal_eq_of_mem_flag x.1.2 x.1.1 y.1.1
    · exact x.2.1
    · exact x.2.2
    · rw [hflag]
      exact y.2.1
    · rw [hflag]
      exact y.2.2
  · exact hflag

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenNegativePortalFlagCount_eq_positive
statement:
theorem hansenNegativePortalFlagCount_eq_positive (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    hansenNegativePortalFlagCount G = hansenPositivePortalFlagCount G
proof:
:= by
  unfold hansenNegativePortalFlagCount hansenPositivePortalFlagCount
  exact (Fintype.card_congr (hansenCentralPortalFlagEquiv G)).symm

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_le_fullFlagCount
statement:
theorem hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_le_fullFlagCount (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    hansenPositivePortalFlagCount G ≤ hansenFullFlagCount G
proof:
:= by
  exact Fintype.card_le_of_injective (portalFlagToFlag G)
    (portalFlagToFlag_injective G)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.negativePortalFlagToFlag_injective
statement:
theorem negativePortalFlagToFlag_injective (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Function.Injective (negativePortalFlagToFlag G)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hflag
  apply (hansenCentralPortalFlagEquiv G).symm.injective
  apply portalFlagToFlag_injective G
  change (hansenCentralFlagEquiv G).symm x.1.2 =
    (hansenCentralFlagEquiv G).symm y.1.2
  exact congrArg (hansenCentralFlagEquiv G).symm hflag

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.positivePortalFlag_ne_negativePortalFlag
statement:
theorem positivePortalFlag_ne_negativePortalFlag
    (x : HansenPortalFlag G) (y : HansenNegativePortalFlag G) :
    portalFlagToFlag G x ≠ negativePortalFlagToFlag G y
proof:
:= by
  intro hflag
  change x.1.2 = y.1.2 at hflag
  have hyF : y.1.1.1.2.1 ∈ x.1.2 := by
    rw [hflag]
    exact y.2.2
  rcases x.1.2.le_or_le x.2.2 hyF with hposneg | hnegpos
  · exact y.1.1.1.2.2.2 (x.1.1.1.2.2.1.mono hposneg)
  · exact x.1.1.1.2.2.2 (y.1.1.1.2.2.1.mono hnegpos)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.signedPortalFlagToFlag_injective
statement:
theorem signedPortalFlagToFlag_injective (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Function.Injective (signedPortalFlagToFlag G)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  rcases x with x | x <;> rcases y with y | y
  · exact congrArg Sum.inl (portalFlagToFlag_injective G h)
  · exact False.elim (positivePortalFlag_ne_negativePortalFlag x y h)
  · exact False.elim (positivePortalFlag_ne_negativePortalFlag y x h.symm)
  · exact congrArg Sum.inr (negativePortalFlagToFlag_injective G h)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.Flag.exists_rooted_face
statement:
theorem Flag.exists_rooted_face
    (s : Flag (HansenCombinatorialFace G)) :
    (∃ F : RootedPos G, F.1 ∈ s) ∨
      (∃ F : RootedNeg G, F.1 ∈ s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let proper : Set (HansenCombinatorialFace G) :=
    {F | F ∈ s ∧ F ≠ ⊤}
  have hbotne : (⊥ : HansenCombinatorialFace G) ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    have hfacet : emptyHansenFacet G HansenSign.pos ∈
        ((⊥ : HansenCombinatorialFace G) :
          Set (HansenFacetLabel G)) := by
      change _ ∈ (Set.univ : Set (HansenFacetLabel G))
      exact Set.mem_univ _
    rw [h] at hfacet
    exact hfacet
  have hproper : proper.Nonempty :=
    ⟨⊥, Flag.bot_mem s, hbotne⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := (Set.toFinite proper).exists_maximal hproper
  rcases strata_cases G E with htop | hpos | hneg | hneutral
  · exact False.elim (hE.1.2 htop)
  · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨E, hpos⟩, hE.1.1⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨E, hneg⟩, hE.1.1⟩
  · let Eneutral : NeutralOrEmpty G := ⟨E, hneutral⟩
    let R : RootedPos G := positiveRootExtension Eneutral
    have hER : E < R.1 := lt_positiveRootExtension Eneutral
    have hR : R.1 ∈ s := (Flag.mem_iff_forall_le_or_ge).2 (by
      intro C hC
      rcases s.le_or_le hE.1.1 hC with hEC | hCE
      · by_cases hCtop : C = ⊤
        · exact Or.inl (hCtop ▸ le_top)
        · exact Or.inr ((hE.2 ⟨hC, hCtop⟩ hEC).trans hER.le)
      · exact Or.inr (hCE.trans hER.le))
    have hRE : R.1 ≤ E := hE.2 ⟨hR, R.2.ne_top⟩ hER.le
    exact False.elim (hER.2 hRE)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.Flag.exists_positive_portal_of_rootedPos
statement:
theorem Flag.exists_positive_portal_of_rootedPos
    (s : Flag (HansenCombinatorialFace G))
    (F : RootedPos G) (hF : F.1 ∈ s) :
    ∃ p : HansenPortal G, p.1.1.1 ∈ s ∧ p.1.2.1 ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let neutral : Set (HansenCombinatorialFace G) :=
    {E | E ∈ s ∧ E.IsNeutralOrEmpty}
  have hneutral : neutral.Nonempty :=
    ⟨⊥, Flag.bot_mem s, bottom_isNeutralOrEmpty G⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := (Set.toFinite neutral).exists_maximal hneutral
  have hEF : E < F.1 := by
    rcases s.le_or_le hE.1.1 hF with hEF | hFE
    · exact lt_of_le_of_ne hEF (by
        intro h
        exact F.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (h ▸ hE.1.2))
    · exact False.elim (hE.1.2.1 (F.2.1.mono hFE))
  let above : Set (HansenCombinatorialFace G) :=
    {X | X ∈ s ∧ E < X}
  have habove : above.Nonempty := ⟨F.1, hF, hEF⟩
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := (Set.toFinite above).exists_minimal habove
  have hEXcover : E ⋖ X := Flag.covBy_of_mem_of_mem_of_no_between
    s hE.1.1 hX.1.1 hX.1.2 (by
      intro C hC hEC hCX
      exact hCX.2 (hX.2 ⟨hC, hEC⟩ hCX.le))
  have hXpos : X.IsRootedPos := by
    have hXF : X ≤ F.1 := by
      rcases s.le_or_le hX.1.1 hF with hXF | hFX
      · exact hXF
      · exact hX.2 ⟨hF, hEF⟩ hFX
    rcases F.2.lower_strata hXF with hpos | hneutralX
    · exact hpos
    · have hXE : X ≤ E := hE.2 ⟨hX.1.1, hneutralX⟩ hX.1.2.le
      exact False.elim (hX.1.2.2 hXE)
  exact ⟨⟨(⟨E, hE.1.2⟩, ⟨X, hXpos⟩), hEXcover⟩,
    hE.1.1, hX.1.1⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.Flag.exists_negative_portal_of_rootedNeg
statement:
theorem Flag.exists_negative_portal_of_rootedNeg
    (s : Flag (HansenCombinatorialFace G))
    (F : RootedNeg G) (hF : F.1 ∈ s) :
    ∃ p : HansenNegativePortal G, p.1.1.1 ∈ s ∧ p.1.2.1 ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s' := hansenCentralFlagEquiv G s
  let F' : RootedPos G :=
    ⟨hansenCentralFaceOrderIso G F.1,
      centralFace_rootedNeg_to_rootedPos F.2⟩
  have hF' : F'.1 ∈ s' := ⟨F.1, hF, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hpE, hpF⟩ :=
    HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.Flag.exists_positive_portal_of_rootedPos
      s' F' hF'
  let marked : HansenPortalFlag G := ⟨(p, s'), hpE, hpF⟩
  let negMarked : HansenNegativePortalFlag G :=
    hansenCentralPortalFlagEquiv G marked
  have hflag : negMarked.1.2 = s := by
    change hansenCentralFlagEquiv G (hansenCentralFlagEquiv G s) = s
    exact (hansenCentralFlagEquiv G).left_inv s
  exact ⟨negMarked.1.1, hflag ▸ negMarked.2.1, hflag ▸ negMarked.2.2⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.Flag.exists_signed_portal
statement:
theorem Flag.exists_signed_portal
    (s : Flag (HansenCombinatorialFace G)) :
    (∃ p : HansenPortal G, p.1.1.1 ∈ s ∧ p.1.2.1 ∈ s) ∨
      (∃ p : HansenNegativePortal G,
        p.1.1.1 ∈ s ∧ p.1.2.1 ∈ s)
proof:
:= by
  rcases HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.Flag.exists_rooted_face s with
    ⟨F, hF⟩ | ⟨F, hF⟩
  · exact Or.inl
      (HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.Flag.exists_positive_portal_of_rootedPos
        s F hF)
  · exact Or.inr
      (HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.Flag.exists_negative_portal_of_rootedNeg
        s F hF)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.signedPortalFlagToFlag_surjective
statement:
theorem signedPortalFlagToFlag_surjective (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Function.Surjective (signedPortalFlagToFlag G)
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  rcases HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.Flag.exists_signed_portal s with
    ⟨p, hpE, hpF⟩ | ⟨p, hpE, hpF⟩
  · exact ⟨Sum.inl ⟨(p, s), hpE, hpF⟩, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨Sum.inr ⟨(p, s), hpE, hpF⟩, rfl⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenFullFlagCount_eq_two_mul_positivePortalFlagCount
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagCount_eq_two_mul_positivePortalFlagCount
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    hansenFullFlagCount G = 2 * hansenPositivePortalFlagCount G
proof:
:= by
  change Fintype.card (Flag (HansenCombinatorialFace G)) =
    2 * Fintype.card (HansenPortalFlag G)
  have hcard := Fintype.card_congr (signedPortalFlagEquiv G)
  rw [Fintype.card_sum] at hcard
  have heq : Fintype.card (HansenNegativePortalFlag G) =
      Fintype.card (HansenPortalFlag G) :=
    (Fintype.card_congr (hansenCentralPortalFlagEquiv G)).symm
  rw [heq] at hcard
  omega

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.two_mul_hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_le_fullFlagCount
statement:
theorem two_mul_hansenPositivePortalFlagCount_le_fullFlagCount
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    2 * hansenPositivePortalFlagCount G ≤ hansenFullFlagCount G
proof:
:= by
  change 2 * Fintype.card (HansenPortalFlag G) ≤
    Fintype.card (Flag (HansenCombinatorialFace G))
  have h := Fintype.card_le_of_injective (signedPortalFlagToFlag G)
    (signedPortalFlagToFlag_injective G)
  rw [Fintype.card_sum] at h
  have heq : Fintype.card (HansenNegativePortalFlag G) =
      Fintype.card (HansenPortalFlag G) :=
    (Fintype.card_congr (hansenCentralPortalFlagEquiv G)).symm
  rw [heq] at h
  omega

name: HansenCograph.cliqueIndicatorValue_eq_card_inter
statement:
theorem cliqueIndicatorValue_eq_card_inter (c s : Finset V) :
    cliqueIndicatorValue c s = ((c ∩ s).card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [cliqueIndicatorValue, indicator]

name: HansenCograph.clique_inter_indep_card_le_one
statement:
theorem clique_inter_indep_card_le_one (G : SimpleGraph V) (c s : Finset V)
    (hc : G.IsClique (↑c : Set V))
    (hs : G.IsIndepSet (↑s : Set V)) :
    (c ∩ s).card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.card_le_one]
  intro u hu v hv
  by_contra huv
  have hu' := Finset.mem_inter.mp hu
  have hv' := Finset.mem_inter.mp hv
  exact (hs hu'.2 hv'.2 huv) (hc hu'.1 hv'.1 huv)

name: HansenCograph.cliqueIndicatorValue_le_one
statement:
theorem cliqueIndicatorValue_le_one (G : SimpleGraph V) (c s : Finset V)
    (hc : G.IsClique (↑c : Set V))
    (hs : G.IsIndepSet (↑s : Set V)) :
    cliqueIndicatorValue c s ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [cliqueIndicatorValue_eq_card_inter]
  exact_mod_cast clique_inter_indep_card_le_one G c s hc hs

name: HansenCograph.cliqueIndicatorValue_eq_zero_iff_disjoint
statement:
theorem cliqueIndicatorValue_eq_zero_iff_disjoint (c s : Finset V) :
    cliqueIndicatorValue c s = 0 ↔ Disjoint c s
proof:
:= by
  rw [cliqueIndicatorValue_eq_card_inter]
  norm_cast
  rw [Finset.card_eq_zero]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro v hvc hvs
    have hmem : v ∈ c ∩ s := Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hvc, hvs⟩
    rw [h] at hmem
    simp at hmem
  · intro h
    rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    intro v hmem
    exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp h (Finset.mem_inter.mp hmem).1)
      (Finset.mem_inter.mp hmem).2

name: HansenCograph.cliqueIndicatorValue_eq_one_iff_inter_nonempty
statement:
theorem cliqueIndicatorValue_eq_one_iff_inter_nonempty
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (c s : Finset V)
    (hc : G.IsClique (↑c : Set V))
    (hs : G.IsIndepSet (↑s : Set V)) :
    cliqueIndicatorValue c s = 1 ↔ (c ∩ s).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [cliqueIndicatorValue_eq_card_inter]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hcard : (c ∩ s).card = 1 := by exact_mod_cast h
    exact Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  · intro h
    have hpos : 0 < (c ∩ s).card := Finset.card_pos.mpr h
    have hle := clique_inter_indep_card_le_one G c s hc hs
    have hcard : (c ∩ s).card = 1 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast hcard

name: HansenCograph.hansenJoinFaceEquiv_apply_carrier
statement:
@[simp] theorem hansenJoinFaceEquiv_apply_carrier
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (C : IncidenceClosedSet
      (signedJoinIncidence
        (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
        (signB := fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1)
        (hansenLabelIncidence A) (hansenLabelIncidence B))) :
    ((hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B C : HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B)) :
      Set (HansenFacetLabel (A ⊗g B))) =
      joinFacetLabelEquiv A B '' (C : Set _)
proof: := rfl

name: HansenCograph.hansenJoinFaceEquiv_symm_carrier
statement:
@[simp] theorem hansenJoinFaceEquiv_symm_carrier
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (F : HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B)) :
    (((hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B).symm F : IncidenceClosedSet
      (signedJoinIncidence
        (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
        (signB := fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1)
        (hansenLabelIncidence A) (hansenLabelIncidence B))) : Set _) =
      (joinFacetLabelEquiv A B).symm '' (F : Set _)
proof: := rfl

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenJoinFaceEquiv_contains_map
statement:
theorem hansenJoinFaceEquiv_contains_map
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) (C : AbstractJoinFace A B)
    (vertex : HansenVertexLabel A ⊕ HansenVertexLabel B) :
    (hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B C).ContainsVertex
        (joinVertexLabelMap A B vertex) ↔
      vertex ∈ incidenceModels
        (signedJoinIncidence
          (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
          (signB := fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1)
          (hansenLabelIncidence A) (hansenLabelIncidence B)) C
proof:
:= by
  exact incidenceClosedTransportSurjEquiv_models
    (signedJoinIncidence
      (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
      (signB := fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1)
      (hansenLabelIncidence A) (hansenLabelIncidence B))
    (hansenLabelIncidence (A ⊗g B))
    (joinVertexLabelMap A B) (joinFacetLabelEquiv A B)
    (joinVertexLabelMap_surjective A B)
    (fun v f ↦ hansenLabelIncidence_join_map A B v f) C vertex

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenJoinFaceEquiv_rootedPos_of_sign_neg
statement:
theorem hansenJoinFaceEquiv_rootedPos_of_sign_neg
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) (C : AbstractJoinFace A B)
    (hne : (C : Set (SignedJoinFacet
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1))).Nonempty)
    (hsign : ∀ facet : SignedJoinFacet
        (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
        (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1),
      facet ∈ (C : Set _) → facet.1.1.1 = HansenSign.neg) :
    (hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B C).IsRootedPos
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have hmodel : Sum.inl (emptyHansenVertex A HansenSign.pos) ∈
        incidenceModels
          (signedJoinIncidence
            (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
            (signB := fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1)
            (hansenLabelIncidence A) (hansenLabelIncidence B)) C := by
      intro facet hfacet
      change hansenLabelIncidence A
        (emptyHansenVertex A HansenSign.pos) facet.1.1
      rw [emptyHansenVertex_incident_iff_ne]
      rw [hsign facet hfacet]
      decide
    have h := (hansenJoinFaceEquiv_contains_map A B C
      (Sum.inl (emptyHansenVertex A HansenSign.pos))).mpr hmodel
    simpa [joinVertexLabelMap, joinVertexLabelLeft, emptyHansenVertex,
      sumFinset] using h
  · intro hcontains
    have h := (hansenJoinFaceEquiv_contains_map A B C
      (Sum.inl (emptyHansenVertex A HansenSign.neg))).mp
      (by simpa [joinVertexLabelMap, joinVertexLabelLeft, emptyHansenVertex,
          sumFinset] using hcontains)
    rcases hne with ⟨facet, hfacet⟩
    have hinc := h facet hfacet
    change hansenLabelIncidence A
      (emptyHansenVertex A HansenSign.neg) facet.1.1 at hinc
    rw [emptyHansenVertex_incident_iff_ne] at hinc
    exact hinc (hsign facet hfacet)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenJoinFaceEquiv_rootedNeg_of_sign_pos
statement:
theorem hansenJoinFaceEquiv_rootedNeg_of_sign_pos
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) (C : AbstractJoinFace A B)
    (hne : (C : Set (SignedJoinFacet
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1))).Nonempty)
    (hsign : ∀ facet : SignedJoinFacet
        (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
        (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1),
      facet ∈ (C : Set _) → facet.1.1.1 = HansenSign.pos) :
    (hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B C).IsRootedNeg
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have hmodel : Sum.inl (emptyHansenVertex A HansenSign.neg) ∈
        incidenceModels
          (signedJoinIncidence
            (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
            (signB := fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1)
            (hansenLabelIncidence A) (hansenLabelIncidence B)) C := by
      intro facet hfacet
      change hansenLabelIncidence A
        (emptyHansenVertex A HansenSign.neg) facet.1.1
      rw [emptyHansenVertex_incident_iff_ne]
      rw [hsign facet hfacet]
      decide
    have h := (hansenJoinFaceEquiv_contains_map A B C
      (Sum.inl (emptyHansenVertex A HansenSign.neg))).mpr hmodel
    simpa [joinVertexLabelMap, joinVertexLabelLeft, emptyHansenVertex,
      sumFinset] using h
  · intro hcontains
    have h := (hansenJoinFaceEquiv_contains_map A B C
      (Sum.inl (emptyHansenVertex A HansenSign.pos))).mp
      (by simpa [joinVertexLabelMap, joinVertexLabelLeft, emptyHansenVertex,
          sumFinset] using hcontains)
    rcases hne with ⟨facet, hfacet⟩
    have hinc := h facet hfacet
    change hansenLabelIncidence A
      (emptyHansenVertex A HansenSign.pos) facet.1.1 at hinc
    rw [emptyHansenVertex_incident_iff_ne] at hinc
    exact hinc (hsign facet hfacet)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenJoinFaceEquiv_neutral_of_both_signs
statement:
theorem hansenJoinFaceEquiv_neutral_of_both_signs
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) (C : AbstractJoinFace A B)
    (negFacet posFacet : SignedJoinFacet

      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1))
    (hnegMem : negFacet ∈ (C : Set _))
    (hneg : negFacet.1.1.1 = HansenSign.neg)
    (hposMem : posFacet ∈ (C : Set _))
    (hpos : posFacet.1.1.1 = HansenSign.pos) :
    (hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B C).IsNeutralOrEmpty
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hcontains
    have h := (hansenJoinFaceEquiv_contains_map A B C
      (Sum.inl (emptyHansenVertex A HansenSign.pos))).mp
      (by simpa [joinVertexLabelMap, joinVertexLabelLeft, emptyHansenVertex,
          sumFinset] using hcontains)
    have hinc := h posFacet hposMem
    change hansenLabelIncidence A
      (emptyHansenVertex A HansenSign.pos) posFacet.1.1 at hinc
    rw [emptyHansenVertex_incident_iff_ne] at hinc
    exact hinc hpos
  · intro hcontains
    have h := (hansenJoinFaceEquiv_contains_map A B C
      (Sum.inl (emptyHansenVertex A HansenSign.neg))).mp
      (by simpa [joinVertexLabelMap, joinVertexLabelLeft, emptyHansenVertex,
          sumFinset] using hcontains)
    have hinc := h negFacet hnegMem
    change hansenLabelIncidence A
      (emptyHansenVertex A HansenSign.neg) negFacet.1.1 at hinc
    rw [emptyHansenVertex_incident_iff_ne] at hinc
    exact hinc hneg

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinLeftFactor_contains_iff
statement:
theorem joinLeftFactor_contains_iff
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) (C : AbstractJoinFace A B)
    (vertex : HansenVertexLabel A) :
    (joinLeftFactor A B C).ContainsVertex vertex ↔
      Sum.inl vertex ∈ incidenceModels
        (signedJoinIncidence
          (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
          (signB := fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1)
          (hansenLabelIncidence A) (hansenLabelIncidence B)) C
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_join_models_inl_iff
    (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
    (signB := fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1)]
  exact Set.ext_iff.mp
    (incidenceModels_incidenceClosure_eq (hansenLabelIncidence A)
      (joinFacetProjLeft
        (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
        (signB := fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1) C)) vertex

    (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinFactors_rootedPos_of_sign_neg
statement:
theorem joinFactors_rootedPos_of_sign_neg
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) (C : AbstractJoinFace A B)
    (hne : (C : Set (SignedJoinFacet
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1))).Nonempty)
    (hsign : ∀ facet : SignedJoinFacet
        (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
        (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1),
      facet ∈ (C : Set _) → facet.1.1.1 = HansenSign.neg) :
    (joinLeftFactor A B C).IsRootedPos ∧
      (joinRightFactor A B C).IsRootedPos
proof:
:= by
  rcases hne with ⟨witness, hwitness⟩
  constructor
  · constructor
    · rw [joinLeftFactor_contains_iff]
      intro facet hfacet
      change hansenLabelIncidence A (emptyHansenVertex A HansenSign.pos) facet.1.1
      rw [emptyHansenVertex_incident_iff_ne]
      have hs := hsign facet hfacet
      simpa [hs]
    · intro hcontains
      rw [joinLeftFactor_contains_iff] at hcontains
      have hinc := hcontains witness hwitness
      change hansenLabelIncidence A (emptyHansenVertex A HansenSign.neg) witness.1.1 at hinc
      rw [emptyHansenVertex_incident_iff_ne] at hinc
      exact hinc (hsign witness hwitness)
  · constructor
    · rw [joinRightFactor_contains_iff]
      intro facet hfacet
      change hansenLabelIncidence B (emptyHansenVertex B HansenSign.pos) facet.1.2
      rw [emptyHansenVertex_incident_iff_ne]
      have hs : facet.1.2.1 = HansenSign.neg := by
        exact facet.2.symm.trans (hsign facet hfacet)
      simpa [hs]
    · intro hcontains
      rw [joinRightFactor_contains_iff] at hcontains
      have hinc := hcontains witness hwitness
      change hansenLabelIncidence B (emptyHansenVertex B HansenSign.neg) witness.1.2 at hinc
      rw [emptyHansenVertex_incident_iff_ne] at hinc
      have hs : witness.1.2.1 = HansenSign.neg := by
        exact witness.2.symm.trans (hsign witness hwitness)
      exact hinc hs

    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) (C : AbstractJoinFace A B)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rootedPos_left_projection
statement:
private theorem rootedPos_left_projection
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (F : RootedPos A) (K : RootedPos B) :
    joinFacetProjLeft
        (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)

        (sameSignFacetProduct
          (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)

          (F.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A))

  intro facet hfacet
  rcases K.2.carrier_nonempty with ⟨other, hother⟩

proof:
:= by
  apply hansenJoinFaceEquiv_rootedPos_of_sign_neg
  · rcases F.2.carrier_nonempty with ⟨left, hleft⟩
    rcases K.2.carrier_nonempty with ⟨right, hright⟩
    have hsign : left.1 = right.1 := by
      rw [F.2.facet_sign hleft, K.2.facet_sign hright]
    exact ⟨⟨(left, right), hsign⟩, hleft, hright⟩
  · intro facet hfacet
    exact F.2.facet_sign hfacet.1

theorem joinNeutral_isNeutralOrEmpty
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)

    (joinNeutral A B F K).IsNeutralOrEmpty
proof:
:= by
  rcases F.2.exists_neg_facet with ⟨leftNeg, hleftNeg, hsleftNeg⟩
  rcases K.2.exists_neg_facet with ⟨rightNeg, hrightNeg, hsrightNeg⟩
  rcases F.2.exists_pos_facet with ⟨leftPos, hleftPos, hsleftPos⟩
  rcases K.2.exists_pos_facet with ⟨rightPos, hrightPos, hsrightPos⟩
  let negFacet : SignedJoinFacet
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1) :=
    ⟨(leftNeg, rightNeg), hsleftNeg.trans hsrightNeg.symm⟩
  let posFacet : SignedJoinFacet
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1) :=
    ⟨(leftPos, rightPos), hsleftPos.trans hsrightPos.symm⟩
  apply hansenJoinFaceEquiv_neutral_of_both_signs A B _ negFacet posFacet
  · exact ⟨hleftNeg, hrightNeg⟩
  · exact hsleftNeg
  · exact ⟨hleftPos, hrightPos⟩
  · exact hsleftPos

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinFaceCodeToFace_surjective
statement:
theorem joinFaceCodeToFace_surjective
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    Function.Surjective (joinFaceCodeToFace A B)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro F
  let C : AbstractJoinFace A B := (hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B).symm F
  have hFC : hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B C = F := by
    exact (hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B).apply_symm_apply F
  by_cases hempty : (C : Set (SignedJoinFacet
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1))) = ∅
  · have htop : F = top (A ⊗g B) := by
      rw [← hFC]
      rw [← (hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B).apply_symm_apply (top (A ⊗g B))]
      apply congrArg (hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B)
      apply IncidenceClosedSet.ext
      change C.carrier = (joinFacetLabelEquiv A B).symm ''
        (top (A ⊗g B) : Set (HansenFacetLabel (A ⊗g B)))
      have hempty' : C.carrier = ∅ := hempty
      rw [hempty']
      have htopcarrier :
          (top (A ⊗g B) : Set (HansenFacetLabel (A ⊗g B))) = ∅ := rfl
      rw [htopcarrier, Set.image_empty]
    exact ⟨Sum.inl PUnit.unit, by simp [joinFaceCodeToFace, htop]⟩
  · have hne : (C : Set (SignedJoinFacet
        (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
        (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1))).Nonempty :=
      Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hempty
    by_cases hneg : ∀ facet : SignedJoinFacet
        (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
        (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1),
        facet ∈ (C : Set _) → facet.1.1.1 = HansenSign.neg
    · have hroot := joinFactors_rootedPos_of_sign_neg A B C hne hneg
      refine ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inl
        (⟨joinLeftFactor A B C, hroot.1⟩,
          ⟨joinRightFactor A B C, hroot.2⟩)), ?_⟩
      change joinRootedPos A B
        ⟨joinLeftFactor A B C, hroot.1⟩
        ⟨joinRightFactor A B C, hroot.2⟩ = F
      rw [joinRootedPos_eq_of_factors A B C hroot.1 hroot.2, hFC]
    · by_cases hpos : ∀ facet : SignedJoinFacet
          (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
          (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1),
          facet ∈ (C : Set _) → facet.1.1.1 = HansenSign.pos
      · have hroot := joinFactors_rootedNeg_of_sign_pos A B C hne hpos
        refine ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl
          (⟨joinLeftFactor A B C, hroot.1⟩,
            ⟨joinRightFactor A B C, hroot.2⟩))), ?_⟩
        change joinRootedNeg A B
          ⟨joinLeftFactor A B C, hroot.1⟩
          ⟨joinRightFactor A B C, hroot.2⟩ = F
        rw [joinRootedNeg_eq_of_factors A B C hroot.1 hroot.2, hFC]
      · have hexPos : ∃ facet : SignedJoinFacet
            (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
            (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1),
            facet ∈ (C : Set _) ∧ facet.1.1.1 = HansenSign.pos := by
          push Not at hneg
          rcases hneg with ⟨facet, hfacet, hsign⟩
          refine ⟨facet, hfacet, ?_⟩
          cases hs : facet.1.1.1 with
          | neg => exact False.elim (hsign hs)
          | pos => rfl
        have hexNeg : ∃ facet : SignedJoinFacet
            (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
            (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1),
            facet ∈ (C : Set _) ∧ facet.1.1.1 = HansenSign.neg := by
          push Not at hpos
          rcases hpos with ⟨facet, hfacet, hsign⟩
          refine ⟨facet, hfacet, ?_⟩
          cases hs : facet.1.1.1 with
          | neg => rfl
          | pos => exact False.elim (hsign hs)
        rcases hexNeg with ⟨negFacet, hnegMem, hnegSign⟩
        rcases hexPos with ⟨posFacet, hposMem, hposSign⟩
        have hneutral := joinFactors_neutral_of_both_signs A B C
          negFacet posFacet hnegMem hnegSign hposMem hposSign
        refine ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr
          (⟨joinLeftFactor A B C, hneutral.1⟩,
            ⟨joinRightFactor A B C, hneutral.2⟩))), ?_⟩
        change joinNeutral A B
          ⟨joinLeftFactor A B C, hneutral.1⟩
          ⟨joinRightFactor A B C, hneutral.2⟩ = F
        rw [joinNeutral_eq_of_factors A B C hneutral.1 hneutral.2, hFC]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinRootedPos_pair_injective

:= by

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinRootedPos_ne_top
statement:
private theorem joinRootedPos_ne_top
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (pair : RootedPos A × RootedPos B) :
    joinRootedPos A B pair.1 pair.2 ≠ top (A ⊗g B)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rcases pair.1.2.carrier_nonempty with ⟨left, hleft⟩
  rcases pair.2.2.carrier_nonempty with ⟨right, hright⟩
  have hsign : left.1 = right.1 := by
    rw [pair.1.2.facet_sign hleft, pair.2.2.facet_sign hright]
  let facet : SignedJoinFacet
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1) := ⟨(left, right), hsign⟩
  have hmem : facet ∈
      (signedJoinClosedProduct (hansenLabelIncidence A) (hansenLabelIncidence B)
        pair.1.1 pair.2.1
        (rootedPos_left_projection A B pair.1 pair.2)
        (rootedPos_right_projection A B pair.1 pair.2) : Set _) :=
    ⟨hleft, hright⟩
  have habstract := congrArg (hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B).symm h
  dsimp [joinRootedPos] at habstract
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at habstract
  have hcarrier := congrArg IncidenceClosedSet.carrier habstract
  dsimp [signedJoinClosedProduct] at hcarrier
  have htopcarrier :
      ((hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B).symm (top (A ⊗g B)) : AbstractJoinFace A B).carrier =
        (∅ : Set (SignedJoinFacet
          (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
          (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1))) := by
    change (joinFacetLabelEquiv A B).symm ''
      (top (A ⊗g B) : Set (HansenFacetLabel (A ⊗g B))) = ∅
    have ht : (top (A ⊗g B) : Set (HansenFacetLabel (A ⊗g B))) = ∅ := rfl
    rw [ht, Set.image_empty]
  have : facet ∈ (∅ : Set _) := by
    rw [← htopcarrier, ← hcarrier]
    exact hmem
  exact this.elim

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinRootedPos_ne_joinRootedNeg
statement:
private theorem joinRootedPos_ne_joinRootedNeg
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (posPair : RootedPos A × RootedPos B)
    (negPair : RootedNeg A × RootedNeg B) :
    joinRootedPos A B posPair.1 posPair.2 ≠
      joinRootedNeg A B negPair.1 negPair.2
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have habstract := (hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B).injective h
  have hcarrier := congrArg IncidenceClosedSet.carrier habstract
  dsimp [signedJoinClosedProduct] at hcarrier
  rcases posPair.1.2.carrier_nonempty with ⟨left, hleft⟩
  rcases posPair.2.2.carrier_nonempty with ⟨right, hright⟩
  have hsign : left.1 = right.1 := by
    rw [posPair.1.2.facet_sign hleft, posPair.2.2.facet_sign hright]
  let facet : SignedJoinFacet
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1) := ⟨(left, right), hsign⟩
  have hmemPos : facet ∈ sameSignFacetProduct
      (posPair.1.1 : Set _) (posPair.2.1 : Set _) := ⟨hleft, hright⟩
  have hmemNeg : facet ∈ sameSignFacetProduct
      (negPair.1.1 : Set _) (negPair.2.1 : Set _) := hcarrier ▸ hmemPos
  have hnegSign := negPair.1.2.facet_sign hmemNeg.1
  have hposSign := posPair.1.2.facet_sign hleft
  rw [hposSign] at hnegSign
  exact HansenSign.noConfusion hnegSign

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinRootedPos_ne_joinNeutral
statement:
private theorem joinRootedPos_ne_joinNeutral
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)

  rcases neutralPair.2.2.exists_pos_facet with ⟨right, hright, hsright⟩
  let facet : SignedJoinFacet
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1) := ⟨(left, right), hsleft.trans hsright.symm⟩
  have hmemNeutral : facet ∈ sameSignFacetProduct
      (neutralPair.1.1 : Set _) (neutralPair.2.1 : Set _) := ⟨hleft, hright⟩
  have hmemRoot : facet ∈ sameSignFacetProduct
      (rootPair.1.1 : Set _) (rootPair.2.1 : Set _) := hcarrier.symm ▸ hmemNeutral
  have hrootSign := rootPair.1.2.facet_sign hmemRoot.1
  rw [hsleft] at hrootSign
  exact HansenSign.noConfusion hrootSign
