name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinFaceCodeToFace_injective
statement:
theorem joinFaceCodeToFace_injective
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    Function.Injective (joinFaceCodeToFace A B)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  rcases x with x | x
  · rcases y with y | y
    · rfl
    · rcases y with y | y
      · exact False.elim (joinRootedPos_ne_top A B y h.symm)
      · rcases y with y | y
        · exact False.elim (joinRootedNeg_ne_top A B y h.symm)
        · exact False.elim (joinNeutral_ne_top A B y h.symm)
  · rcases x with x | x
    · rcases y with y | y
      · exact False.elim (joinRootedPos_ne_top A B x h)
      · rcases y with y | y
        · exact congrArg Sum.inr (congrArg Sum.inl
            (joinRootedPos_pair_injective A B h))
        · rcases y with y | y
          · exact False.elim (joinRootedPos_ne_joinRootedNeg A B x y h)
          · exact False.elim (joinRootedPos_ne_joinNeutral A B x y h)
    · rcases x with x | x
      · rcases y with y | y
        · exact False.elim (joinRootedNeg_ne_top A B x h)
        · rcases y with y | y
          · exact False.elim (joinRootedPos_ne_joinRootedNeg A B y x h.symm)
          · rcases y with y | y
            · exact congrArg Sum.inr (congrArg Sum.inr (congrArg Sum.inl
                (joinRootedNeg_pair_injective A B h)))
            · exact False.elim (joinRootedNeg_ne_joinNeutral A B x y h)
      · rcases y with y | y
        · exact False.elim (joinNeutral_ne_top A B x h)
        · rcases y with y | y
          · exact False.elim (joinRootedPos_ne_joinNeutral A B y x h.symm)
          · rcases y with y | y
            · exact False.elim (joinRootedNeg_ne_joinNeutral A B y x h.symm)
            · exact congrArg Sum.inr (congrArg Sum.inr (congrArg Sum.inr
                (joinNeutral_pair_injective A B h)))

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinRootedPosMap_bijective
statement:
theorem joinRootedPosMap_bijective
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    Function.Bijective (joinRootedPosMap A B)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro p q h
    apply joinRootedPos_pair_injective A B
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h
  · intro X
    let code := (joinFaceCodeEquiv A B).symm X.1
    have hrepr : joinFaceCodeToFace A B code = X.1 :=
      (joinFaceCodeEquiv A B).apply_symm_apply X.1
    rcases code with unit | code
    · change top (A ⊗g B) = X.1 at hrepr
      exact False.elim (X.2.ne_top hrepr.symm)
    · rcases code with pair | code
      · exact ⟨pair, Subtype.ext hrepr⟩
      · rcases code with pair | pair
        · change joinRootedNeg A B pair.1 pair.2 = X.1 at hrepr
          exfalso
          apply X.2.not_isRootedNeg
          rw [← hrepr]
          exact joinRootedNeg_isRootedNeg A B pair.1 pair.2
        · change joinNeutral A B pair.1 pair.2 = X.1 at hrepr
          exfalso
          apply X.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty
          rw [← hrepr]
          exact joinNeutral_isNeutralOrEmpty A B pair.1 pair.2

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinNeutralMap_bijective
statement:
theorem joinNeutralMap_bijective
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    Function.Bijective (joinNeutralMap A B)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro p q h
    apply joinNeutral_pair_injective A B
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h
  · intro X
    let code := (joinFaceCodeEquiv A B).symm X.1
    have hrepr : joinFaceCodeToFace A B code = X.1 :=
      (joinFaceCodeEquiv A B).apply_symm_apply X.1
    rcases code with unit | code
    · change top (A ⊗g B) = X.1 at hrepr
      exact False.elim (X.2.ne_top hrepr.symm)
    · rcases code with pair | code
      · change joinRootedPos A B pair.1 pair.2 = X.1 at hrepr
        exfalso
        apply (joinRootedPos_isRootedPos A B pair.1 pair.2).not_isNeutralOrEmpty
        rw [hrepr]
        exact X.2
      · rcases code with pair | pair
        · change joinRootedNeg A B pair.1 pair.2 = X.1 at hrepr
          exfalso
          apply (joinRootedNeg_isRootedNeg A B pair.1 pair.2).not_isNeutralOrEmpty
          rw [hrepr]
          exact X.2
        · exact ⟨pair, Subtype.ext hrepr⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenJoinFaceEquiv_le_iff
statement:
private theorem hansenJoinFaceEquiv_le_iff
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (C D : AbstractJoinFace A B) :
    hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B C ≤ hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B D ↔ C ≤ D
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hansenJoinFaceEquiv] using
    incidenceClosedTransportSurjEquiv_le_iff
      (signedJoinIncidence
        (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
        (signB := fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1)
        (hansenLabelIncidence A) (hansenLabelIncidence B))
      (hansenLabelIncidence (A ⊗g B))
      (joinVertexLabelMap A B) (joinFacetLabelEquiv A B)
      (joinVertexLabelMap_surjective A B)
      (fun vertex facet ↦ hansenLabelIncidence_join_map A B vertex facet) C D

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinRootedPos_le_iff
statement:
theorem joinRootedPos_le_iff
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (F₁ F₂ : RootedPos A) (K₁ K₂ : RootedPos B) :
    joinRootedPos A B F₁ K₁ ≤ joinRootedPos A B F₂ K₂ ↔
      F₁.1 ≤ F₂.1 ∧ K₁.1 ≤ K₂.1
proof:
:= by
  change hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B _ ≤ hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B _ ↔ _
  rw [hansenJoinFaceEquiv_le_iff]
  change sameSignFacetProduct
      (F₂.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) (K₂.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) ⊆
      sameSignFacetProduct
        (F₁.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) (K₁.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) ↔
    (F₂.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) ⊆ (F₁.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) ∧
      (K₂.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) ⊆ (K₁.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B))
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · rw [← rootedPos_left_projection A B F₂ K₂,
          ← rootedPos_left_projection A B F₁ K₁]
      exact Set.image_mono h
    · rw [← rootedPos_right_projection A B F₂ K₂,
          ← rootedPos_right_projection A B F₁ K₁]
      exact Set.image_mono h
  · rintro ⟨hF, hK⟩ facet hfacet
    exact ⟨hF hfacet.1, hK hfacet.2⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinNeutral_le_iff
statement:
theorem joinNeutral_le_iff
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (F₁ F₂ : NeutralOrEmpty A) (K₁ K₂ : NeutralOrEmpty B) :
    joinNeutral A B F₁ K₁ ≤ joinNeutral A B F₂ K₂ ↔
      F₁.1 ≤ F₂.1 ∧ K₁.1 ≤ K₂.1
proof:
:= by
  change hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B _ ≤ hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B _ ↔ _
  rw [hansenJoinFaceEquiv_le_iff]
  change sameSignFacetProduct
      (F₂.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) (K₂.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) ⊆
      sameSignFacetProduct
        (F₁.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) (K₁.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) ↔
    (F₂.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) ⊆ (F₁.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) ∧
      (K₂.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) ⊆ (K₁.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B))
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · rw [← neutral_left_projection A B F₂ K₂,
          ← neutral_left_projection A B F₁ K₁]
      exact Set.image_mono h
    · rw [← neutral_right_projection A B F₂ K₂,
          ← neutral_right_projection A B F₁ K₁]
      exact Set.image_mono h
  · rintro ⟨hF, hK⟩ facet hfacet
    exact ⟨hF hfacet.1, hK hfacet.2⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinNeutral_le_joinRootedPos_iff
statement:
theorem joinNeutral_le_joinRootedPos_iff
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (E : NeutralOrEmpty A) (L : NeutralOrEmpty B)
    (F : RootedPos A) (K : RootedPos B) :
    joinNeutral A B E L ≤ joinRootedPos A B F K ↔
      E.1 ≤ F.1 ∧ L.1 ≤ K.1
proof:
:= by
  change hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B _ ≤ hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B _ ↔ _
  rw [hansenJoinFaceEquiv_le_iff]
  change sameSignFacetProduct
      (F.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) (K.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) ⊆
      sameSignFacetProduct
        (E.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) (L.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) ↔
    (F.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) ⊆ (E.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) ∧
      (K.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) ⊆ (L.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B))
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · rw [← rootedPos_left_projection A B F K,
          ← neutral_left_projection A B E L]
      exact Set.image_mono h
    · rw [← rootedPos_right_projection A B F K,
          ← neutral_right_projection A B E L]
      exact Set.image_mono h
  · rintro ⟨hF, hK⟩ facet hfacet
    exact ⟨hF hfacet.1, hK hfacet.2⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinPortal_covBy_factors
statement:
theorem joinPortal_covBy_factors
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (E : NeutralOrEmpty A) (L : NeutralOrEmpty B)
    (F : RootedPos A) (K : RootedPos B)
    (hportal : joinNeutral A B E L ⋖ joinRootedPos A B F K) :
    E.1 ⋖ F.1 ∧ L.1 ⋖ K.1
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := (joinNeutral_le_joinRootedPos_iff A B E L F K).mp hportal.le
  constructor
  · apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
    · exact lt_of_le_of_ne hcomp.1 (by
        intro hEF
        exact F.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (hEF ▸ E.2))
    · intro X hEX hXF
      rcases F.2.lower_strata hXF with hXpos | hXneutral
      · let Xpos : RootedPos A := ⟨X, hXpos⟩
        have hlower : joinNeutral A B E L ≤ joinRootedPos A B Xpos K :=
          (joinNeutral_le_joinRootedPos_iff A B E L Xpos K).mpr
            ⟨hEX, hcomp.2⟩
        have hupper : joinRootedPos A B Xpos K ≤ joinRootedPos A B F K :=
          (joinRootedPos_le_iff A B Xpos F K K).mpr ⟨hXF, le_rfl⟩
        rcases hportal.eq_or_eq hlower hupper with heq | heq
        · exact False.elim
            (joinRootedPos_ne_joinNeutral A B (Xpos, K) (E, L) heq)
        · have hpairs : (Xpos, K) = (F, K) :=
            joinRootedPos_pair_injective A B heq
          exact Or.inr (by
            simpa only [Xpos] using congrArg
              (fun pair : RootedPos A × RootedPos B ↦ pair.1.1) hpairs)
      · let Xneutral : NeutralOrEmpty A := ⟨X, hXneutral⟩
        have hlower : joinNeutral A B E L ≤ joinNeutral A B Xneutral L :=
          (joinNeutral_le_iff A B E Xneutral L L).mpr ⟨hEX, le_rfl⟩
        have hupper : joinNeutral A B Xneutral L ≤ joinRootedPos A B F K :=
          (joinNeutral_le_joinRootedPos_iff A B Xneutral L F K).mpr
            ⟨hXF, hcomp.2⟩
        rcases hportal.eq_or_eq hlower hupper with heq | heq
        · have hpairs : (Xneutral, L) = (E, L) :=
            joinNeutral_pair_injective A B heq
          exact Or.inl (by
            simpa only [Xneutral] using congrArg
              (fun pair : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B ↦ pair.1.1) hpairs)
        · exact False.elim
            (joinRootedPos_ne_joinNeutral A B (F, K) (Xneutral, L) heq.symm)
  · apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
    · exact lt_of_le_of_ne hcomp.2 (by
        intro hLK
        exact K.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (hLK ▸ L.2))
    · intro X hLX hXK
      rcases K.2.lower_strata hXK with hXpos | hXneutral
      · let Xpos : RootedPos B := ⟨X, hXpos⟩
        have hlower : joinNeutral A B E L ≤ joinRootedPos A B F Xpos :=
          (joinNeutral_le_joinRootedPos_iff A B E L F Xpos).mpr
            ⟨hcomp.1, hLX⟩
        have hupper : joinRootedPos A B F Xpos ≤ joinRootedPos A B F K :=
          (joinRootedPos_le_iff A B F F Xpos K).mpr ⟨le_rfl, hXK⟩
        rcases hportal.eq_or_eq hlower hupper with heq | heq
        · exact False.elim
            (joinRootedPos_ne_joinNeutral A B (F, Xpos) (E, L) heq)
        · have hpairs : (F, Xpos) = (F, K) :=
            joinRootedPos_pair_injective A B heq
          exact Or.inr (by
            simpa only [Xpos] using congrArg
              (fun pair : RootedPos A × RootedPos B ↦ pair.2.1) hpairs)
      · let Xneutral : NeutralOrEmpty B := ⟨X, hXneutral⟩
        have hlower : joinNeutral A B E L ≤ joinNeutral A B E Xneutral :=
          (joinNeutral_le_iff A B E E L Xneutral).mpr ⟨le_rfl, hLX⟩
        have hupper : joinNeutral A B E Xneutral ≤ joinRootedPos A B F K :=
          (joinNeutral_le_joinRootedPos_iff A B E Xneutral F K).mpr
            ⟨hcomp.1, hXK⟩
        rcases hportal.eq_or_eq hlower hupper with heq | heq
        · have hpairs : (E, Xneutral) = (E, L) :=
            joinNeutral_pair_injective A B heq
          exact Or.inl (by
            simpa only [Xneutral] using congrArg
              (fun pair : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B ↦ pair.2.1) hpairs)
        · exact False.elim
            (joinRootedPos_ne_joinNeutral A B (F, K) (E, Xneutral) heq.symm)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinRootedNeg_not_le_joinRootedPos
statement:
private theorem joinRootedNeg_not_le_joinRootedPos
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (N : RootedNeg A) (M : RootedNeg B)
    (F : RootedPos A) (K : RootedPos B) :
    ¬joinRootedNeg A B N M ≤ joinRootedPos A B F K
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  change hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B _ ≤ hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B _ at h
  rw [hansenJoinFaceEquiv_le_iff] at h
  change sameSignFacetProduct
      (F.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) (K.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) ⊆
    sameSignFacetProduct
      (N.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) (M.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) at h
  rcases F.2.carrier_nonempty with ⟨left, hleft⟩
  rcases K.2.carrier_nonempty with ⟨right, hright⟩
  have hsign : left.1 = right.1 := by
    rw [F.2.facet_sign hleft, K.2.facet_sign hright]
  let facet : SignedJoinFacet
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1) := ⟨(left, right), hsign⟩
  have hmemPos : facet ∈ sameSignFacetProduct
      (F.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) (K.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) :=
    ⟨hleft, hright⟩
  have hmemNeg := h hmemPos
  have hnegSign := N.2.facet_sign hmemNeg.1
  have hposSign := F.2.facet_sign hleft
  rw [hposSign] at hnegSign
  exact HansenSign.noConfusion hnegSign

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinPortal_covBy_of_factors
statement:
theorem joinPortal_covBy_of_factors
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (E : NeutralOrEmpty A) (L : NeutralOrEmpty B)
    (F : RootedPos A) (K : RootedPos B)
    (hEF : E.1 ⋖ F.1) (hLK : L.1 ⋖ K.1) :
    joinNeutral A B E L ⋖ joinRootedPos A B F K
proof:
:= by
  apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
  · apply lt_of_le_of_ne
    · exact (joinNeutral_le_joinRootedPos_iff A B E L F K).mpr
        ⟨hEF.le, hLK.le⟩
    · exact (joinRootedPos_ne_joinNeutral A B (F, K) (E, L)).symm
  · intro X hlower hupper
    let code := (joinFaceCodeEquiv A B).symm X
    have hrepr : joinFaceCodeToFace A B code = X :=
      (joinFaceCodeEquiv A B).apply_symm_apply X
    rcases code with unit | code
    · exfalso
      apply joinRootedPos_ne_top A B (F, K)
      apply le_antisymm
      · intro facet hfacet
        exact hfacet.elim
      · have htop_eq : top (A ⊗g B) = X := by
          simpa only [joinFaceCodeToFace] using hrepr
        rw [htop_eq]
        exact hupper
    · rcases code with pair | code
      · rw [← hrepr] at hlower hupper
        have hlower' :=
          (joinNeutral_le_joinRootedPos_iff A B E L pair.1 pair.2).mp hlower
        have hupper' :=
          (joinRootedPos_le_iff A B pair.1 F pair.2 K).mp hupper
        have hleft := hEF.eq_or_eq hlower'.1 hupper'.1
        have hright := hLK.eq_or_eq hlower'.2 hupper'.2
        rcases hleft with hleft | hleft
        · exact False.elim
            (pair.1.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (hleft ▸ E.2))
        · rcases hright with hright | hright
          · exact False.elim
              (pair.2.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (hright ▸ L.2))
          · right
            have hpairs : pair = (F, K) := by
              apply Prod.ext
              · exact Subtype.ext hleft
              · exact Subtype.ext hright
            rw [hpairs] at hrepr
            exact hrepr.symm
      · rcases code with pair | pair
        · rw [← hrepr] at hupper
          exact False.elim
            (joinRootedNeg_not_le_joinRootedPos A B pair.1 pair.2 F K hupper)
        · rw [← hrepr] at hlower hupper
          have hlower' := (joinNeutral_le_iff A B E pair.1 L pair.2).mp hlower
          have hupper' :=
            (joinNeutral_le_joinRootedPos_iff A B pair.1 pair.2 F K).mp hupper
          have hleft := hEF.eq_or_eq hlower'.1 hupper'.1
          have hright := hLK.eq_or_eq hlower'.2 hupper'.2
          rcases hleft with hleft | hleft
          · rcases hright with hright | hright
            · left
              have hpairs : pair = (E, L) := by
                apply Prod.ext
                · exact Subtype.ext hleft
                · exact Subtype.ext hright
              rw [hpairs] at hrepr
              exact hrepr.symm
            · exact False.elim
                (K.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (hright.symm ▸ pair.2.2))
          · exact False.elim
              (F.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (hleft.symm ▸ pair.1.2))

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinPortal_covBy_iff
statement:
theorem joinPortal_covBy_iff
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (E : NeutralOrEmpty A) (L : NeutralOrEmpty B)
    (F : RootedPos A) (K : RootedPos B) :
    joinNeutral A B E L ⋖ joinRootedPos A B F K ↔
      E.1 ⋖ F.1 ∧ L.1 ⋖ K.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact joinPortal_covBy_factors A B E L F K
  · rintro ⟨hEF, hLK⟩
    exact joinPortal_covBy_of_factors A B E L F K hEF hLK

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinPortalMap_bijective
statement:
theorem joinPortalMap_bijective
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    Function.Bijective (joinPortalMap A B)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro p q h
    have hvalues := congrArg Subtype.val h
    have hneutral :
        joinNeutralMap A B (p.1.1.1, p.2.1.1) =
          joinNeutralMap A B (q.1.1.1, q.2.1.1) :=
      congrArg Prod.fst hvalues
    have hpositive :
        joinRootedPosMap A B (p.1.1.2, p.2.1.2) =
          joinRootedPosMap A B (q.1.1.2, q.2.1.2) :=
      congrArg Prod.snd hvalues
    have hneutralFactors := (joinNeutralMap_bijective A B).1 hneutral
    have hpositiveFactors := (joinRootedPosMap_bijective A B).1 hpositive
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply Subtype.ext
      apply Prod.ext
      · exact congrArg
          (fun pair : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B ↦ pair.1)
          hneutralFactors
      · exact congrArg
          (fun pair : RootedPos A × RootedPos B ↦ pair.1)
          hpositiveFactors
    · apply Subtype.ext
      apply Prod.ext
      · exact congrArg
          (fun pair : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B ↦ pair.2)
          hneutralFactors
      · exact congrArg
          (fun pair : RootedPos A × RootedPos B ↦ pair.2)
          hpositiveFactors
  · intro X
    let neutralFactors := (joinNeutralEquiv A B).symm X.1.1
    let positiveFactors := (joinRootedPosEquiv A B).symm X.1.2
    have hneutral : joinNeutralMap A B neutralFactors = X.1.1 :=
      (joinNeutralEquiv A B).apply_symm_apply X.1.1
    have hpositive : joinRootedPosMap A B positiveFactors = X.1.2 :=
      (joinRootedPosEquiv A B).apply_symm_apply X.1.2
    have hcover :
        joinNeutral A B neutralFactors.1 neutralFactors.2 ⋖
          joinRootedPos A B positiveFactors.1 positiveFactors.2 := by
      rw [show joinNeutral A B neutralFactors.1 neutralFactors.2 = X.1.1.1 from
            congrArg Subtype.val hneutral,
          show joinRootedPos A B positiveFactors.1 positiveFactors.2 = X.1.2.1 from
            congrArg Subtype.val hpositive]
      exact X.2
    have hfactors := (joinPortal_covBy_iff A B
      neutralFactors.1 neutralFactors.2 positiveFactors.1 positiveFactors.2).mp hcover
    let leftPortal : HansenPortal A :=
      ⟨(neutralFactors.1, positiveFactors.1), hfactors.1⟩
    let rightPortal : HansenPortal B :=
      ⟨(neutralFactors.2, positiveFactors.2), hfactors.2⟩
    refine ⟨(leftPortal, rightPortal), ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact hneutral
    · exact hpositive

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.compl_ne_top_of_ne_bot
statement:
private theorem compl_ne_top_of_ne_bot
    {X : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph X) (hG : G ≠ ⊥) : Gᶜ ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro htop
  apply hG
  have hc := congrArg (fun H : SimpleGraph X ↦ Hᶜ) htop
  simpa using hc

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.isThreshold_of_hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_one
statement:
theorem isThreshold_of_hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_one
    (hstrict : CotreePortalEndpointStrictness) :
    ∀ T : Cotree, hansenFullFlagRatio T.eval = 1 → T.IsThreshold
proof:
:= by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | leaf =>
      intro _
      trivial
  | compl A ih =>
      intro heq
      apply ih
      change @hansenFullFlagRatio (Vert A) (instFintypeVert A)
        (instDecidableEqVert A) (eval A)ᶜ = 1 at heq
      simpa only [hansenFullFlagRatio_compl] using heq
  | sum A B ihA ihB =>
      intro heq
      let _ : Fintype (Vert A ⊕ Vert B) := instFintypeVert (.sum A B)
      let _ : DecidableEq (Vert A ⊕ Vert B) :=
        instDecidableEqVert (.sum A B)
      change hansenFullFlagRatio (A.eval ⊕g B.eval) = 1 at heq
      have hgeA : 1 ≤ hansenFullFlagRatio A.eval :=
        hansenFullFlagRatio_ge_one A
      have hgeB : 1 ≤ hansenFullFlagRatio B.eval :=
        hansenFullFlagRatio_ge_one B
      have hbot : A.eval = ⊥ ∨ B.eval = ⊥ := by
        by_contra hn
        have hnA : A.eval ≠ ⊥ := fun h ↦ hn (Or.inl h)
        have hnB : B.eval ≠ ⊥ := fun h ↦ hn (Or.inr h)
        have hsA := hstrict (.compl A)
          (compl_ne_top_of_ne_bot A.eval hnA)
        have hsB := hstrict (.compl B)
          (compl_ne_top_of_ne_bot B.eval hnB)
        change HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector A.evalᶜ 0 <
            HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector A.evalᶜ
              (Fintype.card A.Vert) at hsA
        change HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector B.evalᶜ 0 <
            HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector B.evalᶜ
              (Fintype.card B.Vert) at hsB
        have hgt :
            hansenFullFlagRatio A.eval * hansenFullFlagRatio B.eval <
              hansenFullFlagRatio (A.eval ⊕g B.eval) :=
          hansenFullFlagRatio_sum_gt A.eval B.eval
            (uniformFlagCard_eval A) (uniformFlagCard_eval B)
            (portalPolynomialMonotone (.compl A))
            (portalPolynomialMonotone (.compl B)) hsA hsB
        rw [heq] at hgt
        nlinarith
      have hprod :
          hansenFullFlagRatio A.eval * hansenFullFlagRatio B.eval =
            hansenFullFlagRatio (A.eval ⊕g B.eval) :=
        hansenFullFlagRatio_sum_eq_of_eval_eq_bot A B hbot
      have hprodOne :
          hansenFullFlagRatio A.eval * hansenFullFlagRatio B.eval = 1 := by
        rw [hprod, heq]
      have heqA : hansenFullFlagRatio A.eval = 1 := by
        nlinarith
      have heqB : hansenFullFlagRatio B.eval = 1 := by
        nlinarith
      exact ⟨ihA heqA, ihB heqB, hbot⟩

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_one_iff_isThreshold
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_one_iff_isThreshold
    (hstrict : CotreePortalEndpointStrictness) (T : Cotree) :
    hansenFullFlagRatio T.eval = 1 ↔ T.IsThreshold
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact isThreshold_of_hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_one hstrict T
  · exact hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_one_of_isThreshold T

name: HansenCograph.hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_one_iff_fullFlagCount_eq
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_one_iff_fullFlagCount_eq
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    hansenFullFlagRatio G = 1 ↔
      hansenFullFlagCount G =
        2 ^ (Fintype.card V + 1) *
          (Fintype.card V + 1).factorial
proof:
:= by
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) <
      2 ^ (Fintype.card V + 1) *
        ((Fintype.card V + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold hansenFullFlagRatio at h
    have hreal : (hansenFullFlagCount G : ℝ) =
        2 ^ (Fintype.card V + 1) *
          ((Fintype.card V + 1).factorial : ℝ) :=
      (div_eq_one_iff_eq hden.ne').mp h
    exact_mod_cast hreal
  · intro h
    unfold hansenFullFlagRatio
    apply (div_eq_one_iff_eq hden.ne').mpr
    exact_mod_cast h

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.hansenFullFlagCount_eq_iff_isThreshold
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagCount_eq_iff_isThreshold
    (hstrict : CotreePortalEndpointStrictness) (T : Cotree) :
    hansenFullFlagCount T.eval =
        2 ^ (Fintype.card T.Vert + 1) *
          (Fintype.card T.Vert + 1).factorial ↔
      T.IsThreshold
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_one_iff_fullFlagCount_eq]
  exact hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_one_iff_isThreshold hstrict T

name: HansenCograph.hansenFullFlagRatio_iso
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagRatio_iso
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} (e : G ≃g H) :
    hansenFullFlagRatio G = hansenFullFlagRatio H
proof:
:= by
  unfold hansenFullFlagRatio
  rw [hansenFullFlagCount_iso e, Fintype.card_congr e.toEquiv]

name: HansenCograph.hansen_cograph_fullFlagRatio_eq_one_iff_isThresholdGraph
statement:
theorem hansen_cograph_fullFlagRatio_eq_one_iff_isThresholdGraph
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (hstrict : CotreePortalEndpointStrictness)
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : IsCograph G) :
    hansenFullFlagRatio G = 1 ↔ IsThresholdGraph G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    obtain ⟨T, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hG
    have heqT : hansenFullFlagRatio T.eval = 1 := by
      rw [← hansenFullFlagRatio_iso e]
      exact heq
    exact ⟨T, (Cotree.hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_one_iff_isThreshold
      hstrict T).mp heqT, ⟨e⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨T, hT, ⟨e⟩⟩
    rw [hansenFullFlagRatio_iso e]
    exact Cotree.hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_one_of_isThreshold T hT

name: HansenCograph.hansen_cograph_fullFlagCount_eq_iff_isThresholdGraph
statement:
theorem hansen_cograph_fullFlagCount_eq_iff_isThresholdGraph
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (hstrict : CotreePortalEndpointStrictness)
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : IsCograph G) :
    hansenFullFlagCount G =
        2 ^ (Fintype.card V + 1) *
          (Fintype.card V + 1).factorial ↔
      IsThresholdGraph G
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hansenFullFlagRatio_eq_one_iff_fullFlagCount_eq]
  exact hansen_cograph_fullFlagRatio_eq_one_iff_isThresholdGraph
    hstrict G hG

name: HansenCograph.subset_incidenceClosure
statement:
theorem subset_incidenceClosure (inc : V → F → Prop) (T : Set F) :
    T ⊆ incidenceClosure inc T
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf v hv
  exact hv f hf

name: HansenCograph.incidenceModels_incidenceClosure_eq
statement:
theorem incidenceModels_incidenceClosure_eq
    (inc : V → F → Prop) (T : Set F) :
    incidenceModels inc (incidenceClosure inc T) = incidenceModels inc T
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro v hv f hf
    exact hv f (subset_incidenceClosure inc T hf)
  · intro v hv f hf
    exact hf v hv

name: HansenCograph.incidenceClosure_idem
statement:
theorem incidenceClosure_idem (inc : V → F → Prop) (T : Set F) :
    incidenceClosure inc (incidenceClosure inc T) = incidenceClosure inc T
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  change (∀ v ∈ incidenceModels inc (incidenceClosure inc T), inc v f) ↔
    (∀ v ∈ incidenceModels inc T, inc v f)
  rw [incidenceModels_incidenceClosure_eq]

name: HansenCograph.incidenceClosure_mono
statement:
theorem incidenceClosure_mono (inc : V → F → Prop) :
    Monotone (incidenceClosure inc)
proof:
:= by
  intro T U hTU f hf v hv
  apply hf v
  intro g hg
  exact hv g (hTU hg)

name: HansenCograph.incidenceClosure_preimage_equiv
statement:
theorem incidenceClosure_preimage_equiv
    {V' F' : Type*}
    (inc : V → F → Prop) (inc' : V' → F' → Prop)
    (vertexMap : V → V') (facetEquiv : F ≃ F')
    (hvertex : Function.Surjective vertexMap)
    (hinc : ∀ v f, inc' (vertexMap v) (facetEquiv f) ↔ inc v f)
    (T : Set F) :
    facetEquiv ⁻¹' incidenceClosure inc' (facetEquiv '' T) =
      incidenceClosure inc T
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  constructor
  · intro hf v hv
    apply (hinc v f).mp
    apply hf (vertexMap v)
    intro f' hf'
    rcases hf' with ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    exact (hinc v g).mpr (hv g hg)
  · intro hf v' hv'
    rcases hvertex v' with ⟨v, rfl⟩
    apply (hinc v f).mpr
    apply hf v
    intro g hg
    apply (hinc v g).mp
    exact hv' (facetEquiv g) ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩

name: HansenCograph.incidenceClosedDual_carrier
statement:
@[simp] theorem incidenceClosedDual_carrier (inc : V → F → Prop)
    (C : IncidenceClosedSet inc) :
    (incidenceClosedDual inc C : Set V) = incidenceModels inc C
proof: := rfl

name: HansenCograph.incidenceClosedTransportSurjEquiv_models
statement:
theorem incidenceClosedTransportSurjEquiv_models
    {V' F' : Type*} (inc : V → F → Prop) (inc' : V' → F' → Prop)
    (vertexMap : V → V') (facetEquiv : F ≃ F')
    (hvertex : Function.Surjective vertexMap)
    (hinc : ∀ v f, inc' (vertexMap v) (facetEquiv f) ↔ inc v f)
    (C : IncidenceClosedSet inc) (vertex : V) :
    vertexMap vertex ∈ incidenceModels inc'
        (incidenceClosedTransportSurjEquiv inc inc' vertexMap facetEquiv
          hvertex hinc C) ↔
      vertex ∈ incidenceModels inc C
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h f hf
    exact (hinc vertex f).mp (h (facetEquiv f) ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩)
  · intro h f' hf'
    rcases hf' with ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    exact (hinc vertex f).mpr (h f hf)

name: HansenCograph.incidenceClosedTransportSurjEquiv_le_iff
statement:
theorem incidenceClosedTransportSurjEquiv_le_iff
    {V' F' : Type*} (inc : V → F → Prop) (inc' : V' → F' → Prop)
    (vertexMap : V → V') (facetEquiv : F ≃ F')
    (hvertex : Function.Surjective vertexMap)
    (hinc : ∀ v f, inc' (vertexMap v) (facetEquiv f) ↔ inc v f)
    (C D : IncidenceClosedSet inc) :
    incidenceClosedTransportSurjEquiv inc inc' vertexMap facetEquiv
        hvertex hinc C ≤
      incidenceClosedTransportSurjEquiv inc inc' vertexMap facetEquiv
        hvertex hinc D ↔
      C ≤ D
proof:
:= by
  change facetEquiv '' (D : Set F) ⊆ facetEquiv '' (C : Set F) ↔
    (D : Set F) ⊆ C
  constructor
  · intro h facet hfacet
    have himage := h ⟨facet, hfacet, rfl⟩
    rcases himage with ⟨original, horiginal, heq⟩
    exact facetEquiv.injective heq ▸ horiginal
  · intro h facet hfacet
    rcases hfacet with ⟨original, horiginal, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨original, h horiginal, rfl⟩

name: HansenCograph.incidenceClosedTransportEquiv_le_iff
statement:
theorem incidenceClosedTransportEquiv_le_iff
    {V' F' : Type*} (inc : V → F → Prop) (inc' : V' → F' → Prop)
    (vertexEquiv : V ≃ V') (facetEquiv : F ≃ F')
    (hinc : ∀ v f, inc' (vertexEquiv v) (facetEquiv f) ↔ inc v f)
    (C D : IncidenceClosedSet inc) :
    incidenceClosedTransportEquiv inc inc' vertexEquiv facetEquiv hinc C ≤
        incidenceClosedTransportEquiv inc inc' vertexEquiv facetEquiv hinc D ↔
      C ≤ D
proof:
:=
  incidenceClosedTransportSurjEquiv_le_iff inc inc' vertexEquiv facetEquiv
    vertexEquiv.surjective hinc C D

name: HansenCograph.incidenceClosedDual_le_iff
statement:
theorem incidenceClosedDual_le_iff (inc : V → F → Prop)
    (C D : IncidenceClosedSet inc) :
    incidenceClosedDual inc C ≤ incidenceClosedDual inc D ↔ D ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  change incidenceModels inc D ⊆ incidenceModels inc C ↔
    (C : Set F) ⊆ D
  constructor
  · intro h facet hfacet
    change facet ∈ D.carrier
    rw [← D.isClosed]
    intro vertex hmodelD
    exact h hmodelD facet hfacet
  · intro h vertex hmodelD facet hfacetC
    exact hmodelD facet (h hfacetC)

name: HansenCograph.incidenceClosedHull_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem incidenceClosedHull_coe (inc : V → F → Prop) (T : Set F) :
    (incidenceClosedHull inc T : Set F) = incidenceClosure inc T
proof: := rfl

name: HansenCograph.joinFacetProjLeft_sameSignFacetProduct_eq
statement:
theorem joinFacetProjLeft_sameSignFacetProduct_eq
    {signA : FA → Sgn} {signB : FB → Sgn}
    (A : Set FA) (B : Set FB)
    (hmatch : ∀ a ∈ A, ∃ b ∈ B, signA a = signB b) :
    joinFacetProjLeft (signA := signA) (signB := signB)
      (sameSignFacetProduct (signA := signA) (signB := signB) A B) = A
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    exact hj.1
  · intro ha
    rcases hmatch a ha with ⟨b, hb, hab⟩
    exact ⟨⟨(a, b), hab⟩, ⟨ha, hb⟩, rfl⟩

name: HansenCograph.joinFacetProjRight_sameSignFacetProduct_eq
statement:
theorem joinFacetProjRight_sameSignFacetProduct_eq
    {signA : FA → Sgn} {signB : FB → Sgn}
    (A : Set FA) (B : Set FB)
    (hmatch : ∀ b ∈ B, ∃ a ∈ A, signA a = signB b) :
    joinFacetProjRight (signA := signA) (signB := signB)
      (sameSignFacetProduct (signA := signA) (signB := signB) A B) = B
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    exact hj.2
  · intro hb
    rcases hmatch b hb with ⟨a, ha, hab⟩
    exact ⟨⟨(a, b), hab⟩, ⟨ha, hb⟩, rfl⟩

name: HansenCograph.mem_join_models_inl_iff
statement:
theorem mem_join_models_inl_iff
    (incA : VA → FA → Prop) (incB : VB → FB → Prop)
    {signA : FA → Sgn} {signB : FB → Sgn}
    (T : Set (SignedJoinFacet signA signB)) (v : VA) :
    Sum.inl v ∈ incidenceModels (signedJoinIncidence incA incB) T ↔
      v ∈ incidenceModels incA (joinFacetProjLeft T)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hv f hf
    rcases hf with ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    exact hv j hj
  · intro hv j hj
    exact hv j.1.1 ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩

name: HansenCograph.mem_join_models_inr_iff
statement:
theorem mem_join_models_inr_iff
    (incA : VA → FA → Prop) (incB : VB → FB → Prop)
    {signA : FA → Sgn} {signB : FB → Sgn}
    (T : Set (SignedJoinFacet signA signB)) (v : VB) :
    Sum.inr v ∈ incidenceModels (signedJoinIncidence incA incB) T ↔
      v ∈ incidenceModels incB (joinFacetProjRight T)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hv f hf
    rcases hf with ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    exact hv j hj
  · intro hv j hj
    exact hv j.1.2 ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩

name: HansenCograph.signedJoin_models_nonempty_iff
statement:
theorem signedJoin_models_nonempty_iff
    (incA : VA → FA → Prop) (incB : VB → FB → Prop)
    {signA : FA → Sgn} {signB : FB → Sgn}
    (T : Set (SignedJoinFacet signA signB)) :
    (incidenceModels (signedJoinIncidence incA incB) T).Nonempty ↔
      (incidenceModels incA (joinFacetProjLeft T)).Nonempty ∨
        (incidenceModels incB (joinFacetProjRight T)).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
    cases v with
    | inl v => exact Or.inl ⟨v, (mem_join_models_inl_iff incA incB T v).mp hv⟩
    | inr v => exact Or.inr ⟨v, (mem_join_models_inr_iff incA incB T v).mp hv⟩
  · rintro (hA | hB)
    · rcases hA with ⟨v, hv⟩
      exact ⟨Sum.inl v, (mem_join_models_inl_iff incA incB T v).mpr hv⟩
    · rcases hB with ⟨v, hv⟩
      exact ⟨Sum.inr v, (mem_join_models_inr_iff incA incB T v).mpr hv⟩

name: HansenCograph.joinFacetClosure_eq
statement:
theorem joinFacetClosure_eq
    (incA : VA → FA → Prop) (incB : VB → FB → Prop)
    {signA : FA → Sgn} {signB : FB → Sgn}
    (T : Set (SignedJoinFacet signA signB)) :
    incidenceClosure (signedJoinIncidence incA incB) T =
      sameSignFacetProduct
        (incidenceClosure incA (joinFacetProjLeft T))
        (incidenceClosure incB (joinFacetProjRight T))
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  constructor
  · intro hj
    constructor
    · intro v hv
      exact hj (Sum.inl v) ((mem_join_models_inl_iff incA incB T v).mpr hv)
    · intro v hv
      exact hj (Sum.inr v) ((mem_join_models_inr_iff incA incB T v).mpr hv)
  · rintro ⟨hA, hB⟩ v hv
    cases v with
    | inl v =>
        exact hA v ((mem_join_models_inl_iff incA incB T v).mp hv)
    | inr v =>
      exact hB v ((mem_join_models_inr_iff incA incB T v).mp hv)

name: HansenCograph.signedJoinClosed_eq_product_factors
statement:
theorem signedJoinClosed_eq_product_factors
    (incA : VA → FA → Prop) (incB : VB → FB → Prop)
    {signA : FA → Sgn} {signB : FB → Sgn}
    (C : IncidenceClosedSet
      (signedJoinIncidence (signA := signA) (signB := signB) incA incB)) :
    (C : Set (SignedJoinFacet signA signB)) =
      sameSignFacetProduct
        (signedJoinLeftFactor incA incB C : Set FA)
        (signedJoinRightFactor incA incB C : Set FB)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (C : Set (SignedJoinFacet signA signB)) =
        incidenceClosure
          (signedJoinIncidence (signA := signA) (signB := signB) incA incB) C :=
      C.isClosed.symm
    _ = sameSignFacetProduct
          (incidenceClosure incA
            (joinFacetProjLeft (signA := signA) (signB := signB) C))
          (incidenceClosure incB
            (joinFacetProjRight (signA := signA) (signB := signB) C)) :=
      joinFacetClosure_eq (signA := signA) (signB := signB) incA incB C
    _ = sameSignFacetProduct
          (signedJoinLeftFactor incA incB C : Set FA)
          (signedJoinRightFactor incA incB C : Set FB) := rfl

name: HansenCograph.Flag.prod_card_eq_of_card
statement:
theorem prod_card_eq_of_card
    {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}
    [LinearOrder P] [Finite P] [Nonempty P]
    [LinearOrder Q] [Finite Q] [Nonempty Q]
    (s : Flag (P × Q)) {n m : ℕ}
    (hP : Nat.card P = n + 1) (hQ : Nat.card Q = m + 1) :
    Nat.card s = n + m + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : Fintype P := Fintype.ofFinite P
  let _ : Fintype Q := Fintype.ofFinite Q
  let _ : BoundedOrder P := Fintype.toBoundedOrder P
  let _ : BoundedOrder Q := Fintype.toBoundedOrder Q
  let _ : Fintype s := Fintype.ofFinite s
  let _ : Nonempty s := ⟨⟨⊥, Flag.bot_mem s⟩⟩
  let t := Nat.card s - 1
  have hspos : 0 < Nat.card s := Nat.card_pos
  have hs : Nat.card s = t + 1 := by
    dsimp [t]
    omega
  have hs' : Fintype.card s = t + 1 := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hs
  have hP' : Fintype.card P = n + 1 := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hP
  have hQ' : Fintype.card Q = m + 1 := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hQ
  let e : Fin (t + 1) ≃o s := Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq s hs'
  let eP : Fin (n + 1) ≃o P := Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq P hP'
  let eQ : Fin (m + 1) ≃o Q := Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq Q hQ'
  let rank : Fin (t + 1) → ℕ := fun k ↦
    (eP.symm (e k).1.1).1 + (eQ.symm (e k).1.2).1
  have rank_zero : rank 0 = 0 := by
    have he0 : (e (0 : Fin (t + 1))).1 = (⊥ : P × Q) :=
      congrArg Subtype.val e.map_bot
    have hP0 : eP.symm (⊥ : P) = (0 : Fin (n + 1)) := eP.symm.map_bot
    have hQ0 : eQ.symm (⊥ : Q) = (0 : Fin (m + 1)) := eQ.symm.map_bot
    rw [show rank 0 =
      (eP.symm (e 0).1.1).1 + (eQ.symm (e 0).1.2).1 by rfl,
      he0]
    change (eP.symm (⊥ : P)).1 + (eQ.symm (⊥ : Q)).1 = 0
    rw [hP0, hQ0]
    rfl
  have rank_succ (k : Fin t) :
      rank k.succ = rank k.castSucc + 1 := by
    have hkFin : (k.castSucc : Fin (t + 1)) ⋖ k.succ := by
      rw [Fin.covBy_iff, Nat.covBy_iff_add_one_eq]
      rfl
    have hkSub : e k.castSucc ⋖ e k.succ :=
      (apply_covBy_apply_iff e).mpr hkFin
    have hk : (e k.castSucc).1 ⋖ (e k.succ).1 :=
      Flag.coe_covBy_coe.mpr hkSub
    rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hk with hkP | hkQ
    · have hcov : eP.symm (e k.castSucc).1.1 ⋖
          eP.symm (e k.succ).1.1 :=
        (apply_covBy_apply_iff eP.symm).mpr hkP.1
      have hstep := Nat.covBy_iff_add_one_eq.mp (Fin.covBy_iff.mp hcov)
      have heq := congrArg (fun q ↦ (eQ.symm q).1) hkP.2
      dsimp [rank]
      omega
    · have hcov : eQ.symm (e k.castSucc).1.2 ⋖
          eQ.symm (e k.succ).1.2 :=
        (apply_covBy_apply_iff eQ.symm).mpr hkQ.1
      have hstep := Nat.covBy_iff_add_one_eq.mp (Fin.covBy_iff.mp hcov)
      have heq := congrArg (fun p ↦ (eP.symm p).1) hkQ.2
      dsimp [rank]
      omega
  have rank_eq_val (k : Fin (t + 1)) : rank k = k.1 := by
    induction k using Fin.induction with
    | zero => exact rank_zero
    | succ k ih =>
        rw [rank_succ k, ih]
        rfl
  have rank_last : rank (Fin.last t) = n + m := by
    have helast : (e (Fin.last t)).1 = (⊤ : P × Q) :=
      congrArg Subtype.val e.map_top
    have hPtop : eP.symm (⊤ : P) = Fin.last n := eP.symm.map_top
    have hQtop : eQ.symm (⊤ : Q) = Fin.last m := eQ.symm.map_top
    rw [show rank (Fin.last t) =
      (eP.symm (e (Fin.last t)).1.1).1 +
        (eQ.symm (e (Fin.last t)).1.2).1 by rfl,
      helast]
    change (eP.symm (⊤ : P)).1 + (eQ.symm (⊤ : Q)).1 = n + m
    rw [hPtop, hQtop]
    rfl
  have ht : t = n + m := by
    have h := rank_eq_val (Fin.last t)
    rw [rank_last] at h
    simpa using h.symm
  omega

name: HansenCograph.Flag.prod_card_eq
statement:
theorem prod_card_eq
    {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}
    [LinearOrder P] [Finite P] [Nonempty P]
    [LinearOrder Q] [Finite Q] [Nonempty Q]
    (s : Flag (P × Q)) :
    Nat.card s = Nat.card P + Nat.card Q - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hPpos : 0 < Nat.card P := Nat.card_pos
  have hQpos : 0 < Nat.card Q := Nat.card_pos
  have h := prod_card_eq_of_card s
    (n := Nat.card P - 1) (m := Nat.card Q - 1)
    (by omega) (by omega)
  omega

name: HansenCograph.portalPolynomial_continuous
statement:
theorem portalPolynomial_continuous (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    Continuous (portalPolynomial n a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold portalPolynomial
  fun_prop

name: HansenCograph.portalPolynomial_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem portalPolynomial_zero (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    portalPolynomial n a 0 = a 0 / (n.factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold portalPolynomial
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simp
  · intro k hk hk0
    have hkpos : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk0
    simp [zero_pow hkpos.ne']
  · simp

name: HansenCograph.portalPolynomial_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem portalPolynomial_one (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    portalPolynomial n a 1 = a n / (n.factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold portalPolynomial
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single n]
  · simp
  · intro k hk hkn
    have hkle : k ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
    have hsubpos : 0 < n - k := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_ne hkle hkn)
    simp [zero_pow hsubpos.ne']
  · simp

name: HansenCograph.portalPolynomial_zero_lt_one_iff
statement:
theorem portalPolynomial_zero_lt_one_iff (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    portalPolynomial n a 0 < portalPolynomial n a 1 ↔ a 0 < a n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [portalPolynomial_zero, portalPolynomial_one]
  exact div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right (by positivity)

name: HansenCograph.sum_range_diag
statement:
private theorem sum_range_diag
    (n m : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1),
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        if k + l = s then F s k l else 0) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), F (k + l) k l
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro l hl
  have hk' : k ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
  have hl' : l ≤ m := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)
  have hmem : k + l ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1) :=
    Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (k + l)]
  · simp
  · intro s hs hsne
    simp [Ne.symm hsne]
  · intro hnot
    exact False.elim (hnot hmem)

name: HansenCograph.portalPolynomial_convolution_expand
statement:
theorem portalPolynomial_convolution_expand
    (n m : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    portalPolynomial (n + m) (portalShuffleConvolution n m a b) x =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        (a k / ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ((n - k).factorial : ℝ))) *
          (b l / ((l.factorial : ℝ) * ((m - l).factorial : ℝ))) *
            x ^ (k + l) * (1 - x) ^ ((n - k) + (m - l))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold portalPolynomial
  calc
    (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1),
        portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s /
            ((s.factorial : ℝ) * ((n + m - s).factorial : ℝ)) *
          x ^ s * (1 - x) ^ (n + m - s)) =
        ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1),
          (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
            if k + l = s then
              (a k / ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ((n - k).factorial : ℝ))) *
                (b l / ((l.factorial : ℝ) * ((m - l).factorial : ℝ)))
            else 0) * x ^ s * (1 - x) ^ (n + m - s) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s hs
      rw [portalShuffleConvolution_factorial_normalized]
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        (a k / ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ((n - k).factorial : ℝ))) *
          (b l / ((l.factorial : ℝ) * ((m - l).factorial : ℝ))) *
            x ^ (k + l) * (1 - x) ^ (n + m - (k + l)) := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + m + 1),
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
              if k + l = s then
                (a k / ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ((n - k).factorial : ℝ))) *
                  (b l / ((l.factorial : ℝ) * ((m - l).factorial : ℝ))) *
                    x ^ s * (1 - x) ^ (n + m - s)
              else 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro s hs
          conv_lhs => rw [mul_assoc]
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro k hk
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro l hl
          by_cases h : k + l = s <;> simp [h, mul_assoc]
        _ = _ := sum_range_diag n m (fun s k l ↦
          (a k / ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ((n - k).factorial : ℝ))) *
            (b l / ((l.factorial : ℝ) * ((m - l).factorial : ℝ))) *
              x ^ s * (1 - x) ^ (n + m - s))
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l hl
      have hk' : k ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
      have hl' : l ≤ m := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)
      have hsub : n + m - (k + l) = (n - k) + (m - l) := by omega
      rw [hsub]

name: HansenCograph.portalPolynomial_convolution
statement:
theorem portalPolynomial_convolution
    (n m : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    portalPolynomial (n + m) (portalShuffleConvolution n m a b) x =
      portalPolynomial n a x * portalPolynomial m b x
proof:
:= by
  rw [portalPolynomial_convolution_expand]
  unfold portalPolynomial
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro l hl
  have hk' : k ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
  have hl' : l ≤ m := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)
  rw [pow_add, pow_add]
  ring

name: HansenCograph.Flag.mem_dropWithTop
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_dropWithTop (s : Flag (WithTop P)) (x : P) :

name: HansenCograph.Flag.coe_mem_addWithTop
statement:

@[simp] theorem top_mem_addWithTop (s : Flag P) :

name: HansenCograph.portalPolynomial_monovary
statement:
theorem portalPolynomial_monovary
    {n m : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha : MonotoneOn (portalPolynomial n a) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hb : MonotoneOn (portalPolynomial m b) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) :
    MonovaryOnUnit (portalPolynomial n a) (portalPolynomial m b)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy
  rcases le_total x y with hxy | hyx
  · exact mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos
      (sub_nonpos.mpr (ha hx hy hxy)) (sub_nonpos.mpr (hb hx hy hxy))
  · exact mul_nonneg
      (sub_nonneg.mpr (ha hy hx hyx)) (sub_nonneg.mpr (hb hy hx hyx))

name: HansenCograph.portalPolynomial_convolution_integral_ge
statement:
theorem portalPolynomial_convolution_integral_ge
    {n m : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha : MonotoneOn (portalPolynomial n a) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hb : MonotoneOn (portalPolynomial m b) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, portalPolynomial n a x) *
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, portalPolynomial m b x) ≤
      ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        portalPolynomial (n + m) (portalShuffleConvolution n m a b) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x hx ↦
    portalPolynomial_convolution n m a b x)]
  exact integral_mul_ge_mul_integral_of_monovary
    (portalPolynomial_continuous n a).continuousOn
    (portalPolynomial_continuous m b).continuousOn
    (portalPolynomial_monovary ha hb)

name: HansenCograph.portalPolynomial_convolution_integral_gt
statement:
theorem portalPolynomial_convolution_integral_gt
    {n m : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha : MonotoneOn (portalPolynomial n a) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hb : MonotoneOn (portalPolynomial m b) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (ha_strict : portalPolynomial n a 0 < portalPolynomial n a 1)
    (hb_strict : portalPolynomial m b 0 < portalPolynomial m b 1) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, portalPolynomial n a x) *
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, portalPolynomial m b x) <
      ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        portalPolynomial (n + m) (portalShuffleConvolution n m a b) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x hx ↦
    portalPolynomial_convolution n m a b x)]
  apply integral_mul_gt_mul_integral_of_strict_monovary
    (portalPolynomial_continuous n a).continuousOn
    (portalPolynomial_continuous m b).continuousOn
    (portalPolynomial_monovary ha hb)
  refine ⟨1, 0, by simp, by simp, ?_⟩
  exact mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr ha_strict) (sub_pos.mpr hb_strict)

name: HansenCograph.cliqueFunctional_indicator
statement:
theorem cliqueFunctional_indicator (c s : Finset V) :
    cliqueFunctional c (indicator s) = ((c ∩ s).card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [cliqueFunctional, indicator]

name: HansenCograph.cliqueFunctional_neg_indicator
statement:
theorem cliqueFunctional_neg_indicator (c s : Finset V) :
    cliqueFunctional c (-indicator s) = -((c ∩ s).card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show cliqueFunctional c (-indicator s) = -cliqueFunctional c (indicator s) by
    simp [cliqueFunctional]]
  rw [cliqueFunctional_indicator]

name: HansenCograph.cliqueFunctional_signed_layers_of_inter_nonempty
statement:
theorem cliqueFunctional_signed_layers_of_inter_nonempty
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (c s : Finset V)
    (hc : G.IsClique (↑c : Set V))
    (hs : G.IsIndepSet (↑s : Set V))
    (hcs : (c ∩ s).Nonempty) :
    cliqueFunctional c (indicator s) = 1 ∧
      cliqueFunctional c (-indicator s) = -1
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (c ∩ s).card ≤ 1 := by
    rw [Finset.card_le_one]
    intro u hu v hv
    by_contra huv
    have hu' := Finset.mem_inter.mp hu
    have hv' := Finset.mem_inter.mp hv
    exact (hs hu'.2 hv'.2 huv) (hc hu'.1 hv'.1 huv)
  have hpos : 0 < (c ∩ s).card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hcs
  have hcard : (c ∩ s).card = 1 := by omega
  constructor
  · rw [cliqueFunctional_indicator]
    exact_mod_cast hcard
  · rw [cliqueFunctional_neg_indicator]
    have hcardInt : ((c ∩ s).card : ℤ) = 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast hcard
    exact_mod_cast congrArg Neg.neg hcardInt

name: HansenCograph.cliqueFacetFunctional_signedStableLayerPoint
statement:
theorem cliqueFacetFunctional_signedStableLayerPoint (ε : ℝ) (c s : Finset V) :
    cliqueFacetFunctional c (signedStableLayerPoint ε s) =
      ε * (-1 + 2 * ((c ∩ s).card : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  change -ε + 2 * (∑ v ∈ c, ε * indicator s v) =
    ε * (-1 + 2 * ((c ∩ s).card : ℝ))
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [show (∑ v ∈ c, indicator s v) = ((c ∩ s).card : ℝ) from
    cliqueFunctional_indicator c s]
  ring

name: HansenCograph.cliqueFacetFunctional_eq_sign_of_inter_nonempty
statement:
theorem cliqueFacetFunctional_eq_sign_of_inter_nonempty
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (ε : ℝ) (c s : Finset V)
    (hc : G.IsClique (↑c : Set V))
    (hs : G.IsIndepSet (↑s : Set V))
    (hcs : (c ∩ s).Nonempty) :
    cliqueFacetFunctional c (signedStableLayerPoint ε s) = ε
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : (c ∩ s).card = 1 := by
    have hpos : 0 < (c ∩ s).card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hcs
    have hle : (c ∩ s).card ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.card_le_one]
      intro u hu v hv
      by_contra huv
      have hu' := Finset.mem_inter.mp hu
      have hv' := Finset.mem_inter.mp hv
      exact (hs hu'.2 hv'.2 huv) (hc hu'.1 hv'.1 huv)
    omega
  rw [cliqueFacetFunctional_signedStableLayerPoint, hcard]
  norm_num

name: HansenCograph.cliqueFacetFunctional_eq_neg_sign_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem cliqueFacetFunctional_eq_neg_sign_of_disjoint
    (ε : ℝ) (c s : Finset V) (hcs : Disjoint c s) :
    cliqueFacetFunctional c (signedStableLayerPoint ε s) = -ε
proof:
:= by
  rw [cliqueFacetFunctional_signedStableLayerPoint]
  have hinter : c ∩ s = ∅ := Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp hcs
  simp [hinter]

name: HansenCograph.cliqueFacetFunctional_eq_iff
statement:
theorem cliqueFacetFunctional_eq_iff
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (ε δ : ℝ) (c s : Finset V)
    (hc : G.IsClique (↑c : Set V))
    (hs : G.IsIndepSet (↑s : Set V)) :
    cliqueFacetFunctional c (signedStableLayerPoint ε s) = δ ↔
      (δ = ε ∧ (c ∩ s).Nonempty) ∨ (δ = -ε ∧ Disjoint c s)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Finset.disjoint_or_nonempty_inter c s with hdis | hnonempty
  · rw [cliqueFacetFunctional_eq_neg_sign_of_disjoint ε c s hdis]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact Or.inr ⟨h.symm, hdis⟩
    · rintro (⟨_, hne⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩)
      · exact False.elim (hne.not_disjoint hdis)
      · exact h.symm
  · rw [cliqueFacetFunctional_eq_sign_of_inter_nonempty G ε c s hc hs hnonempty]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact Or.inl ⟨h.symm, hnonempty⟩
    · rintro (⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨_, hdis⟩)
      · exact h.symm
      · exact False.elim (hnonempty.not_disjoint hdis)

name: HansenCograph.portalShuffleConvolution_domination
statement:
theorem portalShuffleConvolution_domination
    {n m : ℕ} {a a' b b' : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha0 : ∀ k < n + 1, 0 ≤ a k)
    (hb0 : ∀ l < m + 1, 0 ≤ b l)
    (haa' : ∀ k < n + 1, a k ≤ a' k)
    (hbb' : ∀ l < m + 1, b l ≤ b' l) :
    ∀ s : ℕ,
      portalShuffleConvolution n m a b s ≤
        portalShuffleConvolution n m a' b' s
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  exact portalShuffleConvolution_le ha0 hb0 haa' hbb' s

name: HansenCograph.hansenGenerators_subset_hansen
statement:
theorem hansenGenerators_subset_hansen (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    hansenGenerators G ⊆ hansen G
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨⟨sign, ⟨s, hs⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  apply subset_convexHull ℝ
  cases sign with
  | pos =>
      left
      have hi : indicator s ∈ stab G :=
        subset_convexHull ℝ (stableIndicators G)
          (show indicator s ∈ stableIndicators G from ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩)
      exact ⟨indicator s, hi, by
        simp [HansenVertexLabel.point, signedStableLayerPoint, HansenSign.real]⟩
  | neg =>
      right
      have hi : indicator s ∈ stab G :=
        subset_convexHull ℝ (stableIndicators G)
          (show indicator s ∈ stableIndicators G from ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩)
      exact ⟨indicator s, hi, by
        simp [HansenVertexLabel.point, signedStableLayerPoint, HansenSign.real]⟩

name: HansenCograph.top_stab_image_subset_generatorHull
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  change p ∈ {q : V → ℝ | ((1 : ℝ), q) ∈ convexHull ℝ (hansenGenerators G)}
  apply (convexHull_min ?_ ?_) hp
  · rintro q ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    apply subset_convexHull ℝ
    exact ⟨⟨HansenSign.pos, ⟨s, hs⟩⟩, by
      simp [HansenVertexLabel.point, signedStableLayerPoint, HansenSign.real]⟩
  · intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    have h := (convex_convexHull ℝ (hansenGenerators G)) hx hy ha hb hab
    change ((1 : ℝ), a • x + b • y) ∈ convexHull ℝ (hansenGenerators G)
    have heq : ((1 : ℝ), a • x + b • y) =
        a • ((1 : ℝ), x) + b • ((1 : ℝ), y) := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · dsimp
        linarith
      · rfl
    rw [heq]
    exact h

name: HansenCograph.bottom_stab_image_subset_generatorHull
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  change p ∈ {q : V → ℝ | ((-1 : ℝ), -q) ∈ convexHull ℝ (hansenGenerators G)}
  apply (convexHull_min ?_ ?_) hp
  · rintro q ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    apply subset_convexHull ℝ
    exact ⟨⟨HansenSign.neg, ⟨s, hs⟩⟩, by
      simp [HansenVertexLabel.point, signedStableLayerPoint, HansenSign.real]⟩
  · intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    have h := (convex_convexHull ℝ (hansenGenerators G)) hx hy ha hb hab
    change ((-1 : ℝ), -(a • x + b • y)) ∈ convexHull ℝ (hansenGenerators G)
    have heq : ((-1 : ℝ), -(a • x + b • y)) =
        a • ((-1 : ℝ), -x) + b • ((-1 : ℝ), -y) := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · dsimp
        linarith
      · funext v
        dsimp
        ring
    rw [heq]
    exact h

name: HansenCograph.hansen_eq_convexHull_generators
statement:
theorem hansen_eq_convexHull_generators (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    hansen G = convexHull ℝ (hansenGenerators G)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · unfold hansen
    apply convexHull_min
    · exact union_subset (top_stab_image_subset_generatorHull G)
        (bottom_stab_image_subset_generatorHull G)
    · exact convex_convexHull ℝ _
  · apply convexHull_min
    · exact hansenGenerators_subset_hansen G
    · exact convex_hansen G

name: HansenCograph.cliqueFacetCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cliqueFacetCLM_apply (c : Finset V) (x : ℝ × (V → ℝ)) :
    cliqueFacetCLM c x = cliqueFacetFunctional c x
proof: := rfl

name: HansenCograph.hansenFacetFace_isExposed
statement:
theorem hansenFacetFace_isExposed (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (facet : HansenFacetLabel G) :
    IsExposed ℝ (hansen G) (hansenFacetFace G facet)
proof:
:= by
  intro hface
  rcases hface with ⟨w, hwG, hw⟩
  rcases facet with ⟨sign, ⟨c, hc⟩⟩
  cases sign with
  | pos =>
      refine ⟨cliqueFacetCLM c, Set.ext fun x ↦ ?_⟩
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hxG, hx⟩
        exact ⟨hxG, fun y hyG ↦ by
          have hy := (cliqueFacetFunctional_bounds_on_hansen G c hc hyG).2
          simpa [HansenFacetLabel.value, HansenSign.real,
            cliqueFacetCLM_apply] using hy.trans_eq hx.symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨hxG, hxmax⟩
        have hxUpper := (cliqueFacetFunctional_bounds_on_hansen G c hc hxG).2
        have hxLower : 1 ≤ cliqueFacetFunctional c x := by
          have := hxmax w hwG
          simpa [HansenFacetLabel.value, HansenSign.real,
            cliqueFacetCLM_apply] using this.trans' (le_of_eq hw.symm)
        exact ⟨hxG, by
          change cliqueFacetFunctional c x = 1
          exact le_antisymm hxUpper hxLower⟩
  | neg =>
      refine ⟨-(cliqueFacetCLM c), Set.ext fun x ↦ ?_⟩
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hxG, hx⟩
        exact ⟨hxG, fun y hyG ↦ by
          have hy := (cliqueFacetFunctional_bounds_on_hansen G c hc hyG).1
          change -cliqueFacetFunctional c y ≤ -cliqueFacetFunctional c x
          change cliqueFacetFunctional c x = -1 at hx
          linarith⟩
      · rintro ⟨hxG, hxmax⟩
        have hxLower := (cliqueFacetFunctional_bounds_on_hansen G c hc hxG).1
        have hxUpper : cliqueFacetFunctional c x ≤ -1 := by
          have := hxmax w hwG
          change -cliqueFacetFunctional c w ≤ -cliqueFacetFunctional c x at this
          change cliqueFacetFunctional c w = -1 at hw
          linarith
        exact ⟨hxG, by
          change cliqueFacetFunctional c x = -1
          exact le_antisymm hxUpper hxLower⟩

name: HansenCograph.vertexPoint_mem_hansenFacetFace_iff
statement:
theorem vertexPoint_mem_hansenFacetFace_iff (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (vertex : HansenVertexLabel G) (facet : HansenFacetLabel G) :
    vertex.point ∈ hansenFacetFace G facet ↔
      hansenLabelIncidence G vertex facet
proof:
:= by
  rw [hansenFacetFace]
  constructor
  · exact fun h ↦ (cliqueFacetFunctional_eq_label_iff G vertex facet).mp h.2
  · intro h
    exact ⟨hansenGenerators_subset_hansen G ⟨vertex, rfl⟩,
      (cliqueFacetFunctional_eq_label_iff G vertex facet).mpr h⟩

name: HansenCograph.hansenFacetIntersection_isExposed
statement:
theorem hansenFacetIntersection_isExposed (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    ∀ T : Finset (HansenFacetLabel G),
      IsExposed ℝ (hansen G) (hansenFacetIntersection G T)
proof:
:= by
  intro T
  induction T using Finset.induction with
  | empty =>
      simpa [hansenFacetIntersection] using (IsExposed.refl (𝕜 := ℝ) (hansen G))
  | @insert facet T hfacet ih =>
      have heq : hansenFacetIntersection G (insert facet T) =
          hansenFacetFace G facet ∩ hansenFacetIntersection G T := by
        ext x
        simp [hansenFacetIntersection, hansenFacetFace, and_assoc, and_left_comm]
      rw [heq]
      exact (hansenFacetFace_isExposed G facet).inter ih

name: HansenCograph.vertexPoint_mem_hansenFacetIntersection_iff
statement:
theorem vertexPoint_mem_hansenFacetIntersection_iff
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (vertex : HansenVertexLabel G)
    (T : Finset (HansenFacetLabel G)) :
    vertex.point ∈ hansenFacetIntersection G T ↔
      ∀ facet ∈ T, hansenLabelIncidence G vertex facet
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hansenFacetIntersection, mem_setOf_eq,
    hansenGenerators_subset_hansen G ⟨vertex, rfl⟩, true_and]
  exact forall_congr' fun facet ↦ forall_congr' fun _ ↦
    cliqueFacetFunctional_eq_label_iff G vertex facet

name: HansenCograph.emptyHansenVertex_not_incident_same_sign
statement:
theorem emptyHansenVertex_not_incident_same_sign
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (sign : HansenSign) :
    ¬hansenLabelIncidence G (emptyHansenVertex G sign)
      (emptyHansenFacet G sign)
proof:
:= by
  simp [hansenLabelIncidence, emptyHansenVertex, emptyHansenFacet]

name: HansenCograph.emptyHansenVertex_not_incident_facet
statement:
theorem emptyHansenVertex_not_incident_facet
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (facet : HansenFacetLabel G) :
