proof:
:= by
  simp [hansenLabelIncidence, emptyHansenVertex]

name: HansenCograph.incidenceClosure_empty_eq_empty
statement:
theorem incidenceClosure_empty_eq_empty (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence G) ∅ = ∅
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro facet hfacet
  have hmodel : emptyHansenVertex G facet.1 ∈
      incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) ∅ := by
    simp [incidenceModels]
  exact emptyHansenVertex_not_incident_facet G facet
    (hfacet (emptyHansenVertex G facet.1) hmodel)

name: HansenCograph.incidenceClosure_univ_eq_univ
statement:
theorem incidenceClosure_univ_eq_univ (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence G) Set.univ = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  exact Set.eq_univ_of_univ_subset
    (subset_incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence G) Set.univ)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.mem_facetFinset
proof:
:= by
  simp only [facetFinset, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
  rfl

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.geometricCarrier_isExposed
proof:
:=
  hansenFacetIntersection_isExposed G F.facetFinset

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.geometricCarrier_top
statement:
@[simp] theorem geometricCarrier_top (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    (top G).geometricCarrier = hansen G
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [geometricCarrier, facetFinset, top, hansenFacetIntersection]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.geometricCarrier_bottom
statement:
@[simp] theorem geometricCarrier_bottom (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    (bottom G).geometricCarrier = ∅
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨hxG, hxFacet⟩
  have hpos := hxFacet (emptyHansenFacet G HansenSign.pos)
    (by simp [facetFinset, bottom])
  have hneg := hxFacet (emptyHansenFacet G HansenSign.neg)
    (by simp [facetFinset, bottom])
  simp [emptyHansenFacet, HansenFacetLabel.value, HansenSign.real,
    cliqueFacetFunctional, cliqueFunctional] at hpos hneg
  linarith

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.vertexPoint_mem_geometricCarrier_iff
statement:
theorem vertexPoint_mem_geometricCarrier_iff {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (F : HansenCombinatorialFace G) (vertex : HansenVertexLabel G) :
    vertex.point ∈ F.geometricCarrier ↔
      vertex ∈ incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) F
proof:
:= by
  rw [geometricCarrier, vertexPoint_mem_hansenFacetIntersection_iff]
  simp [incidenceModels]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.geometricCarrier_mono
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨hxG, hxFacets⟩
  exact ⟨hxG, fun facet hfacet ↦
    hxFacets facet (mem_facetFinset F facet |>.2 (hFK (mem_facetFinset K facet |>.1 hfacet)))⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.geometricCarrier_injective
statement:
theorem geometricCarrier_injective {G : SimpleGraph V} :
    Function.Injective
      (fun F : HansenCombinatorialFace G ↦ F.geometricCarrier)
proof:
:= by
  intro F K hcarrier
  change F.geometricCarrier = K.geometricCarrier at hcarrier
  apply IncidenceClosedSet.ext
  have hmodels :
      incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) F =
        incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) K := by
    ext vertex
    rw [← vertexPoint_mem_geometricCarrier_iff F vertex,
      ← vertexPoint_mem_geometricCarrier_iff K vertex, hcarrier]
  calc
    (F : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)) =
        incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence G) F := F.isClosed.symm
    _ = incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence G) K := by
      simp only [incidenceClosure, hmodels]
    _ = (K : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)) := K.isClosed

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.geometricCarrier_le_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact geometricCarrier_mono
  · intro hcarrier facet hfacet
    change facet ∈ F.carrier
    rw [← F.isClosed]
    intro vertex hmodelF
    have hpointF := (vertexPoint_mem_geometricCarrier_iff F vertex).mpr hmodelF
    have hpointK := hcarrier hpointF
    have hmodelK := (vertexPoint_mem_geometricCarrier_iff K vertex).mp hpointK
    exact hmodelK facet hfacet

name: HansenCograph.Flag.card_map
statement:
theorem card_map [PartialOrder P] [PartialOrder Q]
    (e : P ≃o Q) (s : Flag P) :
    Nat.card (Flag.map e s) = Nat.card s
proof:
:=
  (Nat.card_congr (mapCarrierEquiv e s)).symm

name: HansenCograph.Flag.card_addWithTop
statement:
theorem card_addWithTop [PartialOrder P] [Finite P] (s : Flag P) :
    Nat.card (addWithTop s) = Nat.card s + 1
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set (WithTop P) := ((↑) : P → WithTop P) '' (s : Set P)
  have hdisj : Disjoint S ({⊤} : Set (WithTop P)) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_singleton_right]
    rintro ⟨x, hx, heq⟩
    exact WithTop.coe_ne_top heq
  change Nat.card {x // x ∈ S ∪ ({⊤} : Set (WithTop P))} = Nat.card s + 1
  rw [Nat.card_coe_set_eq,
    Set.ncard_union_eq hdisj,
    Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ WithTop.coe_injective]
  rw [Set.ncard_singleton]
  exact congrArg (· + 1) (Nat.card_coe_set_eq (s : Set P)).symm

name: HansenCograph.Flag.card_withTopEquiv_add_one
statement:
theorem card_withTopEquiv_add_one [PartialOrder P] [Finite P]
    (s : Flag (WithTop P)) :
    Nat.card (Flag.withTopEquiv s) + 1 = Nat.card s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_addWithTop (Flag.withTopEquiv s)]
  exact congrArg (fun t : Flag (WithTop P) ↦ Nat.card t)
    (Flag.withTopEquiv.left_inv s)

name: HansenCograph.Flag.disjoint_glueCover_images
statement:
theorem disjoint_glueCover_images [PartialOrder P]
    {a b : P} (hab : a ⋖ b)
    (lo : Flag (Set.Iic a)) (hi : Flag (Set.Ici b)) :
    Disjoint (Subtype.val '' (lo : Set (Set.Iic a)))
      (Subtype.val '' (hi : Set (Set.Ici b)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxlo hxhi
  rcases hxlo with ⟨xl, hxl, rfl⟩
  rcases hxhi with ⟨xh, hxh, heq⟩
  apply (not_le_of_gt hab.lt)
  calc
    b ≤ xh.1 := xh.2
    _ = xl.1 := heq
    _ ≤ a := xl.2

name: HansenCograph.Flag.card_glueCover
statement:
theorem card_glueCover [PartialOrder P] [Finite P]
    {a b : P} (hab : a ⋖ b)
    (lo : Flag (Set.Iic a)) (hi : Flag (Set.Ici b)) :
    Nat.card (glueCover hab lo hi) = Nat.card lo + Nat.card hi
proof:
:= by
  let L : Set P := Subtype.val '' (lo : Set (Set.Iic a))
  let H : Set P := Subtype.val '' (hi : Set (Set.Ici b))
  change Nat.card {x // x ∈ L ∪ H} = Nat.card lo + Nat.card hi
  rw [Nat.card_coe_set_eq,
    Set.ncard_union_eq (disjoint_glueCover_images hab lo hi),
    Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective,
    Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective]
  exact congrArg₂ Nat.add
    (Nat.card_coe_set_eq (lo : Set (Set.Iic a))).symm
    (Nat.card_coe_set_eq (hi : Set (Set.Ici b))).symm

name: HansenCograph.Flag.card_throughCoverEquiv
statement:
theorem card_throughCoverEquiv [PartialOrder P] [Finite P]
    {a b : P} (hab : a ⋖ b)
    (pair : Flag (Set.Iic a) × Flag (Set.Ici b)) :
    Nat.card ((throughCoverEquiv hab pair).1) =
      Nat.card pair.1 + Nat.card pair.2
proof:
:=
  card_glueCover hab pair.1 pair.2

name: HansenCograph.Flag.card_eq_add_card_throughCoverEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem card_eq_add_card_throughCoverEquiv_symm [PartialOrder P] [Finite P]
    {a b : P} (hab : a ⋖ b)
    (marked : {s : Flag P // a ∈ s ∧ b ∈ s}) :
    Nat.card marked.1 =
      Nat.card ((throughCoverEquiv hab).symm marked).1 +
        Nat.card ((throughCoverEquiv hab).symm marked).2
proof:
:= by
  let pair := (throughCoverEquiv hab).symm marked
  calc
    Nat.card marked.1 = Nat.card ((throughCoverEquiv hab pair).1) := by
      exact congrArg (fun x ↦ Nat.card x.1)
        ((throughCoverEquiv hab).apply_symm_apply marked).symm
    _ = Nat.card pair.1 + Nat.card pair.2 :=
      card_throughCoverEquiv hab pair
    _ = Nat.card ((throughCoverEquiv hab).symm marked).1 +
        Nat.card ((throughCoverEquiv hab).symm marked).2 := rfl

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.card_withTopEquiv_map_rootedUpper
statement:
theorem card_withTopEquiv_map_rootedUpper
    {V : Type w} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (F : RootedPos G)
    (s : Flag (Set.Ici F.1)) :
    Nat.card
        (Flag.withTopEquiv
          (Flag.map (rootedUpperWithTopOrderIso G F).symm s)) + 1 =
      Nat.card s
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Nat.card
          (Flag.withTopEquiv
            (Flag.map (rootedUpperWithTopOrderIso G F).symm s)) + 1 =
        Nat.card (Flag.map (rootedUpperWithTopOrderIso G F).symm s) :=
      Flag.card_withTopEquiv_add_one _
    _ = Nat.card s := Flag.card_map _ _

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsNeutralOrEmpty.lower
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hX
    exact hE.1 (hX.mono hXE)
  · intro hX
    exact hE.2 (hX.mono hXE)

name: HansenCograph.Flag.productShuffle_toShufflePath
statement:
theorem productShuffle_toShufflePath
    {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}
    [PartialOrder P] [Finite P] [Nonempty P]
    [PartialOrder Q] [Finite Q] [Nonempty Q]
    (s : Flag (P × Q)) {n m : ℕ}
    (hP : Nat.card (fstProjection s) = n + 1)
    (hQ : Nat.card (sndProjection s) = m + 1) :
    productShuffle (fstProjection s) (sndProjection s) hP hQ
      (projectionShufflePath s hP hQ) = s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : Nonempty (fstProjection s) :=
    ((fstProjection s).maxChain.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance).to_subtype
  let _ : Nonempty (sndProjection s) :=
    ((sndProjection s).maxChain.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance).to_subtype
  let _ : Fintype (fstProjection s) := Fintype.ofFinite (fstProjection s)
  let _ : Fintype (sndProjection s) := Fintype.ofFinite (sndProjection s)
  let _ : Fintype (restrictToProjections s) :=
    Fintype.ofFinite (restrictToProjections s)
  have hcard : Nat.card (restrictToProjections s) = n + m + 1 :=
    prod_card_eq_of_card (restrictToProjections s) hP hQ
  have hcard' : Fintype.card (restrictToProjections s) = n + m + 1 := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hcard
  have hP' : Fintype.card (fstProjection s) = n + 1 := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hP
  have hQ' : Fintype.card (sndProjection s) = m + 1 := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hQ
  let e : Fin (n + m + 1) ≃o restrictToProjections s :=
    Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq (restrictToProjections s) hcard'
  let eP : Fin (n + 1) ≃o fstProjection s :=
    Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq (fstProjection s) hP'
  let eQ : Fin (m + 1) ≃o sndProjection s :=
    Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq (sndProjection s) hQ'
  apply Flag.ext
  ext z
  change z ∈ Set.range (fun k : Fin (n + m + 1) ↦
      ((eP ((projectionShufflePath s hP hQ).left k)).1,
       (eQ ((projectionShufflePath s hP hQ).right k)).1)) ↔ z ∈ s
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have hk : (e k).1 ∈ restrictToProjections s := (e k).2
    change ((e k).1.1.1, (e k).1.2.1) ∈ s at hk
    have hleft :
        (eP ((projectionShufflePath s hP hQ).left k)).1 =
          (e k).1.1.1 := by
      simp [projectionShufflePath, toShufflePath, eP, e]
    have hright :
        (eQ ((projectionShufflePath s hP hQ).right k)).1 =
          (e k).1.2.1 := by
      simp [projectionShufflePath, toShufflePath, eQ, e]
    simpa [hleft, hright] using hk
  · intro hz
    let z' : fstProjection s × sndProjection s :=
      (⟨z.1, (mem_fstProjection_iff s z.1).2 ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩⟩,
       ⟨z.2, (mem_sndProjection_iff s z.2).2 ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩⟩)
    have hz' : z' ∈ restrictToProjections s := by
      simpa [z'] using hz
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := e.surjective ⟨z', hz'⟩
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    have hk' := congrArg Subtype.val hk
    have hleft :
        (eP ((projectionShufflePath s hP hQ).left k)).1 =
          (e k).1.1.1 := by
      simp [projectionShufflePath, toShufflePath, eP, e]
    have hright :
        (eQ ((projectionShufflePath s hP hQ).right k)).1 =
          (e k).1.2.1 := by
      simp [projectionShufflePath, toShufflePath, eQ, e]
    apply Prod.ext
    · calc
        (eP ((projectionShufflePath s hP hQ).left k)).1 =
            (e k).1.1.1 := hleft
        _ = z.1 := by
          simpa [z'] using congrArg (fun w ↦ w.1.1) hk'
    · calc
        (eQ ((projectionShufflePath s hP hQ).right k)).1 =
            (e k).1.2.1 := hright
        _ = z.2 := by
          simpa [z'] using congrArg (fun w ↦ w.2.1) hk'

name: HansenCograph.Flag.ProductShuffleCode.decode_surjective
statement:
theorem ProductShuffleCode.decode_surjective
    {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}
    [PartialOrder P] [Finite P] [Nonempty P]
    [PartialOrder Q] [Finite Q] [Nonempty Q] :
    Function.Surjective
      (ProductShuffleCode.decode : ProductShuffleCode P Q → Flag (P × Q))
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  let n := Nat.card (fstProjection s) - 1
  let m := Nat.card (sndProjection s) - 1
  let _ : Nonempty (fstProjection s) :=
    ((fstProjection s).maxChain.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance).to_subtype
  let _ : Nonempty (sndProjection s) :=
    ((sndProjection s).maxChain.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance).to_subtype
  have hfpos : 0 < Nat.card (fstProjection s) := Nat.card_pos
  have hgpos : 0 < Nat.card (sndProjection s) := Nat.card_pos
  have hf : Nat.card (fstProjection s) = n + 1 := by
    dsimp [n]
    omega
  have hg : Nat.card (sndProjection s) = m + 1 := by
    dsimp [m]
    omega
  let code : ProductShuffleCode P Q :=
    { n := n
      m := m
      leftFlag := fstProjection s
      rightFlag := sndProjection s
      left_card := hf
      right_card := hg
      path := projectionShufflePath s hf hg }
  refine ⟨code, ?_⟩
  exact productShuffle_toShufflePath s hf hg

name: HansenCograph.Flag.ProductShuffleCode.decode_injective
statement:
theorem ProductShuffleCode.decode_injective
    {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}
    [PartialOrder P] [Finite P] [Nonempty P]
    [PartialOrder Q] [Finite Q] [Nonempty Q] :
    Function.Injective
      (ProductShuffleCode.decode : ProductShuffleCode P Q → Flag (P × Q))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨n, m, f, g, hf, hg, p⟩ ⟨n', m', f', g', hf', hg', p'⟩ h
  change productShuffle f g hf hg p =
    productShuffle f' g' hf' hg' p' at h
  have hff : f = f' := by
    apply Flag.ext
    calc
      (f : Set P) = Prod.fst ''
          (productShuffle f g hf hg p).carrier :=
        (productShuffle_fst_range f g hf hg p).symm
      _ = Prod.fst '' (productShuffle f' g' hf' hg' p').carrier := by
        rw [h]
      _ = (f' : Set P) := productShuffle_fst_range f' g' hf' hg' p'
  have hgg : g = g' := by
    apply Flag.ext
    calc
      (g : Set Q) = Prod.snd ''
          (productShuffle f g hf hg p).carrier :=
        (productShuffle_snd_range f g hf hg p).symm
      _ = Prod.snd '' (productShuffle f' g' hf' hg' p').carrier := by
        rw [h]
      _ = (g' : Set Q) := productShuffle_snd_range f' g' hf' hg' p'
  subst f'
  subst g'
  have hn : n = n' := by omega
  have hm : m = m' := by omega
  subst n'
  subst m'
  have hp : p = p' := by
    apply productShuffle_injective_fixed f g hf hg
    change productShuffle f g hf hg p =
      productShuffle f g hf' hg' p' at h
    simpa using h
  subst p'
  rfl

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.card_leftSupport
statement:
@[simp] theorem card_leftSupport (w : Interleaving n m) :
    (leftSupport w).card = n
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftSupport, Set.powersetCard.card_eq]

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.card_rightSupport
statement:
@[simp] theorem card_rightSupport (w : Interleaving n m) :
    (rightSupport w).card = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightSupport, card_map, card_compl, Fintype.card_fin,
    Set.powersetCard.card_eq]
  omega

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.castSucc_mem_leftSupport
statement:
@[simp] theorem castSucc_mem_leftSupport (w : Interleaving n m)
    (k : Fin (n + m)) : k.castSucc ∈ leftSupport w ↔ k ∈ w.val
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftSupport]

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.castSucc_mem_rightSupport
statement:
@[simp] theorem castSucc_mem_rightSupport (w : Interleaving n m)
    (k : Fin (n + m)) : k.castSucc ∈ rightSupport w ↔ k ∉ w.val
proof:
:= by
  simp [rightSupport]

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.leftCount_le
statement:
theorem leftCount_le (w : Interleaving n m) (k : Fin (n + m + 1)) :
    leftCount w k ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  exact (card_filter_le (leftSupport w) (· < k)).trans_eq
    (card_leftSupport w)

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.rightCount_le
statement:
theorem rightCount_le (w : Interleaving n m) (k : Fin (n + m + 1)) :
    rightCount w k ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  exact (card_filter_le (rightSupport w) (· < k)).trans_eq
    (card_rightSupport w)

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.filter_lt_succ_eq_insert
statement:
theorem filter_lt_succ_eq_insert (S : Finset (Fin (n + m + 1)))
    (k : Fin (n + m)) (hk : k.castSucc ∈ S) :
    S.filter (· < k.succ) = insert k.castSucc (S.filter (· < k.castSucc))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_insert]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxS, hxlt⟩
    by_cases hx : x = k.castSucc
    · exact Or.inl hx
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hxS, by
        apply Fin.mk_lt_mk.mpr
        have hxv := Fin.mk_lt_mk.mp hxlt
        have hne : x.val ≠ k.val := by
          intro heq
          exact hx (Fin.ext heq)
        omega⟩
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨hxS, hxlt⟩)
    · exact ⟨hk, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨hxS, lt_trans hxlt (by simp)⟩

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.filter_lt_succ_eq_of_notMem
statement:
theorem filter_lt_succ_eq_of_notMem (S : Finset (Fin (n + m + 1)))
    (k : Fin (n + m)) (hk : k.castSucc ∉ S) :
    S.filter (· < k.succ) = S.filter (· < k.castSucc)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxS, hxlt⟩
    refine ⟨hxS, ?_⟩
    apply Fin.mk_lt_mk.mpr
    have hxv := Fin.mk_lt_mk.mp hxlt
    have hne : x.val ≠ k.val := by
      intro heq
      have hxeq : x = k.castSucc := Fin.ext heq
      rw [hxeq] at hxS
      apply hk
      exact hxS
    omega
  · rintro ⟨hxS, hxlt⟩
    exact ⟨hxS, lt_trans hxlt (by simp)⟩

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.leftCount_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem leftCount_zero (w : Interleaving n m) : leftCount w 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftCount]

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.rightCount_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem rightCount_zero (w : Interleaving n m) : rightCount w 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [rightCount]

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.leftCount_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftCount_last (w : Interleaving n m) :
    leftCount w (.last (n + m)) = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftCount, filter_eq_self.mpr, card_leftSupport]
  intro x hx
  rcases mem_map.mp hx with ⟨a, _, rfl⟩
  exact Fin.castSucc_lt_last a

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.rightCount_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightCount_last (w : Interleaving n m) :
    rightCount w (.last (n + m)) = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightCount, filter_eq_self.mpr, card_rightSupport]
  intro x hx
  rcases mem_map.mp hx with ⟨a, _, rfl⟩
  exact Fin.castSucc_lt_last a

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.leftCount_succ_of_mem
statement:
theorem leftCount_succ_of_mem (w : Interleaving n m) (k : Fin (n + m))
    (hk : k ∈ w.val) :
    leftCount w k.succ = leftCount w k.castSucc + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftCount, leftCount,
    filter_lt_succ_eq_insert (leftSupport w) k (by simpa)]
  rw [card_insert_of_notMem]
  simp

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.leftCount_succ_of_notMem
statement:
theorem leftCount_succ_of_notMem (w : Interleaving n m) (k : Fin (n + m))
    (hk : k ∉ w.val) :
    leftCount w k.succ = leftCount w k.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftCount, leftCount,
    filter_lt_succ_eq_of_notMem (leftSupport w) k (by simpa)]

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.rightCount_succ_of_mem
statement:
theorem rightCount_succ_of_mem (w : Interleaving n m) (k : Fin (n + m))
    (hk : k ∈ w.val) :
    rightCount w k.succ = rightCount w k.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightCount, rightCount,
    filter_lt_succ_eq_of_notMem (rightSupport w) k (by simpa)]

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.rightCount_succ_of_notMem
statement:
theorem rightCount_succ_of_notMem (w : Interleaving n m) (k : Fin (n + m))
    (hk : k ∉ w.val) :
    rightCount w k.succ = rightCount w k.castSucc + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightCount, rightCount,
    filter_lt_succ_eq_insert (rightSupport w) k (by simpa)]
  rw [card_insert_of_notMem]
  simp

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.exists_card_filter_lt_eq
statement:
theorem exists_card_filter_lt_eq {N r : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin (N + 1)))
    (hcard : S.card = r) (hlast : ∀ x ∈ S, x < Fin.last N)
    (i : Fin (r + 1)) :
    ∃ k : Fin (N + 1), (S.filter (· < k)).card = i.val
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i
    exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  · let j : Fin r := i.pred hi
    let e : Fin r ↪o Fin (N + 1) := S.orderEmbOfFin hcard
    have hej_mem : e j ∈ S := by
      exact S.orderEmbOfFin_mem hcard j
    have hej_last : e j < Fin.last N := hlast (e j) hej_mem
    let k : Fin (N + 1) := ⟨(e j).val + 1, by
      change (e j).val < N at hej_last
      omega⟩
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    have hfilter : S.filter (· < k) = S.filter (· ≤ e j) := by
      ext x
      simp only [mem_filter]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hxS, hxk⟩
        refine ⟨hxS, Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr ?_⟩
        have hxk' : x.val < (e j).val + 1 := by
          change x.val < (e j).val + 1 at hxk
          exact hxk
        exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ hxk'
      · rintro ⟨hxS, hxj⟩
        refine ⟨hxS, Fin.mk_lt_mk.mpr ?_⟩
        exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Fin.mk_le_mk.mp hxj)
    rw [hfilter]
    have hbij : (Finset.Iic j).card = (S.filter (· ≤ e j)).card := by
      apply Finset.card_bij (fun a _ ↦ e a)
      · intro a ha
        exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨S.orderEmbOfFin_mem hcard a,
          e.monotone (Finset.mem_Iic.mp ha)⟩
      · intro a _ b _ hab
        exact e.injective hab
      · intro x hx
        rcases mem_filter.mp hx with ⟨hxS, hxle⟩
        have hxrange : x ∈ Set.range e := by
          rw [show Set.range e = (S : Set (Fin (N + 1))) by
            exact S.range_orderEmbOfFin hcard]
          exact hxS
        rcases hxrange with ⟨a, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨a, Finset.mem_Iic.mpr (e.le_iff_le.mp hxle), rfl⟩
    rw [← hbij, Fin.card_Iic]
    have hneval : i.val ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hi
      exact Fin.ext h
    have hival : 0 < i.val := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hneval
    simp only [j, Fin.val_pred]
    omega

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.mem_iff_left_ne
statement:
theorem mem_iff_left_ne (w : Interleaving n m) (k : Fin (n + m)) :
    k ∈ w.val ↔ left w k.castSucc ≠ left w k.succ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k ∈ w.val
  · refine ⟨fun _ hEq ↦ ?_, fun _ ↦ hk⟩
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val hEq
    change leftCount w k.castSucc = leftCount w k.succ at hv
    rw [leftCount_succ_of_mem w k hk] at hv
    omega
  · exact ⟨fun h ↦ (hk h).elim, fun hne ↦ (hne (Fin.ext (by
      change leftCount w k.castSucc = leftCount w k.succ
      exact (leftCount_succ_of_notMem w k hk).symm))).elim⟩

name: HansenCograph.Interleaving.toShufflePath_injective
statement:
theorem toShufflePath_injective : Function.Injective
    (toShufflePath : Interleaving n m → ShufflePath n m)
proof:
:= by
  intro w z hwz
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext k
  rw [mem_iff_left_ne w, mem_iff_left_ne z]
  have hleft := congrArg ShufflePath.left hwz
  change left w = left z at hleft
  rw [hleft]

name: HansenCograph.choose_le_card_shufflePath
statement:
theorem choose_le_card_shufflePath (n m : ℕ) :
    Nat.choose (n + m) n ≤ Nat.card (ShufflePath n m)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective (Interleaving.embedding n m)
    (Interleaving.embedding n m).injective
  rw [Set.powersetCard.card, Nat.card_fin] at h
  exact h

name: HansenCograph.rankedFlag_product_choose_lower_bound
statement:
theorem rankedFlag_product_choose_lower_bound
    {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}
    [PartialOrder P] [BoundedOrder P] [Finite P]
    [PartialOrder Q] [BoundedOrder Q] [Finite Q]
    {n m : ℕ} :
    Nat.card (RankedFlag P n) * Nat.card (RankedFlag Q m) *
        Nat.choose (n + m) n ≤
      Nat.card (RankedFlag (P × Q) (n + m))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ Nat.card (RankedFlag P n) * Nat.card (RankedFlag Q m) *
        Nat.card (ShufflePath n m) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (choose_le_card_shufflePath n m)
    _ ≤ _ := rankedFlag_product_card_lower_bound

name: HansenCograph.continuous_q
statement:
theorem continuous_q (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Continuous (q G)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold q
  fun_prop

name: HansenCograph.q_nonneg_on_unit
statement:
theorem q_nonneg_on_unit (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ q G x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold q qCoeff
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro s hs
  apply mul_nonneg
  · apply mul_nonneg
    · exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (nu_nonneg _) (nu_nonneg _)) (by positivity)
    · exact pow_nonneg hx0 _
  · exact pow_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx1) _

name: HansenCograph.qCoeff_compl
statement:
theorem qCoeff_compl (G : SimpleGraph V) (s : Finset V) :
    qCoeff G sᶜ = qCoeff G s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcc : sᶜᶜ = s := by ext; simp
  have hsle : s.card ≤ Fintype.card V := Finset.card_le_univ s
  have hcard : Fintype.card V - (Fintype.card V - s.card) = s.card := by
    omega
  unfold qCoeff
  rw [Finset.card_compl]
  rw [hcc, hcard]
  ring

name: HansenCograph.q_one_sub
statement:
theorem q_one_sub (G : SimpleGraph V) (x : ℝ) :
    q G (1 - x) = q G x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold q
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun s _ => sᶜ)
  · intro s hs
    simp
  · intro s₁ hs₁ s₂ hs₂ h
    apply Finset.ext
    intro v
    have hv := congrArg (fun t : Finset V => v ∈ t) h
    have hv' : (v ∉ s₁) = (v ∉ s₂) := by simpa using hv
    constructor
    · intro hv₁
      by_contra hv₂
      have hn₁ : v ∉ s₁ := by
        rw [hv']
        exact hv₂
      exact hn₁ hv₁
    · intro hv₂
      by_contra hv₁
      have hn₂ : v ∉ s₂ := by
        rw [← hv']
        exact hv₁
      exact hn₂ hv₂
  · intro s hs
    exact ⟨sᶜ, by simp, by ext; simp⟩
  · intro s hs
    have hsle : s.card ≤ Fintype.card V := Finset.card_le_univ s
    have hcard : Fintype.card V - (Fintype.card V - s.card) = s.card := by
      omega
    rw [qCoeff_compl, Finset.card_compl, hcard]
    ring

name: HansenCograph.q_symmetric_about_half
statement:
theorem q_symmetric_about_half (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, q G (1 - x) = q G x
proof:
:=
  q_one_sub G

name: HansenCograph.zeroCoord_apply_same
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeroCoord_apply_same (v : V) (x : V → ℝ) :
    zeroCoord v x v = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [zeroCoord]

name: HansenCograph.zeroCoord_apply_ne
statement:
theorem zeroCoord_apply_ne {v w : V} (h : w ≠ v) (x : V → ℝ) :
    zeroCoord v x w = x w
proof:
:= by
  simp [zeroCoord, h]

name: HansenCograph.zeroCoord_indicator
statement:
theorem zeroCoord_indicator (v : V) (s : Finset V) :
    zeroCoord v (indicator s) = indicator (s.erase v)
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  by_cases h : w = v
  · subst w
    simp [zeroCoord, indicator]
  · simp [zeroCoord, indicator, h]

name: HansenCograph.zeroCoordLM_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeroCoordLM_apply (v : V) (x : V → ℝ) :
    zeroCoordLM v x = zeroCoord v x
proof: := rfl

name: HansenCograph.isIndepSet_erase
statement:
theorem isIndepSet_erase (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {s : Finset V} (hs : G.IsIndepSet (↑s : Set V)) (v : V) :
    G.IsIndepSet (↑(s.erase v) : Set V)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  have ha' : a ∈ s.erase v := by
    simp at ha
    simpa using ha.symm
  have hb' : b ∈ s.erase v := by
    simp at hb
    simpa using hb.symm
  apply hs
  · simpa using (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase ha')
  · simpa using (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hb')
  · exact hab

name: HansenCograph.zeroCoord_mem_stab
statement:
theorem zeroCoord_mem_stab (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {x : V → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ stab G) (v : V) :
    zeroCoord v x ∈ stab G
proof:
:= by
  change zeroCoordLM v x ∈ stab G
  change x ∈ convexHull ℝ (stableIndicators G) at hx
  apply
    (convexHull_min
      (t := (zeroCoordLM v) ⁻¹' stab G)
      ?_
      ((convex_stab G).linear_preimage (zeroCoordLM v))) hx
  rintro y ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
  change zeroCoord v (indicator s) ∈ stab G
  rw [zeroCoord_indicator]
  exact indicator_mem_stab G (isIndepSet_erase G hs v)

name: HansenCograph.scaleCoord_apply_same
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scaleCoord_apply_same (v : V) (a : ℝ) (x : V → ℝ) :
    scaleCoord v a x v = a * x v
proof:
:= by
  simp [scaleCoord]

name: HansenCograph.scaleCoord_apply_ne
statement:
theorem scaleCoord_apply_ne {v w : V} (h : w ≠ v)
    (a : ℝ) (x : V → ℝ) :
    scaleCoord v a x w = x w
proof:
:= by
  simp [scaleCoord, h]

name: HansenCograph.scaleCoord_eq_combo
statement:
theorem scaleCoord_eq_combo (v : V) (a : ℝ) (x : V → ℝ) :
    scaleCoord v a x =
      a • x + (1 - a) • zeroCoord v x
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  by_cases h : w = v
  · subst w
    simp [scaleCoord, zeroCoord]
  · simp [scaleCoord, zeroCoord, h]
    ring

name: HansenCograph.scaleCoord_mem_stab
statement:
theorem scaleCoord_mem_stab (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {x : V → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ stab G)
    (v : V) {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    scaleCoord v a x ∈ stab G
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : zeroCoord v x ∈ stab G :=
    zeroCoord_mem_stab G hx v
  rw [scaleCoord_eq_combo]
  apply (convex_stab G) hx hx0
  · exact ha0
  · linarith
  · ring

name: HansenCograph.scaleOn_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scaleOn_empty (r : V → ℝ) (x : V → ℝ) :
    scaleOn (∅ : Finset V) r x = x
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp [scaleOn]

name: HansenCograph.scaleOn_univ_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scaleOn_univ_apply (r : V → ℝ) (x : V → ℝ) (v : V) :
    scaleOn (Finset.univ : Finset V) r x v = r v * x v
proof:
:= by
  simp [scaleOn]

name: HansenCograph.scaleOn_insert
statement:
theorem scaleOn_insert {s : Finset V} {v : V} (hv : v ∉ s)
    (r : V → ℝ) (x : V → ℝ) :
    scaleOn (insert v s) r x =
      scaleCoord v (r v) (scaleOn s r x)
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  by_cases hw : w = v
  · subst w
    simp [scaleOn, scaleCoord, hv]
  · simp [scaleOn, scaleCoord, hw]

name: HansenCograph.scaleOn_mem_stab
statement:
theorem scaleOn_mem_stab (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (r : V → ℝ)
    (hr : ∀ v, 0 ≤ r v ∧ r v ≤ 1)
    (s : Finset V)
    {x : V → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ stab G) :
    scaleOn s r x ∈ stab G
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      simpa [scaleOn] using hx
  | @insert v s hv ih =>
      rw [scaleOn_insert (r := r) (x := x) hv]
      exact scaleCoord_mem_stab G ih v (hr v).1 (hr v).2

name: HansenCograph.stab_downward
statement:
theorem stab_downward (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {x y : V → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ stab G)
    (hy0 : ∀ v, 0 ≤ y v)
    (hyx : ∀ v, y v ≤ x v) :
    y ∈ stab G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r : V → ℝ :=
    fun v => if x v = 0 then 0 else y v / x v
  have hr : ∀ v, 0 ≤ r v ∧ r v ≤ 1 := by
    intro v
    by_cases hxv : x v = 0
    · simp [r, hxv]
    · have hxpos : 0 < x v := by
        exact lt_of_le_of_ne
          (stab_coordinate_nonneg G hx v)
          (Ne.symm hxv)
      constructor
      · simp only [r, hxv]
        exact div_nonneg (hy0 v) hxpos.le
      · simp only [r, hxv]
        apply (div_le_iff₀ hxpos).2
        simpa using hyx v
  have hscaled :
      scaleOn (Finset.univ : Finset V) r x ∈ stab G :=
    scaleOn_mem_stab G r hr Finset.univ hx
  convert hscaled using 1
  ext v
  by_cases hxv : x v = 0
  · have hyv_le : y v ≤ 0 := by
      simpa [hxv] using hyx v
    have hyv : y v = 0 :=
      le_antisymm hyv_le (hy0 v)
    simp [scaleOn, r, hxv, hyv]
  · simp [scaleOn, r, hxv]

name: HansenCograph.restrictToLM_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrictToLM_apply (s : Finset V) (x : V → ℝ) :
    restrictToLM s x = restrictTo s x
proof: := rfl

name: HansenCograph.restrictTo_indicator
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrictTo_indicator (s t : Finset V) :
    restrictTo s (indicator t) =
      indicator (restrictFinset s t)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp [restrictTo, restrictFinset, indicator]

name: HansenCograph.restrictFinset_indep
statement:
theorem restrictFinset_indep (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (s : Finset V) {t : Finset V}
    (ht : G.IsIndepSet (↑t : Set V)) :
    (inducedFinset G s).IsIndepSet
      (↑(restrictFinset s t) :
        Set ↥(↑s : Set V))
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  change ¬ G.Adj (a : V) (b : V)
  apply ht
  · simpa [restrictFinset] using ha
  · simpa [restrictFinset] using hb
  · intro h
    apply hab
    exact Subtype.ext h

name: HansenCograph.restrictTo_mem_stab
statement:
theorem restrictTo_mem_stab (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (s : Finset V) {x : V → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ stab G) :
    restrictTo s x ∈ stab (inducedFinset G s)
proof:
:= by
  change restrictToLM s x ∈ stab (inducedFinset G s)
  change x ∈ convexHull ℝ (stableIndicators G) at hx
  apply
    (convexHull_min
      (t := (restrictToLM s) ⁻¹' stab (inducedFinset G s))
      ?_
      ((convex_stab (inducedFinset G s)).linear_preimage
        (restrictToLM s))) hx
  rintro y ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  change restrictTo s (indicator t) ∈ stab (inducedFinset G s)
  rw [restrictTo_indicator]
  exact indicator_mem_stab _
    (restrictFinset_indep G s ht)

name: HansenCograph.extendZeroLM_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extendZeroLM_apply (s : Finset V)
    (x : ↥(↑s : Set V) → ℝ) :
    extendZeroLM s x = extendZero s x
proof: := rfl

name: HansenCograph.extendZero_indicator
statement:
theorem extendZero_indicator (s : Finset V)
    (t : Finset ↥(↑s : Set V)) :
    extendZero s (indicator t) =
      indicator (t.image Subtype.val)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  by_cases hv : v ∈ s
  · have hmem :
        (⟨v, hv⟩ : ↥(↑s : Set V)) ∈ t ↔
          v ∈ t.image Subtype.val := by
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr
          ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, h, rfl⟩
      · intro h
        rcases Finset.mem_image.mp h with ⟨w, hw, hwv⟩
        have heq : w = ⟨v, hv⟩ := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          exact hwv
        simpa [heq] using hw
    unfold extendZero
    unfold indicator
    simp [hv]
  · have hnot : v ∉ t.image Subtype.val := by
      intro h
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp h with ⟨w, hw, hwv⟩
      apply hv
      rw [← hwv]
      exact w.property
    simp [extendZero, indicator, hv, hnot]

name: HansenCograph.extendFinset_indep
statement:
theorem extendFinset_indep (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (s : Finset V)
    {t : Finset ↥(↑s : Set V)}
    (ht :
      (inducedFinset G s).IsIndepSet
        (↑t : Set ↥(↑s : Set V))) :
    G.IsIndepSet
      (↑(t.image Subtype.val) : Set V)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  have ha' : a ∈ t.image Subtype.val := by
    simpa using ha
  have hb' : b ∈ t.image Subtype.val := by
    simpa using hb
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp ha' with ⟨a', ha't, haa⟩
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hb' with ⟨b', hb't, hbb⟩
  have hne : a' ≠ b' := by
    intro h
    apply hab
    calc
      a = (a' : V) := haa.symm
      _ = (b' : V) := congrArg Subtype.val h
      _ = b := hbb
  have hnonadj :=
    ht
      (by simpa using ha't)
      (by simpa using hb't)
      hne
  simpa [inducedFinset, haa, hbb] using hnonadj

name: HansenCograph.extendZero_mem_stab
statement:
theorem extendZero_mem_stab (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (s : Finset V)
    {x : ↥(↑s : Set V) → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ stab (inducedFinset G s)) :
    extendZero s x ∈ stab G
proof:
:= by
  change extendZeroLM s x ∈ stab G
  change
    x ∈ convexHull ℝ
      (stableIndicators (inducedFinset G s)) at hx
  apply
    (convexHull_min
      (t := (extendZeroLM s) ⁻¹' stab G)
      ?_
      ((convex_stab G).linear_preimage
        (extendZeroLM s))) hx
  rintro y ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  change extendZero s (indicator t) ∈ stab G
  rw [extendZero_indicator]
  exact indicator_mem_stab G
    (extendFinset_indep G s ht)

name: HansenCograph.disjoint_compl_finset
statement:
theorem disjoint_compl_finset (s : Finset V) :
    Disjoint s sᶜ
proof: := Finset.disjoint_sdiff

name: HansenCograph.splitEquiv_measurePreserving
statement:
theorem splitEquiv_measurePreserving (s : Finset V) :
    MeasurePreserving (⇑(splitEquiv s)) volume volume
proof:
:= by
  have hfull :
      MeasurePreserving
        (⇑(fullToUnionEquiv s))
        volume volume := by
    exact
      MeasureTheory.volume_measurePreserving_piCongrLeft
        (fun _ : ↥(s ∪ sᶜ) => ℝ)
        (unionIndexEquiv s)
  have hunion :
      MeasurePreserving
        (⇑(unionProdEquiv s))
        volume volume := by
    exact
      MeasureTheory.volume_preserving_piFinsetUnion
        (fun _ : V => ℝ)
        (disjoint_compl_finset s)
  have hunion_symm :
      MeasurePreserving
        (⇑(unionProdEquiv s).symm)
        volume volume :=
    MeasurePreserving.symm
      (unionProdEquiv s)
      hunion
  have h :=
    hunion_symm.comp hfull
  simpa only [
    splitEquiv,
    MeasurableEquiv.coe_trans,
    Function.comp_apply
  ] using h

name: HansenCograph.splitEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem splitEquiv_apply (s : Finset V) (z : V → ℝ) :
    splitEquiv s z =
      (restrictTo s z, restrictTo sᶜ z)
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext v
    rfl
  · funext v
    rfl

name: HansenCograph.mem_sectionPiece_iff
statement:
theorem mem_sectionPiece_iff
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (x : ℝ)
    (s : Finset V) (z : V → ℝ) :
    z ∈ sectionPiece G x s ↔
      restrictTo s z ∈
          x • stab (inducedFinset G s) ∧
      restrictTo sᶜ z ∈
          (-(1 - x)) •
            stab (inducedFinset G sᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  change
    splitEquiv s z ∈
      (x • stab (inducedFinset G s)) ×ˢ
        ((-(1 - x)) • stab (inducedFinset G sᶜ)) ↔ _
  rw [splitEquiv_apply]
  rfl

name: HansenCograph.sectionPiece_eq_sectionSet_inter_orthant
statement:
theorem sectionPiece_eq_sectionSet_inter_orthant
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1)
    (s : Finset V) :
    sectionPiece G x s =
      sectionSet G x ∩ orthant s
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rw [mem_sectionPiece_iff]
  change
    (_ ∧ _) ↔
      (z ∈ sectionSet G x ∧ z ∈ orthant s)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hzs, hzsc⟩
    rcases Set.mem_smul_set.mp hzs with
      ⟨a, ha, haeq⟩
    rcases Set.mem_smul_set.mp hzsc with
      ⟨b, hb, hbeq⟩
    have hza :
        x • extendZero s a ∈
          x • stab G :=
      Set.smul_mem_smul_set
        (extendZero_mem_stab G s ha)
    have hzb :
        (-(1 - x)) • extendZero sᶜ b ∈
          (-(1 - x)) • stab G :=
      Set.smul_mem_smul_set
        (extendZero_mem_stab G sᶜ hb)
    have hsum :
        x • extendZero s a +
            (-(1 - x)) • extendZero sᶜ b =
          z := by
      ext v
      by_cases hv : v ∈ s
      · have hvc : v ∉ sᶜ := by
          simp [hv]
        have ha_v :=
          congrFun haeq
            (⟨v, hv⟩ : ↥(↑s : Set V))
        have hbzero :
            extendZero sᶜ b v = 0 := by
          simp [extendZero, hvc]
        simpa [extendZero, restrictTo, hv, hvc,
          Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hbzero] using ha_v
      · have hvc : v ∈ sᶜ := by
          simp [hv]
        have hb_v :=
          congrFun hbeq
            (⟨v, hvc⟩ : ↥(↑sᶜ : Set V))
        have hazero :
            extendZero s a v = 0 := by
          simp [extendZero, hv]
        simpa [extendZero, restrictTo, hv, hvc,
          Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hazero] using hb_v
    have hzsection : z ∈ sectionSet G x := by
      unfold sectionSet
      rw [← hsum]
      exact Set.add_mem_add hza hzb
    have hzorth : z ∈ orthant s := by
      constructor
      · intro v hv
        have ha0 :
            0 ≤ a ⟨v, hv⟩ :=
          stab_coordinate_nonneg
            (inducedFinset G s) ha ⟨v, hv⟩
        have heq :=
          congrFun haeq
            (⟨v, hv⟩ : ↥(↑s : Set V))
        have heq' :
            x * a ⟨v, hv⟩ = z v := by
          simpa [restrictTo,
            Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using heq
        rw [← heq']
        exact mul_nonneg hx0 ha0
      · intro v hv
        have hvc : v ∈ sᶜ := by
          simp [hv]
        have hb0 :
            0 ≤ b ⟨v, hvc⟩ :=
          stab_coordinate_nonneg
            (inducedFinset G sᶜ) hb ⟨v, hvc⟩
        have heq :=
          congrFun hbeq
            (⟨v, hvc⟩ : ↥(↑sᶜ : Set V))
        have heq' :
            (-(1 - x)) * b ⟨v, hvc⟩ = z v := by
          simpa [restrictTo,
            Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using heq
        rw [← heq']
        exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
          (by linarith)
          hb0
    exact ⟨hzsection, hzorth⟩
  · rintro ⟨hzsection, hzorth⟩
    unfold sectionSet at hzsection
    rcases Set.mem_add.mp hzsection with
      ⟨za, hza, zb, hzb, hzab⟩
    rcases Set.mem_smul_set.mp hza with
      ⟨a, ha, haeq⟩
    rcases Set.mem_smul_set.mp hzb with
      ⟨b, hb, hbeq⟩
    have hz_formula :
        ∀ v : V,
          z v =
            x * a v -
              (1 - x) * b v := by
      intro v
      have habv := congrFun hzab v
      have hav := congrFun haeq v
      have hbv := congrFun hbeq v
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul] at habv hav hbv
      nlinarith
    have hares :
        restrictTo s a ∈
          stab (inducedFinset G s) :=
      restrictTo_mem_stab G s ha
    have hbres :
        restrictTo sᶜ b ∈
          stab (inducedFinset G sᶜ) :=
      restrictTo_mem_stab G sᶜ hb
    have hpos :
        restrictTo s z ∈
          x • stab (inducedFinset G s) := by
      by_cases hx : x = 0
      · have hz0 :
            restrictTo s z = 0 := by
          ext v
          have hznonneg :=
            hzorth.1 (v : V) v.property
          have hb0 :=
            stab_coordinate_nonneg G hb (v : V)
          have hzv := hz_formula (v : V)
          rw [hx] at hzv
          norm_num at hzv
          dsimp [restrictTo]
          nlinarith
        refine Set.mem_smul_set.mpr
          ⟨0, zero_mem_stab _, ?_⟩
        simp [hx, hz0]
      · have hxpos : 0 < x :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne hx0 (Ne.symm hx)
        let a' :
            ↥(↑s : Set V) → ℝ :=
          fun v => z v / x
        have ha' :
            a' ∈ stab (inducedFinset G s) := by
          apply stab_downward
            (inducedFinset G s) hares
          · intro v
            dsimp [a']
            apply div_nonneg
            · exact hzorth.1 (v : V) v.property
            · exact hxpos.le
          · intro v
            dsimp [a', restrictTo]
            apply (div_le_iff₀ hxpos).2
            have hb0 :=
              stab_coordinate_nonneg G hb (v : V)
            have hterm :
                0 ≤ (1 - x) * b (v : V) :=
              mul_nonneg
                (sub_nonneg.mpr hx1) hb0
            have hzv := hz_formula (v : V)
            nlinarith
        refine Set.mem_smul_set.mpr
          ⟨a', ha', ?_⟩
        ext v
        simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        dsimp [a', restrictTo]
        field_simp [hx]
    have hneg :
        restrictTo sᶜ z ∈
          (-(1 - x)) •
            stab (inducedFinset G sᶜ) := by
      by_cases hc : 1 - x = 0
      · have hz0 :
            restrictTo sᶜ z = 0 := by
          ext v
          have hvnot : (v : V) ∉ s := by
            simpa using v.property
          have hznonpos :=
            hzorth.2 (v : V) hvnot
          have ha0 :=
            stab_coordinate_nonneg G ha (v : V)
          have hxa :
              0 ≤ x * a (v : V) :=
            mul_nonneg hx0 ha0
          have hzv := hz_formula (v : V)
          rw [hc] at hzv
          norm_num at hzv
          dsimp [restrictTo]
          nlinarith
        refine Set.mem_smul_set.mpr
          ⟨0, zero_mem_stab _, ?_⟩
        simp [hc, hz0]
      · have hcpos : 0 < 1 - x :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne
            (sub_nonneg.mpr hx1)
            (Ne.symm hc)
        let b' :
            ↥(↑sᶜ : Set V) → ℝ :=
          fun v => -z v / (1 - x)
        have hb' :
            b' ∈ stab (inducedFinset G sᶜ) := by
          apply stab_downward
            (inducedFinset G sᶜ) hbres
          · intro v
            dsimp [b']
            have hvnot : (v : V) ∉ s := by
              simpa using v.property
            exact div_nonneg
              (neg_nonneg.mpr
                (hzorth.2 (v : V) hvnot))
              hcpos.le
          · intro v
            dsimp [b', restrictTo]
            apply (div_le_iff₀ hcpos).2
            have ha0 := stab_coordinate_nonneg G ha (v : V)
            have hxa :
                0 ≤ x * a (v : V) :=
              mul_nonneg hx0 ha0
            have hzv := hz_formula (v : V)
            nlinarith
        refine Set.mem_smul_set.mpr
          ⟨b', hb', ?_⟩
        ext v
        simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        dsimp [b', restrictTo]
        field_simp [hc]
    exact ⟨hpos, hneg⟩

name: HansenCograph.sectionSet_eq_biUnion_sectionPiece
statement:
theorem sectionSet_eq_biUnion_sectionPiece
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) :
    sectionSet G x =
      ⋃ s ∈ Finset.univ.powerset,
        sectionPiece G x s
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    let s : Finset V :=
      Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 0 ≤ z v)
    have hs :
        s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset V).powerset := by
      simp [s]
    have hzorth : z ∈ orthant s := by
      constructor
      · intro v hv
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
      · intro v hv
        have hn : ¬ 0 ≤ z v := by
          intro h
          apply hv
          simp [s, h]
        exact le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hn)
    have hpiece :
        z ∈ sectionPiece G x s := by
      rw [sectionPiece_eq_sectionSet_inter_orthant
        G hx0 hx1 s]
      exact ⟨hz, hzorth⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨s, hs, hpiece⟩
  · simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
    rintro ⟨s, hs, hz⟩
    rw [sectionPiece_eq_sectionSet_inter_orthant
      G hx0 hx1 s] at hz
    exact hz.1

name: HansenCograph.volume_coordHyperplane
statement:
theorem volume_coordHyperplane (v : V) :
    volume {z : V → ℝ | z v = 0} = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [MeasureTheory.volume_pi]
  exact
    Measure.pi_hyperplane
      (fun _ : V => (volume : Measure ℝ))
      v 0

name: HansenCograph.orthant_aeDisjoint
statement:
theorem orthant_aeDisjoint
    {s t : Finset V} (hst : s ≠ t) :
    AEDisjoint volume (orthant s) (orthant t)
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff :
      ∃ v : V,
        (v ∈ s ∧ v ∉ t) ∨
        (v ∈ t ∧ v ∉ s) := by
    by_contra h
    apply hst
    ext v
    by_cases hs : v ∈ s <;>
      by_cases ht : v ∈ t <;>
      simp_all
  rcases hdiff with ⟨v, hv⟩
  change volume (orthant s ∩ orthant t) = 0
  apply measure_mono_null
    (t := {z : V → ℝ | z v = 0})
    ?_
    (volume_coordHyperplane v)
  intro z hz
  rcases hz with ⟨hzs, hzt⟩
  rcases hv with hv | hv
  · exact le_antisymm
      (hzt.2 v hv.2)
      (hzs.1 v hv.1)
  · exact le_antisymm
      (hzs.2 v hv.2)
      (hzt.1 v hv.1)

name: HansenCograph.sectionPiece_aeDisjoint
statement:
theorem sectionPiece_aeDisjoint
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1)
    {s t : Finset V} (hst : s ≠ t) :
    AEDisjoint volume
      (sectionPiece G x s)
      (sectionPiece G x t)
proof:
:= by
  change
    volume
      (sectionPiece G x s ∩
        sectionPiece G x t) = 0
  have horth :=
    orthant_aeDisjoint (V := V) hst
  change volume (orthant s ∩ orthant t) = 0 at horth
  apply measure_mono_null
    (t := orthant s ∩ orthant t)
    ?_
    horth
  intro z hz
  constructor
  · have h := hz.1
    rw [sectionPiece_eq_sectionSet_inter_orthant
      G hx0 hx1 s] at h
    exact h.2
  · have h := hz.2
    rw [sectionPiece_eq_sectionSet_inter_orthant
      G hx0 hx1 t] at h
    exact h.2

name: HansenCograph.sectionPiece_nullMeasurable
statement:
theorem sectionPiece_nullMeasurable
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (x : ℝ)
    (s : Finset V) :
    NullMeasurableSet (sectionPiece G x s) volume
proof:
:= by
  have hs' : NullMeasurableSet
        (x • stab (inducedFinset G s)) volume :=
    ((convex_stab (inducedFinset G s)).smul x).nullMeasurableSet volume
  have hsc' : NullMeasurableSet
        ((-(1 - x)) • stab (inducedFinset G sᶜ)) volume :=
    ((convex_stab (inducedFinset G sᶜ)).smul (-(1 - x))).nullMeasurableSet volume
  have hprod :
      NullMeasurableSet
        ((x • stab (inducedFinset G s)) ×ˢ
          ((-(1 - x)) •
            stab (inducedFinset G sᶜ)))
        (volume :
          Measure
            ((↥(↑s : Set V) → ℝ) ×
             (↥(↑sᶜ : Set V) → ℝ))) := by
    have h :=
      hs'.prod hsc'
    simpa [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using h
  unfold sectionPiece
  exact hprod.preimage
    (splitEquiv_measurePreserving
      (V := V) s).quasiMeasurePreserving

name: HansenCograph.volume_stab_ne_top
statement:
theorem volume_stab_ne_top
    {W : Type w}
    [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (H : SimpleGraph W) :
    volume (stab H) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hlt :
      volume (stab H) < ⊤ :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt
      (measure_mono (stab_subset_unitCube H))
      isCompact_Icc.measure_lt_top
  exact ne_of_lt hlt

name: HansenCograph.volume_smul_stab_ne_top
statement:
theorem volume_smul_stab_ne_top
    {W : Type w}
    [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (H : SimpleGraph W) (r : ℝ) :
    volume (r • stab H) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.addHaar_smul]
  exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top
    (by finiteness)
    (volume_stab_ne_top H)

name: HansenCograph.sectionPiece_volume_ne_top
statement:
theorem sectionPiece_volume_ne_top
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (x : ℝ)
    (s : Finset V) :
    volume (sectionPiece G x s) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  unfold sectionPiece
  rw [
    (splitEquiv_measurePreserving
      (V := V) s).measure_preimage_equiv
  ]
  rw [
    Measure.volume_eq_prod
      (↥(↑s : Set V) → ℝ)
      (↥(↑sᶜ : Set V) → ℝ),
    Measure.prod_prod
  ]
  exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top
    (volume_smul_stab_ne_top
      (inducedFinset G s) x)
    (volume_smul_stab_ne_top
      (inducedFinset G sᶜ) (-(1 - x)))

name: HansenCograph.volume_smul_stab_toReal
statement:
theorem volume_smul_stab_toReal
    {W : Type w}
    [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (H : SimpleGraph W) (r : ℝ) :
    (volume (r • stab H)).toReal =
      |r| ^ Fintype.card W *
        (volume (stab H)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.addHaar_smul]
  simp [abs_pow]

name: HansenCograph.sectionPiece_volume
statement:
theorem sectionPiece_volume
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1)
    (s : Finset V) :
    (volume (sectionPiece G x s)).toReal =
      (volume (stab (inducedFinset G s))).toReal *
      (volume (stab (inducedFinset G sᶜ))).toReal *
      x ^ s.card *
      (1 - x) ^
        (Fintype.card V - s.card)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sectionPiece
  rw [
    (splitEquiv_measurePreserving
      (V := V) s).measure_preimage_equiv
  ]
  rw [
    Measure.volume_eq_prod
      (↥(↑s : Set V) → ℝ)
      (↥(↑sᶜ : Set V) → ℝ),
    Measure.prod_prod,
    ENNReal.toReal_mul
  ]
  rw [
    volume_smul_stab_toReal
      (inducedFinset G s) x,
    volume_smul_stab_toReal
      (inducedFinset G sᶜ) (-(1 - x))
  ]
  simp only [
    abs_of_nonneg hx0,
    abs_neg,
    abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx1)
  ]
  have : ({ x | x ∉ s} : Finset V) = sᶜ := by
    ext V
    simp
  simp [this]
  ring_nf
  congr
  exact Finset.card_compl s

name: HansenCograph.section_volume_eq_sum
statement:
theorem section_volume_eq_sum (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) :
    (volume (sectionSet G x)).toReal =
      ∑ s ∈ Finset.univ.powerset,
        (volume (stab (inducedFinset G s))).toReal *
        (volume (stab (inducedFinset G sᶜ))).toReal *
        x ^ s.card *
        (1 - x) ^
          (Fintype.card V - s.card)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [sectionSet_eq_biUnion_sectionPiece
    G hx0 hx1]
  calc
    (volume
        (⋃ s ∈ Finset.univ.powerset,
          sectionPiece G x s)).toReal
        =
      ∑ s ∈ Finset.univ.powerset,
        (volume (sectionPiece G x s)).toReal := by
          apply MeasureTheory.measureReal_biUnion_finset₀
          · intro s hs t ht hst
            exact sectionPiece_aeDisjoint
              G hx0 hx1 hst
          · intro s hs
            exact sectionPiece_nullMeasurable G x s
          · intro s hs
            exact sectionPiece_volume_ne_top G x s
    _ =
      ∑ s ∈ Finset.univ.powerset,
        (volume (stab (inducedFinset G s))).toReal *
        (volume (stab (inducedFinset G sᶜ))).toReal *
        x ^ s.card *
        (1 - x) ^
          (Fintype.card V - s.card) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro s hs
          exact sectionPiece_volume G hx0 hx1 s

name: HansenCograph.q_eq_section_volume
statement:
theorem q_eq_section_volume (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) :
    q G x = (volume (sectionSet G x)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [section_volume_eq_sum G hx0 hx1]
  unfold q qCoeff nuInduced nu
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s hs
  have hsle : s.card ≤ Fintype.card V :=
    Finset.card_le_univ s
  have hcard_s :
      Fintype.card ↥(↑s : Set V) = s.card := by
    simp
  have hcard_sc :
      Fintype.card ↥(↑sᶜ : Set V) =
        Fintype.card V - s.card := by
    rw [← Finset.card_compl s]
    unfold Fintype.card
    simp
  rw [hcard_s, hcard_sc]
  have hs_fact :
      (s.card.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    positivity
  have hsc_fact :
      ((Fintype.card V - s.card).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    positivity
  field_simp

name: HansenCograph.q_eq_actual_section_volume_spec
statement:
theorem q_eq_actual_section_volume_spec (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      q G x = (volume (sectionSet G x)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact q_eq_section_volume G hx.1 hx.2

name: HansenCograph.isChain_orderDual_iff
statement:
private theorem isChain_orderDual_iff (P : Type u) [PartialOrder P]
    (s : Set P) :
    @IsChain (OrderDual P) (fun x y ↦ x ≤ y) s ↔
      IsChain (fun x y : P ↦ x ≤ y) s
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h a ha b hb hab
  · exact (h ha hb hab).symm
  · exact (h ha hb hab).symm

name: HansenCograph.Flag.covBy_of_mem_of_mem_of_no_between
statement:
theorem covBy_of_mem_of_mem_of_no_between {P : Type u} [PartialOrder P]
    (s : Flag P) {a b : P} (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : b ∈ s) (hab : a < b)
    (hno : ∀ c, c ∈ s → a < c → c < b → False) :
    a ⋖ b
proof:
:= by
  apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq hab
  intro c hac hcb
  by_cases hca : c = a
  · exact Or.inl hca
  by_cases hcb' : c = b
  · exact Or.inr hcb'
  have hac' : a < c := lt_of_le_of_ne hac (Ne.symm hca)
  have hcb'' : c < b := lt_of_le_of_ne hcb hcb'
  have hc : c ∈ s := (Flag.mem_iff_forall_le_or_ge).2 (by
    intro d hd
    rcases s.le_or_le ha hd with had | hda
    · rcases s.le_or_le hb hd with hbd | hdb
      · exact Or.inl (hcb.trans hbd)
      · by_cases hda' : d = a
        · exact Or.inr (hda' ▸ hac)
        by_cases hdb' : d = b
        · exact Or.inl (hdb' ▸ hcb)
        exact False.elim (hno d hd
          (lt_of_le_of_ne had (Ne.symm hda'))
          (lt_of_le_of_ne hdb hdb'))
    · exact Or.inr (hda.trans hac))
  exact False.elim (hno c hc hac' hcb'')

name: HansenCograph.hansenCentralFaceOrderIso_involutive
statement:
theorem hansenCentralFaceOrderIso_involutive (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (F : HansenCombinatorialFace G) :
    hansenCentralFaceOrderIso G (hansenCentralFaceOrderIso G F) = F
proof:
:= by
  exact HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenCentralFaceEquiv_involutive G F

name: HansenCograph.hansenFullFlagCount_iso
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagCount_iso (e : G ≃g H) :
    hansenFullFlagCount G = hansenFullFlagCount H
proof:
:= by
  unfold hansenFullFlagCount
  exact Fintype.card_congr (Flag.map (hansenFaceOrderIso e))

name: HansenCograph.hansenFullFlagCount_compl
statement:
theorem hansenFullFlagCount_compl (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    hansenFullFlagCount Gᶜ = hansenFullFlagCount G
proof:
:= by

  exact Fintype.card_congr
    ((flagOrderDualEquiv (HansenCombinatorialFace G)).symm.trans
      (Flag.map (hansenFaceComplOrderIso G)))

name: HansenCograph.Flag.ProductShuffleCode.decode_card
statement:
theorem ProductShuffleCode.decode_card
    {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}
    [PartialOrder P] [Finite P] [Nonempty P]
    [PartialOrder Q] [Finite Q] [Nonempty Q]
    (c : ProductShuffleCode P Q) :
    Nat.card c.decode = c.n + c.m + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hfst : fstProjection c.decode = c.leftFlag := by
    apply Flag.ext
    change Prod.fst ''
      (productShuffle c.leftFlag c.rightFlag
        c.left_card c.right_card c.path).carrier = c.leftFlag
    exact productShuffle_fst_range
      c.leftFlag c.rightFlag c.left_card c.right_card c.path
  have hsnd : sndProjection c.decode = c.rightFlag := by
    apply Flag.ext
    calc
      (sndProjection c.decode : Set Q) =
          Prod.snd '' c.decode.carrier := by
        ext y
        exact mem_sndProjection_iff c.decode y
      _ = (c.rightFlag : Set Q) := by
        change Prod.snd ''
          (productShuffle c.leftFlag c.rightFlag
            c.left_card c.right_card c.path).carrier = c.rightFlag
        exact productShuffle_snd_range
          c.leftFlag c.rightFlag c.left_card c.right_card c.path
  have hcard := card_eq_projection_cards c.decode
  rw [hfst, hsnd, c.left_card, c.right_card] at hcard
  omega

name: HansenCograph.card_deleteVertex
statement:
theorem card_deleteVertex (v : V) :
    Fintype.card ↥(↑(Finset.univ.erase v) : Set V) = Fintype.card V - 1
proof:
:= by
  change Fintype.card ↥(Finset.univ.erase v) = Fintype.card V - 1
  simpa using
    (Finset.card_erase_of_mem (s := (Finset.univ : Finset V))
      (Finset.mem_univ v))

name: HansenCograph.ShufflePath.ext
proof:
:= by
  cases s
  cases t
  simp only [mk.injEq]
  exact ⟨funext hleft, funext hright⟩

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.map_covBy
statement:
theorem RankedFlag.map_covBy (f : RankedFlag P n)
    {i j : Fin (n + 1)} (hij : i ⋖ j) : f i ⋖ f j
proof:
:= by
  have hij' : i.1 + 1 = j.1 := by
    exact Nat.covBy_iff_add_one_eq.mp (Fin.covBy_iff.mp hij)
  let k : Fin n := ⟨i.1, by omega⟩
  have hi : i = k.castSucc := Fin.ext (by rfl)
  have hj : j = k.succ := Fin.ext (by
    change j.1 = i.1 + 1
    exact hij'.symm)
  rw [hi, hj]
  exact f.covBy_succ k

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle_fst_range
statement:
theorem RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle_fst_range
    (f : RankedFlag P n) (g : RankedFlag Q m) (s : ShufflePath n m) :
    Prod.fst '' (prodOfShuffle f g s).toFlag.carrier = Set.range f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (prodOfShuffle f g s).mem_toFlag_iff z |>.mp hz
    exact ⟨s.left k, by simpa [prodOfShuffle] using congrArg Prod.fst hk⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := s.left_surjective i
    refine ⟨(f i, g (s.right k)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (prodOfShuffle f g s).mem_toFlag_iff _ |>.mpr ⟨k, by
        simp [prodOfShuffle, hk]
      ⟩
    · rfl

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle_snd_range
statement:
theorem RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle_snd_range
    (f : RankedFlag P n) (g : RankedFlag Q m) (s : ShufflePath n m) :
    Prod.snd '' (prodOfShuffle f g s).toFlag.carrier = Set.range g
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (prodOfShuffle f g s).mem_toFlag_iff z |>.mp hz
    exact ⟨s.right k, by simpa [prodOfShuffle] using congrArg Prod.snd hk⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := s.right_surjective j
    refine ⟨(f (s.left k), g j), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (prodOfShuffle f g s).mem_toFlag_iff _ |>.mpr ⟨k, by
        simp [prodOfShuffle, hk]
      ⟩
    · rfl

name: HansenCograph.RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle_injective
statement:
theorem RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle_injective :
    Function.Injective
      (fun x : RankedFlag P n × RankedFlag Q m × ShufflePath n m ↦
        RankedFlag.prodOfShuffle x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨f, g, s⟩ ⟨f', g', t⟩ h
  have hst : s = t := by
    have hout (k : Fin (n + m + 1)) :
        (f (s.left k), g (s.right k)) =
          (f' (t.left k), g' (t.right k)) := by
      exact congrArg (fun z : RankedFlag (P × Q) (n + m) ↦ z k) h
    have hleftMove (k : Fin (n + m)) :
        s.left k.castSucc ≠ s.left k.succ ↔
          t.left k.castSucc ≠ t.left k.succ := by
      rw [← f.injective.ne_iff, ← f'.injective.ne_iff]
      have h₀ := congrArg Prod.fst (hout k.castSucc)
      have h₁ := congrArg Prod.fst (hout k.succ)
      change f (s.left k.castSucc) = f' (t.left k.castSucc) at h₀
      change f (s.left k.succ) = f' (t.left k.succ) at h₁
      rw [h₀, h₁]
    have hcoords : ∀ k : Fin (n + m + 1),
        s.left k = t.left k ∧ s.right k = t.right k := by
      intro k
      induction k using Fin.induction with
      | zero => exact ⟨s.left_zero.trans t.left_zero.symm,
          s.right_zero.trans t.right_zero.symm⟩
      | succ k ih =>
          rcases s.step k with hs | hs <;> rcases t.step k with ht | ht
          · constructor
            · apply Fin.ext
              rw [Fin.covBy_iff, Nat.covBy_iff_add_one_eq] at hs ht
              have hi := congrArg Fin.val ih.1
              omega
            · exact hs.2.symm.trans (ih.2.trans ht.2)
          · exact False.elim ((hleftMove k).mp hs.1.ne ht.2)
          · exact False.elim ((hleftMove k).mpr ht.1.ne hs.2)
          · constructor
            · exact hs.2.symm.trans (ih.1.trans ht.2)
            · apply Fin.ext
              rw [Fin.covBy_iff, Nat.covBy_iff_add_one_eq] at hs ht
              have hi := congrArg Fin.val ih.2
              omega
    apply ShufflePath.ext
    · exact fun k ↦ (hcoords k).1
    · exact fun k ↦ (hcoords k).2
  subst t
  have hf : f = f' := by
    apply RankedFlag.ext
    intro i
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := s.left_surjective i
    have hv := congrArg
      (fun z : RankedFlag (P × Q) (n + m) ↦ (z k).1) h
    change f (s.left k) = f' (s.left k) at hv
    simpa only [hk] using hv
  have hg : g = g' := by
    apply RankedFlag.ext
    intro i
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := s.right_surjective i
    have hv := congrArg
      (fun z : RankedFlag (P × Q) (n + m) ↦ (z k).2) h
    change g (s.right k) = g' (s.right k) at hv
    simpa only [hk] using hv
  cases hf
  cases hg
  rfl

name: HansenCograph.rankedFlag_product_card_lower_bound
statement:
theorem rankedFlag_product_card_lower_bound [Finite P] [Finite Q] :
    Nat.card (RankedFlag P n) * Nat.card (RankedFlag Q m) *
        Nat.card (ShufflePath n m) ≤
      Nat.card (RankedFlag (P × Q) (n + m))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Nat.card_prod, Nat.mul_assoc] using
    Nat.card_le_card_of_injective rankedFlagProductEmbedding
      rankedFlagProductEmbedding.injective

name: HansenCograph.Flag.toFlag_toRankedFlagOfCardEq
proof:
:= by
  apply Flag.ext
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    classical
    letI : Fintype s := Fintype.ofFinite s
    exact (Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq s (by
      simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hcard) k).2
  · intro hx
    classical
    letI : Fintype s := Fintype.ofFinite s
    let e : Fin (n + 1) ≃o s := Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq s (by
      simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hcard)
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := e.surjective ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact ⟨k, congrArg Subtype.val hk⟩

theorem hansenLabelIncidence_compl_transpose (G : SimpleGraph V)

    hansenLabelIncidence Gᶜ (facetComplVertexEquiv G facet)
        (vertexComplFacetEquiv G vertex) ↔
      hansenLabelIncidence G vertex facet
proof:
:= by
  rcases vertex with ⟨vertexSign, ⟨stable, hstable⟩⟩
  rcases facet with ⟨facetSign, ⟨clique, hclique⟩⟩

    vertexComplFacetEquiv]

name: HansenCograph.Flag.mem_fstProjection_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_fstProjection_iff
    {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}
    [PartialOrder P] [Finite P] [Nonempty P]
    [PartialOrder Q] [Finite Q] [Nonempty Q]
    (s : Flag (P × Q)) (x : P) :
    x ∈ fstProjection s ↔ ∃ z ∈ s, z.1 = x
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: HansenCograph.Flag.mem_sndProjection_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_sndProjection_iff
    {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}
    [PartialOrder P] [Finite P] [Nonempty P]
    [PartialOrder Q] [Finite Q] [Nonempty Q]
    (s : Flag (P × Q)) (y : Q) :
    y ∈ sndProjection s ↔ ∃ z ∈ s, z.2 = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, ⟨z, hz, hzw⟩, hwy⟩
    refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
    rw [← hwy]
    exact congrArg Prod.fst hzw
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨z.swap, ?_, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩

name: HansenCograph.Flag.mem_restrictToProjections_iff
statement:

theorem mem_restrictToProjections_iff
    {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}

    [PartialOrder Q] [Finite Q] [Nonempty Q]
    (s : Flag (P × Q)) (z : fstProjection s × sndProjection s) :
    z ∈ restrictToProjections s ↔ (z.1.1, z.2.1) ∈ s
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: HansenCograph.Flag.card_restrictToProjections

theorem card_restrictToProjections

    (s : Flag (P × Q)) :
