proof:
:=
  Nat.card_congr (restrictToProjectionsEquiv s)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalLayerSwitch_one_not_surjective_of_exposedSquare
statement:
theorem hansenPortalLayerSwitch_one_not_surjective_of_exposedSquare
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (hSquare : PairedPositivePortalSquare G)
    (w : ExposedPositiveSquareWitness hG) :
    ¬ Function.Surjective
      (hansenPortalLayerSwitch hG hSquare (k := 1) w.one_lt)
proof:
:= by
  intro hsurj
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hsurj w.target
  have hm := hansenPortalLayerSwitch_has_rooted_middle
    hG hSquare w.one_lt c
  rw [hc] at hm
  exact w.no_rooted_middle hm

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector_one_lt_two_of_exposedSquare
statement:
theorem hansenPortalVector_one_lt_two_of_exposedSquare
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (hSquare : PairedPositivePortalSquare G)
    (w : ExposedPositiveSquareWitness hG) :
    hansenPortalVector G 1 < hansenPortalVector G 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold hansenPortalVector
  exact Fintype.card_lt_of_injective_not_surjective
    (hansenPortalLayerSwitch hG hSquare (k := 1) w.one_lt)
    (hansenPortalLayerSwitch_injective hG hSquare w.one_lt)
    (hansenPortalLayerSwitch_one_not_surjective_of_exposedSquare
      hG hSquare w)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector_monoOn_support
statement:
theorem hansenPortalVector_monoOn_support
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (hSquare : PairedPositivePortalSquare G) :
    MonotoneOn (hansenPortalVector G) (Icc 0 n)
proof:
:= by
  apply monotoneOn_of_le_succ ordConnected_Icc
  intro k hkmax hk hksucc
  change hansenPortalVector G k ≤ hansenPortalVector G (k + 1)
  apply hansenPortalVector_le_succ hG hSquare
  exact (Order.succ_le_iff_of_not_isMax hkmax).mp hksucc.2

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector_zero_lt_top_of_exposedSquare
statement:
theorem hansenPortalVector_zero_lt_top_of_exposedSquare
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {n : ℕ}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G) (n + 3))
    (hSquare : PairedPositivePortalSquare G)
    (w : ExposedPositiveSquareWitness hG) :
    hansenPortalVector G 0 < hansenPortalVector G n
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 1 < n := w.one_lt
  have h01 : hansenPortalVector G 0 ≤ hansenPortalVector G 1 :=
    hansenPortalVector_le_succ hG hSquare (by omega)
  have h12 : hansenPortalVector G 1 < hansenPortalVector G 2 :=
    hansenPortalVector_one_lt_two_of_exposedSquare hG hSquare w
  have h2n : hansenPortalVector G 2 ≤ hansenPortalVector G n := by
    apply hansenPortalVector_monoOn_support hG hSquare
    · exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
    · exact ⟨by omega, le_rfl⟩
    · omega
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt h01 (lt_of_lt_of_le h12 h2n)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenPortalVector_zero_lt_top_of_noncomplete_cograph
statement:
theorem hansenPortalVector_zero_lt_top_of_noncomplete_cograph
    {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G)
      (Fintype.card V + 3))
    (hcograph : IsCograph G)
    (hexposed : NonedgeExposesPositiveSquare G hG)
    (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    hansenPortalVector G 0 <
      hansenPortalVector G (Fintype.card V)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hnadj⟩ :=
    SimpleGraph.ne_top_iff_exists_not_adj.mp hne
  let ⟨w⟩ := hexposed i j hij hnadj
  have hSquare : PairedPositivePortalSquare G :=
    pairedPositivePortalSquare_of_rankTwoDiamond G
      (rankTwoDiamond_of_isCograph G hcograph)
  exact hansenPortalVector_zero_lt_top_of_exposedSquare hG hSquare w

name: HansenCograph.RankTwoDiamond.prod
statement:
theorem prod {P : Type u} {Q : Type v} [PartialOrder P] [PartialOrder Q]
    (hP : RankTwoDiamond P) (hQ : RankTwoDiamond Q) :
    RankTwoDiamond (P × Q)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c hab hbc
  rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hab with habP | habQ
  · rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hbc with hbcP | hbcQ
    · obtain ⟨p, hp, hp_unique⟩ := hP habP.1 hbcP.1
      refine ⟨(p, a.2), ?_, ?_⟩
      · constructor
        · exact Prod.covBy_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨hp.1, rfl⟩)
        constructor
        · exact Prod.covBy_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨hp.2.1,
            habP.2.trans hbcP.2⟩)
        · intro h
          apply hp.2.2
          exact congrArg Prod.fst h
      · intro x hx
        rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hx.1 with haxP | haxQ
        · rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hx.2.1 with hxcP | hxcQ
          · have hx_ne : x.1 ≠ b.1 := by
              intro hxb
              apply hx.2.2
              apply Prod.ext hxb
              exact haxP.2.symm.trans habP.2
            have hxp : x.1 = p := hp_unique x.1
              ⟨haxP.1, hxcP.1, hx_ne⟩
            apply Prod.ext hxp
            exact haxP.2.symm
          · have hac : a.2 = c.2 := habP.2.trans hbcP.2
            exact False.elim (hxcQ.1.ne
              (haxP.2.symm.trans hac))
        · rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hx.2.1 with hxcP | hxcQ
          · have hac : a.2 = c.2 := habP.2.trans hbcP.2
            exact False.elim (haxQ.1.ne (hxcP.2.trans hac.symm).symm)
          · have hac : a.1 = c.1 := haxQ.2.trans hxcQ.2
            exact False.elim ((lt_trans habP.1.lt hbcP.1.lt).ne hac)
    · refine ⟨(a.1, c.2), ?_, ?_⟩
      · constructor
        · exact Prod.covBy_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨habP.2.symm ▸ hbcQ.1, rfl⟩)
        constructor
        · exact Prod.covBy_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨hbcQ.2 ▸ habP.1, rfl⟩)
        · intro h
          have hfirst : a.1 = b.1 := by
            simpa using congrArg (fun z : P × Q ↦ z.1) h
          exact habP.1.ne hfirst
      · intro x hx
        rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hx.1 with haxP | haxQ
        · rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hx.2.1 with hxcP | hxcQ
          · have hac : a.2 = c.2 := haxP.2.trans hxcP.2
            exact False.elim (hbcQ.1.ne
              (habP.2.symm.trans hac))
          · exact False.elim (hx.2.2 (Prod.ext
              (hxcQ.2.trans hbcQ.2.symm)
              (haxP.2.symm.trans habP.2)))
        · rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hx.2.1 with hxcP | hxcQ
          · apply Prod.ext <;> simp only
            · exact haxQ.2.symm
            · exact hxcP.2
          · have hac : a.1 = c.1 := haxQ.2.trans hxcQ.2
            exact False.elim (habP.1.ne (hac.trans hbcQ.2.symm))
  · rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hbc with hbcP | hbcQ
    · refine ⟨(c.1, a.2), ?_, ?_⟩
      · constructor
        · exact Prod.covBy_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨habQ.2.symm ▸ hbcP.1, rfl⟩)
        constructor
        · exact Prod.covBy_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hbcP.2 ▸ habQ.1, rfl⟩)
        · intro h
          have hsecond : a.2 = b.2 := by
            simpa using congrArg (fun z : P × Q ↦ z.2) h
          exact habQ.1.ne hsecond
      · intro x hx
        rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hx.1 with haxP | haxQ
        · rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hx.2.1 with hxcP | hxcQ
          · have hac : a.2 = c.2 := haxP.2.trans hxcP.2
            exact False.elim (habQ.1.ne (hac.trans hbcP.2.symm))
          · apply Prod.ext <;> simp only
            · exact hxcQ.2
            · exact haxP.2.symm
        · rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hx.2.1 with hxcP | hxcQ
          · exact False.elim (hx.2.2 (Prod.ext
              (haxQ.2.symm.trans habQ.2)
              (hxcP.2.trans hbcP.2.symm)))
          · have hac : a.1 = c.1 := haxQ.2.trans hxcQ.2
            exact False.elim (hbcP.1.ne
              (habQ.2.symm.trans hac))
    · obtain ⟨q, hq, hq_unique⟩ := hQ habQ.1 hbcQ.1
      refine ⟨(a.1, q), ?_, ?_⟩
      · constructor
        · exact Prod.covBy_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hq.1, rfl⟩)
        constructor
        · exact Prod.covBy_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hq.2.1,
            habQ.2.trans hbcQ.2⟩)
        · intro h
          apply hq.2.2
          exact congrArg Prod.snd h
      · intro x hx
        rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hx.1 with haxP | haxQ
        · rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hx.2.1 with hxcP | hxcQ
          · have hac : a.2 = c.2 := haxP.2.trans hxcP.2
            exact False.elim ((lt_trans habQ.1.lt hbcQ.1.lt).ne hac)
          · have hac : a.1 = c.1 := habQ.2.trans hbcQ.2
            exact False.elim (haxP.1.ne (hxcQ.2.trans hac.symm).symm)
        · rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hx.2.1 with hxcP | hxcQ
          · have hac : a.1 = c.1 := habQ.2.trans hbcQ.2
            exact False.elim (hxcP.1.ne
              (haxQ.2.symm.trans hac))
          · have hx_ne : x.2 ≠ b.2 := by
              intro hxb
              apply hx.2.2
              apply Prod.ext
              · exact haxQ.2.symm.trans habQ.2
              · exact hxb
            have hxq : x.2 = q := hq_unique x.2
              ⟨haxQ.1, hxcQ.1, hx_ne⟩
            apply Prod.ext <;> simp only
            · exact haxQ.2.symm
            · exact hxq

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenJoinFaceEquiv_le_iff_local
statement:
private theorem hansenJoinFaceEquiv_le_iff_local
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (C D : AbstractJoinFace A B) :
    hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B C ≤ hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B D ↔ C ≤ D
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hansenJoinFaceEquiv] using
    incidenceClosedTransportSurjEquiv_le_iff
      (signedJoinIncidence
        (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
        (signB := fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1)
        (hansenLabelIncidence A) (hansenLabelIncidence B))
      (hansenLabelIncidence (A ⊗g B))
      (joinVertexLabelMap A B) (joinFacetLabelEquiv A B)
      (joinVertexLabelMap_surjective A B)
      (fun vertex facet ↦ hansenLabelIncidence_join_map A B vertex facet) C D

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rootedNeg_left_projection_local
statement:
private theorem rootedNeg_left_projection_local
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (F : RootedNeg A) (K : RootedNeg B) :
    joinFacetProjLeft
        (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
        (signB := fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1)
        (sameSignFacetProduct
          (F.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A))
          (K.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B))) = (F.1 : Set _)
proof:
:= by
  apply joinFacetProjLeft_sameSignFacetProduct_eq
  intro facet hfacet
  rcases K.2.carrier_nonempty with ⟨other, hother⟩
  exact ⟨other, hother, by rw [F.2.facet_sign hfacet, K.2.facet_sign hother]⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rootedNeg_right_projection_local
statement:
private theorem rootedNeg_right_projection_local
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (F : RootedNeg A) (K : RootedNeg B) :
    joinFacetProjRight
        (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
        (signB := fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1)
        (sameSignFacetProduct
          (F.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A))
          (K.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B))) = (K.1 : Set _)
proof:
:= by
  apply joinFacetProjRight_sameSignFacetProduct_eq
  intro facet hfacet
  rcases F.2.carrier_nonempty with ⟨other, hother⟩
  exact ⟨other, hother, by rw [F.2.facet_sign hother, K.2.facet_sign hfacet]⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.neutral_left_projection_local
statement:
private theorem neutral_left_projection_local
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (F : NeutralOrEmpty A) (K : NeutralOrEmpty B) :
    joinFacetProjLeft
        (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
        (signB := fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1)
        (sameSignFacetProduct (F.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A))
          (K.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B))) = (F.1 : Set _)
proof:
:= by
  apply joinFacetProjLeft_sameSignFacetProduct_eq
  intro facet hfacet
  rcases K.2.exists_facet_sign facet.1 with ⟨other, hother, hs⟩
  exact ⟨other, hother, hs.symm⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.neutral_right_projection_local
statement:
private theorem neutral_right_projection_local
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (F : NeutralOrEmpty A) (K : NeutralOrEmpty B) :
    joinFacetProjRight
        (signA := fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
        (signB := fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1)
        (sameSignFacetProduct (F.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A))
          (K.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B))) = (K.1 : Set _)
proof:
:= by
  apply joinFacetProjRight_sameSignFacetProduct_eq
  intro facet hfacet
  rcases F.2.exists_facet_sign facet.1 with ⟨other, hother, hs⟩
  exact ⟨other, hother, hs⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinRootedNeg_le_iff
statement:
theorem joinRootedNeg_le_iff
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (F₁ F₂ : RootedNeg A) (K₁ K₂ : RootedNeg B) :
    joinRootedNeg A B F₁ K₁ ≤ joinRootedNeg A B F₂ K₂ ↔
      F₁.1 ≤ F₂.1 ∧ K₁.1 ≤ K₂.1
proof:
:= by
  change hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B _ ≤ hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B _ ↔ _
  rw [hansenJoinFaceEquiv_le_iff_local]
  change sameSignFacetProduct
      (F₂.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) (K₂.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) ⊆
      sameSignFacetProduct
        (F₁.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) (K₁.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) ↔
    (F₂.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) ⊆ (F₁.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) ∧
      (K₂.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) ⊆ (K₁.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B))
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · rw [← rootedNeg_left_projection_local A B F₂ K₂,
          ← rootedNeg_left_projection_local A B F₁ K₁]
      exact Set.image_mono h
    · rw [← rootedNeg_right_projection_local A B F₂ K₂,
          ← rootedNeg_right_projection_local A B F₁ K₁]
      exact Set.image_mono h
  · rintro ⟨hF, hK⟩ facet hfacet
    exact ⟨hF hfacet.1, hK hfacet.2⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinNeutral_le_joinRootedNeg_iff
statement:
theorem joinNeutral_le_joinRootedNeg_iff
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (E : NeutralOrEmpty A) (L : NeutralOrEmpty B)
    (F : RootedNeg A) (K : RootedNeg B) :
    joinNeutral A B E L ≤ joinRootedNeg A B F K ↔
      E.1 ≤ F.1 ∧ L.1 ≤ K.1
proof:
:= by
  change hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B _ ≤ hansenJoinFaceEquiv A B _ ↔ _
  rw [hansenJoinFaceEquiv_le_iff_local]
  change sameSignFacetProduct
      (F.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) (K.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) ⊆
      sameSignFacetProduct
        (E.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) (L.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) ↔
    (F.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) ⊆ (E.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel A)) ∧
      (K.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B)) ⊆ (L.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel B))
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · rw [← rootedNeg_left_projection_local A B F K,
          ← neutral_left_projection_local A B E L]
      exact Set.image_mono h
    · rw [← rootedNeg_right_projection_local A B F K,
          ← neutral_right_projection_local A B E L]
      exact Set.image_mono h
  · rintro ⟨hF, hK⟩ facet hfacet
    exact ⟨hF hfacet.1, hK hfacet.2⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsRootedNeg.ne_top_local
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hF.2
  rw [h]
  exact containsVertex_top G _

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsRootedNeg.not_isRootedPos_local
statement:
theorem IsRootedNeg.not_isRootedPos_local
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {F : HansenCombinatorialFace G} (hF : F.IsRootedNeg) :
    ¬F.IsRootedPos
proof:
:= by
  intro hpos
  exact hF.2 hpos.1

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsRootedNeg.lower_strata_local
statement:
theorem IsRootedNeg.lower_strata_local
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {F X : HansenCombinatorialFace G} (hF : F.IsRootedNeg) (hXF : X ≤ F) :
    X.IsRootedNeg ∨ X.IsNeutralOrEmpty
proof:
:= by
  rcases strata_cases G X with htop | hpos | hneg | hneutral
  · exfalso
    apply hF.ne_top_local
    rw [htop] at hXF
    exact top_unique hXF
  · exfalso
    exact hF.2 (hpos.1.mono hXF)
  · exact Or.inl hneg
  · exact Or.inr hneutral

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsRootedNeg.upper_of_ne_top_local
statement:
theorem IsRootedNeg.upper_of_ne_top_local
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {F X : HansenCombinatorialFace G} (hF : F.IsRootedNeg)
    (hFX : F ≤ X) (hX : X ≠ top G) : X.IsRootedNeg
proof:
:= by
  rcases strata_cases G X with htop | hpos | hneg | hneutral
  · exact False.elim (hX htop)
  · exfalso
    exact hpos.2 (hF.1.mono hFX)
  · exact hneg
  · exfalso
    exact hneutral.2 (hF.1.mono hFX)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinRootedNegMap_bijective
statement:
theorem joinRootedNegMap_bijective
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W) :
    Function.Bijective (joinRootedNegMap A B)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro p q h
    apply joinRootedNeg_pair_injective A B
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h
  · intro X
    let code := (joinFaceCodeEquiv A B).symm X.1
    have hrepr : joinFaceCodeToFace A B code = X.1 :=
      (joinFaceCodeEquiv A B).apply_symm_apply X.1
    rcases code with unit | code
    · change top (A ⊗g B) = X.1 at hrepr
      exact False.elim (X.2.ne_top_local hrepr.symm)
    · rcases code with pair | code
      · change joinRootedPos A B pair.1 pair.2 = X.1 at hrepr
        exfalso
        apply X.2.not_isRootedPos_local
        rw [← hrepr]
        exact joinRootedPos_isRootedPos A B pair.1 pair.2
      · rcases code with pair | pair
        · exact ⟨pair, Subtype.ext hrepr⟩
        · change joinNeutral A B pair.1 pair.2 = X.1 at hrepr
          exfalso
          apply X.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty
          rw [← hrepr]
          exact joinNeutral_isNeutralOrEmpty A B pair.1 pair.2

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinNegativePortal_covBy_iff
statement:
theorem joinNegativePortal_covBy_iff
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (E : NeutralOrEmpty A) (L : NeutralOrEmpty B)
    (F : RootedNeg A) (K : RootedNeg B) :
    joinNeutral A B E L ⋖ joinRootedNeg A B F K ↔
      E.1 ⋖ F.1 ∧ L.1 ⋖ K.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hjoin
    have hcomp := (joinNeutral_le_joinRootedNeg_iff A B E L F K).mp hjoin.le
    constructor
    · apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
      · exact lt_of_le_of_ne hcomp.1 (fun h ↦ F.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty
          (h.symm ▸ E.2))
      · intro X hEX hXF
        rcases F.2.lower_strata_local hXF with hXneg | hXneutral
        · let Xneg : RootedNeg A := ⟨X, hXneg⟩
          have hlower : joinNeutral A B E L ≤ joinRootedNeg A B Xneg K :=
            (joinNeutral_le_joinRootedNeg_iff A B E L Xneg K).mpr
              ⟨hEX, hcomp.2⟩
          have hupper : joinRootedNeg A B Xneg K ≤ joinRootedNeg A B F K :=
            (joinRootedNeg_le_iff A B Xneg F K K).mpr ⟨hXF, le_rfl⟩
          rcases hjoin.eq_or_eq hlower hupper with heq | heq
          · exact False.elim ((joinRootedNeg_isRootedNeg A B Xneg K).not_isNeutralOrEmpty
              (heq ▸ joinNeutral_isNeutralOrEmpty A B E L))
          · right
            have hp : (Xneg, K) = (F, K) :=
              joinRootedNeg_pair_injective A B heq
            simpa only [Xneg] using congrArg
              (fun pair : RootedNeg A × RootedNeg B ↦ pair.1.1) hp
        · let Xneutral : NeutralOrEmpty A := ⟨X, hXneutral⟩
          have hlower : joinNeutral A B E L ≤ joinNeutral A B Xneutral L :=
            (joinNeutral_le_iff A B E Xneutral L L).mpr ⟨hEX, le_rfl⟩
          have hupper : joinNeutral A B Xneutral L ≤ joinRootedNeg A B F K :=
            (joinNeutral_le_joinRootedNeg_iff A B Xneutral L F K).mpr
              ⟨hXF, hcomp.2⟩
          rcases hjoin.eq_or_eq hlower hupper with heq | heq
          · left
            have hp : (Xneutral, L) = (E, L) :=
              joinNeutral_pair_injective A B heq
            simpa only [Xneutral] using congrArg
              (fun pair : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B ↦ pair.1.1) hp
          · exact False.elim ((joinRootedNeg_isRootedNeg A B F K).not_isNeutralOrEmpty
              (heq.symm ▸ joinNeutral_isNeutralOrEmpty A B Xneutral L))
    · apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
      · exact lt_of_le_of_ne hcomp.2 (fun h ↦ K.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty
          (h.symm ▸ L.2))
      · intro X hLX hXK
        rcases K.2.lower_strata_local hXK with hXneg | hXneutral
        · let Xneg : RootedNeg B := ⟨X, hXneg⟩
          have hlower : joinNeutral A B E L ≤ joinRootedNeg A B F Xneg :=
            (joinNeutral_le_joinRootedNeg_iff A B E L F Xneg).mpr
              ⟨hcomp.1, hLX⟩
          have hupper : joinRootedNeg A B F Xneg ≤ joinRootedNeg A B F K :=
            (joinRootedNeg_le_iff A B F F Xneg K).mpr ⟨le_rfl, hXK⟩
          rcases hjoin.eq_or_eq hlower hupper with heq | heq
          · exact False.elim ((joinRootedNeg_isRootedNeg A B F Xneg).not_isNeutralOrEmpty
              (heq ▸ joinNeutral_isNeutralOrEmpty A B E L))
          · right
            have hp : (F, Xneg) = (F, K) :=
              joinRootedNeg_pair_injective A B heq
            simpa only [Xneg] using congrArg
              (fun pair : RootedNeg A × RootedNeg B ↦ pair.2.1) hp
        · let Xneutral : NeutralOrEmpty B := ⟨X, hXneutral⟩
          have hlower : joinNeutral A B E L ≤ joinNeutral A B E Xneutral :=
            (joinNeutral_le_iff A B E E L Xneutral).mpr ⟨le_rfl, hLX⟩
          have hupper : joinNeutral A B E Xneutral ≤ joinRootedNeg A B F K :=
            (joinNeutral_le_joinRootedNeg_iff A B E Xneutral F K).mpr
              ⟨hcomp.1, hXK⟩
          rcases hjoin.eq_or_eq hlower hupper with heq | heq
          · left
            have hp : (E, Xneutral) = (E, L) :=
              joinNeutral_pair_injective A B heq
            simpa only [Xneutral] using congrArg
              (fun pair : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B ↦ pair.2.1) hp
          · exact False.elim ((joinRootedNeg_isRootedNeg A B F K).not_isNeutralOrEmpty
              (heq.symm ▸ joinNeutral_isNeutralOrEmpty A B E Xneutral))
  · rintro ⟨hEF, hLK⟩
    apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
    · exact lt_of_le_of_ne
        ((joinNeutral_le_joinRootedNeg_iff A B E L F K).mpr
          ⟨hEF.le, hLK.le⟩)
        (fun h ↦ (joinRootedNeg_isRootedNeg A B F K).not_isNeutralOrEmpty
          (h.symm ▸ joinNeutral_isNeutralOrEmpty A B E L))
    · intro X hlower hupper
      rcases (joinRootedNeg_isRootedNeg A B F K).lower_strata_local hupper with
          hXneg | hXneutral
      · let Xneg : RootedNeg (A ⊗g B) := ⟨X, hXneg⟩
        let eR := joinRootedNegOrderIso A B
        let x : RootedNeg A × RootedNeg B := eR.symm Xneg
        have hXrep : joinRootedNeg A B x.1 x.2 = X :=
          congrArg Subtype.val (eR.apply_symm_apply Xneg)
        have hl := (joinNeutral_le_joinRootedNeg_iff A B E L x.1 x.2).mp
          (by simpa only [hXrep] using hlower)
        have hu := (joinRootedNeg_le_iff A B x.1 F x.2 K).mp
          (by simpa only [hXrep] using hupper)
        have hxF := hEF.eq_or_eq hl.1 hu.1
        have hxK := hLK.eq_or_eq hl.2 hu.2
        rcases hxF with hxF | hxF
        · exact False.elim (x.1.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (hxF.symm ▸ E.2))
        · rcases hxK with hxK | hxK
          · exact False.elim (x.2.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (hxK.symm ▸ L.2))
          · right
            rw [← hXrep]
            congr 2
            · exact Subtype.ext hxF
            · exact Subtype.ext hxK
      · let Xneutral : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B) := ⟨X, hXneutral⟩
        let eN := joinNeutralOrderIso A B
        let x : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B := eN.symm Xneutral
        have hXrep : joinNeutral A B x.1 x.2 = X :=
          congrArg Subtype.val (eN.apply_symm_apply Xneutral)
        have hl := (joinNeutral_le_iff A B E x.1 L x.2).mp
          (by simpa only [hXrep] using hlower)
        have hu := (joinNeutral_le_joinRootedNeg_iff A B x.1 x.2 F K).mp
          (by simpa only [hXrep] using hupper)
        have hxE := hEF.eq_or_eq hl.1 hu.1
        have hxL := hLK.eq_or_eq hl.2 hu.2
        rcases hxE with hxE | hxE
        · rcases hxL with hxL | hxL
          · left
            rw [← hXrep]
            congr 2
            · exact Subtype.ext hxE
            · exact Subtype.ext hxL
          · exact False.elim (K.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (hxL.symm ▸ x.2.2))
        · exact False.elim (F.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (hxE.symm ▸ x.1.2))

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.faceInf_le_left
statement:
theorem faceInf_le_left {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (F K : HansenCombinatorialFace G) :
    faceInf F K ≤ F
proof:
:= by
  intro facet hfacet
  exact subset_incidenceClosure _ _ (Or.inl hfacet)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.faceInf_le_right
statement:
theorem faceInf_le_right {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (F K : HansenCombinatorialFace G) :
    faceInf F K ≤ K
proof:
:= by
  intro facet hfacet
  exact subset_incidenceClosure _ _ (Or.inr hfacet)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.le_faceInf
proof:
:= by
  change incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence G)
      ((F : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)) ∪ K) ⊆ (E : Set _)
  have hunion :
      ((F : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)) ∪ (K : Set (HansenFacetLabel G))) ⊆
        (E : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)) := by
    exact Set.union_subset hEF hEK
  have hmono := incidenceClosure_mono (hansenLabelIncidence G) hunion
  have hclosed : incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence G)
      (E : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)) = (E : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)) :=
    E.isClosed
  rw [hclosed] at hmono
  exact hmono

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.faceInf_containsVertex
statement:
theorem faceInf_containsVertex {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {F K : HansenCombinatorialFace G}
    {vertex : HansenVertexLabel G} (hF : F.ContainsVertex vertex)
    (hK : K.ContainsVertex vertex) :
    (faceInf F K).ContainsVertex vertex
proof:
:= by
  change vertex ∈ incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G)
    (incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence G)
      ((F : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)) ∪ K))
  rw [incidenceModels_incidenceClosure_eq]
  intro facet hfacet
  rcases hfacet with hfacet | hfacet
  · exact hF facet hfacet
  · exact hK facet hfacet

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.neutral_not_covBy_top
statement:
theorem neutral_not_covBy_top {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (E : NeutralOrEmpty G) : ¬E.1 ⋖ top G
proof:
:= by
  intro hEtop
  have hupper : (positiveRootExtension E).1 ≤ top G := le_top
  rcases hEtop.eq_or_eq (le_positiveRootExtension E) hupper with heq | heq
  · exact (lt_positiveRootExtension E).ne heq.symm
  · exact (positiveRootExtension E).2.ne_top heq

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinRootedPos_covBy_iff_product
statement:
theorem joinRootedPos_covBy_iff_product
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (F₁ F₂ : RootedPos A) (K₁ K₂ : RootedPos B) :
    joinRootedPos A B F₁ K₁ ⋖ joinRootedPos A B F₂ K₂ ↔
      (F₁, K₁) ⋖ (F₂, K₂)
proof:
:= by
  let X : RootedPos (A ⊗g B) := ⟨joinRootedPos A B F₁ K₁,
    joinRootedPos_isRootedPos A B F₁ K₁⟩
  let Y : RootedPos (A ⊗g B) := ⟨joinRootedPos A B F₂ K₂,
    joinRootedPos_isRootedPos A B F₂ K₂⟩
  calc
    X.1 ⋖ Y.1 ↔ X ⋖ Y := rootedPos_covBy_val_iff X Y
    _ ↔ (F₁, K₁) ⋖ (F₂, K₂) := by
      change (joinRootedPosOrderIso A B) (F₁, K₁) ⋖
        (joinRootedPosOrderIso A B) (F₂, K₂) ↔ _
      exact apply_covBy_apply_iff (joinRootedPosOrderIso A B)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinNeutral_covBy_iff_product
statement:
theorem joinNeutral_covBy_iff_product
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (E₁ E₂ : NeutralOrEmpty A) (L₁ L₂ : NeutralOrEmpty B) :
    joinNeutral A B E₁ L₁ ⋖ joinNeutral A B E₂ L₂ ↔
      (E₁, L₁) ⋖ (E₂, L₂)
proof:
:= by
  let X : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B) := ⟨joinNeutral A B E₁ L₁,
    joinNeutral_isNeutralOrEmpty A B E₁ L₁⟩
  let Y : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B) := ⟨joinNeutral A B E₂ L₂,
    joinNeutral_isNeutralOrEmpty A B E₂ L₂⟩
  calc
    X.1 ⋖ Y.1 ↔ X ⋖ Y := neutral_covBy_val_iff X Y
    _ ↔ (E₁, L₁) ⋖ (E₂, L₂) := by
      change (joinNeutralOrderIso A B) (E₁, L₁) ⋖
        (joinNeutralOrderIso A B) (E₂, L₂) ↔ _
      exact apply_covBy_apply_iff (joinNeutralOrderIso A B)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rootedNeg_covBy_val_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.1, fun X hFX hXH ↦ h.2 hFX hXH⟩
  · intro h
    apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
    · exact h.1
    · intro X hFX hXH
      have hXtop : X ≠ top G := by
        intro htop
        apply H.2.ne_top_local
        rw [htop] at hXH
        exact top_unique hXH
      let X' : RootedNeg G := ⟨X, F.2.upper_of_ne_top_local hFX hXtop⟩
      rcases h.eq_or_eq (show F ≤ X' from hFX) (show X' ≤ H from hXH) with hXF | hXH'
      · exact Or.inl (congrArg Subtype.val hXF)
      · exact Or.inr (congrArg Subtype.val hXH')

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinRootedNeg_covBy_iff_product
statement:
theorem joinRootedNeg_covBy_iff_product
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (F₁ F₂ : RootedNeg A) (K₁ K₂ : RootedNeg B) :
    joinRootedNeg A B F₁ K₁ ⋖ joinRootedNeg A B F₂ K₂ ↔
      (F₁, K₁) ⋖ (F₂, K₂)
proof:
:= by
  let X : RootedNeg (A ⊗g B) := ⟨joinRootedNeg A B F₁ K₁,
    joinRootedNeg_isRootedNeg A B F₁ K₁⟩
  let Y : RootedNeg (A ⊗g B) := ⟨joinRootedNeg A B F₂ K₂,
    joinRootedNeg_isRootedNeg A B F₂ K₂⟩
  calc
    X.1 ⋖ Y.1 ↔ X ⋖ Y := rootedNeg_covBy_val_iff X Y
    _ ↔ (F₁, K₁) ⋖ (F₂, K₂) := by
      change (joinRootedNegOrderIso A B) (F₁, K₁) ⋖
        (joinRootedNegOrderIso A B) (F₂, K₂) ↔ _
      exact apply_covBy_apply_iff (joinRootedNegOrderIso A B)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinRootedPos_covBy_top_iff
statement:
theorem joinRootedPos_covBy_top_iff
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (F : RootedPos A) (K : RootedPos B) :
    joinRootedPos A B F K ⋖ top (A ⊗g B) ↔
      F.1 ⋖ top A ∧ K.1 ⋖ top B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hjoin
    constructor
    · apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
      · exact lt_of_le_of_ne le_top F.2.ne_top
      · intro X hFX hXtop
        by_cases hX : X = top A
        · exact Or.inr hX
        · let Xpos : RootedPos A := ⟨X, F.2.upper_of_ne_top hFX hX⟩
          have hlower : joinRootedPos A B F K ≤
              joinRootedPos A B Xpos K :=
            (joinRootedPos_le_iff A B F Xpos K K).mpr ⟨hFX, le_rfl⟩
          have hupper : joinRootedPos A B Xpos K ≤ top (A ⊗g B) := le_top
          rcases hjoin.eq_or_eq hlower hupper with heq | heq
          · left
            have hpairs : (F, K) = (Xpos, K) :=
              joinRootedPos_pair_injective A B heq.symm
            simpa only [Xpos] using congrArg
              (fun pair : RootedPos A × RootedPos B ↦ pair.1.1) hpairs.symm
          · exact False.elim
              ((joinRootedPos_isRootedPos A B Xpos K).ne_top heq)
    · apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
      · exact lt_of_le_of_ne le_top K.2.ne_top
      · intro X hKX hXtop
        by_cases hX : X = top B
        · exact Or.inr hX
        · let Xpos : RootedPos B := ⟨X, K.2.upper_of_ne_top hKX hX⟩
          have hlower : joinRootedPos A B F K ≤
              joinRootedPos A B F Xpos :=
            (joinRootedPos_le_iff A B F F K Xpos).mpr ⟨le_rfl, hKX⟩
          have hupper : joinRootedPos A B F Xpos ≤ top (A ⊗g B) := le_top
          rcases hjoin.eq_or_eq hlower hupper with heq | heq
          · left
            have hpairs : (F, K) = (F, Xpos) :=
              joinRootedPos_pair_injective A B heq.symm
            simpa only [Xpos] using congrArg
              (fun pair : RootedPos A × RootedPos B ↦ pair.2.1) hpairs.symm
          · exact False.elim
              ((joinRootedPos_isRootedPos A B F Xpos).ne_top heq)
  · rintro ⟨hF, hK⟩
    apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
    · exact lt_of_le_of_ne le_top
        (joinRootedPos_isRootedPos A B F K).ne_top
    · intro X hlower hupper
      by_cases hX : X = top (A ⊗g B)
      · exact Or.inr hX
      · let Xpos : RootedPos (A ⊗g B) :=
          ⟨X, (joinRootedPos_isRootedPos A B F K).upper_of_ne_top hlower hX⟩
        let eP := joinRootedPosOrderIso A B
        let x : RootedPos A × RootedPos B := eP.symm Xpos
        have hXrep : joinRootedPos A B x.1 x.2 = X := by
          exact congrArg Subtype.val (eP.apply_symm_apply Xpos)
        have hcomp : F.1 ≤ x.1.1 ∧ K.1 ≤ x.2.1 := by
          apply (joinRootedPos_le_iff A B F x.1 K x.2).mp
          simpa only [hXrep] using hlower
        have hxF : x.1 = F := by
          rcases hF.eq_or_eq hcomp.1 le_top with heq | heq
          · exact Subtype.ext heq
          · exact False.elim (x.1.2.ne_top heq)
        have hxK : x.2 = K := by
          rcases hK.eq_or_eq hcomp.2 le_top with heq | heq
          · exact Subtype.ext heq
          · exact False.elim (x.2.2.ne_top heq)
        left
        rw [← hXrep, hxF, hxK]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.joinRootedNeg_covBy_top_iff
statement:
theorem joinRootedNeg_covBy_top_iff
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (F : RootedNeg A) (K : RootedNeg B) :
    joinRootedNeg A B F K ⋖ top (A ⊗g B) ↔
      F.1 ⋖ top A ∧ K.1 ⋖ top B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hjoin
    constructor
    · apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
      · exact lt_of_le_of_ne le_top F.2.ne_top_local
      · intro X hFX hXtop
        by_cases hX : X = top A
        · exact Or.inr hX
        · let Xneg : RootedNeg A := ⟨X, F.2.upper_of_ne_top_local hFX hX⟩
          have hlower : joinRootedNeg A B F K ≤
              joinRootedNeg A B Xneg K :=
            (joinRootedNeg_le_iff A B F Xneg K K).mpr ⟨hFX, le_rfl⟩
          rcases hjoin.eq_or_eq hlower le_top with heq | heq
          · left
            have hpairs : (F, K) = (Xneg, K) :=
              joinRootedNeg_pair_injective A B heq.symm
            simpa only [Xneg] using congrArg
              (fun pair : RootedNeg A × RootedNeg B ↦ pair.1.1) hpairs.symm
          · exact False.elim
              ((joinRootedNeg_isRootedNeg A B Xneg K).ne_top_local heq)
    · apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
      · exact lt_of_le_of_ne le_top K.2.ne_top_local
      · intro X hKX hXtop
        by_cases hX : X = top B
        · exact Or.inr hX
        · let Xneg : RootedNeg B := ⟨X, K.2.upper_of_ne_top_local hKX hX⟩
          have hlower : joinRootedNeg A B F K ≤
              joinRootedNeg A B F Xneg :=
            (joinRootedNeg_le_iff A B F F K Xneg).mpr ⟨le_rfl, hKX⟩
          rcases hjoin.eq_or_eq hlower le_top with heq | heq
          · left
            have hpairs : (F, K) = (F, Xneg) :=
              joinRootedNeg_pair_injective A B heq.symm
            simpa only [Xneg] using congrArg
              (fun pair : RootedNeg A × RootedNeg B ↦ pair.2.1) hpairs.symm
          · exact False.elim
              ((joinRootedNeg_isRootedNeg A B F Xneg).ne_top_local heq)
  · rintro ⟨hF, hK⟩
    apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
    · exact lt_of_le_of_ne le_top
        (joinRootedNeg_isRootedNeg A B F K).ne_top_local
    · intro X hlower hupper
      by_cases hX : X = top (A ⊗g B)
      · exact Or.inr hX
      · let Xneg : RootedNeg (A ⊗g B) :=
          ⟨X, (joinRootedNeg_isRootedNeg A B F K).upper_of_ne_top_local hlower hX⟩
        let eN := joinRootedNegOrderIso A B
        let x : RootedNeg A × RootedNeg B := eN.symm Xneg
        have hXrep : joinRootedNeg A B x.1 x.2 = X := by
          exact congrArg Subtype.val (eN.apply_symm_apply Xneg)
        have hcomp : F.1 ≤ x.1.1 ∧ K.1 ≤ x.2.1 := by
          apply (joinRootedNeg_le_iff A B F x.1 K x.2).mp
          simpa only [hXrep] using hlower
        have hxF : x.1 = F := by
          rcases hF.eq_or_eq hcomp.1 le_top with heq | heq
          · exact Subtype.ext heq
          · exact False.elim (x.1.2.ne_top_local heq)
        have hxK : x.2 = K := by
          rcases hK.eq_or_eq hcomp.2 le_top with heq | heq
          · exact Subtype.ext heq
          · exact False.elim (x.2.2.ne_top_local heq)
        left
        rw [← hXrep, hxF, hxK]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.lower_containsVertex_of_distinct_middles
statement:
theorem lower_containsVertex_of_distinct_middles
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {E F K H : HansenCombinatorialFace G} {vertex : HansenVertexLabel G}
    (hEF : E ⋖ F) (hFH : F ⋖ H)
    (hEK : E ⋖ K) (hKH : K ⋖ H) (hne : K ≠ F)
    (hFvertex : F.ContainsVertex vertex)
    (hKvertex : K.ContainsVertex vertex) : E.ContainsVertex vertex
proof:
:= by
  have hEinf : E ≤ faceInf F K := le_faceInf hEF.le hEK.le
  have hinfF : faceInf F K ≤ F := faceInf_le_left F K
  have hinf_eq : faceInf F K = E := by
    rcases hEF.eq_or_eq hEinf hinfF with hinfE | hinfF'
    · exact hinfE
    · exfalso
      have hFK : F ≤ K := by
        rw [← hinfF']
        exact faceInf_le_right F K
      rcases hEK.eq_or_eq hEF.le hFK with hFE | hFK'
      · exact hEF.lt.ne hFE.symm
      · exact hne hFK'.symm
  rw [← hinf_eq]
  exact faceInf_containsVertex hFvertex hKvertex

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.pairedPositivePortalSquare_of_rankTwoDiamond
statement:
theorem pairedPositivePortalSquare_of_rankTwoDiamond
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hG : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace G)) :
    PairedPositivePortalSquare G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro E F H hEF hFH
    obtain ⟨K, hK, hK_unique⟩ := hG hEF hFH
    have hKneutral : K.IsNeutralOrEmpty := by
      rcases H.2.lower_strata hK.2.1.le with hKpos | hKneutral
      · exfalso
        exact E.2.1 (lower_containsVertex_of_distinct_middles
          hEF hFH hK.1 hK.2.1 hK.2.2 F.2.1 hKpos.1)
      · exact hKneutral
    let Kneutral : NeutralOrEmpty G := ⟨K, hKneutral⟩
    refine ⟨Kneutral, ⟨hK.1, hK.2.1⟩, ?_⟩
    intro L hL
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply hK_unique L.1
    exact ⟨hL.1, hL.2, fun h ↦ F.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (h ▸ L.2)⟩
  · intro E F H hEF hFH
    obtain ⟨K, hK, hK_unique⟩ := hG hEF hFH
    have hKneutral : K.IsNeutralOrEmpty := by
      rcases H.2.lower_strata hK.2.1.le with hKpos | hKneutral
      · exfalso
        exact E.2.1 (lower_containsVertex_of_distinct_middles
          hEF hFH hK.1 hK.2.1 hK.2.2 F.2.1 hKpos.1)
      · exact hKneutral
    intro F' hF'
    by_cases heq : F'.1 = F.1
    · exact Subtype.ext heq
    · have hFK : F'.1 = K := hK_unique F'.1
        ⟨hF'.1, hF'.2, heq⟩
      exfalso
      exact F'.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (hFK ▸ hKneutral)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rankTwoDiamond_neutral
statement:
theorem rankTwoDiamond_neutral
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hG : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace G)) :
    RankTwoDiamond (NeutralOrEmpty G)
proof:
:= by

    ((neutral_covBy_val_iff E F).mpr hEF)
    ((neutral_covBy_val_iff F H).mpr hFH)
  let Kneutral : NeutralOrEmpty G := ⟨K, H.2.lower hK.2.1.le⟩
  refine ⟨Kneutral, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨(neutral_covBy_val_iff E Kneutral).mp hK.1,
      (neutral_covBy_val_iff Kneutral H).mp hK.2.1,
      fun h ↦ hK.2.2 (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩
  · intro L hL
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply hK_unique L.1
    exact ⟨(neutral_covBy_val_iff E L).mpr hL.1,
      (neutral_covBy_val_iff L H).mpr hL.2.1,
      fun h ↦ hL.2.2 (Subtype.ext h)⟩

statement:
theorem rankTwoDiamond_joinNeutral
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.join_neutral_sameStratum_diamond
statement:
theorem join_neutral_sameStratum_diamond
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (hA : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace A))
    (hB : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace B))
    (E F H : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B))
    (hEF : E.1 ⋖ F.1) (hFH : F.1 ⋖ H.1) :
    ∃! K : HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B),
      E.1 ⋖ K ∧ K ⋖ H.1 ∧ K ≠ F.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hKuniq⟩ := rankTwoDiamond_joinNeutral A B hA hB
    ((neutral_covBy_val_iff E F).mp hEF)
    ((neutral_covBy_val_iff F H).mp hFH)
  refine ⟨K.1, ⟨(neutral_covBy_val_iff E K).mpr hK.1,
    (neutral_covBy_val_iff K H).mpr hK.2.1,
    fun h ↦ hK.2.2 (Subtype.ext h)⟩, ?_⟩
  intro X hX
  let Xn : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B) := ⟨X, H.2.lower hX.2.1.le⟩
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (hKuniq Xn ⟨
    (neutral_covBy_val_iff E Xn).mp hX.1,
    (neutral_covBy_val_iff Xn H).mp hX.2.1,
    fun h ↦ hX.2.2 (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩)
