name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rootedNeg_otherMiddle_to_top_aux
statement:
private theorem rootedNeg_otherMiddle_to_top_aux
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hG : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace G))
    (E : NeutralOrEmpty G) (F : RootedPos G)
    (hEF : E.1 ⋖ F.1) (hFtop : F.1 ⋖ top G) :
    ∃! K : RootedNeg G, E.1 ⋖ K.1 ∧ K.1 ⋖ top G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hK_unique⟩ := hG hEF hFtop
  have hKneg : K.IsRootedNeg := by
    rcases strata_cases G K with htop | hpos | hneg | hneutral
    · exact False.elim (hK.2.1.ne htop)
    · exfalso
      exact E.2.1 (lower_containsVertex_of_distinct_middles
        hEF hFtop hK.1 hK.2.1 hK.2.2 F.2.1 hpos.1)
    · exact hneg
    · exact False.elim (neutral_not_covBy_top ⟨K, hneutral⟩ hK.2.1)
  let Kneg : RootedNeg G := ⟨K, hKneg⟩
  refine ⟨Kneg, ⟨hK.1, hK.2.1⟩, ?_⟩
  intro L hL
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply hK_unique L.1
  exact ⟨hL.1, hL.2, fun h ↦ F.2.not_isRootedNeg (h ▸ L.2)⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.join_neutral_rootedPos_top_diamond
statement:
theorem join_neutral_rootedPos_top_diamond
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (hA : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace A))
    (hB : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace B))
    (E : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B)) (F : RootedPos (A ⊗g B))
    (hEF : E.1 ⋖ F.1) (hFtop : F.1 ⋖ top (A ⊗g B)) :
    ∃! K : HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B),
      E.1 ⋖ K ∧ K ⋖ top (A ⊗g B) ∧ K ≠ F.1
proof:
:= by
  let eN := joinNeutralOrderIso A B
  let eP := joinRootedPosOrderIso A B
  let e : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B := eN.symm E
  let f : RootedPos A × RootedPos B := eP.symm F
  have hErep : joinNeutral A B e.1 e.2 = E.1 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (eN.apply_symm_apply E)
  have hFrep : joinRootedPos A B f.1 f.2 = F.1 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (eP.apply_symm_apply F)
  have hportal : e.1.1 ⋖ f.1.1 ∧ e.2.1 ⋖ f.2.1 := by
    apply (joinPortal_covBy_iff A B e.1 e.2 f.1 f.2).mp
    simpa only [hErep, hFrep] using hEF
  have hcoatom : f.1.1 ⋖ top A ∧ f.2.1 ⋖ top B := by
    apply (joinRootedPos_covBy_top_iff A B f.1 f.2).mp
    simpa only [hFrep] using hFtop
  obtain ⟨nA, hnA, _⟩ := rootedNeg_otherMiddle_to_top_aux A hA
    e.1 f.1 hportal.1 hcoatom.1
  obtain ⟨nB, hnB, _⟩ := rootedNeg_otherMiddle_to_top_aux B hB
    e.2 f.2 hportal.2 hcoatom.2
  let N := joinRootedNeg A B nA nB
  refine ⟨N, ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · rw [← hErep]
      exact (joinNegativePortal_covBy_iff A B e.1 e.2 nA nB).mpr
        ⟨hnA.1, hnB.1⟩
    constructor
    · exact (joinRootedNeg_covBy_top_iff A B nA nB).mpr
        ⟨hnA.2, hnB.2⟩
    · intro h
      change joinRootedNeg A B nA nB = F.1 at h
      apply (joinRootedNeg_isRootedNeg A B nA nB).not_isRootedPos_local
      rw [h]
      exact F.2
  · intro X hX
    rcases strata_cases (A ⊗g B) X with htop | hpos | hneg | hneutral
    · exact False.elim (hX.2.1.ne htop)
    · exfalso
      exact hX.2.2 (by
        let xP : RootedPos (A ⊗g B) := ⟨X, hpos⟩
        let x : RootedPos A × RootedPos B := eP.symm xP
        have hXrep : joinRootedPos A B x.1 x.2 = X :=
          congrArg Subtype.val (eP.apply_symm_apply xP)
        have hxportal := (joinPortal_covBy_iff A B e.1 e.2 x.1 x.2).mp
          (by simpa only [hErep, hXrep] using hX.1)
        have hxcoatom := (joinRootedPos_covBy_top_iff A B x.1 x.2).mp
          (by simpa only [hXrep] using hX.2.1)
        have hxA : x.1 = f.1 := by
          by_contra hne
          obtain ⟨O, hO, hOuniq⟩ := hA hportal.1 hcoatom.1
          have hxO := hOuniq x.1.1 ⟨hxportal.1, hxcoatom.1, fun h ↦ hne (Subtype.ext h)⟩
          have hnO := hOuniq nA.1 ⟨hnA.1, hnA.2,
            fun h ↦ f.1.2.not_isRootedNeg (h.symm ▸ nA.2)⟩
          apply x.1.2.not_isRootedNeg
          rw [hxO.trans hnO.symm]
          exact nA.2
        have hxB : x.2 = f.2 := by
          by_contra hne
          obtain ⟨O, hO, hOuniq⟩ := hB hportal.2 hcoatom.2
          have hxO := hOuniq x.2.1 ⟨hxportal.2, hxcoatom.2, fun h ↦ hne (Subtype.ext h)⟩
          have hnO := hOuniq nB.1 ⟨hnB.1, hnB.2,
            fun h ↦ f.2.2.not_isRootedNeg (h.symm ▸ nB.2)⟩
          apply x.2.2.not_isRootedNeg
          rw [hxO.trans hnO.symm]
          exact nB.2
        rw [← hXrep, ← hFrep, hxA, hxB])
    · let xN : RootedNeg (A ⊗g B) := ⟨X, hneg⟩
      let eR := joinRootedNegOrderIso A B
      let x : RootedNeg A × RootedNeg B := eR.symm xN
      have hXrep : joinRootedNeg A B x.1 x.2 = X :=
        congrArg Subtype.val (eR.apply_symm_apply xN)
      have hxportal := (joinNegativePortal_covBy_iff A B e.1 e.2 x.1 x.2).mp
        (by simpa only [hErep, hXrep] using hX.1)
      have hxcoatom := (joinRootedNeg_covBy_top_iff A B x.1 x.2).mp
        (by simpa only [hXrep] using hX.2.1)
      have hxA : x.1 = nA := by
        obtain ⟨O, hO, hOuniq⟩ := hA hportal.1 hcoatom.1
        have hxO := hOuniq x.1.1 ⟨hxportal.1, hxcoatom.1,
          fun h ↦ f.1.2.not_isRootedNeg (h.symm ▸ x.1.2)⟩
        have hnO := hOuniq nA.1 ⟨hnA.1, hnA.2,
          fun h ↦ f.1.2.not_isRootedNeg (h.symm ▸ nA.2)⟩
        exact Subtype.ext (hxO.trans hnO.symm)
      have hxB : x.2 = nB := by
        obtain ⟨O, hO, hOuniq⟩ := hB hportal.2 hcoatom.2
        have hxO := hOuniq x.2.1 ⟨hxportal.2, hxcoatom.2,
          fun h ↦ f.2.2.not_isRootedNeg (h.symm ▸ x.2.2)⟩
        have hnO := hOuniq nB.1 ⟨hnB.1, hnB.2,
          fun h ↦ f.2.2.not_isRootedNeg (h.symm ▸ nB.2)⟩
        exact Subtype.ext (hxO.trans hnO.symm)
      rw [← hXrep, hxA, hxB]
    · exact False.elim (neutral_not_covBy_top ⟨X, hneutral⟩ hX.2.1)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.join_neutral_rootedPos_rootedPos_diamond
statement:
theorem join_neutral_rootedPos_rootedPos_diamond
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (hA : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace A))
    (hB : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace B))
    (E : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B)) (F H : RootedPos (A ⊗g B))
    (hEF : E.1 ⋖ F.1) (hFH : F.1 ⋖ H.1) :
    ∃! K : HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B),
      E.1 ⋖ K ∧ K ⋖ H.1 ∧ K ≠ F.1
proof:
:= by
  have hpair : PairedPositivePortalSquare (A ⊗g B) :=
    (pairedPositivePortalSquare_of_rankTwoDiamond A hA).join A B
      (pairedPositivePortalSquare_of_rankTwoDiamond B hB)
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hKuniq⟩ := hpair.1 E F H hEF hFH
  refine ⟨K.1, ⟨hK.1, hK.2, fun h ↦ F.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (h.symm ▸ K.2)⟩, ?_⟩
  intro X hX
  rcases H.2.lower_strata hX.2.1.le with hXpos | hXneutral
  · exfalso
    exact hX.2.2 (congrArg Subtype.val
      (hpair.2 E F H hEF hFH ⟨X, hXpos⟩ ⟨hX.1, hX.2.1⟩))
  · exact congrArg Subtype.val
      (hKuniq ⟨X, hXneutral⟩ ⟨hX.1, hX.2.1⟩)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.join_rootedPos_rootedPos_top_diamond
statement:
theorem join_rootedPos_rootedPos_top_diamond
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (hA : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace A))
    (hB : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace B))
    (E F : RootedPos (A ⊗g B))
    (hEF : E.1 ⋖ F.1) (hFtop : F.1 ⋖ top (A ⊗g B)) :
    ∃! K : HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B),
      E.1 ⋖ K ∧ K ⋖ top (A ⊗g B) ∧ K ≠ F.1
proof:
:= by
  let eP := joinRootedPosOrderIso A B
  let e : RootedPos A × RootedPos B := eP.symm E
  let f : RootedPos A × RootedPos B := eP.symm F
  have hErep : joinRootedPos A B e.1 e.2 = E.1 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (eP.apply_symm_apply E)
  have hFrep : joinRootedPos A B f.1 f.2 = F.1 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (eP.apply_symm_apply F)
  have hef : e ⋖ f := (apply_covBy_apply_iff eP.symm).mpr
    ((rootedPos_covBy_val_iff E F).mp hEF)
  have hcoatom := (joinRootedPos_covBy_top_iff A B f.1 f.2).mp
    (by simpa only [hFrep] using hFtop)
  rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hef with hefA | hefB
  · obtain ⟨O, hO, hOuniq⟩ := hA
      ((rootedPos_covBy_val_iff e.1 f.1).mpr hefA.1) hcoatom.1
    have hOtop : O ≠ top A := fun h ↦ (not_lt_of_ge le_top) (h ▸ hO.2.1.lt)
    let o : RootedPos A := ⟨O, e.1.2.upper_of_ne_top hO.1.le hOtop⟩
    let K := joinRootedPos A B o f.2
    refine ⟨K, ?_, ?_⟩
    · constructor
      · rw [← hErep]
        apply (joinRootedPos_covBy_iff_product A B e.1 o e.2 f.2).mpr
        exact Prod.covBy_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨
          (rootedPos_covBy_val_iff e.1 o).mp hO.1, hefA.2⟩)
      constructor
      · exact (joinRootedPos_covBy_top_iff A B o f.2).mpr ⟨hO.2.1, hcoatom.2⟩
      · intro h
        change joinRootedPos A B o f.2 = F.1 at h
        rw [← hFrep] at h
        have hp : (o, f.2) = f := joinRootedPos_pair_injective A B h
        exact hO.2.2 (congrArg (fun p : RootedPos A × RootedPos B ↦ p.1.1) hp)
    · intro X hX
      have hXtop : X ≠ top (A ⊗g B) := hX.2.1.ne
      let xP : RootedPos (A ⊗g B) :=
        ⟨X, E.2.upper_of_ne_top hX.1.le hXtop⟩
      let x : RootedPos A × RootedPos B := eP.symm xP
      have hXrep : joinRootedPos A B x.1 x.2 = X :=
        congrArg Subtype.val (eP.apply_symm_apply xP)
      have hex : e ⋖ x := (joinRootedPos_covBy_iff_product A B e.1 x.1 e.2 x.2).mp
        (by simpa only [hErep, hXrep] using hX.1)
      have hxcoat := (joinRootedPos_covBy_top_iff A B x.1 x.2).mp
        (by simpa only [hXrep] using hX.2.1)
      rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hex with hexA | hexB
      · have hxB : x.2 = f.2 := hexA.2.symm.trans hefA.2
        have hxne : x.1.1 ≠ f.1.1 := by
          intro h
          apply hX.2.2
          rw [← hXrep, ← hFrep]
          exact congrArg (fun p : RootedPos A × RootedPos B ↦
            joinRootedPos A B p.1 p.2) (Prod.ext (Subtype.ext h) hxB)
        have hxO := hOuniq x.1.1 ⟨
          (rootedPos_covBy_val_iff e.1 x.1).mpr hexA.1, hxcoat.1, hxne⟩
        rw [← hXrep]
        exact congrArg (fun p : RootedPos A × RootedPos B ↦
          joinRootedPos A B p.1 p.2)
          (show x = (o, f.2) from Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hxO) hxB)
      · have hbad : e.1.1 ⋖ top A := hexB.2 ▸ hxcoat.1
        exfalso
        rcases hbad.eq_or_eq hefA.1.le hcoatom.1.le with h | h
        · exact hefA.1.ne (Subtype.ext h.symm)
        · exact hcoatom.1.ne h
  · obtain ⟨O, hO, hOuniq⟩ := hB
      ((rootedPos_covBy_val_iff e.2 f.2).mpr hefB.1) hcoatom.2
    have hOtop : O ≠ top B := fun h ↦ (not_lt_of_ge le_top) (h ▸ hO.2.1.lt)
    let o : RootedPos B := ⟨O, e.2.2.upper_of_ne_top hO.1.le hOtop⟩
    let K := joinRootedPos A B f.1 o
    refine ⟨K, ?_, ?_⟩
    · constructor
      · rw [← hErep]
        apply (joinRootedPos_covBy_iff_product A B e.1 f.1 e.2 o).mpr
        exact Prod.covBy_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨
          (rootedPos_covBy_val_iff e.2 o).mp hO.1, hefB.2⟩)
      constructor
      · exact (joinRootedPos_covBy_top_iff A B f.1 o).mpr ⟨hcoatom.1, hO.2.1⟩
      · intro h
        change joinRootedPos A B f.1 o = F.1 at h
        rw [← hFrep] at h
        have hp : (f.1, o) = f := joinRootedPos_pair_injective A B h
        exact hO.2.2 (congrArg (fun p : RootedPos A × RootedPos B ↦ p.2.1) hp)
    · intro X hX
      have hXtop : X ≠ top (A ⊗g B) := hX.2.1.ne
      let xP : RootedPos (A ⊗g B) :=
        ⟨X, E.2.upper_of_ne_top hX.1.le hXtop⟩
      let x : RootedPos A × RootedPos B := eP.symm xP
      have hXrep : joinRootedPos A B x.1 x.2 = X :=
        congrArg Subtype.val (eP.apply_symm_apply xP)
      have hex : e ⋖ x := (joinRootedPos_covBy_iff_product A B e.1 x.1 e.2 x.2).mp
        (by simpa only [hErep, hXrep] using hX.1)
      have hxcoat := (joinRootedPos_covBy_top_iff A B x.1 x.2).mp
        (by simpa only [hXrep] using hX.2.1)
      rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hex with hexA | hexB
      · have hbad : e.2.1 ⋖ top B := hexA.2 ▸ hxcoat.2
        exfalso
        rcases hbad.eq_or_eq hefB.1.le hcoatom.2.le with h | h
        · exact hefB.1.ne (Subtype.ext h.symm)
        · exact hcoatom.2.ne h
      · have hxA : x.1 = f.1 := hexB.2.symm.trans hefB.2
        have hxne : x.2.1 ≠ f.2.1 := by
          intro h
          apply hX.2.2
          rw [← hXrep, ← hFrep]
          exact congrArg (fun p : RootedPos A × RootedPos B ↦
            joinRootedPos A B p.1 p.2) (Prod.ext hxA (Subtype.ext h))
        have hxO := hOuniq x.2.1 ⟨
          (rootedPos_covBy_val_iff e.2 x.2).mpr hexB.1, hxcoat.2, hxne⟩
        rw [← hXrep]
        exact congrArg (fun p : RootedPos A × RootedPos B ↦
          joinRootedPos A B p.1 p.2)
          (show x = (f.1, o) from Prod.ext hxA (Subtype.ext hxO))

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.join_neutral_neutral_rootedPos_diamond
statement:
theorem join_neutral_neutral_rootedPos_diamond
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (hA : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace A))
    (hB : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace B))
    (E F : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B)) (H : RootedPos (A ⊗g B))
    (hEF : E.1 ⋖ F.1) (hFH : F.1 ⋖ H.1) :
    ∃! K : HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B),
      E.1 ⋖ K ∧ K ⋖ H.1 ∧ K ≠ F.1
proof:
:= by
  let eN := joinNeutralOrderIso A B
  let eP := joinRootedPosOrderIso A B
  let e : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B := eN.symm E
  let f : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B := eN.symm F
  let h : RootedPos A × RootedPos B := eP.symm H
  have hErep : joinNeutral A B e.1 e.2 = E.1 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (eN.apply_symm_apply E)
  have hFrep : joinNeutral A B f.1 f.2 = F.1 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (eN.apply_symm_apply F)
  have hHrep : joinRootedPos A B h.1 h.2 = H.1 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (eP.apply_symm_apply H)
  have hef : e ⋖ f := (apply_covBy_apply_iff eN.symm).mpr
    ((neutral_covBy_val_iff E F).mp hEF)
  have hportal : f.1.1 ⋖ h.1.1 ∧ f.2.1 ⋖ h.2.1 :=
    (joinPortal_covBy_iff A B f.1 f.2 h.1 h.2).mp
      (by simpa only [hFrep, hHrep] using hFH)
  rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hef with hefA | hefB
  · have hefAval : e.1.1 ⋖ f.1.1 :=
      (neutral_covBy_val_iff e.1 f.1).mpr hefA.1
    have hnoA : ¬e.1.1 ⋖ h.1.1 := by
      intro hdirect
      rcases hdirect.eq_or_eq hefAval.le hportal.1.le with q | q
      · exact hefAval.ne q.symm
      · exact hportal.1.ne q
    obtain ⟨O, hO, hOuniq⟩ := hA hefAval hportal.1
    rcases h.1.2.lower_strata hO.2.1.le with hOpos | hOneutral
    · let o : RootedPos A := ⟨O, hOpos⟩
      let K := joinRootedPos A B o h.2
      refine ⟨K, ?_, ?_⟩
      · constructor
        · rw [← hErep]
          apply joinPortal_covBy_of_factors
          · exact hO.1
          · simpa only [← hefA.2] using hportal.2
        constructor
        · change joinRootedPos A B o h.2 ⋖ H.1
          rw [← hHrep]
          apply (joinRootedPos_covBy_iff_product A B o h.1 h.2 h.2).mpr
          exact Prod.covBy_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨
            (rootedPos_covBy_val_iff o h.1).mp hO.2.1, rfl⟩)
        · change joinRootedPos A B o h.2 ≠ F.1
          intro q
          exact (joinRootedPos_isRootedPos A B o h.2).not_isNeutralOrEmpty
            (q.symm ▸ F.2)
      · intro X hX
        rcases H.2.lower_strata hX.2.1.le with hXpos | hXneutral
        · let xP : RootedPos (A ⊗g B) := ⟨X, hXpos⟩
          let x : RootedPos A × RootedPos B := eP.symm xP
          have hXrep : joinRootedPos A B x.1 x.2 = X :=
            congrArg Subtype.val (eP.apply_symm_apply xP)
          have hxportal : e.1.1 ⋖ x.1.1 ∧ e.2.1 ⋖ x.2.1 :=
            (joinPortal_covBy_iff A B e.1 e.2 x.1 x.2).mp
              (by simpa only [hErep, hXrep] using hX.1)
          have hxh : x ⋖ h := (joinRootedPos_covBy_iff_product
            A B x.1 h.1 x.2 h.2).mp
              (by simpa only [hXrep, hHrep] using hX.2.1)
          rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hxh with hxhA | hxhB
          · have hxne : x.1.1 ≠ f.1.1 := by
              intro q
              exact f.1.2.1 (q ▸ x.1.2.1)
            have hxO := hOuniq x.1.1 ⟨hxportal.1,
              (rootedPos_covBy_val_iff x.1 h.1).mpr hxhA.1, hxne⟩
            rw [← hXrep]
            exact congrArg (fun p : RootedPos A × RootedPos B ↦
              joinRootedPos A B p.1 p.2)
              (show x = (o, h.2) from Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hxO) hxhA.2)
          · exact False.elim (hnoA (hxhB.2 ▸ hxportal.1))
        · let xN : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B) := ⟨X, hXneutral⟩
          let x : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B := eN.symm xN
          have hXrep : joinNeutral A B x.1 x.2 = X :=
            congrArg Subtype.val (eN.apply_symm_apply xN)
          have hex : e ⋖ x := (joinNeutral_covBy_iff_product
            A B e.1 x.1 e.2 x.2).mp
              (by simpa only [hErep, hXrep] using hX.1)
          have hxportal : x.1.1 ⋖ h.1.1 ∧ x.2.1 ⋖ h.2.1 :=
            (joinPortal_covBy_iff A B x.1 x.2 h.1 h.2).mp
              (by simpa only [hXrep, hHrep] using hX.2.1)
          rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hex with hexA | hexB
          · by_cases q : x.1.1 = f.1.1
            · exfalso
              apply hX.2.2
              rw [← hXrep, ← hFrep]
              exact congrArg (fun p : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B ↦
                joinNeutral A B p.1 p.2)
                (show x = f from Prod.ext (Subtype.ext q)
                  (hexA.2.symm.trans hefA.2))
            · have hxO := hOuniq x.1.1 ⟨
                (neutral_covBy_val_iff e.1 x.1).mpr hexA.1, hxportal.1, q⟩
              exact False.elim (hOpos.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (hxO ▸ x.1.2))
          · exact False.elim (hnoA (by simpa only [← hexB.2] using hxportal.1))
    · let o : NeutralOrEmpty A := ⟨O, hOneutral⟩
      let K := joinNeutral A B o e.2
      refine ⟨K, ?_, ?_⟩
      · constructor
        · rw [← hErep]
          apply (joinNeutral_covBy_iff_product A B e.1 o e.2 e.2).mpr
          exact Prod.covBy_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨
            (neutral_covBy_val_iff e.1 o).mp hO.1, rfl⟩)
        constructor
        · change joinNeutral A B o e.2 ⋖ H.1
          rw [← hHrep]
          apply joinPortal_covBy_of_factors
          · exact hO.2.1
          · simpa only [← hefA.2] using hportal.2
        · intro q
          change joinNeutral A B o e.2 = F.1 at q
          rw [← hFrep] at q
          have qp : (o, e.2) = f := joinNeutral_pair_injective A B q
          exact hO.2.2 (congrArg
            (fun p : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B ↦ p.1.1) qp)
      · intro X hX
        rcases H.2.lower_strata hX.2.1.le with hXpos | hXneutral
        · let xP : RootedPos (A ⊗g B) := ⟨X, hXpos⟩
          let x : RootedPos A × RootedPos B := eP.symm xP
          have hXrep : joinRootedPos A B x.1 x.2 = X :=
            congrArg Subtype.val (eP.apply_symm_apply xP)
          have hxportal : e.1.1 ⋖ x.1.1 ∧ e.2.1 ⋖ x.2.1 :=
            (joinPortal_covBy_iff A B e.1 e.2 x.1 x.2).mp
              (by simpa only [hErep, hXrep] using hX.1)
          have hxh : x ⋖ h := (joinRootedPos_covBy_iff_product
            A B x.1 h.1 x.2 h.2).mp
              (by simpa only [hXrep, hHrep] using hX.2.1)
          rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hxh with hxhA | hxhB
          · have hxne : x.1.1 ≠ f.1.1 := by
              intro q
              exact f.1.2.1 (q ▸ x.1.2.1)
            have hxO := hOuniq x.1.1 ⟨hxportal.1,
              (rootedPos_covBy_val_iff x.1 h.1).mpr hxhA.1, hxne⟩
            exact False.elim (x.1.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (hxO.symm ▸ hOneutral))
          · exact False.elim (hnoA (hxhB.2 ▸ hxportal.1))
        · let xN : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B) := ⟨X, hXneutral⟩
          let x : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B := eN.symm xN
          have hXrep : joinNeutral A B x.1 x.2 = X :=
            congrArg Subtype.val (eN.apply_symm_apply xN)
          have hex : e ⋖ x := (joinNeutral_covBy_iff_product
            A B e.1 x.1 e.2 x.2).mp
              (by simpa only [hErep, hXrep] using hX.1)
          have hxportal : x.1.1 ⋖ h.1.1 ∧ x.2.1 ⋖ h.2.1 :=
            (joinPortal_covBy_iff A B x.1 x.2 h.1 h.2).mp
              (by simpa only [hXrep, hHrep] using hX.2.1)
          rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hex with hexA | hexB
          · have hxne : x.1.1 ≠ f.1.1 := by
              intro q
              apply hX.2.2
              rw [← hXrep, ← hFrep]
              exact congrArg (fun p : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B ↦
                joinNeutral A B p.1 p.2)
                (show x = f from Prod.ext (Subtype.ext q)
                  (hexA.2.symm.trans hefA.2))
            have hxO := hOuniq x.1.1 ⟨
              (neutral_covBy_val_iff e.1 x.1).mpr hexA.1, hxportal.1, hxne⟩
            rw [← hXrep]
            exact congrArg (fun p : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B ↦
              joinNeutral A B p.1 p.2)
              (show x = (o, e.2) from Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hxO) hexA.2.symm)
          · exact False.elim (hnoA (by simpa only [← hexB.2] using hxportal.1))
  · have hefBval : e.2.1 ⋖ f.2.1 :=
      (neutral_covBy_val_iff e.2 f.2).mpr hefB.1
    have hnoB : ¬e.2.1 ⋖ h.2.1 := by
      intro hdirect
      rcases hdirect.eq_or_eq hefBval.le hportal.2.le with q | q
      · exact hefBval.ne q.symm
      · exact hportal.2.ne q
    obtain ⟨O, hO, hOuniq⟩ := hB hefBval hportal.2
    rcases h.2.2.lower_strata hO.2.1.le with hOpos | hOneutral
    · let o : RootedPos B := ⟨O, hOpos⟩
      let K := joinRootedPos A B h.1 o
      refine ⟨K, ?_, ?_⟩
      · constructor
        · rw [← hErep]
          apply joinPortal_covBy_of_factors
          · simpa only [← hefB.2] using hportal.1
          · exact hO.1
        constructor
        · change joinRootedPos A B h.1 o ⋖ H.1
          rw [← hHrep]
          apply (joinRootedPos_covBy_iff_product A B h.1 h.1 o h.2).mpr
          exact Prod.covBy_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨
            (rootedPos_covBy_val_iff o h.2).mp hO.2.1, rfl⟩)
        · change joinRootedPos A B h.1 o ≠ F.1
          intro q
          exact (joinRootedPos_isRootedPos A B h.1 o).not_isNeutralOrEmpty
            (q.symm ▸ F.2)
      · intro X hX
        rcases H.2.lower_strata hX.2.1.le with hXpos | hXneutral
        · let xP : RootedPos (A ⊗g B) := ⟨X, hXpos⟩
          let x : RootedPos A × RootedPos B := eP.symm xP
          have hXrep : joinRootedPos A B x.1 x.2 = X :=
            congrArg Subtype.val (eP.apply_symm_apply xP)
          have hxportal : e.1.1 ⋖ x.1.1 ∧ e.2.1 ⋖ x.2.1 :=
            (joinPortal_covBy_iff A B e.1 e.2 x.1 x.2).mp
              (by simpa only [hErep, hXrep] using hX.1)
          have hxh : x ⋖ h := (joinRootedPos_covBy_iff_product
            A B x.1 h.1 x.2 h.2).mp
              (by simpa only [hXrep, hHrep] using hX.2.1)
          rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hxh with hxhA | hxhB
          · exact False.elim (hnoB (hxhA.2 ▸ hxportal.2))
          · have hxne : x.2.1 ≠ f.2.1 := by
              intro q
              exact f.2.2.1 (q ▸ x.2.2.1)
            have hxO := hOuniq x.2.1 ⟨hxportal.2,
              (rootedPos_covBy_val_iff x.2 h.2).mpr hxhB.1, hxne⟩
            rw [← hXrep]
            exact congrArg (fun p : RootedPos A × RootedPos B ↦
              joinRootedPos A B p.1 p.2)
              (show x = (h.1, o) from Prod.ext hxhB.2 (Subtype.ext hxO))
        · let xN : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B) := ⟨X, hXneutral⟩
          let x : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B := eN.symm xN
          have hXrep : joinNeutral A B x.1 x.2 = X :=
            congrArg Subtype.val (eN.apply_symm_apply xN)
          have hex : e ⋖ x := (joinNeutral_covBy_iff_product
            A B e.1 x.1 e.2 x.2).mp
              (by simpa only [hErep, hXrep] using hX.1)
          have hxportal : x.1.1 ⋖ h.1.1 ∧ x.2.1 ⋖ h.2.1 :=
            (joinPortal_covBy_iff A B x.1 x.2 h.1 h.2).mp
              (by simpa only [hXrep, hHrep] using hX.2.1)
          rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hex with hexA | hexB
          · exact False.elim (hnoB (by simpa only [← hexA.2] using hxportal.2))
          · by_cases q : x.2.1 = f.2.1
            · exfalso
              apply hX.2.2
              rw [← hXrep, ← hFrep]
              exact congrArg (fun p : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B ↦
                joinNeutral A B p.1 p.2)
                (show x = f from Prod.ext (hexB.2.symm.trans hefB.2)
                  (Subtype.ext q))
            · have hxO := hOuniq x.2.1 ⟨
                (neutral_covBy_val_iff e.2 x.2).mpr hexB.1, hxportal.2, q⟩
              exact False.elim (hOpos.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (hxO ▸ x.2.2))
    · let o : NeutralOrEmpty B := ⟨O, hOneutral⟩
      let K := joinNeutral A B e.1 o
      refine ⟨K, ?_, ?_⟩
      · constructor
        · rw [← hErep]
          apply (joinNeutral_covBy_iff_product A B e.1 e.1 e.2 o).mpr
          exact Prod.covBy_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨
            (neutral_covBy_val_iff e.2 o).mp hO.1, rfl⟩)
        constructor
        · change joinNeutral A B e.1 o ⋖ H.1
          rw [← hHrep]
          apply joinPortal_covBy_of_factors
          · simpa only [← hefB.2] using hportal.1
          · exact hO.2.1
        · intro q
          change joinNeutral A B e.1 o = F.1 at q
          rw [← hFrep] at q
          have qp : (e.1, o) = f := joinNeutral_pair_injective A B q
          exact hO.2.2 (congrArg
            (fun p : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B ↦ p.2.1) qp)
      · intro X hX
        rcases H.2.lower_strata hX.2.1.le with hXpos | hXneutral
        · let xP : RootedPos (A ⊗g B) := ⟨X, hXpos⟩
          let x : RootedPos A × RootedPos B := eP.symm xP
          have hXrep : joinRootedPos A B x.1 x.2 = X :=
            congrArg Subtype.val (eP.apply_symm_apply xP)
          have hxportal : e.1.1 ⋖ x.1.1 ∧ e.2.1 ⋖ x.2.1 :=
            (joinPortal_covBy_iff A B e.1 e.2 x.1 x.2).mp
              (by simpa only [hErep, hXrep] using hX.1)
          have hxh : x ⋖ h := (joinRootedPos_covBy_iff_product
            A B x.1 h.1 x.2 h.2).mp
              (by simpa only [hXrep, hHrep] using hX.2.1)
          rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hxh with hxhA | hxhB
          · exact False.elim (hnoB (hxhA.2 ▸ hxportal.2))
          · have hxne : x.2.1 ≠ f.2.1 := by
              intro q
              exact f.2.2.1 (q ▸ x.2.2.1)
            have hxO := hOuniq x.2.1 ⟨hxportal.2,
              (rootedPos_covBy_val_iff x.2 h.2).mpr hxhB.1, hxne⟩
            exact False.elim (x.2.2.not_isNeutralOrEmpty (hxO.symm ▸ hOneutral))
        · let xN : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B) := ⟨X, hXneutral⟩
          let x : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B := eN.symm xN
          have hXrep : joinNeutral A B x.1 x.2 = X :=
            congrArg Subtype.val (eN.apply_symm_apply xN)
          have hex : e ⋖ x := (joinNeutral_covBy_iff_product
            A B e.1 x.1 e.2 x.2).mp
              (by simpa only [hErep, hXrep] using hX.1)
          have hxportal : x.1.1 ⋖ h.1.1 ∧ x.2.1 ⋖ h.2.1 :=
            (joinPortal_covBy_iff A B x.1 x.2 h.1 h.2).mp
              (by simpa only [hXrep, hHrep] using hX.2.1)
          rcases Prod.covBy_iff.mp hex with hexA | hexB
          · exact False.elim (hnoB (by simpa only [← hexA.2] using hxportal.2))
          · have hxne : x.2.1 ≠ f.2.1 := by
              intro q
              apply hX.2.2
              rw [← hXrep, ← hFrep]
              exact congrArg (fun p : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B ↦
                joinNeutral A B p.1 p.2)
                (show x = f from Prod.ext (hexB.2.symm.trans hefB.2)
                  (Subtype.ext q))
            have hxO := hOuniq x.2.1 ⟨
              (neutral_covBy_val_iff e.2 x.2).mpr hexB.1, hxportal.2, hxne⟩
            rw [← hXrep]
            exact congrArg (fun p : NeutralOrEmpty A × NeutralOrEmpty B ↦
              joinNeutral A B p.1 p.2)
              (show x = (e.1, o) from Prod.ext hexB.2.symm (Subtype.ext hxO))

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rootedNeg_otherMiddle_to_top
statement:
theorem rootedNeg_otherMiddle_to_top
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hG : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace G))
    (E : NeutralOrEmpty G) (F : RootedPos G)
    (hEF : E.1 ⋖ F.1) (hFtop : F.1 ⋖ top G) :
    ∃! K : RootedNeg G, E.1 ⋖ K.1 ∧ K.1 ⋖ top G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hK_unique⟩ := hG hEF hFtop
  have hKneg : K.IsRootedNeg := by
    rcases strata_cases G K with htop | hpos | hneg | hneutral
    · exact False.elim (hK.2.1.ne htop)
    · exfalso
      exact E.2.1 (lower_containsVertex_of_distinct_middles
        hEF hFtop hK.1 hK.2.1 hK.2.2 F.2.1 hpos.1)
    · exact hneg
    · exact False.elim (neutral_not_covBy_top ⟨K, hneutral⟩ hK.2.1)
  let Kneg : RootedNeg G := ⟨K, hKneg⟩
  refine ⟨Kneg, ⟨hK.1, hK.2.1⟩, ?_⟩
  intro L hL
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply hK_unique L.1
  exact ⟨hL.1, hL.2, fun h ↦ F.2.not_isRootedNeg (h ▸ L.2)⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.diamond_step_orderIso
statement:
private theorem diamond_step_orderIso
    {P : Type*} {Q : Type*} [PartialOrder P] [PartialOrder Q]
    (e : P ≃o Q) {a b c : P}
    (h : ∃! x : Q, e a ⋖ x ∧ x ⋖ e c ∧ x ≠ e b) :
    ∃! x : P, a ⋖ x ∧ x ⋖ c ∧ x ≠ b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, huniq⟩ := h
  refine ⟨e.symm x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · apply (apply_covBy_apply_iff e).mp
      simpa using hx.1
    constructor
    · apply (apply_covBy_apply_iff e).mp
      simpa using hx.2.1
    · intro q
      apply hx.2.2
      simpa using congrArg e q
  · intro y hy
    apply e.injective
    simpa using huniq (e y) ⟨
      (apply_covBy_apply_iff e).mpr hy.1,
      (apply_covBy_apply_iff e).mpr hy.2.1,
      fun q ↦ hy.2.2 (e.injective q)⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rankTwoDiamond_join_middle_rootedPos
statement:
private theorem rankTwoDiamond_join_middle_rootedPos
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (hA : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace A))
    (hB : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace B))
    (E : HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B))
    (F : RootedPos (A ⊗g B))
    (H : HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B))
    (hEF : E ⋖ F.1) (hFH : F.1 ⋖ H) :
    ∃! K : HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B),
      E ⋖ K ∧ K ⋖ H ∧ K ≠ F.1
proof:
:= by
  rcases F.2.lower_strata hEF.le with hEpos | hEneutral
  · let Ep : RootedPos (A ⊗g B) := ⟨E, hEpos⟩
    rcases strata_cases (A ⊗g B) H with htop | hHpos | hHneg | hHneutral
    · subst H
      exact join_rootedPos_rootedPos_top_diamond A B hA hB Ep F hEF hFH
    · exact join_rootedPos_sameStratum_diamond A B hA hB Ep F
        ⟨H, hHpos⟩ hEF hFH
    · exact False.elim (hHneg.2 (F.2.1.mono hFH.le))
    · exact False.elim (hHneutral.1 (F.2.1.mono hFH.le))
  · let En : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B) := ⟨E, hEneutral⟩
    rcases strata_cases (A ⊗g B) H with htop | hHpos | hHneg | hHneutral
    · subst H
      exact join_neutral_rootedPos_top_diamond A B hA hB En F hEF hFH
    · exact join_neutral_rootedPos_rootedPos_diamond A B hA hB En F
        ⟨H, hHpos⟩ hEF hFH
    · exact False.elim (hHneg.2 (F.2.1.mono hFH.le))
    · exact False.elim (hHneutral.1 (F.2.1.mono hFH.le))

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rankTwoDiamond_join
statement:
theorem rankTwoDiamond_join
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (hA : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace A))
    (hB : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace B)) :
    RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace (A ⊗g B))
proof:
:= by
  intro E F H hEF hFH
  rcases strata_cases (A ⊗g B) F with htop | hFpos | hFneg | hFneutral
  · exfalso
    exact (not_lt_of_ge le_top) (htop ▸ hFH.lt)
  · exact rankTwoDiamond_join_middle_rootedPos A B hA hB E
      ⟨F, hFpos⟩ H hEF hFH
  · let c := hansenCentralFaceOrderIso (A ⊗g B)
    let Fc : RootedPos (A ⊗g B) :=
      ⟨c F, centralFace_rootedNeg_to_rootedPos hFneg⟩
    apply diamond_step_orderIso c
    exact rankTwoDiamond_join_middle_rootedPos A B hA hB (c E) Fc (c H)
      ((apply_covBy_apply_iff c).mpr hEF)
      ((apply_covBy_apply_iff c).mpr hFH)
  · let En : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B) :=
      ⟨E, hFneutral.lower hEF.le⟩
    let Fn : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B) := ⟨F, hFneutral⟩
    rcases strata_cases (A ⊗g B) H with hHtop | hHpos | hHneg | hHneutral
    · subst H
      exact False.elim (neutral_not_covBy_top Fn hFH)
    · exact join_neutral_neutral_rootedPos_diamond A B hA hB En Fn
        ⟨H, hHpos⟩ hEF hFH
    · let c := hansenCentralFaceOrderIso (A ⊗g B)
      let Ec : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B) :=
        ⟨c E, centralFace_neutral_to_neutral En.2⟩
      let Fc : NeutralOrEmpty (A ⊗g B) :=
        ⟨c F, centralFace_neutral_to_neutral Fn.2⟩
      let Hc : RootedPos (A ⊗g B) :=
        ⟨c H, centralFace_rootedNeg_to_rootedPos hHneg⟩
      apply diamond_step_orderIso c
      exact join_neutral_neutral_rootedPos_diamond A B hA hB Ec Fc Hc
        ((apply_covBy_apply_iff c).mpr hEF)
        ((apply_covBy_apply_iff c).mpr hFH)
    · exact join_neutral_sameStratum_diamond A B hA hB En Fn
        ⟨H, hHneutral⟩ hEF hFH

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rankTwoDiamond_singleton
proof:
:= by
  letI : DecidableEq (OrderDual SingletonFace.Closed) := inferInstance
  letI : DecidableLE (OrderDual SingletonFace.Closed) := by
    intro F K
    change Decidable
      ((show SingletonFace.Closed from K).1 ⊆
        (show SingletonFace.Closed from F).1)
    infer_instance
  letI : DecidableLT (OrderDual SingletonFace.Closed) := by
    intro F K
    change Decidable (F ≤ K ∧ ¬K ≤ F)
    infer_instance
  letI : DecidableRel
      (fun F K : OrderDual SingletonFace.Closed ↦ F ⋖ K) := by
    intro F K
    unfold CovBy
    letI : Decidable (∀ ⦃C : OrderDual SingletonFace.Closed⦄,
        F < C → ¬C < K) := Fintype.decidableForallFintype
    infer_instance
  apply RankTwoDiamond.orderIso singletonFaceOrderIso.symm
  unfold RankTwoDiamond
  let p := fun a b c : OrderDual SingletonFace.Closed ↦
    a ⋖ b → b ⋖ c → ∃! b', a ⋖ b' ∧ b' ⋖ c ∧ b' ≠ b
  letI decP (a b c : OrderDual SingletonFace.Closed) : Decidable (p a b c) := by
    dsimp only [p]
    unfold ExistsUnique
    letI decUnique (x : OrderDual SingletonFace.Closed) : Decidable
        (∀ y, (a ⋖ y ∧ y ⋖ c ∧ y ≠ b) → y = x) :=
      Fintype.decidableForallFintype
    infer_instance
  letI decC (a b : OrderDual SingletonFace.Closed) :
      Decidable (∀ c, p a b c) := Fintype.decidableForallFintype
  letI decB (a : OrderDual SingletonFace.Closed) :
      Decidable (∀ b c, p a b c) := Fintype.decidableForallFintype
  have h : ∀ a b c, p a b c := by decide
  exact h

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rankTwoDiamond_compl
statement:
theorem rankTwoDiamond_compl {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace G)) :
    RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace Gᶜ)
proof:
:=
  RankTwoDiamond.orderIso (hansenFaceComplOrderIso G)
    (RankTwoDiamond.orderDual hG)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rankTwoDiamond_of_compl
statement:
theorem rankTwoDiamond_of_compl {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hGc : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace Gᶜ)) :
    RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace G)
proof:
:=
  RankTwoDiamond.orderDual
    (RankTwoDiamond.orderIso (hansenFaceComplOrderIso G).symm hGc)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rankTwoDiamond_iso
statement:
theorem rankTwoDiamond_iso {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} (e : G ≃g H)
    (hG : RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace G)) :
    RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace H)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c hab hbc
  apply diamond_step_orderIso (hansenFaceOrderIso e).symm
  exact hG
    ((apply_covBy_apply_iff (hansenFaceOrderIso e).symm).mpr hab)
    ((apply_covBy_apply_iff (hansenFaceOrderIso e).symm).mpr hbc)

name: HansenCograph.Cotree.rankTwoDiamond_eval
statement:
theorem rankTwoDiamond_eval : ∀ T : Cotree,
    RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace T.eval)
proof:
:= by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | leaf =>
      exact HansenCombinatorialFace.rankTwoDiamond_singleton
  | compl A ih =>
      exact HansenCombinatorialFace.rankTwoDiamond_compl A.eval ih
  | sum A B ihA ihB =>
      letI : Fintype A.Vert := instFintypeVert A
      letI : DecidableEq A.Vert := instDecidableEqVert A
      letI : Fintype B.Vert := instFintypeVert B
      letI : DecidableEq B.Vert := instDecidableEqVert B
      letI : Fintype (A.Vert ⊕ B.Vert) := instFintypeVert (.sum A B)
      letI : DecidableEq (A.Vert ⊕ B.Vert) :=
        instDecidableEqVert (.sum A B)
      have hAc : RankTwoDiamond
          (HansenCombinatorialFace A.evalᶜ) :=
        HansenCombinatorialFace.rankTwoDiamond_compl A.eval ihA
      have hBc : RankTwoDiamond
          (HansenCombinatorialFace B.evalᶜ) :=
        HansenCombinatorialFace.rankTwoDiamond_compl B.eval ihB
      have hjoin : RankTwoDiamond
          (HansenCombinatorialFace (A.evalᶜ ⊗g B.evalᶜ)) :=
        HansenCombinatorialFace.rankTwoDiamond_join A.evalᶜ B.evalᶜ hAc hBc
      rw [← HansenCombinatorialFace.compl_sum_eq_join_compl] at hjoin
      rw [eval_sum]
      intro a b c hab hbc
      exact (HansenCombinatorialFace.rankTwoDiamond_of_compl
        (A.eval ⊕g B.eval) hjoin) hab hbc

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.rankTwoDiamond_of_isCograph
statement:
theorem rankTwoDiamond_of_isCograph
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : IsCograph G) :
    RankTwoDiamond (HansenCombinatorialFace G)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hG
  exact rankTwoDiamond_iso e.symm (Cotree.rankTwoDiamond_eval T)

name: HansenCograph.convex_hansen
statement:
theorem convex_hansen (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Convex ℝ (hansen G)
proof:
:= by
  exact convex_convexHull ℝ _

name: HansenCograph.convex_hansen_top_image
statement:
private theorem convex_hansen_top_image (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Convex ℝ ((fun p : V → ℝ => ((1 : ℝ), p)) '' stab G)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ _ ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ a b ha hb hab
  refine ⟨a • p + b • q, (convex_stab G) hp hq ha hb hab, ?_⟩
  ext <;> simp [hab]

name: HansenCograph.convex_hansen_bottom_image
statement:
private theorem convex_hansen_bottom_image (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Convex ℝ ((fun p : V → ℝ => ((-1 : ℝ), -p)) '' stab G)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ _ ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ a b ha hb hab
  refine ⟨a • p + b • q, (convex_stab G) hp hq ha hb hab, ?_⟩
  dsimp
  apply Prod.ext
  · change (-1 : ℝ) = a * (-1) + b * (-1)
    linarith
  · funext v
    change -(a * p v + b * q v) = a * (-p v) + b * (-q v)
    ring

name: HansenCograph.hansen_eq_convexJoin
statement:
private theorem hansen_eq_convexJoin (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    hansen G =
      convexJoin ℝ
        ((fun p : V → ℝ => ((1 : ℝ), p)) '' stab G)
        ((fun p : V → ℝ => ((-1 : ℝ), -p)) '' stab G)
proof:
:= by
  unfold hansen
  apply Convex.convexHull_union
  · exact convex_hansen_top_image G
  · exact convex_hansen_bottom_image G
  · exact ⟨((1 : ℝ), (0 : V → ℝ)),
      ⟨(0 : V → ℝ), zero_mem_stab G, rfl⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨((-1 : ℝ), (0 : V → ℝ)),
      ⟨(0 : V → ℝ), zero_mem_stab G, by simp⟩⟩

name: HansenCograph.mem_hansen_iff
statement:
theorem mem_hansen_iff (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (r : ℝ) (z : V → ℝ) :
    (r, z) ∈ hansen G ↔
      r ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ∧
        z ∈ sectionSet G ((r + 1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hansen_eq_convexJoin, mem_convexJoin]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, _, ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩, hrz⟩
    change
      ∃ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a ∧ 0 ≤ b ∧ a + b = 1 ∧
        a • ((1 : ℝ), p) + b • ((-1 : ℝ), -q) = (r, z) at hrz
    rcases hrz with ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hrz⟩
    have hr := congrArg Prod.fst hrz
    have hz := congrArg Prod.snd hrz
    have ha_formula : (r + 1) / 2 = a := by
      dsimp at hr
      linarith
    constructor
    · constructor <;> dsimp at hr <;> linarith
    · rw [ha_formula]
      unfold sectionSet
      refine ⟨a • p, ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩,
        (-(1 - a)) • q, ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      dsimp at hz ⊢
      rw [← hz]
      have hb_formula : b = 1 - a := by linarith
      rw [hb_formula]
      module
  · rintro ⟨hr, hz⟩
    let a : ℝ := (r + 1) / 2
    have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by dsimp [a]; linarith [hr.1]
    have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := by dsimp [a]; linarith [hr.2]
    unfold sectionSet at hz
    rcases hz with ⟨_, ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, _, ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨((1 : ℝ), p), ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩,
      ((-1 : ℝ), -q), ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    refine ⟨a, 1 - a, ha0, sub_nonneg.mpr ha1, by ring, ?_⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · change a * 1 + (1 - a) * (-1) = r
      dsimp [a]
      ring
    · funext v
      change a * p v + (1 - a) * (-q v) =
        a * p v + (-(1 - a)) * q v
      ring

name: HansenCograph.sectionSet_subset_centeredCube
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  unfold sectionSet at hz
  rcases hz with ⟨_, ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, _, ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  constructor <;> intro v
  all_goals
    have hp0 := stab_coordinate_nonneg G hp v
    have hp1 := stab_coordinate_le_one G hp v
    have hq0 := stab_coordinate_nonneg G hq v
    have hq1 := stab_coordinate_le_one G hq v
    have hxp0 : 0 ≤ x * p v := mul_nonneg hx0 hp0
    have hxp1 : x * p v ≤ x := by
      simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp1 hx0
    have hxq0 : 0 ≤ (1 - x) * q v := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx1) hq0
    have hxq1 : (1 - x) * q v ≤ 1 - x :=
      by simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq1 (sub_nonneg.mpr hx1)
    dsimp
    linarith

name: HansenCograph.sectionSet_volume_ne_top
proof:
:= by
  exact ne_of_lt <| lt_of_le_of_lt
    (measure_mono (sectionSet_subset_centeredCube G hx0 hx1))
    isCompact_Icc.measure_lt_top

name: HansenCograph.hasStabAntiblocker_bot_of_subsingleton
statement:
private theorem hasStabAntiblocker_bot_of_subsingleton
    {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Subsingleton X] :
    HasStabAntiblocker (⊥ : SimpleGraph X)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro y hy
  have hc : (⊥ : SimpleGraph X)ᶜ = ⊥ := by
    ext u v
    simp [Subsingleton.elim u v]
  rw [hc, stab_bot]
  constructor
  · exact hy.1
  · intro v
    have hs : (⊥ : SimpleGraph X).IsIndepSet (↑({v} : Finset X) : Set X) := by
      simp
    simpa using hy.2 {v} hs

name: HansenCograph.hasStabAntiblocker_join
statement:
private theorem hasStabAntiblocker_join
    {X : Type u} {Y : Type v}
    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y]
    (A : SimpleGraph X) (B : SimpleGraph Y)
    (hA : HasStabAntiblocker A) (hB : HasStabAntiblocker B) :
    HasStabAntiblocker (A ⊗g B)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro z hz
  let x : X → ℝ := fun a => z (.inl a)
  let y : Y → ℝ := fun b => z (.inr b)
  have hxcond : StabAntiblockerCondition A x := by
    constructor
    · intro a
      exact hz.1 (.inl a)
    · intro s hs
      have hs' := join_sumFinset_left_indep A B hs
      have h := hz.2 (sumFinset s (∅ : Finset Y)) hs'
      simpa [x, sumFinset] using h
  have hycond : StabAntiblockerCondition B y := by
    constructor
    · intro b
      exact hz.1 (.inr b)
    · intro t ht
      have ht' := join_sumFinset_right_indep A B ht
      have h := hz.2 (sumFinset (∅ : Finset X) t) ht'
      simpa [y, sumFinset] using h
  rw [compl_join_eq_sum, stab_sum_eq_split_preimage]
  exact ⟨hA x hxcond, hB y hycond⟩

name: HansenCograph.hasStabAntiblocker_sum
statement:
private theorem hasStabAntiblocker_sum
    {X : Type u} {Y : Type v}
    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y]
    (A : SimpleGraph X) (B : SimpleGraph Y)
    (hA : HasStabAntiblocker A) (hB : HasStabAntiblocker B) :
    HasStabAntiblocker (A ⊕g B)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro z hz
  let x : X → ℝ := fun a => z (.inl a)
  let y : Y → ℝ := fun b => z (.inr b)
  let stableA : Finset (Finset X) :=
    Finset.univ.powerset.filter
      (fun s => A.IsIndepSet (↑s : Set X))
  have hstableA : stableA.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨∅, ?_⟩
    simp [stableA]
  obtain ⟨sA, hsA_mem, hsAmax⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_max_image stableA (fun s => ∑ a ∈ s, x a) hstableA
  have hsA : A.IsIndepSet (↑sA : Set X) := by
    simpa [stableA] using hsA_mem
  let a : ℝ := ∑ u ∈ sA, x u
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by
    dsimp [a]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun u _ => hz.1 (.inl u)
  have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := by
    have hs := sumFinset_indep A B hsA
      (by simp : B.IsIndepSet (↑(∅ : Finset Y) : Set Y))
    have h := hz.2 (sumFinset sA (∅ : Finset Y)) hs
    simpa [a, x, sumFinset] using h
  let p : X → ℝ := if a = 0 then 0 else fun u => x u / a
  let q : Y → ℝ := if 1 - a = 0 then 0 else fun v => y v / (1 - a)
  have hpcond : StabAntiblockerCondition A p := by
    constructor
    · intro u
      dsimp [p]
      split_ifs with ha
      · simp
      · exact div_nonneg (hz.1 (.inl u)) ha0
    · intro s hs
      have hs_mem : s ∈ stableA := by simp [stableA, hs]
      have hmax := hsAmax s hs_mem
      change (∑ u ∈ s, x u) ≤ a at hmax
      dsimp [p]
      split_ifs with ha
      · simp
      · change (∑ u ∈ s, x u / a) ≤ 1
        rw [← Finset.sum_div]
        exact (div_le_one (lt_of_le_of_ne ha0 (Ne.symm ha))).mpr hmax
  have hqcond : StabAntiblockerCondition B q := by
    constructor
    · intro v
      dsimp [q]
      split_ifs with hrema
      · simp
      · exact div_nonneg (hz.1 (.inr v)) (sub_nonneg.mpr ha1)
    · intro t ht
      have hsumIndep := sumFinset_indep A B hsA ht
      have hbound := hz.2 (sumFinset sA t) hsumIndep
      have hsplit : (∑ w ∈ sumFinset sA t, z w) =
          (∑ u ∈ sA, x u) + ∑ v ∈ t, y v := by
        have hdisj : Disjoint
            (sA.map ⟨Sum.inl, Sum.inl_injective⟩)
            (t.map ⟨Sum.inr, Sum.inr_injective⟩) := by
          apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
          intro w hwL hwR
          simp only [Finset.mem_map] at hwL hwR
          rcases hwL with ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
          simp at hwR
        unfold sumFinset
        rw [Finset.sum_union hdisj]
        simp [x, y]
      have hyt : ∑ v ∈ t, y v ≤ 1 - a := by
        rw [hsplit] at hbound
        dsimp [a]
        linarith
      dsimp [q]
      split_ifs with hrema
      · simp
      · change (∑ v ∈ t, y v / (1 - a)) ≤ 1
        rw [← Finset.sum_div]
        exact (div_le_one (lt_of_le_of_ne (sub_nonneg.mpr ha1)
          (Ne.symm hrema))).mpr hyt
  have hxle (u : X) : x u ≤ a := by
    have hu_mem : ({u} : Finset X) ∈ stableA := by simp [stableA]
    simpa using hsAmax {u} hu_mem
  have hyle (v : Y) : y v ≤ 1 - a := by
    have hv_indep : B.IsIndepSet (↑({v} : Finset Y) : Set Y) := by simp
    have hsumIndep := sumFinset_indep A B hsA hv_indep
    have hbound := hz.2 (sumFinset sA {v}) hsumIndep
    have hsplit : (∑ w ∈ sumFinset sA {v}, z w) =
        (∑ u ∈ sA, x u) + y v := by
      have hdisj : Disjoint
          (sA.map ⟨Sum.inl, Sum.inl_injective⟩)
          (({v} : Finset Y).map ⟨Sum.inr, Sum.inr_injective⟩) := by
        apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
        intro w hwL hwR
        simp only [Finset.mem_map] at hwL hwR
        rcases hwL with ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
        simp at hwR
      unfold sumFinset
      rw [Finset.sum_union hdisj]
      simp [x, y]
    rw [hsplit] at hbound
    dsimp [a]
    linarith
  have hp : p ∈ stab Aᶜ := hA p hpcond
  have hq : q ∈ stab Bᶜ := hB q hqcond
  rw [compl_sum_eq_join, stab_join_eq_split_preimage]
  change (x, y) ∈ convexJoin ℝ (productAxisLeft '' stab Aᶜ)
    (productAxisRight '' stab Bᶜ)
  rw [mem_convexJoin]
  refine ⟨(p, 0), ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, (0, q), ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩,
    a, 1 - a, ha0, sub_nonneg.mpr ha1, by ring, ?_⟩
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext u
    dsimp [p, x]
    split_ifs with ha
    · simp only [Pi.zero_apply, mul_zero, zero_add]
      exact le_antisymm (hz.1 (.inl u)) (by simpa [x, ha] using hxle u)
    · simp
      field_simp
  · funext v
    dsimp [q, y]
    split_ifs with hrema
    · have ha : a = 1 := by linarith
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply, mul_zero, add_zero]
      exact le_antisymm (hz.1 (.inr v)) (by simpa [y, ha] using hyle v)
    · simp
      field_simp

name: HansenCograph.cotree_hasStabAntiblocker_both
statement:
theorem cotree_hasStabAntiblocker_both :
    ∀ T : Cotree,
      HasStabAntiblocker (Cotree.eval T) ∧
        HasStabAntiblocker (Cotree.eval T)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | leaf =>
      have hbot : HasStabAntiblocker (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit) :=
        hasStabAntiblocker_bot_of_subsingleton
      constructor
      · exact hbot
      · change HasStabAntiblocker (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit)ᶜ
        rw [show (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit)ᶜ = ⊥ by ext u v; simp]
        exact hbot
  | compl A ih =>
      constructor
      · exact ih.2
      · change HasStabAntiblocker ((Cotree.eval A)ᶜ)ᶜ
        rw [compl_compl]
        exact ih.1
  | sum A B ihA ihB =>
      constructor
      · exact hasStabAntiblocker_sum _ _ ihA.1 ihB.1
      · change HasStabAntiblocker (Cotree.eval A ⊕g Cotree.eval B)ᶜ
        rw [compl_sum_eq_join]
        exact hasStabAntiblocker_join
          (Cotree.eval A)ᶜ (Cotree.eval B)ᶜ ihA.2 ihB.2

name: HansenCograph.stab_compl_subset_antiblockerCondition
statement:
private theorem stab_compl_subset_antiblockerCondition
    {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    (G : SimpleGraph X) {y : X → ℝ} (hy : y ∈ stab Gᶜ) :
    StabAntiblockerCondition G y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro v
    exact stab_coordinate_nonneg Gᶜ hy v
  · intro s hs
    change y ∈ {z : X → ℝ | ∑ v ∈ s, z v ≤ 1}
    apply (convexHull_min ?_ ?_) hy
    · rintro z ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
      have hcard : (s ∩ t).card ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Finset.card_le_one]
        intro u hu v hv
        by_contra huv
        have hu' := Finset.mem_inter.mp hu
        have hv' := Finset.mem_inter.mp hv
        have hnadj := hs hu'.1 hv'.1 huv
        have hncadj := ht hu'.2 hv'.2 huv
        exact hncadj (by simpa [SimpleGraph.compl_adj, huv] using hnadj)
      change ∑ v ∈ s, indicator t v ≤ 1
      calc
        (∑ v ∈ s, indicator t v) = ((s ∩ t).card : ℝ) := by
          simp [indicator]
        _ ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hcard
    · intro p hp q hq a b ha hb hab
      change ∑ v ∈ s, p v ≤ 1 at hp
      change ∑ v ∈ s, q v ≤ 1 at hq
      change ∑ v ∈ s, (a • p + b • q) v ≤ 1
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.mem_stab_compl_iff_antiblockerCondition_of_hasStabAntiblocker
statement:
theorem mem_stab_compl_iff_antiblockerCondition_of_hasStabAntiblocker
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : HasStabAntiblocker G) (y : V → ℝ) :
    y ∈ stab Gᶜ ↔ StabAntiblockerCondition G y
proof:
:=
  ⟨stab_compl_subset_antiblockerCondition G, hG y⟩

name: HansenCograph.hasStabAntiblocker_iso
statement:
private theorem hasStabAntiblocker_iso
    {X : Type u} {Y : Type v}
    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y]
    {G : SimpleGraph X} {H : SimpleGraph Y} (e : G ≃g H)
    (hG : HasStabAntiblocker G) : HasStabAntiblocker H
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro y hy
  let x : X → ℝ := fun v => y (e v)
  have hxcond : StabAntiblockerCondition G x := by
    constructor
    · intro v
      exact hy.1 (e v)
    · intro s hs
      have hs' := isIndepSet_relabel e hs
      have h := hy.2 (relabelFinset e.toEquiv s) hs'
      simpa [x, relabelFinset] using h
  have hx := hG x hxcond
  let ec : Gᶜ ≃g Hᶜ :=
    { toEquiv := e.toEquiv
      map_rel_iff' := by intro u v; simp [e.map_rel_iff] }
  have hy' := coordinateRelabel_mem_stab ec hx
  dsimp [ec] at hy'
  have heq : coordinateRelabel e.toEquiv x = y := by
    ext w
    change y (e.toEquiv (e.toEquiv.symm w)) = y w
    rw [e.toEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rwa [heq] at hy'

name: HansenCograph.hasStabAntiblocker_of_cograph
statement:
theorem hasStabAntiblocker_of_cograph (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hG : IsCograph G) : HasStabAntiblocker G
proof:
:= by
  rcases hG with ⟨T, ⟨e⟩⟩
  exact hasStabAntiblocker_iso e.symm
    (cotree_hasStabAntiblocker_both T).1

name: HansenCograph.dot_le_one_of_cond
statement:
private theorem dot_le_one_of_cond
    {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    (G : SimpleGraph X) {q p : X → ℝ} (hq : StabAntiblockerCondition G q) (hp : p ∈ stab G) :
    dot p q ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change p ∈ {p : X → ℝ | dot p q ≤ 1}
  apply (convexHull_min ?_ ?_) hp
  · rintro z ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    change ∑ v, indicator s v * q v ≤ 1
    simpa [indicator] using hq.2 s hs
  · intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    change dot x q ≤ 1 at hx
    change dot y q ≤ 1 at hy
    change dot (a • x + b • y) q ≤ 1
    have heq : dot (a • x + b • y) q = a * dot x q + b * dot y q := by
      simp only [dot, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      congr 1 <;> rw [Finset.mul_sum] <;>
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl <;> intro v _ <;> ring
    rw [heq]
    nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.dot_nonneg_of_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  unfold dot
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun v _ => mul_nonneg (hp v) (hq v)

name: HansenCograph.hansenPolar_forward
statement:
private theorem hansenPolar_forward {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    (G : SimpleGraph X)
    (hanti : ∀ y, y ∈ stab Gᶜ ↔ StabAntiblockerCondition G y)
    (s : ℝ) (w : X → ℝ)
    (hh : (s, fun v => -w v / 2) ∈ hansen Gᶜ) :
    polarPoint G (s, w)
proof:
:= by
  intro ξ hξ
  rw [mem_hansen_iff] at hh hξ
  let a : ℝ := (s + 1) / 2
  let b : ℝ := (ξ.1 + 1) / 2
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by dsimp [a]; linarith [hh.1.1]
  have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := by dsimp [a]; linarith [hh.1.2]
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := by dsimp [b]; linarith [hξ.1.1]
  have hb1 : b ≤ 1 := by dsimp [b]; linarith [hξ.1.2]
  unfold sectionSet at hh hξ
  rcases hh.2 with ⟨_, ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩, _, ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩, hzw⟩
  rcases hξ.2 with ⟨_, ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, _, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, hzx⟩
  have hqcond := (hanti q).mp hq
  have hrcond := (hanti r).mp hr
  have hp0 : ∀ v, 0 ≤ p v := fun v => stab_coordinate_nonneg G hp v
  have ht0 : ∀ v, 0 ≤ t v := fun v => stab_coordinate_nonneg G ht v
  have hpq0 := dot_nonneg_of_nonneg hp0 hqcond.1
  have hpr0 := dot_nonneg_of_nonneg hp0 hrcond.1
  have htq0 := dot_nonneg_of_nonneg ht0 hqcond.1
  have htr0 := dot_nonneg_of_nonneg ht0 hrcond.1
  have hpq1 := dot_le_one_of_cond G hqcond hp
  have hpr1 := dot_le_one_of_cond G hrcond hp
  have htq1 := dot_le_one_of_cond G hqcond ht
  have htr1 := dot_le_one_of_cond G hrcond ht
  have hs : s = 2 * a - 1 := by dsimp [a]; ring
  have hξs : ξ.1 = 2 * b - 1 := by dsimp [b]; ring
  have hw : w = fun v => -2 * (a * q v - (1 - a) * r v) := by
    funext v
    have hv := congrFun hzw v
    change ((s + 1) / 2) * q v + (-(1 - (s + 1) / 2)) * r v = -w v / 2 at hv
    dsimp [a]
    linarith
  have hξw : ξ.2 = fun v => b * p v - (1 - b) * t v := by
    funext v
    have hv := congrFun hzx v
    change ((ξ.1 + 1) / 2) * p v + (-(1 - (ξ.1 + 1) / 2)) * t v = ξ.2 v at hv
    dsimp [b]
    linarith
  rw [hs, hξs, hw, hξw]
  simp only [dot]
  have hsum :
      (∑ v, (b * p v - (1 - b) * t v) *
        (-2 * (a * q v - (1 - a) * r v))) =
      -2 * (b * a * dot p q - b * (1 - a) * dot p r -
        (1 - b) * a * dot t q + (1 - b) * (1 - a) * dot t r) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ v, -2 * (b * a * (p v * q v) -
          b * (1 - a) * (p v * r v) -
          (1 - b) * a * (t v * q v) +
          (1 - b) * (1 - a) * (t v * r v)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro v _
        ring
      _ = _ := by
        unfold dot
        have hin :
            (∑ v, (b * a * (p v * q v) - b * (1 - a) * (p v * r v) -
              (1 - b) * a * (t v * q v) +
              (1 - b) * (1 - a) * (t v * r v))) =
            b * a * (∑ v, p v * q v) - b * (1 - a) * (∑ v, p v * r v) -
              (1 - b) * a * (∑ v, t v * q v) +
              (1 - b) * (1 - a) * (∑ v, t v * r v) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
            Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
          simp only [← Finset.mul_sum]
        rw [← hin, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [hsum]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hb0 ha0) hpq0,
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) (sub_nonneg.mpr ha1)) htr0,
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.mpr ha1)) (sub_nonneg.mpr hpr1),
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) ha0) (sub_nonneg.mpr htq1)]

name: HansenCograph.hansenPolar_reverse
statement:
private theorem hansenPolar_reverse {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    (G : SimpleGraph X)
    (hanti : ∀ y, y ∈ stab Gᶜ ↔ StabAntiblockerCondition G y)
    (s : ℝ) (w : X → ℝ)
    (hpol : polarPoint G (s, w)) :
    (s, fun v => -w v / 2) ∈ hansen Gᶜ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have htop (p : X → ℝ) (hp : p ∈ stab G) : (1, p) ∈ hansen G := by
    apply subset_convexHull ℝ
    exact Or.inl ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  have hbottom (p : X → ℝ) (hp : p ∈ stab G) : (-1, -p) ∈ hansen G := by
    apply subset_convexHull ℝ
    exact Or.inr ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := by
    have h := hpol (1, 0) (htop 0 (zero_mem_stab G))
    simpa [polarPoint, dot] using h
  have hsm1 : -1 ≤ s := by
    have hm : (-1, (0 : X → ℝ)) ∈ hansen G := by
      simpa using hbottom 0 (zero_mem_stab G)
    have h := hpol (-1, 0) hm
    norm_num [dot] at h
    linarith
  let a : ℝ := (s + 1) / 2
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by dsimp [a]; linarith
  have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := by dsimp [a]; linarith
  have hnegBound (t : Finset X) (ht : G.IsIndepSet (↑t : Set X)) :
      ∑ v ∈ t, max (-w v) 0 ≤ 2 * a := by
    let tn : Finset X := t.filter fun v => w v < 0
    have htn : G.IsIndepSet (↑tn : Set X) := by
      intro u hu v hv huv
      exact ht (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu).1 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).1 huv
    have h := hpol (-1, -indicator tn) (hbottom (indicator tn)
      (indicator_mem_stab G htn))
    have hdot : dot (-indicator tn) w = ∑ v ∈ tn, -w v := by
      simp [dot, indicator]
    have hsum : (∑ v ∈ t, max (-w v) 0) = ∑ v ∈ tn, -w v := by
      calc
        (∑ v ∈ t, max (-w v) 0) =
            ∑ v ∈ t, if w v < 0 then -w v else 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro v hv
          by_cases hvw : w v < 0
          · simp [hvw, le_of_lt (neg_pos.mpr hvw)]
          · have hvw0 : 0 ≤ w v := le_of_not_gt hvw
            simp [hvw, hvw0]
        _ = ∑ v ∈ tn, -w v := by rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    change (-1) * s + dot (-indicator tn) w ≤ 1 at h
    rw [hdot] at h
    rw [hsum]
    dsimp [a]
    linarith
  have hposBound (t : Finset X) (ht : G.IsIndepSet (↑t : Set X)) :
      ∑ v ∈ t, max (w v) 0 ≤ 2 * (1 - a) := by
    let tp : Finset X := t.filter fun v => 0 < w v
    have htp : G.IsIndepSet (↑tp : Set X) := by
      intro u hu v hv huv
      exact ht (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu).1 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).1 huv
    have h := hpol (1, indicator tp) (htop (indicator tp)
      (indicator_mem_stab G htp))
    have hdot : dot (indicator tp) w = ∑ v ∈ tp, w v := by
      simp [dot, indicator]
    have hsum : (∑ v ∈ t, max (w v) 0) = ∑ v ∈ tp, w v := by
      calc
        (∑ v ∈ t, max (w v) 0) =
            ∑ v ∈ t, if 0 < w v then w v else 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro v hv
          by_cases hvw : 0 < w v
          · simp [hvw, hvw.le]
          · have hvw0 : w v ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt hvw
            simp [hvw, hvw0]
        _ = ∑ v ∈ tp, w v := by rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    change 1 * s + dot (indicator tp) w ≤ 1 at h
    rw [hdot] at h
    rw [hsum]
    dsimp [a]
    linarith
  let q : X → ℝ := if a = 0 then 0 else fun v => max (-w v) 0 / (2 * a)
  let r : X → ℝ := if 1 - a = 0 then 0 else fun v => max (w v) 0 / (2 * (1 - a))
  have hqcond : StabAntiblockerCondition G q := by
    constructor
    · intro v
      dsimp [q]
      split_ifs
      · simp
      · positivity
    · intro t ht
      dsimp [q]
      split_ifs with ha
      · simp
      · change (∑ v ∈ t, max (-w v) 0 / (2 * a)) ≤ 1
        rw [← Finset.sum_div]
        apply (div_le_one (by positivity)).mpr
        exact hnegBound t ht
  have hrcond : StabAntiblockerCondition G r := by
    constructor
    · intro v
      dsimp [r]
      split_ifs
      · simp
      · positivity
    · intro t ht
      dsimp [r]
      split_ifs with hra
      · simp
      · change (∑ v ∈ t, max (w v) 0 / (2 * (1 - a))) ≤ 1
        rw [← Finset.sum_div]
        apply (div_le_one (by positivity)).mpr
        exact hposBound t ht
  have hq : q ∈ stab Gᶜ := (hanti q).mpr hqcond
  have hr : r ∈ stab Gᶜ := (hanti r).mpr hrcond
  rw [mem_hansen_iff]
  constructor
  · exact ⟨hsm1, hs1⟩
  · unfold sectionSet
    refine ⟨a • q, ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩, (-(1 - a)) • r,
      ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    funext v
    have hnegv := hnegBound {v} (by simp)
    have hposv := hposBound {v} (by simp)
    simp only [Finset.sum_singleton] at hnegv hposv
    have hmax : max (-w v) 0 - max (w v) 0 = -w v := by
      by_cases hw0 : 0 ≤ w v
      · rw [max_eq_left hw0, max_eq_right (neg_nonpos.mpr hw0)]
        simp
      · have hw0' : w v ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hw0
        rw [max_eq_right hw0', max_eq_left (neg_nonneg.mpr hw0')]
        simp
    dsimp [q, r]
    have haq : a * (if a = 0 then 0 else max (-w v) 0 / (2 * a)) =
        max (-w v) 0 / 2 := by
      split_ifs with hza
      · have hn : max (-w v) 0 = 0 :=
          le_antisymm (by nlinarith) (le_max_right _ _)
        simp [hn]
      · field_simp
    have hbr : (1 - a) *
          (if 1 - a = 0 then 0 else max (w v) 0 / (2 * (1 - a))) =
        max (w v) 0 / 2 := by
      split_ifs with hzra
      · have hpv : max (w v) 0 = 0 :=
          le_antisymm (by nlinarith) (le_max_right _ _)
        simp [hpv]
      · field_simp
    simp only [ite_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
    have hbrneg : -(1 - a) *
          (if 1 - a = 0 then 0 else max (w v) 0 / (2 * (1 - a))) =
        -(max (w v) 0 / 2) := by
      rw [neg_mul, hbr]
    rw [haq, hbrneg]
    linarith

name: HansenCograph.hansen_polar_eq_image_of_hasStabAntiblocker
statement:
theorem hansen_polar_eq_image_of_hasStabAntiblocker
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hanti : HasStabAntiblocker G) :
    {y : ℝ × (V → ℝ) | ∀ x ∈ hansen G,
        x.1 * y.1 + dot x.2 y.2 ≤ 1} =
      hansenPolarMap '' hansen Gᶜ
proof:
:= by
  let hiff :=
    mem_stab_compl_iff_antiblockerCondition_of_hasStabAntiblocker G hanti
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    let z : ℝ × (V → ℝ) := (y.1, fun v => -y.2 v / 2)
    have hz : z ∈ hansen Gᶜ := hansenPolar_reverse G hiff y.1 y.2 hy
    refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · funext v
      dsimp [z, hansenPolarMap]
      ring
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    apply hansenPolar_forward G hiff z.1 (fun v => -2 * z.2 v)
    convert hz using 1
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · funext v
      ring

name: HansenCograph.hansen_volume_ne_top
statement:
private theorem hansen_volume_ne_top (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    volume (hansen G) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : hansen G ⊆
      Set.Icc ((-1 : ℝ), fun _ : V => -1) (1, fun _ => 1) := by
    rintro ⟨r, z⟩ hz
    rw [mem_hansen_iff] at hz
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ (r + 1) / 2 := by linarith [hz.1.1]
    have hx1 : (r + 1) / 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith [hz.1.2]
    exact ⟨⟨hz.1.1, sectionSet_subset_centeredCube G hx0 hx1 hz.2 |>.1⟩,
      ⟨hz.1.2, sectionSet_subset_centeredCube G hx0 hx1 hz.2 |>.2⟩⟩
  exact ne_of_lt <| lt_of_le_of_lt (measure_mono hsub)
    isCompact_Icc.measure_lt_top

name: HansenCograph.polar_volume_toReal_of_hasStabAntiblocker
statement:
theorem polar_volume_toReal_of_hasStabAntiblocker
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hanti : HasStabAntiblocker G) :
    (volume {y : ℝ × (V → ℝ) | ∀ x ∈ hansen G,
        x.1 * y.1 + ∑ v : V, x.2 v * y.2 v ≤ 1}).toReal =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card V * (volume (hansen Gᶜ)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  change (volume {y : ℝ × (V → ℝ) | polarPoint G y}).toReal = _
  unfold polarPoint
  rw [hansen_polar_eq_image_of_hasStabAntiblocker G hanti]
  rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod ℝ (V → ℝ)]
  rw [Measure.addHaar_image_linearMap
    ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure (V → ℝ)))
      (hansenPolarMap (V := V))]
  have hdet : LinearMap.det (hansenPolarMap (V := V)) =
      (-2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card V := by
    rw [hansenPolarMap, LinearMap.det_prodMap, LinearMap.det_smul]
    simp
  rw [hdet, abs_pow, abs_of_nonpos (by norm_num : (-2 : ℝ) ≤ 0)]
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul]
  · simp

name: HansenCograph.volume_hansen_spec
statement:
theorem volume_hansen_spec (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    (volume (hansen G)).toReal
      = 2 * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q G x
proof:
:= by
  have hnull : NullMeasurableSet (hansen G)
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure (V → ℝ))) := by
    exact (convex_hansen G).nullMeasurableSet
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure (V → ℝ)))
  have hvolume :
      volume (hansen G) =
        ∫⁻ r : ℝ in Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
          ENNReal.ofReal (q G ((r + 1) / 2)) := by
    rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod ℝ (V → ℝ)]
    rw [Measure.prod_apply_nullMeasurableSet
      (volume : Measure ℝ) (volume : Measure (V → ℝ)) hnull]
    rw [← lintegral_indicator measurableSet_Icc]
    apply lintegral_congr
    intro r
    rw [Set.indicator]
    by_cases hr : r ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1
    · simp only [hr, ↓reduceIte]
      have hx0 : 0 ≤ (r + 1) / 2 := by linarith [hr.1]
      have hx1 : (r + 1) / 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith [hr.2]
      have hsec : {z : V → ℝ | (r, z) ∈ hansen G} =
          sectionSet G ((r + 1) / 2) := by
        ext z
        simp [mem_hansen_iff, hr]
      rw [hsec, q_eq_section_volume G hx0 hx1]
      exact (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal
        (sectionSet_volume_ne_top G hx0 hx1)).symm
    · simp only [hr, ↓reduceIte]
      have hsec : {z : V → ℝ | (r, z) ∈ hansen G} = ∅ := by
        ext z
        simp [mem_hansen_iff, hr]
      simp [hsec]
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => q G ((r + 1) / 2)
  have hfcont : Continuous f := by
    dsimp [f]
    exact (continuous_q G).comp (by fun_prop)
  have hfint : Integrable f (volume.restrict (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) :=
    ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_Icc hfcont.continuousOn
  have hfnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)] f := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with r hr
    change 0 ≤ q G ((r + 1) / 2)
    exact q_nonneg_on_unit G (by linarith [hr.1]) (by linarith [hr.2])
  have hrealIntegral :
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ r in Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, f r) =
        ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ENNReal.ofReal (f r) :=
    ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hfint hfnn
  have hinterval :
      (∫ r in Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, f r) =
        2 * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q G x := by
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc]
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
    have hcongr :
        (∫ r in (-1 : ℝ)..1, f r) =
          ∫ r in (-1 : ℝ)..1, q G ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + r / 2) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro r _
      dsimp [f]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [hcongr]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_div (f := q G)
      (c := (2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (d := (1 / 2 : ℝ))]
    norm_num
  rw [hvolume]
  rw [← hrealIntegral]
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal]
  · exact hinterval
  · exact integral_nonneg_of_ae hfnn

name: HansenCograph.N_eq_factorial_mul_volume_hansen_spec
statement:
theorem N_eq_factorial_mul_volume_hansen_spec (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    N G = ((Fintype.card V + 1).factorial : ℝ) *
      (volume (hansen G)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [volume_hansen_spec, N_eq_two_factorial_mul_integral_q]
  ring

name: HansenCograph.mahlerRho_hansen_eq_graphRho_of_hasStabAntiblocker
statement:
theorem mahlerRho_hansen_eq_graphRho_of_hasStabAntiblocker
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hanti : HasStabAntiblocker G) :
    mahlerRho (hansen G) = graphRho G
proof:
:= by
  have hvol := N_eq_factorial_mul_volume_hansen_spec G
  have hvolc := N_eq_factorial_mul_volume_hansen_spec Gᶜ
  have hpolar := polar_volume_toReal_of_hasStabAntiblocker G hanti
  have hv : (volume (hansen G)).toReal =
      N G / ((Fintype.card V + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
    rw [hvol]
    field_simp
  have hvc : (volume (hansen Gᶜ)).toReal =
      N Gᶜ / ((Fintype.card V + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
    rw [hvolc]
    field_simp
  have hpow : (4 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card V + 1) =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card V * 2 ^ (Fintype.card V + 2) := by
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 * 2 by norm_num, mul_pow]
    simp only [pow_add]
    ring
  unfold mahlerRho graphRho
  dsimp
  rw [hpolar, hv, hvc, hpow]
  field_simp

name: HansenCograph.mahlerRho_hansen_eq_graphRho_of_cograph
statement:
theorem mahlerRho_hansen_eq_graphRho_of_cograph
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hG : IsCograph G) :
    mahlerRho (hansen G) = graphRho G
proof:
:= by
  exact mahlerRho_hansen_eq_graphRho_of_hasStabAntiblocker G
    (hasStabAntiblocker_of_cograph G hG)

name: HansenCograph.hansen_cograph_mahler'
statement:
theorem hansen_cograph_mahler'
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hG : IsCograph G) :
    1 ≤ mahlerRho (hansen G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mahlerRho_hansen_eq_graphRho_of_cograph G hG]
  exact cograph_graphRho_ge_one G hG

name: HansenCograph.hansen_cograph_mahler_eq_one_iff_threshold'
statement:
theorem hansen_cograph_mahler_eq_one_iff_threshold'
    (G : SimpleGraph V)

    mahlerRho (hansen G) = 1 ↔ IsThresholdGraph G
proof:

statement:
theorem hansen_cograph_mahler_eq_one_iff_thresholdStandard

name: HansenCograph.q_K2_formula
statement:
theorem q_K2_formula (x : ℝ) :
    q K2 x = 1 / 2 + x * (1 - x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : Fin 2 ≃ (PUnit.{1} ⊕ PUnit.{1}) :=
    finTwoEquiv.trans Equiv.boolEquivPUnitSumPUnit
  have hjoin :
      ((⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit.{1}) ⊗g (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit.{1})) =
        completeGraph (PUnit.{1} ⊕ PUnit.{1}) := by
    ext a b
    cases a <;> cases b
    · rw [graphJoin_adj_inl_inl]
      simp
    · constructor
      · intro h
        simp
      · intro h
        exact graphJoin_adj_inl_inr _ _ _ _
    · constructor
      · intro h
        simp
      · intro h
        exact (graphJoin_adj_inl_inr _ _ _ _).symm
    · rw [graphJoin_adj_inr_inr]
      simp
  have e : K2 ≃g
      ((⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit.{1}) ⊗g (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit.{1})) := by
    rw [hjoin]
    exact SimpleGraph.Iso.completeGraph f
  have hnuK2 : nu K2 = 1 := by
    rw [nu_iso e, nu_join, nu_bot]
    norm_num
  have hnu (s : Finset (Fin 2)) : nuInduced K2 s = 1 := by
    have hsle : s.card ≤ 2 := by
      simpa using Finset.card_le_univ s
    have hcases : s.card = 0 ∨ s.card = 1 ∨ s.card = 2 := by
      omega
    rcases hcases with hzero | hone | htwo
    · have hs : s = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hzero
      subst s
      unfold nuInduced inducedFinset
      have hg : SimpleGraph.induce (↑(∅ : Finset (Fin 2)) : Set (Fin 2)) K2 = ⊥ := by
        ext u v
        have hu : False := by simpa using u.property
        exact hu.elim
      rw [hg, nu_bot]
      simp
    · unfold nuInduced inducedFinset
      have hg : SimpleGraph.induce (↑s : Set (Fin 2)) K2 = ⊥ := by
        ext u v
        have huv : u = v := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          by_contra huv
          have htwo_mem : ({u.1, v.1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ⊆ s := by
            intro z hz
            simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hz
            rcases hz with rfl | rfl
            · exact u.property
            · exact v.property
          have hcard_two : ({u.1, v.1} : Finset (Fin 2)).card = 2 := by
            simp [huv]
          have := Finset.card_le_card htwo_mem
          omega
        subst v
        simp
      rw [hg, nu_bot, Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard,
        Set.ncard_coe_finset, hone]
      norm_num
    · have hs : s = Finset.univ := by
        apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (Finset.subset_univ s)
        simp [htwo]
      subst s
      unfold nuInduced inducedFinset
      have eu :
          SimpleGraph.induce
              (↑(Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)) : Set (Fin 2)) K2 ≃g K2 := by
        have hset :
            (↑(Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)) : Set (Fin 2)) = Set.univ := by
          ext v
          simp
        rw [hset]
        exact SimpleGraph.induceUnivIso K2
      rw [nu_iso eu, hnuK2]
  unfold q qCoeff
  simp_rw [hnu, one_mul]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
  let term : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    1 / ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ((2 - k).factorial : ℝ)) *
      x ^ k * (1 - x) ^ (2 - k)
  change (∑ s ∈ Finset.univ.powerset, term s.card) = _
  rw [Finset.sum_powerset_apply_card]
  norm_num [term, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  ring

name: HansenCograph.integral_q_K2
statement:
theorem integral_q_K2 :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q K2 x) = 2 / 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (fun x => q K2 x) =
      (fun x : ℝ => 1 / 2 + x * (1 - x)) by
        funext x
        exact q_K2_formula x]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add]
  · rw [show (fun x : ℝ => x * (1 - x)) =
        (fun x => x ^ 1 * (1 - x) ^ 1) by funext x; ring]
    rw [integral_pow_mul_one_sub_pow]
    norm_num
  · exact continuous_const.intervalIntegrable (μ := volume) 0 1
  · exact (by fun_prop : Continuous
      (fun x : ℝ => x * (1 - x))).intervalIntegrable (μ := volume) 0 1

name: HansenCograph.integral_q_K2_sq
statement:
theorem integral_q_K2_sq :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, q K2 x * q K2 x) = 9 / 20
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun x : ℝ => q K2 x * q K2 x) =
      (fun x => 1 / 4 + x * (1 - x) + x ^ 2 * (1 - x) ^ 2) := by
    funext x
    rw [q_K2_formula]
    ring
  rw [hfun, intervalIntegral.integral_add]
  · rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add]
    · rw [show (fun x : ℝ => x * (1 - x)) =
          (fun x => x ^ 1 * (1 - x) ^ 1) by funext x; ring]
      rw [integral_pow_mul_one_sub_pow 1 1,
        integral_pow_mul_one_sub_pow 2 2]
      norm_num
    · exact continuous_const.intervalIntegrable (μ := volume) 0 1
    · exact (by fun_prop : Continuous
        (fun x : ℝ => x * (1 - x))).intervalIntegrable (μ := volume) 0 1
  · exact (by fun_prop : Continuous
      (fun x : ℝ => 1 / 4 + x * (1 - x))).intervalIntegrable (μ := volume) 0 1
  · exact (by fun_prop : Continuous
      (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 * (1 - x) ^ 2)).intervalIntegrable (μ := volume) 0 1

name: HansenCograph.graphRho_twoK2
statement:
theorem graphRho_twoK2 :
    graphRho (K2 ⊕g K2) = 81 / 80
proof:
:= by
  have hbot :
      ((⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit) ⊕g (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit)) =
        (⊥ : SimpleGraph (PUnit ⊕ PUnit)) := by
    apply bot_unique
    intro x y h
    cases x <;> cases y <;> simp [SimpleGraph.sum_adj] at h
  let f : Fin 2 ≃ (PUnit ⊕ PUnit) :=
    Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by simp)
  have e : K2 ≃g
      (((⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit) ⊕g (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit))ᶜ) := by
    rw [hbot]
    simpa [K2, SimpleGraph.completeGraph_eq_top] using
      (SimpleGraph.Iso.completeGraph f)
  have eleaf : (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit) ≃g Cotree.eval .leaf :=
    SimpleGraph.Iso.refl
  have hleaf : graphRho (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit) = 1 := by
    rw [graphRho_iso eleaf]
    exact Cotree.graphRho_leaf
  have hsum :
      graphRho ((⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit) ⊕g (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit)) = 1 := by
    rw [(graphRho_sum_eq_mul_iff
      (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit) (⊥ : SimpleGraph PUnit)).mpr
      (Or.inl rfl), hleaf]
    norm_num
  have hK2 : graphRho K2 = 1 := by
    rw [graphRho_iso e, graphRho_compl]
    exact hsum
  rw [graphRho_sum_eq, hK2, integral_q_K2, integral_q_K2_sq]
  norm_num

statement:
theorem cliqueFunctional_nonneg_of_mem_stab
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (c : Finset V) {x : V → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ stab G) :
    0 ≤ cliqueFunctional c x
proof:
:= by
  unfold cliqueFunctional

name: HansenCograph.cliqueFunctional_le_one_of_mem_stab
statement:
theorem cliqueFunctional_le_one_of_mem_stab
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (c : Finset V)
    (hc : G.IsClique (↑c : Set V)) {x : V → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ stab G) :
    cliqueFunctional c x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ {y : V → ℝ | cliqueFunctional c y ≤ 1}
  apply (convexHull_min ?_ ?_) hx
  · rintro y ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    change cliqueFunctional c (indicator s) ≤ 1
    rw [cliqueFunctional_indicator]
    exact_mod_cast clique_inter_indep_card_le_one G c s hc hs
  · intro y hy z hz a b ha hb hab
    change cliqueFunctional c y ≤ 1 at hy
    change cliqueFunctional c z ≤ 1 at hz
    change cliqueFunctional c (a • y + b • z) ≤ 1
    have hlinear :
        cliqueFunctional c (a • y + b • z) =
          a * cliqueFunctional c y + b * cliqueFunctional c z := by
      simp [cliqueFunctional, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [hlinear]
    nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.cliqueFacetFunctional_bounds_on_hansen
statement:
theorem cliqueFacetFunctional_bounds_on_hansen
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (c : Finset V)
    (hc : G.IsClique (↑c : Set V)) {x : ℝ × (V → ℝ)}
    (hx : x ∈ hansen G) :
    -1 ≤ cliqueFacetFunctional c x ∧ cliqueFacetFunctional c x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · change x ∈ {y : ℝ × (V → ℝ) | -1 ≤ cliqueFacetFunctional c y}
    apply (convexHull_min ?_ ?_) hx
    · rintro y (⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)
      · have hnonneg := cliqueFunctional_nonneg_of_mem_stab G c hp
        dsimp [cliqueFacetFunctional]
        nlinarith
      · have hle := cliqueFunctional_le_one_of_mem_stab G c hc hp
        dsimp [cliqueFacetFunctional]
        rw [show cliqueFunctional c (-p) = -cliqueFunctional c p by
          simp [cliqueFunctional]]
        nlinarith
    · intro y hy z hz a b ha hb hab
      change -1 ≤ cliqueFacetFunctional c y at hy
      change -1 ≤ cliqueFacetFunctional c z at hz
      change -1 ≤ cliqueFacetFunctional c (a • y + b • z)
      have hlinear :
          cliqueFacetFunctional c (a • y + b • z) =
            a * cliqueFacetFunctional c y + b * cliqueFacetFunctional c z := by
        simp [cliqueFacetFunctional, cliqueFunctional, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
          ← Finset.mul_sum]
        ring
      rw [hlinear]
      nlinarith
  · change x ∈ {y : ℝ × (V → ℝ) | cliqueFacetFunctional c y ≤ 1}
    apply (convexHull_min ?_ ?_) hx
    · rintro y (⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)
      · have hle := cliqueFunctional_le_one_of_mem_stab G c hc hp
        dsimp [cliqueFacetFunctional]
        nlinarith
      · have hnonneg := cliqueFunctional_nonneg_of_mem_stab G c hp
        dsimp [cliqueFacetFunctional]
        rw [show cliqueFunctional c (-p) = -cliqueFunctional c p by
          simp [cliqueFunctional]]
        nlinarith
    · intro y hy z hz a b ha hb hab
      change cliqueFacetFunctional c y ≤ 1 at hy
      change cliqueFacetFunctional c z ≤ 1 at hz
      change cliqueFacetFunctional c (a • y + b • z) ≤ 1
      have hlinear :
          cliqueFacetFunctional c (a • y + b • z) =
            a * cliqueFacetFunctional c y + b * cliqueFacetFunctional c z := by
        simp [cliqueFacetFunctional, cliqueFunctional, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
          ← Finset.mul_sum]
        ring
      rw [hlinear]
      nlinarith

name: HansenCograph.join_sumFinset_clique
statement:
theorem join_sumFinset_clique (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    {c : Finset V} {d : Finset W}
    (hc : A.IsClique (↑c : Set V)) (hd : B.IsClique (↑d : Set W)) :
    (A ⊗g B).IsClique (↑(sumFinset c d) : Set (V ⊕ W))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  cases x with
  | inl x =>
      cases y with
      | inl y =>
          exact (graphJoin_adj_inl_inl A B x y).2
            (hc (by simpa using hx) (by simpa using hy)
              (fun h ↦ hxy (congrArg Sum.inl h)))
      | inr y => exact graphJoin_adj_inl_inr A B x y
  | inr x =>
      cases y with
      | inl y => exact graphJoin_adj_inr_inl A B x y
      | inr y =>
          exact (graphJoin_adj_inr_inr A B x y).2
            (hd (by simpa using hx) (by simpa using hy)
              (fun h ↦ hxy (congrArg Sum.inr h)))

name: HansenCograph.sumFinset_inter_left_nonempty_iff
statement:
theorem sumFinset_inter_left_nonempty_iff
    (c s : Finset V) (d : Finset W) :
    ((sumFinset c d) ∩ sumFinset s ∅).Nonempty ↔ (c ∩ s).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hx' := Finset.mem_inter.mp hx
    cases x with
    | inl x =>
        exact ⟨x, Finset.mem_inter.mpr
          ⟨(inl_mem_sumFinset c d x).mp hx'.1,
            (inl_mem_sumFinset s ∅ x).mp hx'.2⟩⟩
    | inr x => simp at hx'
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hx' := Finset.mem_inter.mp hx
    exact ⟨Sum.inl x, Finset.mem_inter.mpr
      ⟨(inl_mem_sumFinset c d x).mpr hx'.1,
        (inl_mem_sumFinset s ∅ x).mpr hx'.2⟩⟩

name: HansenCograph.sumFinset_inter_right_nonempty_iff

theorem sumFinset_inter_right_nonempty_iff

proof:
:= by

  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hx' := Finset.mem_inter.mp hx
    cases x with
    | inl x => simp at hx'
    | inr x =>
        exact ⟨x, Finset.mem_inter.mpr
          ⟨(inr_mem_sumFinset c d x).mp hx'.1,
            (inr_mem_sumFinset ∅ s x).mp hx'.2⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hx' := Finset.mem_inter.mp hx
    exact ⟨Sum.inr x, Finset.mem_inter.mpr
      ⟨(inr_mem_sumFinset c d x).mpr hx'.1,
        (inr_mem_sumFinset ∅ s x).mpr hx'.2⟩⟩
