name: HansenCograph.joinVertexLabel_left_or_right
statement:
theorem joinVertexLabel_left_or_right (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (vertex : HansenVertexLabel (A ⊗g B)) :
    (∃ left : HansenVertexLabel A, joinVertexLabelLeft A B left = vertex) ∨
      (∃ right : HansenVertexLabel B, joinVertexLabelRight A B right = vertex)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hleft : sumLeftPart vertex.2.1 = ∅
  · right
    let right : HansenVertexLabel B :=
      ⟨vertex.1, ⟨sumRightPart vertex.2.1,
        join_right_indep A B vertex.2.2⟩⟩
    refine ⟨right, ?_⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · apply Subtype.ext
      change sumFinset ∅ (sumRightPart vertex.2.1) = vertex.2.1
      calc
        sumFinset ∅ (sumRightPart vertex.2.1) =
            sumFinset (sumLeftPart vertex.2.1) (sumRightPart vertex.2.1) :=
          (congrArg (fun left ↦ sumFinset left (sumRightPart vertex.2.1)) hleft).symm
        _ = vertex.2.1 := sumFinset_sumParts_faceflag vertex.2.1
  · left
    have hright : sumRightPart vertex.2.1 = ∅ :=
      join_indep_right_empty A B vertex.2.2 hleft
    let left : HansenVertexLabel A :=
      ⟨vertex.1, ⟨sumLeftPart vertex.2.1,
        join_left_indep A B vertex.2.2⟩⟩
    refine ⟨left, ?_⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · apply Subtype.ext
      change sumFinset (sumLeftPart vertex.2.1) ∅ = vertex.2.1
      calc
        sumFinset (sumLeftPart vertex.2.1) ∅ =
            sumFinset (sumLeftPart vertex.2.1) (sumRightPart vertex.2.1) :=
          (congrArg (sumFinset (sumLeftPart vertex.2.1)) hright).symm
        _ = vertex.2.1 := sumFinset_sumParts_faceflag vertex.2.1

name: HansenCograph.hansenJoinFacetClosure_preimage
statement:
theorem hansenJoinFacetClosure_preimage
    (A : SimpleGraph V) (B : SimpleGraph W)
    (T : Set (SignedJoinFacet
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel A ↦ f.1)
      (fun f : HansenFacetLabel B ↦ f.1))) :
    (joinFacetLabelEquiv A B) ⁻¹'
        incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence (A ⊗g B))
          ((joinFacetLabelEquiv A B) '' T) =
      sameSignFacetProduct
        (incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence A) (joinFacetProjLeft T))
        (incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence B) (joinFacetProjRight T))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (joinFacetLabelEquiv A B) ⁻¹'
          incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence (A ⊗g B))
            ((joinFacetLabelEquiv A B) '' T) =
        incidenceClosure
          (signedJoinIncidence (hansenLabelIncidence A) (hansenLabelIncidence B)) T :=
      incidenceClosure_preimage_equiv
        (signedJoinIncidence (hansenLabelIncidence A) (hansenLabelIncidence B))
        (hansenLabelIncidence (A ⊗g B))
        (joinVertexLabelMap A B) (joinFacetLabelEquiv A B)
        (joinVertexLabelMap_surjective A B)
        (fun vertex facet ↦ hansenLabelIncidence_join_map A B vertex facet) T
    _ = sameSignFacetProduct
          (incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence A) (joinFacetProjLeft T))
          (incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence B) (joinFacetProjRight T)) :=
      joinFacetClosure_eq (hansenLabelIncidence A) (hansenLabelIncidence B) T

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.pair_isIndepSet
statement:
theorem pair_isIndepSet (hne : i ≠ j) (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j) :
    G.IsIndepSet (↑({i, j} : Finset V) : Set V)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton,
    Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx hy
  rcases hx with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hy with rfl | rfl
  · exact (hxy rfl).elim
  · exact hnadj
  · exact fun h ↦ hnadj h.symm
  · exact (hxy rfl).elim

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.edgeVertices_subset_squareVertices
statement:
theorem edgeVertices_subset_squareVertices :
    edgeVertices G i j ⊆ squareVertices G i j
proof:
:=
  fun _ h ↦ h.1

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.oppositeVertices_subset_edgeVertices
statement:
theorem oppositeVertices_subset_edgeVertices :
    oppositeVertices G i j ⊆ edgeVertices G i j
proof:
:=
  fun _ h ↦ h.1

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.incidenceClosure_squareVertices
statement:
theorem incidenceClosure_squareVertices :
    incidenceClosure (dualIncidence (hansenLabelIncidence G))
        (squareVertices G i j) =
      squareVertices G i j
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro v hv
    have hsign : v.1 = HansenSign.pos := by
      cases hs : v.1 with
      | neg =>
          exfalso
          have hinc := hv (negativeEmptyFacet G) (by
            intro w hw
            change hansenLabelIncidence G w (negativeEmptyFacet G)
            simp [negativeEmptyFacet, emptyHansenFacet,
              hansenLabelIncidence, hw.1])
          change hansenLabelIncidence G v (negativeEmptyFacet G) at hinc
          simpa [negativeEmptyFacet, emptyHansenFacet,
            hansenLabelIncidence, hs] using hinc
      | pos => rfl
    refine ⟨hsign, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    by_contra hxpair
    have hcommon : negativeSingletonFacet G x ∈
        incidenceModels (dualIncidence (hansenLabelIncidence G))
          (squareVertices G i j) := by
      intro w hw
      change hansenLabelIncidence G w (negativeSingletonFacet G x)
      have hxw : x ∉ w.2.1 := fun hxw ↦ hxpair (hw.2 hxw)
      simp [negativeSingletonFacet, hansenLabelIncidence, hw.1, hxw]
    have hinc := hv (negativeSingletonFacet G x) hcommon
    change hansenLabelIncidence G v (negativeSingletonFacet G x) at hinc
    have hxnot : x ∉ v.2.1 := by
      simp only [negativeSingletonFacet, hansenLabelIncidence, hsign,
        ↓reduceIte] at hinc
      intro hxv
      have hne : (({x} : Finset V) ∩ v.2.1).Nonempty :=
        ⟨x, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨by simp, hxv⟩⟩
      exact HansenSign.noConfusion (hinc.mpr hne)
    exact hxnot hx
  · exact subset_incidenceClosure _ _

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.incidenceClosure_edgeVertices
statement:
theorem incidenceClosure_edgeVertices :
    incidenceClosure (dualIncidence (hansenLabelIncidence G))
        (edgeVertices G i j) =
      edgeVertices G i j
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro v hv
    have hsquare : v ∈ squareVertices G i j := by
      rw [← incidenceClosure_squareVertices G i j]
      exact incidenceClosure_mono _
        (edgeVertices_subset_squareVertices G i j) hv
    refine ⟨hsquare, ?_⟩
    have hcommon : positiveSingletonFacet G i ∈
        incidenceModels (dualIncidence (hansenLabelIncidence G))
          (edgeVertices G i j) := by
      intro w hw
      change hansenLabelIncidence G w (positiveSingletonFacet G i)
      simp [positiveSingletonFacet, hansenLabelIncidence,
        hw.1.1, hw.2]
    have hinc := hv (positiveSingletonFacet G i) hcommon
    change hansenLabelIncidence G v (positiveSingletonFacet G i) at hinc
    simp only [positiveSingletonFacet, hansenLabelIncidence,
      hsquare.1, ↓reduceIte] at hinc
    have hn := hinc.mp True.intro
    have hx := Finset.mem_inter.mp hn.choose_spec
    have hxi : hn.choose = i := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx.1
    simpa [hxi] using hx.2
  · exact subset_incidenceClosure _ _

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.incidenceClosure_oppositeVertices
statement:
theorem incidenceClosure_oppositeVertices :
    incidenceClosure (dualIncidence (hansenLabelIncidence G))
        (oppositeVertices G i j) =
      oppositeVertices G i j
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro v hv
    have hedge : v ∈ edgeVertices G i j := by
      rw [← incidenceClosure_edgeVertices G i j]
      exact incidenceClosure_mono _
        (oppositeVertices_subset_edgeVertices G i j) hv
    refine ⟨hedge, ?_⟩
    have hcommon : positiveSingletonFacet G j ∈
        incidenceModels (dualIncidence (hansenLabelIncidence G))
          (oppositeVertices G i j) := by
      intro w hw
      change hansenLabelIncidence G w (positiveSingletonFacet G j)
      simp [positiveSingletonFacet, hansenLabelIncidence,
        hw.1.1.1, hw.2]
    have hinc := hv (positiveSingletonFacet G j) hcommon
    change hansenLabelIncidence G v (positiveSingletonFacet G j) at hinc
    simp only [positiveSingletonFacet, hansenLabelIncidence,
      hedge.1.1, ↓reduceIte] at hinc
    have hn := hinc.mp True.intro
    have hx := Finset.mem_inter.mp hn.choose_spec
    have hxj : hn.choose = j := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx.1
    simpa [hxj] using hx.2
  · exact subset_incidenceClosure _ _

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.models_squareFace
statement:
@[simp] theorem models_squareFace :
    incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) (squareFace G i j) =
      squareVertices G i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [squareFace, incidenceModels_vertexSpanFace,
    incidenceClosure_squareVertices]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.models_edgeFace
statement:
@[simp] theorem models_edgeFace :
    incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) (edgeFace G i j) =
      edgeVertices G i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeFace, incidenceModels_vertexSpanFace,
    incidenceClosure_edgeVertices]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.models_oppositeFace
statement:
@[simp] theorem models_oppositeFace :
    incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) (oppositeFace G i j) =
      oppositeVertices G i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [oppositeFace, incidenceModels_vertexSpanFace,
    incidenceClosure_oppositeVertices]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.squareVertices_cases
statement:
theorem squareVertices_cases (hne : i ≠ j)
    {v : HansenVertexLabel G} (hv : v ∈ squareVertices G i j) :
    v = emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos ∨
      v = positiveSingletonVertex G i ∨
      v = positiveSingletonVertex G j ∨
      ∃ hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j, v = positivePairVertex G i j hne hnadj
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with ⟨sign, ⟨s, hs⟩⟩
  rcases hv with ⟨rfl, hsub⟩
  have hfin : s = ∅ ∨ s = {i} ∨ s = {j} ∨ s = {i, j} := by
    by_cases hi : i ∈ s
    · by_cases hj : j ∈ s
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Finset.Subset.antisymm hsub (by
          intro x hx
          simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx ⊢
          rcases hx with rfl | rfl <;> assumption))))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Finset.Subset.antisymm (by
          intro x hx
          have hx' : x = i ∨ x = j := by simpa using hsub hx
          rcases hx' with rfl | rfl
          · simp
          · exact (hj hx).elim) (by
          intro x hx
          have hxi : x = i := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx
          simpa [hxi] using hi)))
    · by_cases hj : j ∈ s
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (Finset.Subset.antisymm (by
          intro x hx
          have hx' : x = i ∨ x = j := by simpa using hsub hx
          rcases hx' with rfl | rfl
          · exact (hi hx).elim
          · simp) (by
          intro x hx
          have hxj : x = j := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx
          simpa [hxj] using hj))))
      · exact Or.inl (Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr (by
          intro x hx
          have hx' : x = i ∨ x = j := by simpa using hsub hx
          rcases hx' with rfl | rfl
          · exact hi hx
          · exact hj hx))
  rcases hfin with h0 | hi | hj | hij
  · subst s
    exact Or.inl (by simp [emptyHansenVertex])
  · subst s
    exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by simp [positiveSingletonVertex]))
  · subst s
    exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (by simp [positiveSingletonVertex])))
  · have hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j := by
      intro hadj
      apply hs (by simpa [hij]) (by simpa [hij]) hne
      exact hadj
    right; right; right
    refine ⟨hnadj, ?_⟩
    subst s
    simp [positivePairVertex]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.oppositeVertices_eq_singleton
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    rcases squareVertices_cases G i j hne hv.1.1 with h0 | hi | hj | hp
    · subst v
      simp [oppositeVertices, edgeVertices, squareVertices,
        emptyHansenVertex] at hv
    · subst v
      have hji : j = i := by
        simpa [positiveSingletonVertex] using hv.2
      exact (hne hji.symm).elim
    · subst v
      have hij : i = j := by
        simpa [positiveSingletonVertex] using hv.1.2
      exact (hne hij).elim
    · rcases hp with ⟨hnadj', rfl⟩
      simp
  · rintro rfl
    simp [oppositeVertices, edgeVertices, squareVertices,
      positivePairVertex, hne]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.edgeVertices_eq_pair
statement:
theorem edgeVertices_eq_pair (hne : i ≠ j)
    (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j) :
    edgeVertices G i j =
      {positiveSingletonVertex G i, positivePairVertex G i j hne hnadj}
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    rcases squareVertices_cases G i j hne hv.1 with h0 | hi | hj | hp
    · subst v
      simpa [edgeVertices, positiveSingletonVertex,
        emptyHansenVertex] using hv.2
    · subst v; simp
    · subst v
      simpa [edgeVertices, positiveSingletonVertex, hne] using hv.2
    · rcases hp with ⟨hnadj', rfl⟩
      simp
  · intro hv
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hv
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl <;>
      simp [edgeVertices, squareVertices, positiveSingletonVertex,
        positivePairVertex, hne]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.positivePairVertex_ne_emptyPos
statement:
theorem positivePairVertex_ne_emptyPos (hne : i ≠ j)
    (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j) :
    positivePairVertex G i j hne hnadj ≠
      emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hs := congrArg (fun v : HansenVertexLabel G ↦ (v.2.1 : Finset V)) h
  change ({i, j} : Finset V) = ∅ at hs
  exact (Finset.ne_empty_of_mem (by simp : i ∈ ({i, j} : Finset V))) hs

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.positivePairVertex_ne_emptyNeg
statement:
theorem positivePairVertex_ne_emptyNeg (hne : i ≠ j)
    (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j) :
    positivePairVertex G i j hne hnadj ≠
      emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.neg
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hs := congrArg (fun v : HansenVertexLabel G ↦ v.1) h
  exact HansenSign.noConfusion hs

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.positiveSingletonVertex_ne_emptyPos
statement:
theorem positiveSingletonVertex_ne_emptyPos (x : V) :
    positiveSingletonVertex G x ≠ emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hs := congrArg (fun v : HansenVertexLabel G ↦ (v.2.1 : Finset V)) h
  change ({x} : Finset V) = ∅ at hs
  exact (Finset.ne_empty_of_mem (by simp : x ∈ ({x} : Finset V))) hs

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.positiveSingletonVertex_ne_emptyNeg
statement:
theorem positiveSingletonVertex_ne_emptyNeg (x : V) :
    positiveSingletonVertex G x ≠ emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.neg
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hs := congrArg (fun v : HansenVertexLabel G ↦ v.1) h
  exact HansenSign.noConfusion hs

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.positiveSingletonVertex_ne_pair
statement:
theorem positiveSingletonVertex_ne_pair (hne : i ≠ j)
    (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j) :
    positiveSingletonVertex G i ≠ positivePairVertex G i j hne hnadj
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hs := congrArg (fun v : HansenVertexLabel G ↦ (v.2.1 : Finset V)) h
  change ({i} : Finset V) = {i, j} at hs
  have hj : j ∈ ({i, j} : Finset V) := by simp
  rw [← hs] at hj
  have hji : j = i := by simpa using hj
  exact hne hji.symm

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.oppositeFace_le_edgeFace
statement:
theorem oppositeFace_le_edgeFace :
    oppositeFace G i j ≤ edgeFace G i j
proof:
:=
  vertexSpanFace_mono G (oppositeVertices_subset_edgeVertices G i j)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.edgeFace_le_squareFace
statement:
theorem edgeFace_le_squareFace :
    edgeFace G i j ≤ squareFace G i j
proof:
:=
  vertexSpanFace_mono G (edgeVertices_subset_squareVertices G i j)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.models_bottom
statement:
@[simp] theorem models_bottom :
    incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G)
      (⊥ : HansenCombinatorialFace G) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro v hv
  have hinc := hv (emptyHansenFacet G v.1) (by
    change emptyHansenFacet G v.1 ∈
      (Set.univ : Set (HansenFacetLabel G))
    exact Set.mem_univ _)
  simpa [emptyHansenFacet, hansenLabelIncidence] using hinc

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.oppositeFace_isNeutral
statement:
theorem oppositeFace_isNeutral (hne : i ≠ j)
    (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j) :
    (oppositeFace G i j).IsNeutralOrEmpty
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsNeutralOrEmpty]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · rw [ContainsVertex, models_oppositeFace,
      oppositeVertices_eq_singleton G i j hne hnadj] at h
    have heq : emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos =
        positivePairVertex G i j hne hnadj := by simpa using h
    exact (positivePairVertex_ne_emptyPos G i j hne hnadj) heq.symm
  · rw [ContainsVertex, models_oppositeFace,
      oppositeVertices_eq_singleton G i j hne hnadj] at h
    have heq : emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.neg =
        positivePairVertex G i j hne hnadj := by simpa using h
    exact (positivePairVertex_ne_emptyNeg G i j hne hnadj) heq.symm

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.edgeFace_isNeutral
statement:
theorem edgeFace_isNeutral (hne : i ≠ j)
    (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j) :
    (edgeFace G i j).IsNeutralOrEmpty
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsNeutralOrEmpty]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · rw [ContainsVertex, models_edgeFace,
      edgeVertices_eq_pair G i j hne hnadj] at h
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact (positiveSingletonVertex_ne_emptyPos G i) h.symm
    · exact (positivePairVertex_ne_emptyPos G i j hne hnadj) h.symm
  · rw [ContainsVertex, models_edgeFace,
      edgeVertices_eq_pair G i j hne hnadj] at h
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact (positiveSingletonVertex_ne_emptyNeg G i) h.symm
    · exact (positivePairVertex_ne_emptyNeg G i j hne hnadj) h.symm

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.squareFace_isRootedPos
statement:
theorem squareFace_isRootedPos (hne : i ≠ j)
    (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j) :
    (squareFace G i j).IsRootedPos
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [ContainsVertex, models_squareFace]
    exact ⟨rfl, fun _ h ↦ by simpa [emptyHansenVertex] using h⟩
  · intro h
    rw [ContainsVertex, models_squareFace] at h
    exact HansenSign.noConfusion h.1

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.bottom_covBy_oppositeFace
statement:
theorem bottom_covBy_oppositeFace (hne : i ≠ j)
    (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j) :
    (⊥ : HansenCombinatorialFace G) ⋖ oppositeFace G i j
proof:
:= by
  apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
  · apply lt_of_le_of_ne bot_le
    intro h
    have hp : positivePairVertex G i j hne hnadj ∈
        incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) (oppositeFace G i j) := by
      rw [models_oppositeFace,
        oppositeVertices_eq_singleton G i j hne hnadj]
      simp
    rw [← h, models_bottom] at hp
    exact hp
  · intro X hbot hX
    by_cases hp : positivePairVertex G i j hne hnadj ∈
        incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X
    · right
      apply eq_of_incidenceModels_eq
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · exact incidenceModels_mono hX
      · rw [models_oppositeFace,
          oppositeVertices_eq_singleton G i j hne hnadj]
        simpa only [Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    · left
      apply eq_of_incidenceModels_eq
      rw [models_bottom]
      apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro v hv
      have hvopp := incidenceModels_mono hX hv
      rw [models_oppositeFace,
        oppositeVertices_eq_singleton G i j hne hnadj] at hvopp
      apply hp
      rw [← hvopp]
      exact hv

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.oppositeFace_covBy_edgeFace
statement:
theorem oppositeFace_covBy_edgeFace (hne : i ≠ j)
    (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j) :
    oppositeFace G i j ⋖ edgeFace G i j
proof:
:= by
  apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
  · apply lt_of_le_of_ne (oppositeFace_le_edgeFace G i j)
    intro h
    have hi : positiveSingletonVertex G i ∈
        incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) (edgeFace G i j) := by
      rw [models_edgeFace, edgeVertices_eq_pair G i j hne hnadj]
      simp
    rw [← h, models_oppositeFace,
      oppositeVertices_eq_singleton G i j hne hnadj] at hi
    exact (positiveSingletonVertex_ne_pair G i j hne hnadj)
      (by simpa using hi)
  · intro X hopp hedge
    by_cases hi : positiveSingletonVertex G i ∈
        incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X
    · right
      apply eq_of_incidenceModels_eq
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · exact incidenceModels_mono hedge
      · rw [models_edgeFace, edgeVertices_eq_pair G i j hne hnadj]
        simp only [Set.insert_subset_iff, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
        exact ⟨hi, by
          have := incidenceModels_mono hopp
          rw [models_oppositeFace,
            oppositeVertices_eq_singleton G i j hne hnadj] at this
          exact this (by simp)⟩
    · left
      apply eq_of_incidenceModels_eq
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · intro v hv
        have hvedge := incidenceModels_mono hedge hv
        rw [models_edgeFace, edgeVertices_eq_pair G i j hne hnadj] at hvedge
        simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hvedge
        rw [models_oppositeFace,
          oppositeVertices_eq_singleton G i j hne hnadj]
        simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using
          hvedge.resolve_left (fun h ↦ hi (h ▸ hv))
      · exact incidenceModels_mono hopp

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.emptyPos_mem_of_three_vertices
statement:
theorem emptyPos_mem_of_three_vertices
    {X : HansenCombinatorialFace G} (hne : i ≠ j)
    (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j)
    (hi : positiveSingletonVertex G i ∈
      incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X)
    (hj : positiveSingletonVertex G j ∈
      incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X)
    (hp : positivePairVertex G i j hne hnadj ∈
      incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X) :
    emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos ∈
      incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X
proof:
:= by
  intro facet hfacet
  rcases facet with ⟨sign, ⟨c, hc⟩⟩
  cases sign with
  | neg => simp [hansenLabelIncidence, emptyHansenVertex]
  | pos =>
      have hiinc := hi (HansenSign.pos, ⟨c, hc⟩) hfacet
      have hjinc := hj (HansenSign.pos, ⟨c, hc⟩) hfacet
      change (HansenSign.pos = HansenSign.pos ↔
        (c ∩ {i}).Nonempty) at hiinc
      change (HansenSign.pos = HansenSign.pos ↔
        (c ∩ {j}).Nonempty) at hjinc
      have hni := hiinc.mp rfl
      have hnj := hjinc.mp rfl
      have hic := (Finset.mem_inter.mp hni.choose_spec).1
      have hjc := (Finset.mem_inter.mp hnj.choose_spec).1
      have hei : hni.choose = i :=
        Finset.mem_singleton.mp (Finset.mem_inter.mp hni.choose_spec).2
      have hej : hnj.choose = j :=
        Finset.mem_singleton.mp (Finset.mem_inter.mp hnj.choose_spec).2
      have hiC : i ∈ c := by simpa [hei] using hic
      have hjC : j ∈ c := by simpa [hej] using hjc
      exact False.elim (hnadj (hc hiC hjC hne))

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.singletonJ_mem_of_emptyPos_and_pair
statement:
theorem singletonJ_mem_of_emptyPos_and_pair
    {X : HansenCombinatorialFace G} (hne : i ≠ j)
    (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j)
    (h0 : emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos ∈
      incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X)
    (hp : positivePairVertex G i j hne hnadj ∈
      incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X) :
    positiveSingletonVertex G j ∈
      incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X
proof:
:= by
  intro facet hfacet
  rcases facet with ⟨sign, ⟨c, hc⟩⟩
  cases sign with
  | pos =>
      have hinc := h0 (HansenSign.pos, ⟨c, hc⟩) hfacet
      simp [hansenLabelIncidence, emptyHansenVertex] at hinc
  | neg =>
      have hpair := hp (HansenSign.neg, ⟨c, hc⟩) hfacet
      change (HansenSign.neg = HansenSign.pos ↔
        (c ∩ {i, j}).Nonempty) at hpair
      change (HansenSign.neg = HansenSign.pos ↔
        (c ∩ {j}).Nonempty)
      constructor
      · intro h; exact HansenSign.noConfusion h
      · intro hsingle
        apply HansenSign.noConfusion (hpair.mpr ?_)
        let x := hsingle.choose
        have hx := Finset.mem_inter.mp hsingle.choose_spec
        refine ⟨x, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩⟩
        have hxj : x = j := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx.2
        simpa [hxj]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.singletonI_mem_of_emptyPos_and_pair
statement:
theorem singletonI_mem_of_emptyPos_and_pair
    {X : HansenCombinatorialFace G} (hne : i ≠ j)
    (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j)
    (h0 : emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos ∈
      incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X)
    (hp : positivePairVertex G i j hne hnadj ∈
      incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X) :
    positiveSingletonVertex G i ∈
      incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X
proof:
:= by
  intro facet hfacet
  rcases facet with ⟨sign, ⟨c, hc⟩⟩
  cases sign with
  | pos =>
      have hinc := h0 (HansenSign.pos, ⟨c, hc⟩) hfacet
      simp [hansenLabelIncidence, emptyHansenVertex] at hinc
  | neg =>
      have hpair := hp (HansenSign.neg, ⟨c, hc⟩) hfacet
      change (HansenSign.neg = HansenSign.pos ↔
        (c ∩ {i, j}).Nonempty) at hpair
      change (HansenSign.neg = HansenSign.pos ↔
        (c ∩ {i}).Nonempty)
      constructor
      · intro h; exact HansenSign.noConfusion h
      · intro hsingle
        apply HansenSign.noConfusion (hpair.mpr ?_)
        let x := hsingle.choose
        have hx := Finset.mem_inter.mp hsingle.choose_spec
        refine ⟨x, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩⟩
        have hxi : x = i := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx.2
        simpa [hxi]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.rooted_between_opposite_square_eq_square
statement:
theorem rooted_between_opposite_square_eq_square
    {X : HansenCombinatorialFace G} (hne : i ≠ j)
    (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j)
    (hopp : oppositeFace G i j ≤ X)
    (hsquare : X ≤ squareFace G i j)
    (hroot : X.IsRootedPos) : X = squareFace G i j
proof:
:= by
  have hpX : positivePairVertex G i j hne hnadj ∈
      incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X := by
    apply incidenceModels_mono hopp
    rw [models_oppositeFace,
      oppositeVertices_eq_singleton G i j hne hnadj]
    simp
  have h0X : emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos ∈
      incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X := hroot.1
  have hiX := singletonI_mem_of_emptyPos_and_pair G i j hne hnadj h0X hpX
  have hjX := singletonJ_mem_of_emptyPos_and_pair G i j hne hnadj h0X hpX
  apply eq_of_incidenceModels_eq
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact incidenceModels_mono hsquare
  · rw [models_squareFace]
    intro w hw
    rcases squareVertices_cases G i j hne hw with h0 | hi | hj | hp
    · simpa [h0] using h0X
    · simpa [hi] using hiX
    · simpa [hj] using hjX
    · rcases hp with ⟨hnadj', rfl⟩
      simpa using hpX

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.edgeFace_covBy_squareFace
statement:
theorem edgeFace_covBy_squareFace (hne : i ≠ j)
    (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j) :
    edgeFace G i j ⋖ squareFace G i j
proof:
:= by
  apply covBy_of_eq_or_eq
  · apply lt_of_le_of_ne (edgeFace_le_squareFace G i j)
    intro h
    have h0 : emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos ∈
        incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) (squareFace G i j) := by
      rw [models_squareFace]
      exact ⟨rfl, fun _ hx ↦ by simpa [emptyHansenVertex] using hx⟩
    rw [← h, models_edgeFace,
      edgeVertices_eq_pair G i j hne hnadj] at h0
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h0
    rcases h0 with h0 | h0
    · exact (positiveSingletonVertex_ne_emptyPos G i) h0.symm
    · exact (positivePairVertex_ne_emptyPos G i j hne hnadj) h0.symm
  · intro X hedge hsquare
    by_cases hXe : X = edgeFace G i j
    · exact Or.inl hXe
    right
    have hEdgeModels : edgeVertices G i j ⊆
        incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X := by
      rw [← models_edgeFace]
      exact incidenceModels_mono hedge
    have hnsub : ¬ incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X ⊆
        edgeVertices G i j := by
      intro hsub
      apply hXe
      apply eq_of_incidenceModels_eq
      rw [models_edgeFace]
      exact Set.Subset.antisymm hsub hEdgeModels
    obtain ⟨v, hvX, hvnot⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hnsub
    have hvSquare : v ∈ squareVertices G i j := by
      rw [← models_squareFace]
      exact incidenceModels_mono hsquare hvX
    have hiX : positiveSingletonVertex G i ∈
        incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X := by
      apply hEdgeModels
      rw [edgeVertices_eq_pair G i j hne hnadj]
      simp
    have hpX : positivePairVertex G i j hne hnadj ∈
        incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X := by
      apply hEdgeModels
      rw [edgeVertices_eq_pair G i j hne hnadj]
      simp
    have h0X : emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos ∈
        incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X := by
      rcases squareVertices_cases G i j hne hvSquare with h0 | hi | hj | hp
      · simpa [h0] using hvX
      · subst v
        apply False.elim
        apply hvnot
        rw [edgeVertices_eq_pair G i j hne hnadj]
        exact Or.inl rfl
      · subst v
        exact emptyPos_mem_of_three_vertices G i j hne hnadj hiX hvX hpX
      · rcases hp with ⟨hnadj', rfl⟩
        exact False.elim (hvnot (by
          rw [edgeVertices_eq_pair G i j hne hnadj]
          exact Or.inr rfl))
    have hjX : positiveSingletonVertex G j ∈
        incidenceModels (hansenLabelIncidence G) X :=
      singletonJ_mem_of_emptyPos_and_pair G i j hne hnadj h0X hpX
    apply eq_of_incidenceModels_eq
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · exact incidenceModels_mono hsquare
    · rw [models_squareFace]
      intro w hw
      rcases squareVertices_cases G i j hne hw with h0 | hi | hj | hp
      · simpa [h0] using h0X
      · simpa [hi] using hiX
      · simpa [hj] using hjX
      · rcases hp with ⟨hnadj', rfl⟩
        simpa using hpX

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.card_lowerFlag
statement:
theorem card_lowerFlag (hne : i ≠ j) (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j) :
    Nat.card (lowerFlag G i j hne hnadj) = 3
proof:
:= by
  change Nat.card {x // x ∈
    (lowerFlag G i j hne hnadj : Set (Set.Iic (edgeFace G i j)))} = 3
  rw [Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
  change Set.ncard
    ({lowerBottom G i j, lowerOpposite G i j, lowerTop G i j} :
      Set (Set.Iic (edgeFace G i j))) = 3
  have hbo : lowerBottom G i j ≠ lowerOpposite G i j := by
    intro h
    apply (bottom_covBy_oppositeFace G i j hne hnadj).ne
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h
  have hot : lowerOpposite G i j ≠ lowerTop G i j := by
    intro h
    apply (oppositeFace_covBy_edgeFace G i j hne hnadj).ne
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h
  have hbt : lowerBottom G i j ≠ lowerTop G i j := by
    intro h
    have hface := congrArg Subtype.val h
    have hbotOpp := (bottom_covBy_oppositeFace G i j hne hnadj).lt
    have hoppEdge := (oppositeFace_covBy_edgeFace G i j hne hnadj).lt
    exact (hbotOpp.trans hoppEdge).ne hface
  norm_num [Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem, hbo, hot, hbt]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.opposite_mem_reconstructedFlag
statement:
theorem opposite_mem_reconstructedFlag (hne : i ≠ j)
    (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j) :
    oppositeFace G i j ∈
      ((hansenPortalCodeEquiv G).symm
        (squarePortalCode G i j hne hnadj)).1.2
proof:
:= by
  let rootedCode := squarePortalCode G i j hne hnadj
  let intervalCode := (hansenPortalIntervalRootedEquiv G).symm rootedCode
  change oppositeFace G i j ∈
    ((hansenPortalFlagIntervalEquiv G).symm intervalCode).1.2
  change oppositeFace G i j ∈ HansenCograph.Flag.glueCover
    intervalCode.1.2 intervalCode.2.1 intervalCode.2.2
  apply Or.inl
  refine ⟨lowerOpposite G i j, ?_, rfl⟩
  change lowerOpposite G i j ∈ lowerFlag G i j hne hnadj
  exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.one_lt_card_of_nonedge
statement:
theorem one_lt_card_of_nonedge (hne : i ≠ j) :
    1 < Fintype.card V
proof:
:=
  Fintype.one_lt_card_iff.mpr ⟨i, j, hne⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.rankedFlag_one_eq_opposite
statement:
theorem rankedFlag_one_eq_opposite
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G)
      (Fintype.card V + 3))
    (hne : i ≠ j) (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j) :
    portalLayerRankedFlag hG (squarePortalLayerTwo G i j hne hnadj)
        ⟨1, by omega⟩ = oppositeFace G i j
proof:
:= by
  let target := squarePortalLayerTwo G i j hne hnadj
  let f := portalLayerRankedFlag hG target
  have hcard : 1 < Fintype.card V :=
    one_lt_card_of_nonedge (V := V) i j hne
  have hoppMem : oppositeFace G i j ∈ f.toFlag := by
    rw [portalLayerRankedFlag_toFlag]
    exact opposite_mem_reconstructedFlag G i j hne hnadj
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := (f.mem_toFlag_iff (oppositeFace G i j)).mp hoppMem
  have htwo : f ⟨2, by omega⟩ = edgeFace G i j := by
    have h := portalLayerRankedFlag_portalLower_eq hG target
      (show 2 ≤ Fintype.card V by omega)
    change f ⟨2, by omega⟩ = edgeFace G i j at h
    exact h
  have hq_lt : q.1 < 2 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hle : (⟨2, by omega⟩ : Fin (Fintype.card V + 3)) ≤ q :=
      Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr (Nat.le_of_not_gt hnot)
    have hfaces := f.strictMono.monotone hle
    rw [htwo, hq] at hfaces
    exact (not_le_of_gt (oppositeFace_covBy_edgeFace G i j hne hnadj).lt)
      hfaces
  have hq_pos : 0 < q.1 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hqval : q.1 = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hnot
    have hqzero : q = (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin (Fintype.card V + 3)) :=
      Fin.ext hqval
    have hbot : f q = (⊥ : HansenCombinatorialFace G) := by
      rw [hqzero]
      exact f.map_zero
    rw [hq] at hbot
    exact (bottom_covBy_oppositeFace G i j hne hnadj).ne hbot.symm
  have hqone : q = (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin (Fintype.card V + 3)) := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp
    omega
  rw [← hqone]
  exact hq

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.NonedgeSquare.no_rooted_middle_in_square_target
statement:
theorem no_rooted_middle_in_square_target
    (hG : UniformFlagCard (HansenCombinatorialFace G)
      (Fintype.card V + 3))
    (hne : i ≠ j) (hnadj : ¬G.Adj i j) :
    ¬ ∃ F : RootedPos G,
      (portalLayerRankedFlag hG
          (squarePortalLayerTwo G i j hne hnadj) ⟨1, by omega⟩) ⋖ F.1 ∧
        F.1 ⋖ (squarePortalLayerTwo G i j hne hnadj).1.1.1.2.1
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨F, hpred, hupper⟩
  have hpred' : oppositeFace G i j ⋖ F.1 := by
    rw [← rankedFlag_one_eq_opposite G i j hG hne hnadj]
    exact hpred
  have hupper' : F.1 ⋖ squareFace G i j := by
    exact hupper
  have heq := rooted_between_opposite_square_eq_square G i j hne hnadj
    hpred'.le hupper'.le F.2
  exact hupper'.ne heq

name: HansenCograph.UniformFlagCard.orderDual
statement:
theorem orderDual
    {P : Type u} [PartialOrder P] {r : ℕ}

name: HansenCograph.UniformFlagCard.orderIso
statement:
theorem orderIso
    {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}
    [PartialOrder P] [PartialOrder Q]
    (e : P ≃o Q) {r : ℕ} (hP : UniformFlagCard P r) :
    UniformFlagCard Q r
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  let s : Flag P := (Flag.map e).symm t
  have hs : Flag.map e s = t := (Flag.map e).apply_symm_apply t
  rw [← hs]
  exact (Flag.card_map e s).trans (hP s)

name: HansenCograph.UniformFlagCard.withTop
statement:
theorem withTop
    {P : Type u} [PartialOrder P] [Finite P] {r : ℕ}
    (hP : UniformFlagCard P r) :

proof:
:= by
  intro t

name: HansenCograph.UniformFlagCard.product
statement:
theorem product
    {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}
    [PartialOrder P] [Finite P] [Nonempty P]
    [PartialOrder Q] [Finite Q] [Nonempty Q]
    {r s : ℕ} (hP : UniformFlagCard P r) (hQ : UniformFlagCard Q s) :
    UniformFlagCard (P × Q) (r + s - 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  classical
  let _ : Nonempty (Flag.fstProjection c) :=
    ((Flag.fstProjection c).maxChain.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance).to_subtype
  let _ : Nonempty (Flag.sndProjection c) :=
    ((Flag.sndProjection c).maxChain.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance).to_subtype
  calc
    Nat.card c = Nat.card (Flag.restrictToProjections c) :=
      (Flag.card_restrictToProjections c).symm
    _ = Nat.card (Flag.fstProjection c) +
          Nat.card (Flag.sndProjection c) - 1 :=
      Flag.prod_card_eq (Flag.restrictToProjections c)
    _ = r + s - 1 := by rw [hP (Flag.fstProjection c), hQ (Flag.sndProjection c)]

name: HansenCograph.Flag.card_eq_projection_cards
statement:
theorem card_eq_projection_cards
    {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}
    [PartialOrder P] [Finite P] [Nonempty P]
    [PartialOrder Q] [Finite Q] [Nonempty Q]
    (c : Flag (P × Q)) :
    Nat.card c = Nat.card (Flag.fstProjection c) +
      Nat.card (Flag.sndProjection c) - 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : Nonempty (Flag.fstProjection c) :=
    ((Flag.fstProjection c).maxChain.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance).to_subtype
  let _ : Nonempty (Flag.sndProjection c) :=
    ((Flag.sndProjection c).maxChain.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance).to_subtype
  calc
    Nat.card c = Nat.card (Flag.restrictToProjections c) :=
      (Flag.card_restrictToProjections c).symm
    _ = Nat.card (Flag.fstProjection c) +
          Nat.card (Flag.sndProjection c) - 1 :=
      Flag.prod_card_eq (Flag.restrictToProjections c)

name: HansenCograph.sizedFlag_product_choose_lower_bound
statement:
theorem sizedFlag_product_choose_lower_bound
    {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}
    [PartialOrder P] [BoundedOrder P] [Finite P]
    [PartialOrder Q] [BoundedOrder Q] [Finite Q]
    (n m : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (SizedFlag P n) * Nat.card (SizedFlag Q m) *
        Nat.choose (n + m) n ≤ Nat.card (Flag (P × Q))
proof:
:= by
  have h := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective
    (sizedFlagProductEmbedding (P := P) (Q := Q) n m)
    (sizedFlagProductEmbedding (P := P) (Q := Q) n m).injective
  rw [Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_prod, Set.powersetCard.card, Nat.card_fin] at h
  simpa only [Nat.mul_assoc] using h

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.hansenCentralFaceEquiv_involutive
statement:
theorem hansenCentralFaceEquiv_involutive (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (F : HansenCombinatorialFace G) :
    hansenCentralFaceEquiv G (hansenCentralFaceEquiv G F) = F
proof:
:= by
  apply IncidenceClosedSet.ext
  change facetSignFlipEquiv G '' (facetSignFlipEquiv G '' (F : Set _)) = F
  ext facet
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨original, horiginal, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    rcases original with ⟨sign, clique⟩
    cases sign <;>
      simpa [facetSignFlipEquiv, HansenSign.flipEquiv, HansenSign.flip] using horiginal
  · intro hfacet
    refine ⟨facetSignFlipEquiv G facet, ⟨facet, hfacet, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rcases facet with ⟨sign, clique⟩
    cases sign <;> rfl

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.eq_top_iff_contains_both
statement:
theorem eq_top_iff_contains_both (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (F : HansenCombinatorialFace G) :
    F = top G ↔
      F.ContainsVertex (emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos) ∧
        F.ContainsVertex (emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.neg)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    simp
  · rintro ⟨hpos, hneg⟩
    apply IncidenceClosedSet.ext
    apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    rintro ⟨sign, clique⟩ hfacet
    cases sign with
    | neg =>
        have hnot : ¬hansenLabelIncidence G
            (emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.neg) ⟨HansenSign.neg, clique⟩ := by
          simp [hansenLabelIncidence, emptyHansenVertex]
        exact hnot (hneg ⟨HansenSign.neg, clique⟩ hfacet)
    | pos =>
        have hnot : ¬hansenLabelIncidence G
            (emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos) ⟨HansenSign.pos, clique⟩ := by
          simp [hansenLabelIncidence, emptyHansenVertex]
        exact hnot (hpos ⟨HansenSign.pos, clique⟩ hfacet)

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.strata_cases
statement:
theorem strata_cases (G : SimpleGraph V) (F : HansenCombinatorialFace G) :
    F = top G ∨ F.IsRootedPos ∨ F.IsRootedNeg ∨ F.IsNeutralOrEmpty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hpos : F.ContainsVertex (emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos)
  · by_cases hneg : F.ContainsVertex (emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.neg)
    · exact Or.inl ((eq_top_iff_contains_both G F).mpr ⟨hpos, hneg⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hpos, hneg⟩)
  · by_cases hneg : F.ContainsVertex (emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.neg)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hneg, hpos⟩))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hpos, hneg⟩))

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsRootedPos.ne_top
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hF.2
  rw [h]
  exact containsVertex_top G _

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsRootedPos.not_isRootedNeg
proof:
:= by
  intro hneg
  exact hF.2 hneg.1

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsRootedPos.not_isNeutralOrEmpty
proof:
:= by

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsRootedNeg.not_isNeutralOrEmpty

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsNeutralOrEmpty.ne_top

:= by

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsRootedPos.lower_strata
proof:
:= by
  rcases strata_cases G X with htop | hpos | hneg | hneutral
  · exfalso
    apply hF.ne_top
    rw [htop] at hXF
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro facet hfacet
      exact hfacet.elim
    · exact hXF
  · exact Or.inl hpos
  · exfalso
    exact hF.2 (hneg.1.mono hXF)
  · exact Or.inr hneutral

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsRootedPos.facet_sign
statement:
theorem IsRootedPos.facet_sign {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {F : HansenCombinatorialFace G} (hF : F.IsRootedPos)
    {facet : HansenFacetLabel G} (hfacet : facet ∈ (F : Set _)) :
    facet.1 = HansenSign.neg
proof:
:= by
  rcases facet with ⟨sign, clique⟩
  cases sign with
  | neg => rfl
  | pos =>
      have hnot : ¬hansenLabelIncidence G
          (emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.pos) ⟨HansenSign.pos, clique⟩ := by
        simp [hansenLabelIncidence, emptyHansenVertex]
      exact False.elim (hnot (hF.1 ⟨HansenSign.pos, clique⟩ hfacet))

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsRootedNeg.facet_sign

    facet.1 = HansenSign.pos
proof:
:= by
  rcases facet with ⟨sign, clique⟩
  cases sign with
  | neg =>
      have hnot : ¬hansenLabelIncidence G
          (emptyHansenVertex G HansenSign.neg) ⟨HansenSign.neg, clique⟩ := by
        simp [hansenLabelIncidence, emptyHansenVertex]
      exact False.elim (hnot (hF.1 ⟨HansenSign.neg, clique⟩ hfacet))
  | pos => rfl

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsRootedPos.carrier_nonempty
proof:
:= by

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsNeutralOrEmpty.exists_pos_facet
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnot := hF.1
  simp only [ContainsVertex, incidenceModels, mem_setOf_eq] at hnot
  push_neg at hnot
  rcases hnot with ⟨facet, hfacet, hnoninc⟩
  refine ⟨facet, hfacet, ?_⟩
  rcases facet with ⟨sign, clique⟩
  cases sign with
  | neg =>
      exfalso
      apply hnoninc
      simp [hansenLabelIncidence, emptyHansenVertex]

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsNeutralOrEmpty.exists_neg_facet
proof:
:= by

  push_neg at hnot
  rcases hnot with ⟨facet, hfacet, hnoninc⟩

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.IsNeutralOrEmpty.exists_facet_sign
statement:
theorem IsNeutralOrEmpty.exists_facet_sign {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {F : HansenCombinatorialFace G} (hF : F.IsNeutralOrEmpty)
    (sign : HansenSign) :
    ∃ facet ∈ (F : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)), facet.1 = sign
proof:
:= by

  | neg => exact hF.exists_neg_facet
  | pos => exact hF.exists_pos_facet

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.le_positiveRootExtension
statement:
theorem le_positiveRootExtension {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (F : NeutralOrEmpty G) : F.1 ≤ (positiveRootExtension F).1
proof:
:= by
  change (incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence G)
      (positiveRootFacetPart F)) ⊆ (F.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel G))
  calc
    incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence G) (positiveRootFacetPart F) ⊆
        incidenceClosure (hansenLabelIncidence G)
          (F.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)) :=
      incidenceClosure_mono _ (fun _ hfacet ↦ hfacet.1)
    _ = (F.1 : Set (HansenFacetLabel G)) := F.1.isClosed

name: HansenCograph.HansenCombinatorialFace.lt_positiveRootExtension
statement:
theorem lt_positiveRootExtension {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (F : NeutralOrEmpty G) : F.1 < (positiveRootExtension F).1
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne (le_positiveRootExtension F)
  intro heq
  exact F.2.1 (heq ▸ (positiveRootExtension F).2.1)

name: biSup_add_biSup
statement:
lemma biSup_add_biSup
    {ι κ : Sort*}
    {p : ι → Prop} {q : κ → Prop} (hp : ∃ i, p i) (hq : ∃ j, q j)
    {f : ι → ENNReal} {g : κ → ENNReal} :
    (⨆ i, ⨆ _ : p i, f i) + (⨆ j, ⨆ _ : q j, g j) =
    (⨆ i, ⨆ j, ⨆ _ : p i, ⨆ _ : q j, f i + g j)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · calc
      (⨆ x, ⨆ _ : p x, f x) + (⨆ y, ⨆ _ : q y, g y)
          = ⨆ x, ⨆ _ : p x, (f x + (⨆ y, ⨆ _ : q y, g y)) := by apply ENNReal.biSup_add' hp
      _ ≤ (⨆ x, ⨆ y, ⨆ _ : p x, ⨆ _ : q y, f x + g y) := by
        apply iSup₂_le
        intro x hx
        calc
          f x + (⨆ y, ⨆ _ : q y, g y) = ⨆ y, ⨆ _ : q y, (f x + g y) := by
            apply ENNReal.add_biSup' hq
          _ ≤ ⨆ x, ⨆ _ : p x, (⨆ y, ⨆ _ : q y, (f x + g y)) := by
            apply le_iSup₂ x hx
          _ = ⨆ x, ⨆ y, ⨆ _ : p x, ⨆ _ : q y, (f x + g y) := by
            apply iSup_congr; intro; exact iSup_comm
  simp only [iSup_le_iff]
  intro i j hi hj
  calc
    f i + g j ≤ (⨆ i, ⨆ (_ : p i), f i) + g j := by gcongr; apply le_iSup₂ i hi
    _ ≤ (⨆ i, ⨆ (_ : p i), f i) + ⨆ j, ⨆ (_ : q j), g j := by gcongr; apply le_iSup₂ j hj

name: iSup_nonzero_of_nonzero
statement: lemma iSup_nonzero_of_nonzero {f : ℝ → ENNReal} (hf_nonzero : f ≠ 0) : iSup f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hf_nonzero
  ext x
  simpa using le_iSup f x |>.trans_eq h

name: iSup_min_nat
statement: lemma iSup_min_nat (a : ENNReal) : ⨆ (n : ℕ), min a n = a
proof:
:= by
  apply iSup_eq_of_forall_le_of_forall_lt_exists_gt (by simp)
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENNReal.exists_nat_gt (hw.trans_le le_top).ne
  exact ⟨n, by simp_all⟩

name: iSup_min_nat_ne_top

lemma iSup_min_nat_ne_top {ι : Sort*} (n : ℕ) (f : ι → ENNReal) :
